en_def: a device fixed in a bathroom or kitchen that heats water for use
hi_def: पानी गर्म करने वाला उपकरण जो बाथरूम या रसोई में लगा होता है
hi_nuance: This is the standard Indian/British term; Americans say 'water heater'. In American English 'geyser' (pronounced differently, /ˈɡaɪzər/) usually means the natural hot-spring phenomenon, not the bathroom appliance, so the word can confuse American listeners.

examples.en: Please switch on the geyser fifteen minutes before your bath.
examples.hi: कृपया नहाने से पंद्रह मिनट पहले गीज़र चालू कर दें।

examples.en: The geyser in the guest bathroom isn't heating water properly.
examples.hi: मेहमानों वाले बाथरूम का गीज़र ठीक से पानी गर्म नहीं कर रहा है।

examples.en: We installed a new geyser last month because the old one started leaking.
examples.hi: पुराना गीज़र लीक करने लगा था इसलिए हमने पिछले महीने नया गीज़र लगवाया।

examples.en: Turn off the geyser after your shower to save electricity.
examples.hi: बिजली बचाने के लिए नहाने के बाद गीज़र बंद कर दो।

examples.en: The plumber came to fix the geyser's temperature knob.
examples.hi: प्लंबर गीज़र का तापमान वाला नॉब ठीक करने आया था।

common_mistake.wrong: I take bath after opening the geyser.
common_mistake.right: I take a bath after switching on the geyser.
common_mistake.why: Hindi speakers often translate 'खोलना' as 'open', but electrical appliances in English are 'switched on/off', not 'opened/closed'; also 'take bath' needs the article 'a' before 'bath'.

cloze.sentence: Switch on the ____ before you shower so the water has time to heat up.

en_def: a container used for holding waste or rubbish
hi_def: कूड़ा-कचरा डालने का पात्र या डिब्बा
hi_nuance: 'Dustbin' is the common British/Indian word; Americans say 'trash can' or 'garbage can'. In everyday Indian speech you'll also hear 'kachra can' informally, but 'dustbin' is the standard written and spoken English term.

examples.en: Throw the wrapper in the dustbin, not on the floor.
examples.hi: रैपर फर्श पर नहीं, कूड़ेदान में फेंको।

examples.en: The dustbin outside our building is emptied every morning.
examples.hi: हमारी इमारत के बाहर वाला कूड़ेदान हर सुबह खाली किया जाता है।

examples.en: There's a separate dustbin for wet and dry waste.
examples.hi: गीले और सूखे कचरे के लिए अलग-अलग कूड़ेदान हैं।

examples.en: The kitchen dustbin needs to be emptied; it's overflowing.
examples.hi: रसोई का कूड़ेदान खाली करना है, वह भर गया है।

examples.en: She kept a small dustbin under her office desk.
examples.hi: उसने अपने ऑफिस डेस्क के नीचे एक छोटा कूड़ेदान रखा था।

common_mistake.wrong: Put the paper in dustbin.
common_mistake.right: Put the paper in the dustbin.
common_mistake.why: Hindi has no articles, so learners often drop 'the' before specific, known objects; English requires 'the dustbin' when referring to a particular, identifiable bin.

cloze.sentence: Don't litter — use the ____ next to the kitchen door.

en_def: a tool with a long handle and a soft or absorbent head, used for cleaning floors
hi_def: लंबे हत्थे वाला वह उपकरण जिससे फर्श साफ किया जाता है, पोंछा
hi_nuance: In Indian homes 'mop' can refer both to the tool and the action ('mop the floor'); many Hindi speakers instead say 'pochha lagana', and when speaking English they sometimes say 'do the pochha', which sounds odd — the correct phrase is simply 'mop the floor'.

examples.en: Can you mop the kitchen floor after dinner?
examples.hi: क्या तुम खाने के बाद रसोई का फर्श पोंछ सकते हो?

examples.en: The new mop has a squeeze handle so you don't need to touch the dirty water.
examples.hi: नए पोंछे में निचोड़ने वाला हत्था है ताकि गंदे पानी को छूना न पड़े।

examples.en: I bought a microfiber mop that dries the floor faster.
examples.hi: मैंने एक माइक्रोफाइबर पोंछा खरीदा जो फर्श को जल्दी सुखाता है।

examples.en: Leave the mop outside to dry after use.
examples.hi: इस्तेमाल के बाद पोंछे को बाहर सूखने के लिए रख दो।

examples.en: The maid mops the whole house twice a week.
examples.hi: नौकरानी हफ्ते में दो बार पूरे घर में पोंछा लगाती है।

common_mistake.wrong: I did mopping in the kitchen.
common_mistake.right: I mopped the kitchen floor.
common_mistake.why: Hindi speakers often turn the verb into a noun with 'do' + '-ing' (a pattern common in Indian English), but the natural verb form is simply 'mop', used directly with an object like 'the floor'.

cloze.sentence: Grab the ____ and wipe up that spilled milk before someone slips.

en_def: a round, open container with a handle, used for carrying liquids like water
hi_def: पानी या अन्य तरल पदार्थ ले जाने का हैंडल वाला गोल बर्तन, बाल्टी
hi_nuance: In many Indian homes bathing is done with a bucket and mug rather than a shower, so 'bucket bath' is a very common phrase in Indian English that may need explaining to foreigners.

examples.en: Fill the bucket with water before the supply stops.
examples.hi: पानी की सप्लाई बंद होने से पहले बाल्टी भर लो।

examples.en: He takes a bucket bath every morning even in winter.
examples.hi: वह सर्दियों में भी हर सुबह बाल्टी से नहाता है।

examples.en: The bucket is leaking from a small crack near the base.
examples.hi: बाल्टी के तले के पास एक छोटी दरार से पानी टपक रहा है।

examples.en: Carry two buckets of water to the terrace for the plants.
examples.hi: छत पर पौधों के लिए दो बाल्टी पानी ले जाओ।

examples.en: She kept a bucket under the leaking pipe to collect the drips.
examples.hi: उसने टपकते पाइप के नीचे बूंदें इकट्ठा करने के लिए एक बाल्टी रख दी।

common_mistake.wrong: Give me one bucket water.
common_mistake.right: Give me a bucket of water.
common_mistake.why: Hindi's 'एक बाल्टी पानी' translates word-for-word without a linking preposition, but English requires 'of' to connect a container word like 'bucket' to the substance it holds.

cloze.sentence: He filled the ____ from the tap and carried it upstairs.

en_def: a long-handled brush used for sweeping floors
hi_def: फर्श साफ करने के लिए इस्तेमाल होने वाला लंबे हत्थे वाला ब्रश, झाड़ू
hi_nuance: Indian homes typically use two kinds: a short hand broom ('jhadu') for sweeping and a mop for wet cleaning; in English both the traditional short broom and the long-handled Western-style one are simply called 'broom'.

examples.en: The broom is kept behind the kitchen door.
examples.hi: झाड़ू रसोई के दरवाजे के पीछे रखा है।

examples.en: She swept the courtyard with an old broom.
examples.hi: उसने पुराने झाड़ू से आंगन साफ किया।

examples.en: The bristles of this broom have worn out.
examples.hi: इस झाड़ू के तिनके घिस गए हैं।

examples.en: Buy a new broom the next time you go to the market.
examples.hi: अगली बार बाजार जाओ तो एक नया झाड़ू खरीद लाना।

examples.en: He leaned the broom against the wall and took a break.
examples.hi: उसने झाड़ू को दीवार से टिका दिया और आराम किया।

common_mistake.wrong: Take the broom and clean the room with hand.
common_mistake.right: Sweep the room with the broom.
common_mistake.why: Learners often translate directly ('haath se saaf karo') producing an unnatural phrase; English pairs the tool with the specific verb 'sweep' rather than the general verb 'clean with hand'.

cloze.sentence: She grabbed the ____ and swept the fallen leaves off the porch.

en_def: to clean a floor or surface by brushing dirt or dust away, usually with a broom
hi_def: झाड़ू से गंदगी या धूल हटाकर फर्श या सतह साफ करना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes say 'clean the floor' for every kind of floor cleaning; in English, 'sweep' specifically means removing loose dirt/dust with a broom, while 'mop' means washing the floor with a wet mop — the two are not interchangeable.

examples.en: Please sweep the veranda before the guests arrive.
examples.hi: मेहमानों के आने से पहले बरामदा झाड़ लो।

examples.en: He sweeps the shop floor every morning before opening.
examples.hi: वह दुकान खोलने से पहले हर सुबह फर्श झाड़ता है।

examples.en: I need to sweep away these leaves from the driveway.
examples.hi: मुझे इन पत्तों को ड्राइववे से झाड़कर हटाना है।

examples.en: She swept the crumbs off the table with her hand.
examples.hi: उसने मेज पर से टुकड़ों को हाथ से झाड़ दिया।

examples.en: We swept the whole house before the festival.
examples.hi: त्योहार से पहले हमने पूरा घर झाड़ा-बुहारा।

common_mistake.wrong: I am sweeping the floor from two days.
common_mistake.right: I have been sweeping the floor for two days.
common_mistake.why: Hindi's continuous present ('kar raha hoon') is often overused for actions spanning time; English needs the present perfect continuous with 'for' to express duration up to now.

cloze.sentence: Can you ____ the hallway before the visitors get here?

en_def: to clean or dry a surface by rubbing it with a cloth or your hand
hi_def: कपड़े या हाथ से रगड़कर किसी सतह को साफ या सूखा करना, पोंछना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes overextend 'clean' where English prefers the more specific 'wipe' for quick surface cleaning (a table, a spill, your hands), reserving 'clean' for a more general or thorough job.

examples.en: Wipe the table before you set the plates.
examples.hi: थाली रखने से पहले मेज पोंछ लो।

examples.en: He wiped his hands on a kitchen towel.
examples.hi: उसने अपने हाथ रसोई के तौलिए से पोंछे।

examples.en: She wiped the dust off the shelf with a damp cloth.
examples.hi: उसने गीले कपड़े से शेल्फ की धूल पोंछी।

examples.en: Wipe the mirror; it's fogged up from the shower.
examples.hi: आईना पोंछ दो, शावर की भाप से धुंधला हो गया है।

examples.en: I wiped up the spilled juice before it stained the carpet.
examples.hi: जूस गिरने के बाद मैंने कालीन पर दाग लगने से पहले उसे पोंछ दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: Please clean your hands with this tissue.
common_mistake.right: Please wipe your hands with this tissue.
common_mistake.why: Because Hindi commonly uses one verb ('साफ करना') for all cleaning actions, learners default to 'clean' in English too; native speakers use 'wipe' specifically for rubbing a surface dry or clean with a cloth.

cloze.sentence: She used a napkin to ____ the ketchup off her fingers.

en_def: an electrical point on a wall into which a plug is inserted to connect power
hi_def: दीवार पर लगा वह बिजली का बिंदु जिसमें प्लग लगाकर बिजली जोड़ी जाती है
hi_nuance: Indians usually say 'socket' or 'switch board' for the whole wall unit; Americans more often say 'outlet'. Also note plug shapes differ — Indian sockets use the three-round-pin (Type D/M) standard, unlike the flat-pin American plug, which matters when learners discuss travel adapters.

examples.en: The phone charger won't fit into this socket.
examples.hi: फोन चार्जर इस सॉकेट में फिट नहीं हो रहा।

examples.en: Turn off the socket before removing the plug.
examples.hi: प्लग निकालने से पहले सॉकेट बंद कर दो।

examples.en: There's only one socket free near the desk.
examples.hi: डेस्क के पास सिर्फ एक सॉकेट खाली है।

examples.en: The electrician replaced the damaged socket in the hall.
examples.hi: इलेक्ट्रीशियन ने हॉल के खराब सॉकेट को बदल दिया।

examples.en: Don't overload a single socket with too many appliances.
examples.hi: एक ही सॉकेट में बहुत सारे उपकरण मत लगाओ।

common_mistake.wrong: Put the plug in the socket board.
common_mistake.right: Put the plug in the socket.
common_mistake.why: Indian speakers often say 'switch board' to mean the whole panel, but the specific hole a plug goes into is called a 'socket'; 'switch board' refers to the panel holding switches and sockets together.

cloze.sentence: The charger cable won't reach the ____ behind the sofa.

en_def: to turn off a light, appliance, or machine using its switch
hi_def: स्विच के ज़रिए बत्ती, उपकरण या मशीन को बंद करना
hi_nuance: Indian English strongly prefers 'switch off/on' for electrical devices, whereas American English often just says 'turn off/on'; both are understood in India, but 'switch off' is the more typical local phrasing.

examples.en: Switch off the fan before you leave the room.
examples.hi: कमरे से जाने से पहले पंखा बंद कर दो।

examples.en: Please switch off your phone during the exam.
examples.hi: परीक्षा के दौरान कृपया अपना फोन बंद कर दें।

examples.en: He forgot to switch off the lights in the office.
examples.hi: वह ऑफिस की बत्तियां बंद करना भूल गया।

examples.en: Switch off the geyser once you've finished bathing.
examples.hi: नहाना खत्म होने के बाद गीज़र बंद कर दो।

examples.en: We switch off the main power supply during a storm.
examples.hi: तूफान के दौरान हम मुख्य बिजली आपूर्ति बंद कर देते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Close the fan, it's cold.
common_mistake.right: Switch off the fan, it's cold.
common_mistake.why: Hindi's 'band karo' is often translated as 'close', but electrical devices in English are 'switched off' or 'turned off', not 'closed' — 'close' is reserved for doors, books, and similar physical objects.

cloze.sentence: Remember to ____ the iron before you go out.

en_def: to turn on a light, appliance, or machine using its switch
hi_def: स्विच के ज़रिए बत्ती, उपकरण या मशीन को चालू करना
hi_nuance: Just like 'switch off', Indian English favours 'switch on' over the American preference for 'turn on'; both forms are correct and widely understood.

examples.en: Switch on the fan, it's getting warm in here.
examples.hi: पंखा चालू कर दो, यहां गर्मी हो रही है।

examples.en: Can you switch on the geyser for me?
examples.hi: क्या तुम मेरे लिए गीज़र चालू कर सकते हो?

examples.en: She switched on the TV to watch the news.
examples.hi: उसने खबरें देखने के लिए टीवी चालू किया।

examples.en: Switch on the porch light before it gets dark.
examples.hi: अंधेरा होने से पहले बरामदे की बत्ती जला दो।

examples.en: He switched on the router but the internet still didn't work.
examples.hi: उसने राउटर चालू किया लेकिन फिर भी इंटरनेट नहीं चला।

common_mistake.wrong: Open the light, I can't see anything.
common_mistake.right: Switch on the light, I can't see anything.
common_mistake.why: This is a direct translation of 'batti kholo', but in English lights are 'switched on', never 'opened' — 'open' only applies to physical objects like doors and windows.

cloze.sentence: It's dark in here — please ____ the lamp.

en_def: to connect an electrical device to a power source by inserting its plug into a socket
hi_def: प्लग को सॉकेट में लगाकर किसी बिजली के उपकरण को जोड़ना
hi_nuance: This phrasal verb is separable in general English ('plug the charger in' / 'plug in the charger'), but for this deck's purposes note it's an action distinct from 'switch on' — you plug in a device first, then switch it on.

examples.en: Plug in the laptop; the battery is almost dead.
examples.hi: लैपटॉप प्लग इन करो, बैटरी लगभग खत्म हो गई है।

examples.en: I need to plug in my phone before the meeting.
examples.hi: मुझे मीटिंग से पहले अपना फोन चार्जिंग में लगाना है।

examples.en: Plug the router in near the modem.
examples.hi: राउटर को मॉडेम के पास प्लग इन करो।

examples.en: She plugged in the iron and waited for it to heat up.
examples.hi: उसने इस्त्री प्लग इन की और उसके गर्म होने का इंतजार किया।

examples.en: Don't forget to plug in the fridge after moving it.
examples.hi: फ्रिज को हिलाने के बाद प्लग इन करना मत भूलना।

common_mistake.wrong: First switch on the charger, then it will charge.
common_mistake.right: First plug in the charger, then it will charge.
common_mistake.why: Learners often skip the separate step of physically connecting the plug and jump straight to 'switch on'; in English you must 'plug in' the device before it can be 'switched on'.

cloze.sentence: You need to ____ the speaker before you can use it.

en_def: to disconnect an electrical device by removing its plug from the socket
hi_def: सॉकेट से प्लग निकालकर किसी बिजली के उपकरण को अलग करना
hi_nuance: Unlike 'switch off', 'unplug' means physically removing the plug from the wall, which is often recommended during storms or when leaving home for a long time to prevent electrical damage.

examples.en: Unplug the toaster when it's not in use.
examples.hi: इस्तेमाल में न होने पर टोस्टर को अनप्लग कर दो।

examples.en: We unplug all appliances before going on vacation.
examples.hi: छुट्टियों पर जाने से पहले हम सभी उपकरण अनप्लग कर देते हैं।

examples.en: The technician asked me to unplug the router and plug it back in.
examples.hi: तकनीशियन ने मुझे राउटर अनप्लग करके फिर से लगाने को कहा।

examples.en: Unplug the iron immediately if it starts smoking.
examples.hi: अगर इस्त्री से धुआं निकलने लगे तो तुरंत अनप्लग कर दो।

examples.en: She unplugged her charger and packed it in her bag.
examples.hi: उसने अपना चार्जर अनप्लग करके बैग में रख लिया।

common_mistake.wrong: Remove out the plug from the wall.
common_mistake.right: Unplug the appliance / Remove the plug from the wall.
common_mistake.why: Learners sometimes combine 'remove' with an unnecessary 'out', influenced by Hindi phrasal patterns; English already has the single precise verb 'unplug' for this action.

cloze.sentence: Always ____ the heater before you clean it.

en_def: a kitchen cooking appliance that burns gas to produce a flame for cooking
hi_def: रसोई में खाना पकाने वाला उपकरण जो गैस जलाकर आंच पैदा करता है
hi_nuance: In Indian homes 'gas stove' or simply 'gas' (as in 'gas jala do' meaning 'light the gas') is standard; Americans more often say 'stove' or 'stovetop' and may use 'gas stove' specifically to distinguish from electric stoves.

examples.en: Light the gas stove and put the pan on it.
examples.hi: गैस स्टोव जलाओ और उस पर पैन रख दो।

examples.en: Turn down the gas stove; the milk is about to boil over.
examples.hi: गैस स्टोव धीमी कर दो, दूध उबल कर बाहर आने वाला है।

examples.en: The gas stove has four burners.
examples.hi: इस गैस स्टोव में चार बर्नर हैं।

examples.en: Clean the gas stove after every meal to avoid grease buildup.
examples.hi: चिकनाई जमा न हो इसलिए हर खाना बनाने के बाद गैस स्टोव साफ करो।

examples.en: Never leave the gas stove unattended while cooking.
examples.hi: खाना बनाते समय गैस स्टोव को कभी अकेला मत छोड़ो।

common_mistake.wrong: Open the gas and put fire.
common_mistake.right: Turn on the gas stove and light it.
common_mistake.why: This is a literal translation of 'gas kholo aur aag lagao'; in English the gas knob is 'turned on', and the flame is 'lit', not 'opened' or given 'fire'.

cloze.sentence: The ____ hissed as she turned the knob to light it.

en_def: a metal container that holds cooking gas (LPG) supplied to homes
hi_def: एलपीजी रसोई गैस भरने वाला धातु का सिलेंडर
hi_nuance: This is a distinctly Indian household item and term, since most Western homes have piped gas rather than refillable cylinders; when explaining this to a foreigner you may need to describe it as a 'refillable propane/LPG tank' delivered by a gas agency.

examples.en: We need to book a new gas cylinder; this one is almost empty.
examples.hi: हमें नया गैस सिलेंडर बुक करना है, यह वाला लगभग खाली हो गया है।

examples.en: The delivery boy brought the gas cylinder up three flights of stairs.
examples.hi: डिलीवरी वाला लड़का गैस सिलेंडर तीन मंज़िल सीढ़ियां चढ़ाकर लाया।

examples.en: Check the regulator before connecting the gas cylinder.
examples.hi: गैस सिलेंडर जोड़ने से पहले रेगुलेटर जांच लो।

examples.en: The gas cylinder ran out right in the middle of cooking.
examples.hi: गैस सिलेंडर खाना बनाते-बनाते ही खत्म हो गया।

examples.en: Store the spare gas cylinder in a well-ventilated area.
examples.hi: अतिरिक्त गैस सिलेंडर को हवादार जगह पर रखो।

common_mistake.wrong: Please order gas.
common_mistake.right: Please book a gas cylinder.
common_mistake.why: In casual Hindi-influenced speech people just say 'gas order karo', but in precise English you 'book' or 'order' a 'gas cylinder', since 'gas' alone is ambiguous and doesn't specify the physical container being requested.

cloze.sentence: We ran out of cooking gas, so we need a new ____ delivered.

en_def: an appliance used to keep food and drinks cold
hi_def: खाने-पीने की चीज़ों को ठंडा रखने वाला उपकरण, रेफ्रिजरेटर
hi_nuance: 'Fridge' is the informal short form of 'refrigerator', used equally in British and American English; Indian English also commonly uses the brand-derived word 'fridge' rather than the longer formal term in daily conversation.

examples.en: Put the milk back in the fridge.
examples.hi: दूध वापस फ्रिज में रख दो।

examples.en: There's some leftover curry in the fridge if you're hungry.
examples.hi: अगर भूख लगी है तो फ्रिज में बची हुई सब्ज़ी रखी है।

examples.en: The fridge door doesn't close properly anymore.
examples.hi: फ्रिज का दरवाजा अब ठीक से बंद नहीं होता।

examples.en: Keep the fruit in the lower shelf of the fridge.
examples.hi: फलों को फ्रिज के निचले खाने में रखो।

examples.en: We need to defrost the fridge this weekend.
examples.hi: हमें इस वीकेंड फ्रिज को डीफ्रॉस्ट करना है।

common_mistake.wrong: Keep it in fridge.
common_mistake.right: Keep it in the fridge.
common_mistake.why: As Hindi has no articles, learners often drop 'the' before common household nouns like 'fridge', 'bathroom', or 'kitchen', even though English requires it when referring to a specific, known item.

cloze.sentence: The butter has gone soft — put it back in the ____.

en_def: the part of a fridge, or a separate appliance, used to freeze food and store it below freezing temperature
hi_def: फ्रिज का वह हिस्सा या अलग उपकरण जो खाने को जमाकर बहुत ठंडा रखता है
hi_nuance: In most Indian homes the 'freezer' is the small top compartment of the fridge used mainly for ice trays and occasionally frozen peas; a separate large standalone 'deep freezer' is a distinct item, common in shops and for storing bulk food or ice cream.

examples.en: Keep the ice cream in the freezer, not the main fridge compartment.
examples.hi: आइसक्रीम को फ्रिज के मुख्य हिस्से में नहीं, फ्रीज़र में रखो।

examples.en: The freezer is full of ice trays.
examples.hi: फ्रीज़र बर्फ की ट्रे से भरा है।

examples.en: This packet of peas has been in the freezer for months.
examples.hi: मटर का यह पैकेट महीनों से फ्रीज़र में पड़ा है।

examples.en: Our freezer needs defrosting; there's too much ice buildup.
examples.hi: हमारे फ्रीज़र को डीफ्रॉस्ट करना है, बहुत बर्फ जम गई है।

examples.en: The shop has a big freezer for storing frozen snacks.
examples.hi: दुकान में जमे हुए स्नैक्स रखने के लिए एक बड़ा फ्रीज़र है।

common_mistake.wrong: Put the ice cream in the fridge to freeze it.
common_mistake.right: Put the ice cream in the freezer to keep it frozen.
common_mistake.why: Learners sometimes use 'fridge' as a catch-all term for the whole appliance, forgetting that the freezing compartment specifically is called the 'freezer'; the regular fridge section only cools, it does not freeze.

cloze.sentence: The ice cubes are stuck together in the ____.

en_def: a kitchen appliance that heats or cooks food quickly using electromagnetic waves
hi_def: एक रसोई उपकरण जो विद्युत-चुंबकीय तरंगों से खाना जल्दी गर्म या पका देता है
hi_nuance: As a verb, 'to microwave something' (e.g. 'microwave the leftovers') is common and correct in English; some Indian speakers instead say 'put it in microwave' as a noun-only habit, but using it as a verb is perfectly natural and often more concise.

examples.en: Microwave the rice for two minutes before serving.
examples.hi: परोसने से पहले चावल को दो मिनट माइक्रोवेव में गर्म करो।

examples.en: The microwave beeped to say the food was ready.
examples.hi: माइक्रोवेव ने बीप बजाकर बताया कि खाना तैयार है।

examples.en: Don't put metal containers in the microwave.
examples.hi: माइक्रोवेव में धातु के बर्तन मत रखो।

examples.en: I microwaved the leftover pizza for lunch.
examples.hi: मैंने बचा हुआ पिज्जा दोपहर के खाने के लिए माइक्रोवेव में गर्म किया।

examples.en: The microwave has a defrost setting for frozen meat.
examples.hi: माइक्रोवेव में जमे हुए मांस के लिए डीफ्रॉस्ट सेटिंग है।

common_mistake.wrong: Heat it in microwave.
common_mistake.right: Heat it in the microwave.
common_mistake.why: As with 'fridge', learners frequently omit 'the' before appliance names because Hindi has no direct article equivalent, but standard English requires 'the' before a specific, known appliance.

cloze.sentence: Just pop the leftovers in the ____ for a minute.

en_def: an electric kitchen appliance used in Indian homes to grind, blend, and mix ingredients like spices, chutneys, and batters
hi_def: भारतीय रसोई में मसाले, चटनी और घोल पीसने-मिलाने के लिए इस्तेमाल होने वाला विद्युत उपकरण
hi_nuance: This exact compound term, 'mixer grinder', is distinctly Indian English; in the West the closer equivalent is a 'blender' or 'food processor', though those don't always have the same interchangeable jars for wet and dry grinding that Indian mixer grinders typically have.

examples.en: Use the mixer grinder to make the chutney.
examples.hi: चटनी बनाने के लिए मिक्सर ग्राइंडर का इस्तेमाल करो।

examples.en: The mixer grinder comes with three different jars.
examples.hi: इस मिक्सर ग्राइंडर के साथ तीन अलग-अलग जार आते हैं।

examples.en: Our mixer grinder stopped working after the motor burned out.
examples.hi: मोटर जल जाने के बाद हमारा मिक्सर ग्राइंडर काम करना बंद कर गया।

examples.en: Grind the spices in the small jar of the mixer grinder.
examples.hi: मिक्सर ग्राइंडर के छोटे जार में मसाले पीस लो।

examples.en: She bought a new mixer grinder for making smoothies too.
examples.hi: उसने स्मूदी बनाने के लिए भी नया मिक्सर ग्राइंडर खरीदा।

common_mistake.wrong: Put the tomatoes in mixi and grind.
common_mistake.right: Put the tomatoes in the mixer grinder and grind them.
common_mistake.why: Colloquial regional short forms like 'mixi' (common in South Indian households) are fine in casual conversation but should be written as 'mixer grinder' in standard English, and the object 'them' should not be dropped after the verb.

cloze.sentence: She ground the coconut chutney in the ____.

en_def: a sealed pot that cooks food quickly using steam pressure
hi_def: भाप के दबाव से जल्दी खाना पकाने वाला बंद ढक्कन वाला बर्तन, प्रेशर कुकर
hi_nuance: Pressure cookers are near-universal in Indian kitchens for cooking dal, rice, and vegetables quickly, whereas they're less common in Western homes; the unit of cooking time is often measured in 'whistles' (e.g. 'cook for three whistles'), a distinctly Indian usage worth explaining to outsiders.

examples.en: Cook the dal in the pressure cooker for three whistles.
examples.hi: दाल को प्रेशर कुकर में तीन सीटी तक पकाओ।

examples.en: Let the pressure cooker release steam before opening the lid.
examples.hi: ढक्कन खोलने से पहले प्रेशर कुकर की भाप निकल जाने दो।

examples.en: The pressure cooker whistled loudly in the kitchen.
examples.hi: रसोई में प्रेशर कुकर ज़ोर से सीटी बजा।

examples.en: Never open a pressure cooker while it's still under pressure.
examples.hi: प्रेशर कुकर को दबाव में रहते हुए कभी मत खोलो।

examples.en: We bought a new pressure cooker after the old gasket wore out.
examples.hi: पुरानी गैसकेट घिस जाने के बाद हमने नया प्रेशर कुकर खरीदा।

common_mistake.wrong: Cook it for three whistle in cooker.
common_mistake.right: Cook it for three whistles in the pressure cooker.
common_mistake.why: Learners often drop the plural 's' after a number ('three whistle') because Hindi doesn't mark plurals the same way after numerals, and they omit 'the' before the specific appliance.

cloze.sentence: Let the ____ finish two whistles before turning off the gas.

en_def: a container with a spout and handle used for boiling water
hi_def: टोंटी और हैंडल वाला वह बर्तन जिसमें पानी उबाला जाता है, केतली
hi_nuance: British-English households use electric kettles constantly for tea; this habit is now common in urban India too, though many Indian homes still boil water directly in a pan on the gas stove — 'kettle' specifically refers to the dedicated spouted container, electric or stovetop.

examples.en: Boil water in the kettle for tea.
examples.hi: चाय के लिए केतली में पानी उबालो।

examples.en: The electric kettle switches off automatically once the water boils.
examples.hi: पानी उबलते ही इलेक्ट्रिक केतली अपने आप बंद हो जाती है।

examples.en: Fill the kettle halfway; we only need two cups.
examples.hi: केतली आधी भरो, हमें सिर्फ दो कप चाहिए।

examples.en: The kettle whistled, signalling the water was ready.
examples.hi: केतली ने सीटी बजाई, यह बताते हुए कि पानी तैयार है।

examples.en: Descale the kettle every few months to remove mineral buildup.
examples.hi: खनिज जमाव हटाने के लिए हर कुछ महीनों में केतली को डीस्केल करो।

common_mistake.wrong: Put on the kettle for making tea.
common_mistake.right: Put the kettle on to make tea.
common_mistake.why: This is a common British idiom ('put the kettle on') that gets rearranged incorrectly when translated word-order-first from Hindi sentence structure; the fixed phrase keeps 'the kettle' between 'put' and 'on'.

cloze.sentence: I'll put the ____ on so we can have some tea.

en_def: a fixed basin in a kitchen or bathroom with a water supply and drain, used for washing
hi_def: रसोई या बाथरूम में लगा हुआ पानी की नल और निकासी वाला बर्तन धोने का स्थान, सिंक
hi_nuance: The word 'sink' also functions as a verb meaning 'to go underwater'; learners sometimes confuse 'the kitchen sink' (noun, a fixed basin) with the verb 'sink' (e.g. 'the boat sank'), which are unrelated meanings of the same spelling.

examples.en: Leave the dirty dishes in the sink for now.
examples.hi: गंदे बर्तन अभी सिंक में ही रहने दो।

examples.en: The kitchen sink is clogged again.
examples.hi: रसोई का सिंक फिर से जाम हो गया है।

examples.en: Wash your hands at the sink before eating.
examples.hi: खाने से पहले सिंक पर हाथ धो लो।

examples.en: There's a leak under the bathroom sink.
examples.hi: बाथरूम के सिंक के नीचे रिसाव है।

examples.en: She rinsed the vegetables in the sink.
examples.hi: उसने सिंक में सब्ज़ियां धोईं।

common_mistake.wrong: Wash the plate in wash basin of kitchen.
common_mistake.right: Wash the plate in the kitchen sink.
common_mistake.why: Many Indian speakers use 'wash basin' for both kitchen and bathroom fixtures, but standard English distinguishes them: the kitchen fixture is a 'sink', while 'wash basin' or simply 'basin' is generally reserved for the bathroom.

cloze.sentence: There are still dirty pots piled up in the ____.

en_def: water that comes directly from a tap or faucet, as opposed to bottled or filtered water
hi_def: सीधे नल से आने वाला पानी, जैसा कि बोतलबंद या फिल्टर किए गए पानी के विपरीत
hi_nuance: In most of India, tap water is not safe to drink directly and needs filtering or boiling, unlike in many Western countries where tap water is drinkable straight from the tap; this safety distinction is worth mentioning explicitly to travellers.

examples.en: Don't drink the tap water here; use the filter instead.
examples.hi: यहां का नल का पानी मत पियो, फिल्टर वाला पानी इस्तेमाल करो।

examples.en: Tap water in this city is not considered safe for drinking.
examples.hi: इस शहर में नल के पानी को पीने के लिए सुरक्षित नहीं माना जाता।

examples.en: We use tap water for washing dishes and filtered water for drinking.
examples.hi: हम बर्तन धोने के लिए नल का पानी और पीने के लिए फिल्टर वाला पानी इस्तेमाल करते हैं।

examples.en: Some travellers get sick from drinking tap water abroad.
examples.hi: कुछ यात्री विदेश में नल का पानी पीने से बीमार पड़ जाते हैं।

examples.en: Is the tap water in this hotel safe to brush your teeth with?
examples.hi: क्या इस होटल का नल का पानी दांत साफ करने के लिए सुरक्षित है?

common_mistake.wrong: I drink normal water from the tap directly.
common_mistake.right: I drink tap water directly.
common_mistake.why: 'Normal water' is a literal translation of 'saadha paani' and sounds unnatural in English; the standard term for water straight from a tap is simply 'tap water'.

cloze.sentence: In some countries, ____ is safe to drink straight from the tap.

en_def: a tap that drips or lets water flow out even when it is closed
hi_def: वह नल जो बंद होने के बावजूद टपकता या पानी छोड़ता रहता है
hi_nuance: In British/Indian English the fixture is a 'tap'; Americans call it a 'faucet'. A common household complaint phrase is 'the tap is leaking' or 'a leaking tap' — note the '-ing' adjective form used before the noun.

examples.en: Call the plumber; we have a leaking tap in the bathroom.
examples.hi: प्लंबर को बुलाओ, बाथरूम में नल टपक रहा है।

examples.en: The leaking tap in the kitchen wastes a lot of water.
examples.hi: रसोई का टपकता नल बहुत सारा पानी बर्बाद करता है।

examples.en: I could hear the leaking tap dripping all night.
examples.hi: मुझे पूरी रात टपकते नल की आवाज़ सुनाई दी।

examples.en: A leaking tap can often be fixed by changing the washer.
examples.hi: टपकते नल को अक्सर वॉशर बदलकर ठीक किया जा सकता है।

examples.en: We finally fixed the leaking tap after months of ignoring it.
examples.hi: महीनों नज़रअंदाज़ करने के बाद आखिरकार हमने टपकते नल को ठीक किया।

common_mistake.wrong: The tap is falling water since morning.
common_mistake.right: The tap has been leaking since morning.
common_mistake.why: The verb 'falling' is a literal translation of 'gir raha hai', but English uses 'leaking' or 'dripping' for water escaping from a tap, paired with the present perfect continuous to express an ongoing state since a point in time.

cloze.sentence: That ____ has been dripping all night and keeping me awake.

en_def: a removable cover that fits over the top of a container
hi_def: बर्तन के ऊपर लगाया जाने वाला हटाने योग्य ढक्कन
hi_nuance: Hindi 'dhakkan' translates to 'lid' for pots and pans, but note that a container's screw-top cap (like a water bottle) is usually called a 'cap' or 'lid' interchangeably in casual English, while 'cover' is used more generally and less precisely.

examples.en: Put the lid on the pan so the rice cooks faster.
examples.hi: चावल जल्दी पकने के लिए पैन पर ढक्कन लगाओ।

examples.en: The lid of the pressure cooker is hard to open.
examples.hi: प्रेशर कुकर का ढक्कन खोलना मुश्किल है।

examples.en: Don't forget to close the lid of the container tightly.
examples.hi: डिब्बे का ढक्कन कसकर बंद करना मत भूलना।

examples.en: The jar's lid got stuck and I couldn't twist it open.
examples.hi: जार का ढक्कन फंस गया और मैं उसे मोड़कर नहीं खोल पाया।

examples.en: Keep the lid slightly open while boiling the milk.
examples.hi: दूध उबालते समय ढक्कन थोड़ा खुला रखो।

common_mistake.wrong: Cover the pan with cap.
common_mistake.right: Cover the pan with its lid.
common_mistake.why: Learners sometimes use 'cap' for any covering object, but 'cap' specifically refers to small screw-on tops (bottles, pens); a pan or pot cover is called a 'lid', and 'its' is needed to show possession.

cloze.sentence: Put the ____ back on the pot so the soup stays hot.

en_def: a flat kitchen tool used for flipping, lifting, or spreading food while cooking
hi_def: खाना पलटने, उठाने या फैलाने के लिए इस्तेमाल होने वाला चपटा रसोई का औज़ार, पलटा
hi_nuance: Indian kitchens often just say 'palta' or 'khurchni' in Hindi and may call all flat cooking tools a 'spoon' in English by mistake; in English, a flat tool for flipping (like a roti or omelette) is a 'spatula', while a 'spoon' is specifically for scooping liquids or granular food.

examples.en: Use the spatula to flip the omelette.
examples.hi: ऑमलेट पलटने के लिए पलटे का इस्तेमाल करो।

examples.en: The spatula is made of silicone so it won't scratch the pan.
examples.hi: यह पलटा सिलिकॉन का बना है इसलिए यह पैन को खरोंचेगा नहीं।

examples.en: Hand me the spatula; the paratha is ready to be flipped.
examples.hi: मुझे पलटा दो, पराठा पलटने के लिए तैयार है।

examples.en: She scraped the batter off the bowl with a spatula.
examples.hi: उसने कटोरे में से घोल को पलटे से खुरचा।

examples.en: Keep a wooden spatula for non-stick pans.
examples.hi: नॉन-स्टिक पैन के लिए एक लकड़ी का पलटा रखो।

common_mistake.wrong: Turn the roti with the spoon.
common_mistake.right: Turn the roti with the spatula.
common_mistake.why: Because Hindi sometimes uses one general word for kitchen tools, learners say 'spoon' for any utensil; in English, flipping flat food specifically requires the flat-bladed 'spatula', not a 'spoon'.

cloze.sentence: Flip the pancake gently with a ____.

en_def: a long-handled spoon with a deep cup-shaped bowl, used for serving soup, dal, or curry
hi_def: गहरे कटोरेनुमा हिस्से वाला लंबे हत्थे का चम्मच, दाल-सब्ज़ी परोसने के लिए इस्तेमाल होता है, कलछी
hi_nuance: In Hindi this is called 'kalachhi' or 'karchhi'; Indian English speakers may just call it a 'big spoon', but 'ladle' is the precise English word specifically for serving liquids like soup or dal, distinct from a regular table spoon.

examples.en: Serve the dal with this ladle.
examples.hi: इस कलछी से दाल परोसो।

examples.en: The ladle is hanging on the hook near the stove.
examples.hi: कलछी चूल्हे के पास हुक पर टंगी है।

examples.en: She stirred the curry with a long-handled ladle.
examples.hi: उसने लंबे हत्थे वाली कलछी से सब्ज़ी हिलाई।

examples.en: Fill the bowl using the ladle, not your hands.
examples.hi: कटोरा भरने के लिए कलछी का इस्तेमाल करो, हाथ का नहीं।

examples.en: One ladle of dal should be enough for each plate.
examples.hi: हर थाली के लिए एक कलछी दाल काफी होगी।

common_mistake.wrong: Give me big spoon for the dal.
common_mistake.right: Give me the ladle for the dal.
common_mistake.why: Learners translate 'badi chammach' literally as 'big spoon', but native English speakers use the specific word 'ladle' for the deep, long-handled tool used to serve liquids like dal or soup.

cloze.sentence: He scooped the soup into the bowl with a ____.

en_def: a cylindrical tool used to flatten and roll out dough
hi_def: आटे को बेलने और चपटा करने के लिए इस्तेमाल होने वाला बेलनाकार औज़ार, बेलन
hi_nuance: This is called 'belan' in Hindi and is used along with a 'chakla' (rolling board) for making rotis and parathas; in English the pair is called a 'rolling pin' and 'rolling board' or 'pastry board', which don't have identical single-word equivalents in most Western kitchens.

examples.en: Use the rolling pin to flatten the dough for the roti.
examples.hi: रोटी के लिए आटे को बेलने के लिए बेलन का इस्तेमाल करो।

examples.en: Dust some flour on the rolling pin so the dough doesn't stick.
examples.hi: बेलन पर थोड़ा आटा छिड़को ताकि आटा चिपके नहीं।

examples.en: She rolled the dough evenly with a wooden rolling pin.
examples.hi: उसने लकड़ी के बेलन से आटे को समान रूप से बेला।

examples.en: The rolling pin slipped and the dough tore.
examples.hi: बेलन फिसल गया और आटा फट गया।

examples.en: Clean the rolling pin thoroughly after making parathas.
examples.hi: पराठे बनाने के बाद बेलन को अच्छी तरह साफ करो।

common_mistake.wrong: Press the dough with belan into round shape.
common_mistake.right: Roll the dough into a round shape with the rolling pin.
common_mistake.why: Learners often keep the Hindi word 'belan' inside an English sentence out of habit, and use 'press' instead of the correct verb 'roll', which describes the actual rolling motion used with this tool.

cloze.sentence: She flattened the dough into a circle using a ____.

en_def: a flat board used as a surface for cutting food, especially vegetables and meat
hi_def: सब्ज़ी या मांस काटने के लिए इस्तेमाल होने वाला सपाट तख्ता, कटिंग बोर्ड
hi_nuance: British English says 'chopping board'; American English usually says 'cutting board'. In many Indian kitchens, people traditionally cut vegetables directly with a 'sabzi katne wali'(vegetable-cutting) device or on a plate, so using a dedicated chopping board is a newer, increasingly common habit worth mentioning.

examples.en: Chop the onions on the chopping board, not the counter.
examples.hi: प्याज़ को कटिंग बोर्ड पर काटो, काउंटर पर नहीं।

examples.en: Keep a separate chopping board for meat and vegetables.
examples.hi: मांस और सब्ज़ियों के लिए अलग-अलग कटिंग बोर्ड रखो।

examples.en: Wash the chopping board with hot water after cutting raw chicken.
examples.hi: कच्चा चिकन काटने के बाद कटिंग बोर्ड को गर्म पानी से धो लो।

examples.en: The wooden chopping board has deep knife marks now.
examples.hi: लकड़ी के कटिंग बोर्ड पर अब गहरे चाकू के निशान हैं।

examples.en: Place the chopping board on a damp cloth so it doesn't slip.
examples.hi: कटिंग बोर्ड को गीले कपड़े पर रखो ताकि वह फिसले नहीं।

common_mistake.wrong: Cut the vegetables in the board.
common_mistake.right: Cut the vegetables on the chopping board.
common_mistake.why: Learners often use 'in' by analogy with Hindi's 'mein', but a flat surface like a board takes the preposition 'on', not 'in'.

cloze.sentence: Dice the carrots on the ____ before adding them to the pot.

en_def: a liquid or bar soap specifically made for washing dishes
hi_def: बर्तन धोने के लिए बनाया गया तरल या ठोस साबुन, बर्तन धोने वाला साबुन
hi_nuance: In India this is commonly called 'bartan soap' or by brand names; the neutral English term is 'dish soap' (American) or 'washing-up liquid' (British) — both are understood, though 'dish soap' or simply 'dishwashing liquid' is more common in Indian English usage.

examples.en: We're out of dish soap; buy some on your way home.
examples.hi: बर्तन धोने वाला साबुन खत्म हो गया है, घर आते समय ले आना।

examples.en: Use a little dish soap to cut through the grease.
examples.hi: चिकनाई हटाने के लिए थोड़ा बर्तन साबुन इस्तेमाल करो।

examples.en: This dish soap smells like lemon.
examples.hi: इस बर्तन साबुन से नींबू जैसी खुशबू आती है।

examples.en: Squeeze some dish soap onto the sponge.
examples.hi: स्पंज पर थोड़ा बर्तन साबुन डालो।

examples.en: The dish soap bottle is almost empty.
examples.hi: बर्तन साबुन की बोतल लगभग खाली है।

common_mistake.wrong: Wash the plates with normal soap.
common_mistake.right: Wash the plates with dish soap.
common_mistake.why: 'Normal soap' is vague and doesn't specify the product; English distinguishes bathing soap from 'dish soap', which is formulated differently to cut through food grease.

cloze.sentence: Add a squirt of ____ to the sponge before scrubbing the pan.

en_def: to rub something hard, often with a brush or rough material, to clean it
hi_def: किसी चीज़ को ब्रश या खुरदरी सामग्री से ज़ोर से रगड़कर साफ करना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'wash hard' or 'clean hard' instead of using the specific verb 'scrub', which precisely means vigorous rubbing to remove stuck-on dirt, unlike gentle 'wiping' or plain 'washing'.

examples.en: Scrub the burnt pan with a steel wool pad.
examples.hi: जले हुए पैन को स्टील वूल पैड से घिसो।

examples.en: You need to scrub harder to remove that stain.
examples.hi: उस दाग को हटाने के लिए ज़ोर से रगड़ना होगा।

examples.en: She scrubbed the bathroom tiles until they were spotless.
examples.hi: उसने बाथरूम की टाइलें तब तक रगड़ीं जब तक वे साफ-सुथरी नहीं हो गईं।

examples.en: Scrub your hands well before cooking.
examples.hi: खाना बनाने से पहले अपने हाथ अच्छे से रगड़कर धो लो।

examples.en: It took ten minutes of scrubbing to clean the grill.
examples.hi: ग्रिल को साफ करने में दस मिनट की रगड़ाई लगी।

common_mistake.wrong: Wash it strongly to remove the stain.
common_mistake.right: Scrub it hard to remove the stain.
common_mistake.why: 'Wash strongly' is an unnatural word-for-word rendering of an intensifier plus 'wash'; the correct English collocation uses the specific verb 'scrub' along with 'hard', not 'strongly'.

cloze.sentence: You'll need to ____ the pot hard to get the burnt bits off.

en_def: a frame or stand used to hold washed dishes and utensils so they can dry
hi_def: धुले बर्तनों को सूखने के लिए रखने का ढांचा या स्टैंड, बर्तन सुखाने की टोकरी
hi_nuance: In Indian kitchens this is often a stainless steel or plastic stand called a 'basket' or 'bartan stand'; the standard English term is 'dish rack' (or 'dish drainer' in British English), used near or over the sink.

examples.en: Put the washed plates in the dish rack to dry.
examples.hi: धुली हुई थालियों को सूखने के लिए डिश रैक में रखो।

examples.en: The dish rack is overflowing with clean cups.
examples.hi: डिश रैक साफ कपों से भर गया है।

examples.en: We need a bigger dish rack for all these utensils.
examples.hi: इतने सारे बर्तनों के लिए हमें एक बड़ा डिश रैक चाहिए।

examples.en: She wiped down the dish rack because it had rust spots.
examples.hi: उसने डिश रैक साफ किया क्योंकि उस पर जंग के धब्बे थे।

examples.en: Stack the bowls carefully in the dish rack.
examples.hi: कटोरों को डिश रैक में सावधानी से रखो।

common_mistake.wrong: Keep the plates in basket for drying.
common_mistake.right: Keep the plates in the dish rack to dry.
common_mistake.why: Many Indian speakers call this a 'basket', which in English suggests a woven container for fruit or laundry; the specific kitchen item for drying dishes is a 'dish rack'.

cloze.sentence: After washing, leave the cups in the ____ to air dry.

en_def: a flat, hand-held container into which dirt is swept from the floor
hi_def: फर्श से झाड़ी गई गंदगी इकट्ठा करने का चपटा, हाथ से पकड़ा जाने वाला बर्तन
hi_nuance: 'Dustpan' is always used together with 'broom' in the phrase 'dustpan and brush' (British) or 'dustpan and broom' — it collects the dirt after sweeping, and learners sometimes forget this second tool exists as a distinct word from 'broom' or 'dustbin'.

examples.en: Sweep the dirt into the dustpan.
examples.hi: गंदगी को झाड़कर डस्टपैन में डालो।

examples.en: Where's the dustpan? I need to clean up this broken glass.
examples.hi: डस्टपैन कहां है? मुझे यह टूटा हुआ शीशा साफ करना है।

examples.en: The dustpan and brush are kept together in the utility cupboard.
examples.hi: डस्टपैन और ब्रश दोनों उपयोगिता अलमारी में साथ रखे हैं।

examples.en: Empty the dustpan into the dustbin once you're done sweeping.
examples.hi: झाड़ू लगाने के बाद डस्टपैन को कूड़ेदान में खाली कर दो।

examples.en: This plastic dustpan cracked after just a few months.
examples.hi: यह प्लास्टिक का डस्टपैन कुछ महीनों में ही टूट गया।

common_mistake.wrong: Put the dust in the dustbin directly with broom.
common_mistake.right: Sweep the dust into the dustpan, then empty it into the dustbin.
common_mistake.why: Learners often skip the intermediate step and tool, forgetting that a 'dustpan' is used to collect swept dirt before it's transferred to the 'dustbin' — the two words name different objects.

cloze.sentence: Hold the ____ steady while I sweep the broken glass into it.

en_def: a thin, sticky net made by a spider, often found in corners of a room or ceiling
hi_def: मकड़ी द्वारा बनाया गया पतला, चिपचिपा जाल, जो अक्सर कमरे के कोनों या छत पर पाया जाता है
hi_nuance: Hindi 'jaala' or 'makdi ka jaala' translates directly to 'cobweb' (an old spider's web, often dusty) or 'spider web' (a fresh, intact one); English speakers use 'cobweb' especially for dusty, abandoned corners of a house that need cleaning.

examples.en: There are cobwebs in the corner of the ceiling.
examples.hi: छत के कोने में मकड़ी के जाले हैं।

examples.en: She used a long stick to clear the cobwebs from the storeroom.
examples.hi: उसने स्टोररूम से मकड़ी के जाले हटाने के लिए एक लंबी छड़ी का इस्तेमाल किया।

examples.en: This old house is full of cobwebs and dust.
examples.hi: इस पुराने घर में मकड़ी के जाले और धूल भरी पड़ी है।

examples.en: Wipe away the cobweb before it collects more dust.
examples.hi: और धूल जमा होने से पहले मकड़ी का जाला पोंछ दो।

examples.en: I found a cobweb behind the wardrobe when I moved it.
examples.hi: अलमारी हटाने पर मुझे उसके पीछे मकड़ी का जाला मिला।

common_mistake.wrong: There is spider net on the ceiling.
common_mistake.right: There is a cobweb on the ceiling.
common_mistake.why: A literal translation of 'makdi ka jaala' produces 'spider net', but the natural English word for an old, dusty web found indoors is 'cobweb', with 'spider web' reserved more for a fresh, visible web outdoors.

cloze.sentence: Nobody had cleaned that corner in months, and a thick ____ had formed.

en_def: a mat placed outside or inside a door for wiping shoes before entering
hi_def: दरवाजे के बाहर या अंदर रखी हुई चटाई जिस पर जूते पोंछकर अंदर आया जाता है, पायदान
hi_nuance: In English, 'doormat' also has a figurative meaning — calling a person 'a doormat' means they let others take advantage of them without objecting; learners should know both the literal household item and this common idiomatic usage.

examples.en: Wipe your feet on the doormat before coming inside.
examples.hi: अंदर आने से पहले पायदान पर पैर पोंछ लो।

examples.en: The doormat says 'Welcome' in bold letters.
examples.hi: पायदान पर बड़े अक्षरों में 'स्वागत है' लिखा है।

examples.en: Our doormat got soaked in the rain and now smells musty.
examples.hi: हमारा पायदान बारिश में भीग गया और अब उसमें सीलन की बदबू आती है।

examples.en: He shook the mud off the doormat before washing it.
examples.hi: उसने धोने से पहले पायदान से कीचड़ झाड़ दिया।

examples.en: Don't be a doormat; speak up when someone treats you unfairly.
examples.hi: पायदान मत बनो, जब कोई तुम्हारे साथ गलत करे तो आवाज़ उठाओ।

common_mistake.wrong: Clean your shoes on the carpet outside.
common_mistake.right: Wipe your shoes on the doormat outside.
common_mistake.why: Learners sometimes call any floor covering a 'carpet', but a small mat placed specifically at an entrance for wiping shoes is called a 'doormat', distinct from a decorative or full-room 'carpet'.

cloze.sentence: Please wipe your shoes on the ____ before you step inside.

en_def: pieces of cloth hung to cover a window or doorway for privacy or to block light
hi_def: खिड़की या दरवाजे को ढकने के लिए लटकाए गए कपड़े, गोपनीयता या धूप रोकने के लिए, पर्दा
hi_nuance: 'Curtains' is almost always used in the plural in English even for a single window's set of cloth, since it typically involves two panels; learners sometimes say 'a curtain' when referring to the whole window covering, which can sound slightly off unless they truly mean one single panel.

examples.en: Draw the curtains; the sun is too bright.
examples.hi: पर्दे खींच दो, धूप बहुत तेज़ है।

examples.en: We bought new curtains for the living room.
examples.hi: हमने बैठक के लिए नए पर्दे खरीदे।

examples.en: The curtains need washing; they've collected a lot of dust.
examples.hi: पर्दों को धोना है, उन पर बहुत धूल जमा हो गई है।

examples.en: Close the curtains before you change your clothes.
examples.hi: कपड़े बदलने से पहले पर्दे बंद कर लो।

examples.en: The wind blew the curtains through the open window.
examples.hi: हवा से खुली खिड़की से पर्दे उड़ने लगे।

common_mistake.wrong: Please close the curtain of the hall, both of them.
common_mistake.right: Please close the curtains in the hall.
common_mistake.why: Since 'curtains' functions as a plural even for one window's pair of panels, adding 'both of them' afterward is redundant; simply use the plural form 'curtains' to begin with.

cloze.sentence: It's too bright — can you draw the ____ a little?

en_def: a large piece of cloth used to cover a mattress or as a top layer on a bed
hi_def: गद्दे को ढकने के लिए या बिस्तर पर ऊपरी परत के रूप में इस्तेमाल होने वाला बड़ा कपड़ा, चादर
hi_nuance: Indian English commonly writes this as one word, 'bedsheet', while some British dictionaries prefer the two-word form 'bed sheet' — both are widely understood and accepted in Indian usage.

examples.en: Change the bedsheet; it's been a week.
examples.hi: चादर बदल दो, एक हफ्ता हो गया है।

examples.en: She spread a fresh bedsheet before the guests arrived.
examples.hi: मेहमानों के आने से पहले उसने एक नई चादर बिछाई।

examples.en: The bedsheet has coffee stains on it.
examples.hi: चादर पर कॉफी के दाग हैं।

examples.en: We bought matching bedsheets and pillow covers.
examples.hi: हमने मिलती-जुलती चादरें और तकिये के कवर खरीदे।

examples.en: Tuck the corners of the bedsheet in properly.
examples.hi: चादर के कोनों को ठीक से अंदर दबा दो।

common_mistake.wrong: I will lay the bed cloth.
common_mistake.right: I will spread the bedsheet.
common_mistake.why: 'Bed cloth' is a literal, non-standard translation of 'chadar'; English uses the fixed compound word 'bedsheet', paired with the verb 'spread' or 'change', not 'lay'.

cloze.sentence: Could you change the ____? It's due for a wash.

en_def: a removable fabric case that covers a pillow
hi_def: तकिये को ढकने वाला हटाने योग्य कपड़े का खोल, तकिये का कवर
hi_nuance: Indian English typically says 'pillow cover', while British English more often says 'pillowcase' — both mean exactly the same thing and are widely understood in India.

examples.en: Please change the pillow cover; it smells musty.
examples.hi: कृपया तकिये का कवर बदल दो, उसमें सीलन की बदबू आ रही है।

examples.en: I bought new pillow covers to match the bedsheet.
examples.hi: मैंने चादर से मेल खाने के लिए नए तकिये के कवर खरीदे।

examples.en: The pillow cover has a small tear near the zip.
examples.hi: तकिये के कवर में ज़िप के पास एक छोटा सा फटा हुआ हिस्सा है।

examples.en: Wash the pillow covers separately from the bedsheets.
examples.hi: तकिये के कवर चादरों से अलग धोओ।

examples.en: She embroidered flowers onto the pillow cover.
examples.hi: उसने तकिये के कवर पर फूलों की कढ़ाई की।

common_mistake.wrong: Put the pillow inside its dress.
common_mistake.right: Put the pillow inside its cover.
common_mistake.why: The word 'dress' is used only for clothing worn by people, not fabric coverings on household items; the fabric case for a pillow is a 'pillow cover' or 'pillowcase'.

cloze.sentence: This ____ has a faded floral print.

en_def: a large piece of soft, thick material used for warmth, especially on a bed
hi_def: गर्माहट के लिए इस्तेमाल होने वाला बड़ा, मोटा और नरम कपड़ा, खासकर बिस्तर पर, कंबल
hi_nuance: In Indian English, thinner cotton bed coverings are sometimes also loosely called 'blankets', while thicker quilted ones may be called 'razai' in Hindi and 'quilt' or 'comforter' in English; know that 'blanket' generally refers to a simple woven or woolen cover, distinct from a stuffed 'quilt'.

examples.en: Pull the blanket over you; it's cold tonight.
examples.hi: कंबल ओढ़ लो, आज रात ठंड है।

examples.en: We need to wash the winter blankets before storing them.
examples.hi: सर्दियों के कंबलों को रखने से पहले धोना है।

examples.en: The baby was wrapped in a soft blanket.
examples.hi: बच्चे को एक मुलायम कंबल में लपेटा गया था।

examples.en: He kicked off the blanket in his sleep.
examples.hi: वह नींद में कंबल उतार बैठा।

examples.en: Fold the blanket and put it on the top shelf.
examples.hi: कंबल को मोड़कर ऊपर वाले शेल्फ पर रख दो।

common_mistake.wrong: Cover yourself with blanket, it is cold.
common_mistake.right: Cover yourself with a blanket, it's cold.
common_mistake.why: Learners often drop the indefinite article 'a' before countable nouns since Hindi lacks a direct equivalent; English requires 'a blanket' when speaking generally about one such item.

cloze.sentence: It's freezing outside — grab an extra ____ for the bed.

en_def: a large, thick pad, often filled with springs or foam, used on a bed for sleeping on
hi_def: बिस्तर पर सोने के लिए इस्तेमाल होने वाला बड़ा, मोटा गद्दा, जो स्प्रिंग या फोम से भरा होता है
hi_nuance: Hindi 'gadda' translates directly to 'mattress'; in India both traditional cotton-filled mattresses and modern foam/spring mattresses are common, and it's worth knowing terms like 'memory foam mattress' or 'spring mattress' when discussing quality or firmness.

examples.en: This mattress is too soft for my back.
examples.hi: यह गद्दा मेरी कमर के लिए बहुत नरम है।

examples.en: We flipped the mattress to even out the wear.
examples.hi: हमने घिसाव बराबर करने के लिए गद्दा पलट दिया।

examples.en: The new memory foam mattress is very comfortable.
examples.hi: नया मेमोरी फोम गद्दा बहुत आरामदायक है।

examples.en: Air out the mattress in the sun once a month.
examples.hi: महीने में एक बार गद्दे को धूप में सुखाओ।

examples.en: The mattress sagged in the middle after years of use.
examples.hi: सालों इस्तेमाल के बाद गद्दा बीच से धंस गया।

common_mistake.wrong: The bed is very soft, I can't sleep.
common_mistake.right: The mattress is very soft, I can't sleep.
common_mistake.why: Learners sometimes confuse 'bed' (the whole furniture frame) with 'mattress' (the soft padded part you actually lie on); firmness or softness describes the mattress specifically, not the bed frame.

cloze.sentence: We need a firmer ____ because this one hurts my back.

en_def: a large cupboard or piece of furniture used for storing clothes
hi_def: कपड़े रखने के लिए इस्तेमाल होने वाली बड़ी अलमारी
hi_nuance: British/Indian English says 'wardrobe' for a standing clothes cupboard; Americans usually say 'closet', which in India refers more to a built-in storage space. 'Wardrobe' can also mean a person's entire collection of clothes, e.g. 'update your wardrobe'.

examples.en: Hang your shirts in the wardrobe.
examples.hi: अपनी कमीज़ें अलमारी में टांग दो।

examples.en: The wardrobe door is jammed and won't open.
examples.hi: अलमारी का दरवाजा फंस गया है, खुल नहीं रहा।

examples.en: We need a bigger wardrobe; our clothes don't fit anymore.
examples.hi: हमें एक बड़ी अलमारी चाहिए, कपड़े अब समा नहीं रहे।

examples.en: She organized her wardrobe by color.
examples.hi: उसने अपनी अलमारी को रंगों के हिसाब से व्यवस्थित किया।

examples.en: The wardrobe has a full-length mirror on one door.
examples.hi: अलमारी के एक दरवाजे पर पूरी लंबाई का शीशा लगा है।

common_mistake.wrong: Put the clothes in almirah.
common_mistake.right: Put the clothes in the wardrobe.
common_mistake.why: 'Almirah' is a Hindi loanword commonly used in Indian English speech, but in formal or written standard English, the correct term is 'wardrobe' (for clothes) or 'cupboard' (for general storage).

cloze.sentence: All my winter clothes are packed away in the ____.

en_def: a flat, horizontal surface fixed to a wall or inside a cupboard, used for keeping or displaying things
hi_def: दीवार पर या अलमारी के अंदर लगी हुई सपाट, क्षैतिज सतह, जिस पर सामान रखा या सजाया जाता है, शेल्फ
hi_nuance: The plural of 'shelf' is 'shelves' (irregular), which many learners forget, saying 'shelfs' instead; English also distinguishes a single wall-mounted 'shelf' from a whole standing 'bookshelf' or 'rack'.

examples.en: Put the books back on the shelf.
examples.hi: किताबें वापस शेल्फ पर रख दो।

examples.en: There's no space left on this shelf.
examples.hi: इस शेल्फ पर अब जगह नहीं बची है।

examples.en: The top shelf is too high for me to reach.
examples.hi: सबसे ऊपर वाला शेल्फ मेरी पहुंच से बाहर है।

examples.en: We installed a new shelf in the bathroom for towels.
examples.hi: हमने तौलियों के लिए बाथरूम में एक नया शेल्फ लगवाया।

examples.en: The shelves in the kitchen are stacked with spice jars.
examples.hi: रसोई के शेल्फों में मसालों के जार रखे हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: There are many shelfs in this cupboard.
common_mistake.right: There are many shelves in this cupboard.
common_mistake.why: 'Shelf' has an irregular plural ('shelves'), unlike most English nouns which simply add '-s'; learners often over-regularize it by mistake, producing 'shelfs'.

cloze.sentence: The trophy sits proudly on the top ____ in the living room.

en_def: a sliding, box-shaped storage compartment that can be pulled out from a piece of furniture
hi_def: फर्नीचर से खींचकर बाहर निकाला जा सकने वाला डिब्बे के आकार का भंडारण खंड, दराज
hi_nuance: 'Drawer' (rhymes with 'more', silent 'w' effectively) is often mispronounced by Hindi speakers as if it rhymes with 'flower'; be careful of the pronunciation /drɔː/, and note it's completely different from 'drawer' meaning 'one who draws' (rare usage).

examples.en: The keys are in the top drawer of the desk.
examples.hi: चाबियां डेस्क की सबसे ऊपर वाली दराज में हैं।

examples.en: This drawer is stuck; it won't slide open.
examples.hi: यह दराज फंस गई है, खिसकती नहीं है।

examples.en: Keep your socks in the second drawer.
examples.hi: अपने मोज़े दूसरी दराज में रखो।

examples.en: She emptied the drawer to look for the missing document.
examples.hi: गुम हुए दस्तावेज़ को ढूंढने के लिए उसने दराज खाली की।

examples.en: Close the drawer properly so it doesn't jam.
examples.hi: दराज को ठीक से बंद करो ताकि वह अटके नहीं।

common_mistake.wrong: I kept it in the box of the table.
common_mistake.right: I kept it in the drawer of the table.
common_mistake.why: Learners sometimes use the generic word 'box' for any storage compartment, but the sliding compartment built into furniture like a desk or dresser has its own specific name, 'drawer'.

cloze.sentence: The scissors should be in the top ____ of the desk.

en_def: a long, flexible electrical cable with a plug at one end and one or more sockets at the other, used to extend the reach of a power source
hi_def: एक लंबा, लचीला बिजली का तार जिसके एक सिरे पर प्लग और दूसरे सिरे पर एक या अधिक सॉकेट होते हैं, जो बिजली की पहुंच बढ़ाता है
hi_nuance: In India this is commonly called an 'extension board' or by the popular brand name; British English also uses 'extension lead'. All these terms are understood locally, but 'extension cord' is the more universally recognized term internationally.

examples.en: Use an extension cord to reach the socket near the window.
examples.hi: खिड़की के पास वाले सॉकेट तक पहुंचने के लिए एक्सटेंशन कॉर्ड इस्तेमाल करो।

examples.en: Don't overload the extension cord with too many devices.
examples.hi: एक्सटेंशन कॉर्ड पर बहुत सारे उपकरण मत लगाओ।

examples.en: The extension cord got tangled behind the TV unit.
examples.hi: एक्सटेंशन कॉर्ड टीवी यूनिट के पीछे उलझ गया।

examples.en: We need a longer extension cord for the garden lights.
examples.hi: बगीचे की लाइटों के लिए हमें एक लंबा एक्सटेंशन कॉर्ड चाहिए।

examples.en: Unroll the extension cord fully before using it.
examples.hi: इस्तेमाल करने से पहले एक्सटेंशन कॉर्ड को पूरी तरह खोल लो।

common_mistake.wrong: Take the wire and connect from there.
common_mistake.right: Use an extension cord to connect from there.
common_mistake.why: Learners often say the generic word 'wire' for any electrical cable, but the specific multi-socket cable used to extend reach from a wall socket is called an 'extension cord' or 'extension board'.

cloze.sentence: The lamp is too far from the wall, so we'll need an ____.

en_def: a small, portable, battery-powered light held in the hand
hi_def: हाथ में पकड़ी जाने वाली छोटी, पोर्टेबल, बैटरी से चलने वाली बत्ती, टॉर्च
hi_nuance: 'Torch' is the standard British/Indian term for a handheld battery light; Americans call the same object a 'flashlight'. In American English, 'torch' usually means a burning flame stick, so this is an important British-vs-American distinction to flag.

examples.en: Keep a torch handy during power cuts.
examples.hi: बिजली जाने पर टॉर्च हाथ के पास रखो।

examples.en: The torch's batteries are dead.
examples.hi: टॉर्च की बैटरियां खत्म हो गई हैं।

examples.en: He used his phone's torch to find the keyhole in the dark.
examples.hi: उसने अंधेरे में चाबी का छेद ढूंढने के लिए अपने फोन की टॉर्च का इस्तेमाल किया।

examples.en: Shine the torch under the bed; I think I dropped my earring there.
examples.hi: बिस्तर के नीचे टॉर्च मारो, लगता है मेरी बाली वहीं गिरी है।

examples.en: We packed a torch for the camping trip.
examples.hi: हमने कैंपिंग ट्रिप के लिए टॉर्च पैक की।

common_mistake.wrong: Bring the light stick, it's dark.
common_mistake.right: Bring the torch, it's dark.
common_mistake.why: Some learners avoid the word 'torch' assuming it only means a burning flame (as in American usage) and improvise with unnatural phrases like 'light stick'; in Indian/British English, 'torch' correctly means a handheld electric flashlight.

cloze.sentence: Grab the ____ — the power just went out.

en_def: a stick of wax with a wick in the middle that is burned to produce light
hi_def: मोम की छड़ी जिसके बीच में बत्ती होती है, जिसे जलाकर रोशनी की जाती है, मोमबत्ती
hi_nuance: Candles are commonly used in India during power cuts and festivals like Diwali; note the verb pattern 'light a candle' (not 'open' or 'burn on' a candle) and 'blow out a candle' when extinguishing it.

examples.en: Light a candle; the power is out.
examples.hi: एक मोमबत्ती जला दो, बिजली चली गई है।

examples.en: She blew out the candles on her birthday cake.
examples.hi: उसने अपने जन्मदिन के केक पर मोमबत्तियां फूंक कर बुझाईं।

examples.en: We keep candles ready for emergencies.
examples.hi: हम आपातकाल के लिए मोमबत्तियां तैयार रखते हैं।

examples.en: The scented candle filled the room with a lavender smell.
examples.hi: सुगंधित मोमबत्ती ने कमरे को लैवेंडर की खुशबू से भर दिया।

examples.en: Don't leave a burning candle unattended.
examples.hi: जलती हुई मोमबत्ती को अकेला मत छोड़ो।

common_mistake.wrong: Open the candle, it is dark.
common_mistake.right: Light the candle, it is dark.
common_mistake.why: Because switches and appliances are 'opened/closed' or 'switched on/off' in various loose translations, learners sometimes extend this pattern incorrectly to candles; the correct verb for igniting a candle is 'light', not 'open'.

cloze.sentence: She lit a ____ and placed it on the windowsill during the power cut.

en_def: a temporary interruption in the electricity supply
hi_def: बिजली आपूर्ति में अस्थायी रुकावट, बिजली गुल होना
hi_nuance: 'Power cut' is the standard British/Indian term; Americans usually say 'power outage' or 'blackout'. In many parts of India, scheduled power cuts (called 'load shedding') are common, a term less familiar outside South Asia.

examples.en: There's a power cut in our area since morning.
examples.hi: सुबह से हमारे इलाके में बिजली गुल है।

examples.en: We use an inverter to manage during power cuts.
examples.hi: हम बिजली कटने पर इनवर्टर का इस्तेमाल करते हैं।

examples.en: The power cut lasted almost three hours yesterday.
examples.hi: कल बिजली कटौती लगभग तीन घंटे तक चली।

examples.en: Keep candles ready in case of a power cut tonight.
examples.hi: आज रात बिजली जाने की स्थिति में मोमबत्तियां तैयार रखो।

examples.en: Frequent power cuts make it hard to work from home.
examples.hi: बार-बार बिजली कटने से घर से काम करना मुश्किल हो जाता है।

common_mistake.wrong: Light has gone in our colony.
common_mistake.right: There's a power cut in our neighbourhood.
common_mistake.why: 'Light has gone' is a direct translation of 'batti chali gayi', a very common Indian English expression; the more standard phrasing in written or formal English is 'there's a power cut' or 'the power has gone out'.

cloze.sentence: During the ____, we lit candles and waited for the electricity to return.

en_def: a device that stores electricity in a battery and supplies backup power to a home during a power cut
hi_def: एक उपकरण जो बिजली को बैटरी में संग्रहित करता है और बिजली जाने पर घर को बैकअप बिजली देता है, इन्वर्टर
hi_nuance: This home backup device is extremely common in Indian households due to frequent power cuts, unlike in many Western countries; note the technical distinction — an 'inverter' converts stored DC battery power to AC, while a 'generator' burns fuel to produce power directly, which learners sometimes confuse.

examples.en: The inverter kicks in automatically when the power goes out.
examples.hi: बिजली जाते ही इन्वर्टर अपने आप चालू हो जाता है।

examples.en: Our inverter battery needs to be replaced; it doesn't hold charge anymore.
examples.hi: हमारी इन्वर्टर बैटरी बदलनी है, अब वह चार्ज नहीं पकड़ती।

examples.en: The fan and lights run on the inverter during a power cut.
examples.hi: बिजली कटने पर पंखा और बत्तियां इन्वर्टर पर चलती हैं।

examples.en: We got a bigger inverter to run the fridge too.
examples.hi: फ्रिज भी चलाने के लिए हमने एक बड़ा इन्वर्टर लिया।

examples.en: The inverter makes a soft beeping sound when the battery is low.
examples.hi: बैटरी कम होने पर इन्वर्टर हल्की बीप की आवाज़ करता है।

common_mistake.wrong: We have generator at home for light problem.
common_mistake.right: We have an inverter at home for power cuts.
common_mistake.why: Learners often use 'generator' loosely for any backup power device, but a home battery-backup unit that silently switches on during a power cut is specifically called an 'inverter', distinct from a fuel-powered 'generator'.

cloze.sentence: When the electricity failed, the ____ switched on within seconds.

en_def: a fine mesh net hung over a bed or window to keep mosquitoes out
hi_def: बिस्तर या खिड़की पर लटकाया गया बारीक जाल जो मच्छरों को रोकता है, मच्छरदानी
hi_nuance: Mosquito nets are widely used across India, especially in rural and monsoon-prone areas, to prevent dengue and malaria; note the compound noun is written as two words, 'mosquito net', in standard English, though speakers often just say 'net' when the context is clear.

examples.en: Hang the mosquito net over the bed before you sleep.
examples.hi: सोने से पहले बिस्तर पर मच्छरदानी लगा लो।

examples.en: The mosquito net has a small tear letting insects in.
examples.hi: मच्छरदानी में एक छोटा सा छेद है जिससे कीड़े अंदर आ रहे हैं।

examples.en: We fitted mosquito nets on all the windows.
examples.hi: हमने सभी खिड़कियों पर मच्छरदानी लगवाई।

examples.en: During monsoon, using a mosquito net helps prevent dengue.
examples.hi: मानसून के दौरान मच्छरदानी का इस्तेमाल डेंगू रोकने में मदद करता है।

examples.en: Fold the mosquito net neatly and store it during winter.
examples.hi: सर्दियों में मच्छरदानी को करीने से मोड़कर रख दो।

common_mistake.wrong: Cover the bed with jaali so mosquitoes don't come.
common_mistake.right: Cover the bed with a mosquito net so mosquitoes don't come.
common_mistake.why: The Hindi word 'jaali' is often kept in English sentences out of habit; the correct English term for this specific mesh covering used against insects is 'mosquito net'.

cloze.sentence: Make sure the ____ is properly tucked in before you go to sleep.

en_def: a fan fitted in a kitchen or bathroom wall to remove smoke, steam, or odour from a room
hi_def: रसोई या बाथरूम की दीवार में लगा पंखा जो धुआं, भाप या दुर्गंध कमरे से बाहर निकालता है, एग्ज़ॉस्ट फैन
hi_nuance: This is a standard fixture in Indian kitchens and bathrooms; the same device may also be called a 'ventilator fan' in some contexts, but 'exhaust fan' is the most common and clearly understood term in Indian English.

examples.en: Switch on the exhaust fan while frying; the smoke is thick.
examples.hi: तलते समय एग्ज़ॉस्ट फैन चालू कर दो, धुआं बहुत ज़्यादा है।

examples.en: The bathroom exhaust fan removes the steam after a hot shower.
examples.hi: बाथरूम का एग्ज़ॉस्ट फैन गर्म पानी से नहाने के बाद भाप बाहर निकाल देता है।

examples.en: Our kitchen exhaust fan is making a loud rattling noise.
examples.hi: हमारी रसोई का एग्ज़ॉस्ट फैन ज़ोर से खड़खड़ाहट की आवाज़ कर रहा है।

examples.en: Clean the exhaust fan blades regularly to remove grease.
examples.hi: चिकनाई हटाने के लिए एग्ज़ॉस्ट फैन के पंखे नियमित रूप से साफ करो।

examples.en: The electrician installed a new exhaust fan in the bathroom.
examples.hi: इलेक्ट्रीशियन ने बाथरूम में नया एग्ज़ॉस्ट फैन लगाया।

common_mistake.wrong: Open the fan so smoke goes out.
common_mistake.right: Switch on the exhaust fan so the smoke goes out.
common_mistake.why: As with other electrical devices, learners translate 'chalu karo' as 'open' by mistake; fans and appliances are 'switched on', not 'opened', in standard English.

cloze.sentence: Turn on the ____ before you start frying — the kitchen fills with smoke fast.

en_def: a device that removes impurities from water to make it safe or better to drink
hi_def: एक उपकरण जो पानी में से अशुद्धियां हटाकर उसे पीने योग्य या बेहतर बनाता है, वाटर फिल्टर
hi_nuance: In India, since tap water is often unsafe to drink directly, most homes rely on a water filter (commonly an RO — reverse osmosis — purifier); the term 'water filter' and 'water purifier' are used almost interchangeably in everyday Indian English, though 'purifier' technically implies a more thorough purification process like RO or UV.

examples.en: Fill your bottle from the water filter, not the tap.
examples.hi: अपनी बोतल नल से नहीं, वाटर फिल्टर से भरो।

examples.en: The water filter cartridge needs replacing every six months.
examples.hi: वाटर फिल्टर की कार्ट्रिज हर छह महीने में बदलनी होती है।

examples.en: We installed an RO water filter in the kitchen.
examples.hi: हमने रसोई में एक आरओ वाटर फिल्टर लगवाया।

examples.en: The water filter makes a gurgling sound when it's purifying.
examples.hi: शुद्धिकरण करते समय वाटर फिल्टर से गुड़गुड़ाहट की आवाज़ आती है।

examples.en: Always use filtered water from the water filter for cooking too.
examples.hi: खाना बनाने के लिए भी हमेशा वाटर फिल्टर का शुद्ध पानी इस्तेमाल करो।

common_mistake.wrong: Drink water from filter, not simple water.
common_mistake.right: Drink filtered water, not tap water.
common_mistake.why: The phrase 'simple water' is an unnatural direct translation of 'saadha paani'; the correct contrast in English is between 'filtered water' (from a water filter) and 'tap water' (unfiltered).

cloze.sentence: We drink only water from the ____, never straight from the tap.

en_def: an electric machine that washes clothes
hi_def: कपड़े धोने की मशीन जो बिजली से चलती है
hi_nuance: Many Indian households still say 'washing machine' in English even mid-sentence in Hindi, which is fine, but learners often forget the article and say 'I put clothes in washing machine' instead of 'in the washing machine'. Also note British and American English use the same term here.

examples.en: I put the dirty clothes in the washing machine.
examples.hi: मैंने गंदे कपड़े वॉशिंग मशीन में डाल दिए।

examples.en: Our washing machine broke down last week.
examples.hi: हमारी वॉशिंग मशीन पिछले हफ्ते खराब हो गई।

examples.en: Can you switch on the washing machine, please?
examples.hi: क्या तुम वॉशिंग मशीन चालू कर सकते हो?

examples.en: The washing machine makes a loud noise during the spin cycle.
examples.hi: स्पिन साइकिल के दौरान वॉशिंग मशीन से तेज़ आवाज़ आती है।

examples.en: We bought a new washing machine for the flat.
examples.hi: हमने फ्लैट के लिए नई वॉशिंग मशीन खरीदी।

common_mistake.wrong: I washed my clothes in washing machine.
common_mistake.right: I washed my clothes in the washing machine.
common_mistake.why: Hindi has no articles, so learners often drop 'the' before nouns that need it in English; specific, known objects like 'the washing machine' in your home need the definite article.

cloze.sentence: Please put these clothes in the ____ before you leave for office.

en_def: a basket used to collect dirty clothes before washing, or clean clothes after washing
hi_def: गंदे या धुले हुए कपड़े रखने की टोकरी
hi_nuance: British English prefers 'wash basket' or 'laundry basket'; American English almost always says 'laundry basket' or 'hamper'. In India both 'wash basket' and 'laundry basket' are heard, but 'basket' alone without context can confuse listeners, so add 'clothes' or 'wash' before it.

examples.en: Put your dirty socks in the wash basket, not on the floor.
examples.hi: अपनी गंदी मोज़े फर्श पर नहीं, वॉश बास्केट में डालो।

examples.en: The wash basket is overflowing with clothes.
examples.hi: वॉश बास्केट कपड़ों से भरा हुआ है।

examples.en: I carried the wash basket to the terrace to hang out the clothes.
examples.hi: मैं कपड़े सुखाने के लिए वॉश बास्केट छत पर ले गया।

examples.en: She sorted the clothes from the wash basket into whites and colours.
examples.hi: उसने वॉश बास्केट के कपड़ों को सफेद और रंगीन में अलग किया।

examples.en: There's a small wash basket in the bathroom for towels.
examples.hi: बाथरूम में तौलियों के लिए एक छोटी वॉश बास्केट है।

common_mistake.wrong: Give me your dirty clothes for the wash.
common_mistake.right: Put your dirty clothes in the wash basket.
common_mistake.why: The phrase 'for the wash' sounds unnatural in this context in English; learners translate the Hindi idea of 'dhulai ke liye' too literally instead of naming the container.

cloze.sentence: Before bathing, throw your dirty shirt into the ____.

en_def: a chemical substance, usually in powder or liquid form, used for washing clothes or dishes
hi_def: कपड़े या बर्तन धोने के लिए इस्तेमाल होने वाला रसायन (पाउडर या तरल)
hi_nuance: In Hindi, 'saabun' (soap) is often used loosely for both soap and detergent, so learners sometimes say 'washing soap' for detergent powder. In British and American English 'detergent' is the correct word for the powder/liquid used in machines, distinct from bar soap.

examples.en: Add two spoons of detergent to the washing machine.
examples.hi: वॉशिंग मशीन में दो चम्मच डिटर्जेंट डालो।

examples.en: This detergent removes oil stains very well.
examples.hi: यह डिटर्जेंट तेल के दाग बहुत अच्छे से हटाता है।

examples.en: We ran out of detergent, so I need to buy some.
examples.hi: हमारा डिटर्जेंट खत्म हो गया है, मुझे कुछ खरीदना है।

examples.en: Liquid detergent is gentler on delicate fabrics than powder.
examples.hi: तरल डिटर्जेंट नाज़ुक कपड़ों के लिए पाउडर से ज़्यादा नरम होता है।

examples.en: Too much detergent can leave residue on your clothes.
examples.hi: ज़्यादा डिटर्जेंट कपड़ों पर अवशेष छोड़ सकता है।

common_mistake.wrong: Put washing soap in the machine.
common_mistake.right: Put detergent in the machine.
common_mistake.why: 'Washing soap' is a direct translation of the Hindi habit of calling all cleaning agents 'saabun'; in English, bar soap and machine detergent are named differently, and machines need 'detergent', not 'soap'.

cloze.sentence: You need to buy some more ____ before doing the laundry.

en_def: a liquid added during washing to make clothes feel softer and smell nicer
hi_def: एक तरल पदार्थ जो कपड़े धोते समय डाला जाता है ताकि कपड़े मुलायम और खुशबूदार बनें
hi_nuance: Fabric softener is not widely used in most Indian households, so many learners don't have a word for it in Hindi and just say 'wo cream jo kapdo mein dalte hain' (that cream you put in clothes). It's a separate product from detergent, added at the rinse stage, not the wash stage.

examples.en: Add a capful of fabric softener during the rinse cycle.
examples.hi: रिंस साइकिल के दौरान एक ढक्कन फैब्रिक सॉफ्टनर डालो।

examples.en: Fabric softener makes the towels feel less rough.
examples.hi: फैब्रिक सॉफ्टनर तौलियों को कम खुरदुरा बनाता है।

examples.en: She doesn't like the smell of fabric softener.
examples.hi: उसे फैब्रिक सॉफ्टनर की खुशबू पसंद नहीं है।

examples.en: Some fabric softeners can irritate sensitive skin.
examples.hi: कुछ फैब्रिक सॉफ्टनर संवेदनशील त्वचा में जलन पैदा कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: We switched to a fragrance-free fabric softener.
examples.hi: हमने बिना खुशबू वाला फैब्रिक सॉफ्टनर इस्तेमाल करना शुरू किया।

common_mistake.wrong: Put fabric softener with the detergent at the start.
common_mistake.right: Add fabric softener during the rinse cycle, not with the detergent.
common_mistake.why: Learners assume all liquids go in together like Hindi cooking instructions, but fabric softener is designed to be added at the rinse stage, separate from detergent, or the machine's dispenser drawer handles the timing automatically.

cloze.sentence: Add a little ____ to make the towels feel soft.

en_def: an electrical appliance with a flat heated base used to remove wrinkles from clothes; or the act of using it
hi_def: कपड़ों की सिलवटें हटाने के लिए इस्तेमाल होने वाला बिजली का उपकरण; या उससे कपड़े प्रेस करना
hi_nuance: In everyday Indian English, people commonly say 'press' for both the appliance and the action ('give this for pressing', 'I'll press it') because of the Hindi word 'प्रेस'. In standard British/American English the appliance and the action are both called 'iron', not 'press' — 'press' as a noun for the appliance is understood but is more old-fashioned or regional.

examples.en: Be careful, the iron is very hot.
examples.hi: सावधान, आयरन बहुत गर्म है।

examples.en: Can I borrow your iron for a minute?
examples.hi: क्या मैं तुम्हारा आयरन थोड़ी देर के लिए ले सकता हूँ?

examples.en: She switched off the iron before leaving the room.
examples.hi: कमरे से जाने से पहले उसने आयरन बंद कर दिया।

examples.en: This iron has a steam setting for cotton clothes.
examples.hi: इस आयरन में सूती कपड़ों के लिए स्टीम सेटिंग है।

examples.en: I need to iron my trousers before the meeting.
examples.hi: मुझे मीटिंग से पहले अपनी पैंट प्रेस करनी है।

common_mistake.wrong: Give this shirt for press.
common_mistake.right: Give this shirt for ironing.
common_mistake.why: 'Press' as a verb for ironing is a direct borrowing pattern common in Indian English shops; in standard English the verb form needed here is 'ironing' (as a gerund) or 'to iron', not 'press'.

cloze.sentence: Don't touch the ____, it just came off the switch and is still hot.

en_def: to remove wrinkles from a shirt using a hot iron
hi_def: शर्ट पर आयरन (प्रेस) करके उसकी सिलवटें हटाना
