en_def: Maximum Retail Price — the highest price a seller is legally allowed to charge for a packaged product in India, printed on the package by the manufacturer.
hi_def: अधिकतम खुदरा मूल्य — भारत में किसी पैक की गई वस्तु के लिए विक्रेता द्वारा वसूली जा सकने वाली सबसे अधिक कानूनी कीमत, जो निर्माता द्वारा पैकेट पर छापी जाती है।
hi_nuance: MRP is a distinctly Indian retail concept — most countries don't legally print a maximum price on packaging. It's a ceiling, not a fixed price, so shops can (and sometimes do) sell below MRP but never above it; learners should not assume MRP means the actual or only price.

examples.en: The MRP is printed right there on the packet.
examples.hi: एमआरपी वहीं पैकेट पर छपी है।

examples.en: This shop is charging more than the MRP, that's illegal.
examples.hi: यह दुकान एमआरपी से ज़्यादा वसूल रही है, यह गैरकानूनी है।

examples.en: You can often get products below MRP during sales.
examples.hi: सेल के दौरान अक्सर आपको एमआरपी से कम में सामान मिल जाता है।

examples.en: Always check the MRP before paying at a small shop.
examples.hi: छोटी दुकान पर भुगतान करने से पहले हमेशा एमआरपी जांच लें।

examples.en: The bottled water costs exactly its MRP here.
examples.hi: यहाँ बोतलबंद पानी बिल्कुल अपनी एमआरपी पर मिलता है।

common_mistake.wrong: This is fixed price, no less than MRP, no more than MRP.
common_mistake.right: MRP is the maximum price — shops can legally charge less, but never more.
common_mistake.why: Learners often assume MRP is a single fixed selling price, when it is actually only an upper limit; selling below MRP is completely legal and common.

cloze.sentence: The vendor tried to charge more than the ____ printed on the pack, which isn't allowed.

en_def: a small label attached to an item showing its price.
hi_def: किसी वस्तु पर लगा एक छोटा लेबल जिस पर उसकी कीमत लिखी होती है।
hi_nuance: 'Price tag' is used both literally (the paper/sticker label) and figuratively ('the price tag of the project was huge,' meaning cost). Indian English learners often only know the literal shop sense and are surprised by the figurative use in news/business English.

examples.en: Check the price tag before you try it on.
examples.hi: पहनने से पहले प्राइस टैग देख लो।

examples.en: The price tag says two thousand rupees.
examples.hi: प्राइस टैग पर दो हज़ार रुपये लिखा है।

examples.en: Someone tore off the price tag from this shirt.
examples.hi: किसी ने इस शर्ट का प्राइस टैग फाड़ दिया।

examples.en: This project comes with a hefty price tag.
examples.hi: इस प्रोजेक्ट की कीमत काफी ज़्यादा है।

examples.en: I always look at the price tag first, then the brand.
examples.hi: मैं पहले प्राइस टैग देखता हूँ, फिर ब्रांड।

common_mistake.wrong: What is the price tag of this phone, sir?
common_mistake.right: What is the price of this phone, sir?
common_mistake.why: Learners overuse 'price tag' for simply asking the cost in speech; 'price tag' is mostly used when referring to the physical label or in figurative writing, while everyday spoken English just says 'price.'

cloze.sentence: I checked the ____ and it was way over my budget.

en_def: an arrangement that lets a customer test or use a product before committing to purchase it.
hi_def: कोई ग्राहक खरीदने से पहले किसी वस्तु को आज़मा या इस्तेमाल कर सके, ऐसी व्यवस्था।
hi_nuance: This phrase is common in e-commerce/electronics marketing in India (e.g., mattress or gadget trial periods). It functions as a fixed marketing phrase, not a normal sentence — Indian learners sometimes try to conjugate it ('I am trying before buying'), but it's usually used as a set label or heading.

examples.en: This mattress company offers try before you buy for thirty nights.
examples.hi: यह गद्दा कंपनी तीस रातों के लिए ट्राई-बिफोर-यू-बाय की सुविधा देती है।

examples.en: I love shops with a try before you buy policy.
examples.hi: मुझे ट्राई-बिफोर-यू-बाय नीति वाली दुकानें पसंद हैं।

examples.en: With try before you buy, you can return it if you don't like it.
examples.hi: ट्राई-बिफोर-यू-बाय के साथ, पसंद न आने पर आप इसे वापस कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: Does this store allow try before you buy for shoes?
examples.hi: क्या यह दुकान जूतों के लिए ट्राई-बिफोर-यू-बाय की अनुमति देती है?

examples.en: Try before you buy reduced my hesitation about ordering online.
examples.hi: ट्राई-बिफोर-यू-बाय ने ऑनलाइन ऑर्डर करने को लेकर मेरी झिझक कम कर दी।

collocations: a try before you buy scheme

common_mistake.wrong: This shop gives try before buy option.
common_mistake.right: This shop offers a try-before-you-buy option.
common_mistake.why: Learners often drop the small connecting word 'you' (and sometimes hyphens), turning the fixed idiomatic phrase into an incomplete one; the full phrase must be kept intact as 'try before you buy.'

cloze.sentence: I wasn't sure about the sofa, so I was glad the store had a ____ policy.

en_def: a written promise from a manufacturer or seller to repair or replace a product for free if it develops a fault within a certain period.
hi_def: निर्माता या विक्रेता का लिखित वादा कि यदि उत्पाद में एक निश्चित अवधि के भीतर खराबी आती है, तो उसे मुफ्त में ठीक या बदला जाएगा।
hi_nuance: Indian English speakers sometimes confuse 'warranty' (a promise about product quality/repair, given automatically) with 'guarantee' (a broader promise, sometimes involving a refund) or 'insurance' (a paid protection plan). Also, 'under warranty' is the correct phrase, not 'in warranty,' which is a common calque from Hindi.

examples.en: This phone comes with a one-year warranty.
examples.hi: यह फ़ोन एक साल की वारंटी के साथ आता है।

examples.en: Is the laptop still under warranty?
examples.hi: क्या लैपटॉप अभी भी वारंटी में है?

examples.en: Keep the bill safe, you'll need it to claim the warranty.
examples.hi: बिल संभालकर रखें, वारंटी क्लेम के लिए इसकी ज़रूरत पड़ेगी।

examples.en: The warranty doesn't cover water damage.
examples.hi: वारंटी पानी से हुए नुकसान को कवर नहीं करती।

examples.en: My fridge broke down just after the warranty expired.
examples.hi: मेरा फ्रिज वारंटी खत्म होने के ठीक बाद खराब हो गया।

common_mistake.wrong: This item is in warranty for one year.
common_mistake.right: This item is under warranty for one year.
common_mistake.why: The fixed preposition in English is 'under warranty,' not 'in warranty' — a literal translation of वारंटी में है produces the wrong preposition.

cloze.sentence: Don't worry, this TV is still ____, so the repair will be free.

en_def: never used; still in its original, new condition.
hi_def: कभी इस्तेमाल न किया गया; अभी भी अपनी मूल, नई अवस्था में।
hi_nuance: Note the pronunciation trap: 'unused' (adjective, never used, /ʌnˈjuːzd/) versus 'unused to' (unaccustomed to, /ʌnˈjuːst/) — Hindi speakers sometimes confuse these two different meanings and pronunciations of the same spelling.

examples.en: I'm returning this shirt, it's completely unused.
examples.hi: मैं यह शर्ट वापस कर रहा हूँ, यह बिल्कुल इस्तेमाल नहीं हुई है।

examples.en: The shop only accepts unused products for a refund.
examples.hi: दुकान रिफंड के लिए केवल बिना इस्तेमाल किए गए सामान ही स्वीकार करती है।

examples.en: This is an unused gift card, you can use it.
examples.hi: यह एक बिना इस्तेमाल किया गिफ्ट कार्ड है, आप इसे इस्तेमाल कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: Please keep the tags on if the item is unused.
examples.hi: अगर सामान इस्तेमाल नहीं हुआ है, तो टैग लगे रहने दें।

examples.en: I found an unused voucher in my old wallet.
examples.hi: मुझे अपने पुराने बटुए में एक बिना इस्तेमाल किया वाउचर मिला।

common_mistake.wrong: This product is un-use, please take it back.
common_mistake.right: This product is unused, please take it back.
common_mistake.why: Learners sometimes hyphenate or misspell 'unused' as 'un-use,' treating the prefix 'un-' as separable the way Hindi negation words can be, but English 'unused' is one solid word.

cloze.sentence: The store won't take it back unless it's still ____ with the tags on.

en_def: previously owned or used by someone else; not new.
hi_def: पहले किसी और के द्वारा इस्तेमाल किया गया; नया नहीं।
hi_nuance: American English often prefers 'used' (a used car), while 'secondhand' is common in British and Indian English (a secondhand car, secondhand books). Indian English learners should know both are correct and interchangeable, but 'secondhand' can sound slightly more formal/written.

examples.en: I bought this scooter secondhand.
examples.hi: मैंने यह स्कूटर सेकंड-हैंड खरीदा।

examples.en: There's a good secondhand bookshop near my college.
examples.hi: मेरे कॉलेज के पास एक अच्छी सेकंड-हैंड किताबों की दुकान है।

examples.en: Secondhand phones are much cheaper than new ones.
examples.hi: सेकंड-हैंड फ़ोन नए फ़ोन से बहुत सस्ते होते हैं।

examples.en: He sells secondhand furniture at half the price.
examples.hi: वह आधी कीमत पर सेकंड-हैंड फर्नीचर बेचता है।

examples.en: I don't mind buying secondhand clothes for kids.
examples.hi: मुझे बच्चों के लिए सेकंड-हैंड कपड़े खरीदने में कोई परेशानी नहीं है।

common_mistake.wrong: This is a second-hand item, only one time used.
common_mistake.right: This is a secondhand item, used only once.
common_mistake.why: 'One time used' is a literal calque of एक बार इस्तेमाल हुआ; natural English says 'used once' or 'lightly used,' and 'secondhand' is usually written as one word.

cloze.sentence: I got this camera ____ from an online marketplace, and it works perfectly.

en_def: a bag given by a shop to customers to carry their purchased items home.
hi_def: दुकान द्वारा ग्राहकों को खरीदी गई वस्तुएँ घर ले जाने के लिए दिया गया थैला।
hi_nuance: 'Carry bag' is common Indian English retail usage; in American/British English people usually just say 'bag' or 'shopping bag.' Many Indian shops now charge a small fee for a carry bag due to plastic bans — worth knowing when shopping.

examples.en: Do you need a carry bag for these items?
examples.hi: क्या आपको इन सामानों के लिए थैले की ज़रूरत है?

examples.en: The shop charges two rupees for a carry bag now.
examples.hi: अब दुकान थैले के लिए दो रुपये लेती है।

examples.en: I always bring my own carry bag to avoid the charge.
examples.hi: मैं शुल्क से बचने के लिए हमेशा अपना थैला खुद लाता हूँ।

examples.en: Can I get a bigger carry bag for all these groceries?
examples.hi: क्या मुझे इन सारे किराने के सामान के लिए बड़ा थैला मिल सकता है?

examples.en: The carry bag tore on my way home.
examples.hi: घर जाते समय थैला फट गया।

common_mistake.wrong: Give me one carry, please.
common_mistake.right: Give me a carry bag, please.
common_mistake.why: Learners drop 'bag,' thinking 'carry' alone (echoing Hindi shorthand like 'carry de do') works as a noun, but in English 'carry' is normally a verb; the noun phrase needs 'bag.'

cloze.sentence: The shopkeeper asked if I wanted a ____ for two rupees extra.

en_def: a thin bag made of plastic, once common for carrying shop purchases.
hi_def: प्लास्टिक से बना एक पतला थैला, जो कभी दुकान से सामान ले जाने के लिए आम था।
hi_nuance: Many Indian states have banned or restricted single-use plastic bags, so shopkeepers now often ask customers to bring their own cloth bag; 'plastic bag' in conversation today often comes with a note of it being discouraged or charged extra, unlike a few years ago when it was free and automatic.

examples.en: Sorry, we don't give plastic bags anymore, it's banned here.
examples.hi: माफ़ कीजिए, अब हम प्लास्टिक बैग नहीं देते, यहाँ इस पर पाबंदी है।

examples.en: Please bring your own bag, we don't use plastic bags.
examples.hi: कृपया अपना थैला खुद लाएँ, हम प्लास्टिक बैग इस्तेमाल नहीं करते।

examples.en: The fish was wrapped in a plastic bag.
examples.hi: मछली एक प्लास्टिक बैग में लपेटी हुई थी।

examples.en: I reuse plastic bags for garbage at home.
examples.hi: मैं घर पर कूड़े के लिए प्लास्टिक बैग दोबारा इस्तेमाल करता हूँ।

examples.en: The government fined the shop for using plastic bags.
examples.hi: सरकार ने प्लास्टिक बैग इस्तेमाल करने के लिए दुकान पर जुर्माना लगाया।

common_mistake.wrong: Please put in polythene.
common_mistake.right: Please put it in a plastic bag.
common_mistake.why: 'Polythene' is the material name commonly used colloquially in Indian English/Hindi (पॉलीथिन) but sounds overly technical or unusual to other English speakers, who simply say 'plastic bag.'

cloze.sentence: Since ____s are banned here, I always carry a cloth tote when I shop.

en_def: a wheeled cart used in supermarkets to carry shopping items around the store.
hi_def: सुपरमार्केट में सामान ले जाने के लिए पहियों वाली एक गाड़ी।
hi_nuance: British/Indian English says 'trolley'; American English says 'cart' or 'shopping cart.' Indian supermarkets (like D-Mart, Big Bazaar) use 'trolley' universally, so an Indian speaker visiting the US should expect 'cart' instead.

examples.en: Grab a trolley near the entrance.
examples.hi: प्रवेश द्वार के पास से एक ट्रॉली ले लो।

examples.en: The trolley wheel is stuck, let me get another one.
examples.hi: ट्रॉली का पहिया फंसा हुआ है, मुझे दूसरी लेने दो।

examples.en: Our trolley is already full of groceries.
examples.hi: हमारी ट्रॉली पहले ही किराने के सामान से भरी है।

examples.en: Please don't leave the trolley in the parking lot.
examples.hi: कृपया ट्रॉली पार्किंग में मत छोड़ें।

examples.en: She pushed the trolley slowly through the crowded aisle.
examples.hi: उसने भीड़भाड़ वाले गलियारे में ट्रॉली को धीरे-धीरे धकेला।

common_mistake.wrong: I need one cart for shopping, where is trolley?
common_mistake.right: I need a trolley for shopping, where can I find one?
common_mistake.why: Mixing British 'trolley' and American 'cart' mid-sentence confuses listeners; Indian English mostly uses 'trolley,' so stick to it consistently unless speaking with Americans, who prefer 'cart.'

cloze.sentence: The supermarket was so crowded that I could barely push my ____ down the aisle.

en_def: a small hand-held container provided in shops for carrying a few items while browsing.
hi_def: दुकान में दी जाने वाली एक छोटी टोकरी, जिसमें कुछ सामान लेकर घूमा जा सकता है।
hi_nuance: Used when buying only a few items (as opposed to a trolley for a big shop); in online shopping, 'shopping basket' and 'shopping cart' are used interchangeably by different websites (British sites often say 'basket,' American sites say 'cart') — this can confuse Indian users switching between apps.

examples.en: I only need a shopping basket, not a full trolley.
examples.hi: मुझे सिर्फ एक शॉपिंग बास्केट चाहिए, पूरी ट्रॉली नहीं।

examples.en: The shopping basket was too small for all my groceries.
examples.hi: शॉपिंग बास्केट मेरे सारे किराने के सामान के लिए बहुत छोटी थी।

examples.en: Add the item to your shopping basket before checkout.
examples.hi: चेकआउट से पहले वस्तु को अपने शॉपिंग बास्केट में जोड़ें।

examples.en: I left my shopping basket near the dairy section.
examples.hi: मैंने अपनी शॉपिंग बास्केट डेयरी सेक्शन के पास छोड़ दी।

examples.en: Hand-held shopping baskets are stacked near the entrance.
examples.hi: हाथ से पकड़ने वाली शॉपिंग बास्केट प्रवेश द्वार के पास रखी हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I put in the basket the item.
common_mistake.right: I put the item in the basket.
common_mistake.why: Word order error placing the location phrase before the object, following Hindi's flexible word order (मैंने टोकरी में सामान रखा); English fixes the order as verb + object + location.

cloze.sentence: For just a few items, I'll grab a small ____ instead of a trolley.

en_def: the desk or counter in a shop where a customer's bill is prepared and payment is taken.
hi_def: दुकान में वह मेज़ या काउंटर जहाँ ग्राहक का बिल तैयार किया जाता है और भुगतान लिया जाता है।
hi_nuance: 'Billing counter' is standard Indian retail English, used on signs in supermarkets; American English usually calls this the 'checkout' or 'checkout counter,' and British English often says 'till.' All refer to the same place where you pay.

examples.en: The billing counter is at the front of the store.
examples.hi: बिलिंग काउंटर दुकान के सामने है।

examples.en: There's a long line at the billing counter today.
examples.hi: आज बिलिंग काउंटर पर लंबी लाइन है।

examples.en: Please pay at the billing counter before leaving.
examples.hi: जाने से पहले कृपया बिलिंग काउंटर पर भुगतान करें।

examples.en: The billing counter closes at nine every night.
examples.hi: बिलिंग काउंटर हर रात नौ बजे बंद हो जाता है।

examples.en: I left my umbrella at the billing counter.
examples.hi: मैं अपना छाता बिलिंग काउंटर पर छोड़ आया।

common_mistake.wrong: Go to billing, they will make bill.
common_mistake.right: Go to the billing counter, they'll prepare your bill.
common_mistake.why: 'Make bill' is a direct calque from बिल बनाना; the natural English verb is 'prepare' or 'generate' a bill, and 'billing' alone (without 'counter') sounds incomplete as a location.

cloze.sentence: Please take these items to the ____ to pay before you leave.

en_def: a person whose job is to handle payments and receipts at a shop's counter.
hi_def: दुकान के काउंटर पर भुगतान और रसीद संभालने वाला व्यक्ति।
hi_nuance: In small Indian shops, the shopkeeper and cashier are often the same person, so learners sometimes don't distinguish the roles; in supermarkets and malls, 'cashier' specifically refers to the employee at the billing counter, distinct from sales staff on the floor.

examples.en: The cashier gave me the wrong change.
examples.hi: कैशियर ने मुझे गलत चेंज दे दिया।

examples.en: Ask the cashier for a receipt.
examples.hi: रसीद के लिए कैशियर से पूछो।

examples.en: The cashier scanned each item quickly.
examples.hi: कैशियर ने हर वस्तु को जल्दी से स्कैन किया।

examples.en: There's only one cashier on duty right now.
examples.hi: अभी सिर्फ एक कैशियर ड्यूटी पर है।

examples.en: The new cashier is still learning the billing system.
examples.hi: नया कैशियर अभी बिलिंग सिस्टम सीख रहा है।

common_mistake.wrong: Cashier is sitting there, go ask money.
common_mistake.right: The cashier is over there, ask about the payment.
common_mistake.why: 'Ask money' drops necessary structure ('ask about the payment' or 'pay the cashier'); a direct calque of पैसे पूछो doesn't map onto correct English verb-object patterns.

cloze.sentence: Please pay the ____ at the counter before you leave the store.

en_def: a person who owns or manages a small shop.
hi_def: एक छोटी दुकान का मालिक या प्रबंधक।
hi_nuance: 'Shopkeeper' is widely used in Indian English for small, local, often family-run shops (kirana stores); it's less commonly used for big retail chain staff, where 'store manager' or 'salesperson' is more accurate. Non-Indian English speakers may find 'shopkeeper' slightly old-fashioned or literary, but it's completely natural and current in Indian usage.

examples.en: The shopkeeper knows all his regular customers by name.
examples.hi: दुकानदार अपने सभी नियमित ग्राहकों को नाम से जानता है।

examples.en: I asked the shopkeeper for a discount.
examples.hi: मैंने दुकानदार से छूट माँगी।

examples.en: The shopkeeper closed early today.
examples.hi: आज दुकानदार ने जल्दी दुकान बंद कर दी।

examples.en: Our neighbourhood shopkeeper gives credit to regular customers.
examples.hi: हमारे मोहल्ले का दुकानदार नियमित ग्राहकों को उधार देता है।

examples.en: The shopkeeper counted the change twice.
examples.hi: दुकानदार ने चेंज दो बार गिना।

common_mistake.wrong: Shop owner man told me no discount today.
common_mistake.right: The shopkeeper told me there's no discount today.
common_mistake.why: 'Shop owner man' is an awkward, redundant construction directly built from Hindi (दुकान का मालिक आदमी); English already has the single natural word 'shopkeeper' for this.

cloze.sentence: The ____ gave me a good deal because I buy from him every week.

en_def: the selling of goods in large quantities, usually at lower prices, typically to retailers rather than individual customers.
hi_def: बड़ी मात्रा में, आमतौर पर कम कीमत पर, सामान बेचना — आमतौर पर खुदरा विक्रेताओं को, न कि सीधे व्यक्तिगत ग्राहकों को।
hi_nuance: Indian English learners sometimes use 'wholesale' loosely to mean simply 'cheap' or 'bulk,' but strictly it refers to the business model of selling to other sellers, not the general public. Its opposite, 'retail,' is selling directly to individual consumers.

examples.en: This market sells clothes wholesale to shop owners.
examples.hi: यह बाज़ार दुकान मालिकों को थोक में कपड़े बेचता है।

examples.en: You can get a better rate if you buy wholesale.
examples.hi: अगर आप थोक में खरीदें तो बेहतर दर मिल सकती है।

examples.en: He runs a wholesale business supplying to small stores.
examples.hi: वह एक थोक व्यवसाय चलाता है जो छोटी दुकानों को सामान देता है।

examples.en: Wholesale prices are usually much lower than retail.
examples.hi: थोक कीमतें आमतौर पर खुदरा से बहुत कम होती हैं।

examples.en: That market in the old city is famous for wholesale textiles.
examples.hi: पुराने शहर का वह बाज़ार थोक कपड़ों के लिए मशहूर है।

common_mistake.wrong: I want wholesale rate, I am buying only two pieces.
common_mistake.right: Wholesale rates usually apply only to bulk orders, not just two pieces.
common_mistake.why: Learners sometimes assume 'wholesale' just means 'a discount,' without understanding it requires buying in large quantities, not a small number of items.

cloze.sentence: The trader offers a much better rate if you buy in ____ instead of one piece at a time.

en_def: the selling of goods directly to individual consumers, usually in smaller quantities and at higher per-unit prices than wholesale.
hi_def: सामान सीधे व्यक्तिगत ग्राहकों को, आमतौर पर छोटी मात्रा में और थोक से अधिक कीमत पर बेचना।
hi_nuance: Retail is the standard shopping most people do daily; Indian English learners should recognize 'retail price,' 'retail store,' and 'retail sector' as common business terms in news and job contexts (e.g., 'retail sector jobs'), distinct from 'wholesale.'

examples.en: This is the retail price, not the wholesale rate.
examples.hi: यह खुदरा कीमत है, थोक दर नहीं।

examples.en: She works in the retail sector as a store manager.
examples.hi: वह खुदरा क्षेत्र में स्टोर मैनेजर के रूप में काम करती है।

examples.en: Retail shops in this mall close by ten at night.
examples.hi: इस मॉल की खुदरा दुकानें रात दस बजे तक बंद हो जाती हैं।

examples.en: The item costs more at retail than at the wholesale market.
examples.hi: यह वस्तु थोक बाज़ार से खुदरा में ज़्यादा कीमत पर मिलती है।

examples.en: Retail sales usually rise before festivals in India.
examples.hi: भारत में त्योहारों से पहले खुदरा बिक्री आमतौर पर बढ़ जाती है।

common_mistake.wrong: This shop does retail and wholesale, same-same price.
common_mistake.right: This shop offers both retail and wholesale, but the prices differ.
common_mistake.why: 'Same-same' is a common Indian English colloquialism for emphasis, but retail and wholesale prices are, by definition, different — using 'same-same' here creates a factually confusing statement.

cloze.sentence: Buying from the factory directly is cheaper than paying the usual ____ price in shops.

en_def: the place in a store where customers pay for the goods they are buying.
hi_def: दुकान में वह जगह जहाँ ग्राहक अपने खरीदे हुए सामान का भुगतान करते हैं।
hi_nuance: 'Checkout counter' is the more international/American term, while Indian shops often say 'billing counter.' Both are understood in India, but 'checkout' is the word used on e-commerce websites ('proceed to checkout'), so it's useful to know for online shopping too.

examples.en: The checkout counter had a self-service option.
examples.hi: चेकआउट काउंटर पर सेल्फ-सर्विस का विकल्प था।

examples.en: There were only two checkout counters open.
examples.hi: सिर्फ दो चेकआउट काउंटर खुले थे।

examples.en: I waited fifteen minutes at the checkout counter.
examples.hi: मैं चेकआउट काउंटर पर पंद्रह मिनट इंतज़ार करता रहा।

examples.en: Please proceed to the checkout counter with your trolley.
examples.hi: कृपया अपनी ट्रॉली के साथ चेकआउट काउंटर पर जाएँ।

examples.en: The checkout counter accepts both cash and card.
examples.hi: चेकआउट काउंटर कैश और कार्ड दोनों स्वीकार करता है।

common_mistake.wrong: I did checkout at ten minutes only.
common_mistake.right: I checked out in just ten minutes.
common_mistake.why: Learners use 'do checkout' as a noun-plus-verb combo (a calque similar to 'checkout kiya'), but English needs the phrasal verb 'check out' (as a verb) or 'at the checkout' (as a location noun), not a mixed form.

cloze.sentence: After filling the trolley, we headed straight to the ____ to pay.

en_def: a card given by a shop that rewards regular customers with points, discounts, or benefits.
hi_def: दुकान द्वारा नियमित ग्राहकों को दिया जाने वाला एक कार्ड, जो अंक, छूट या अन्य लाभ देता है।
hi_nuance: Many Indian retail chains (like supermarkets, pharmacies) now use loyalty cards or linked mobile numbers instead of physical cards; learners should know 'loyalty card,' 'loyalty points,' and 'reward points' are often used interchangeably in Indian retail conversation.

examples.en: Do you have a loyalty card with this store?
examples.hi: क्या इस दुकान का आपके पास लॉयल्टी कार्ड है?

examples.en: I collected enough points on my loyalty card for a free item.
examples.hi: मैंने अपने लॉयल्टी कार्ड पर मुफ्त वस्तु के लिए काफी अंक जमा कर लिए।

examples.en: Show your loyalty card to get the member discount.
examples.hi: सदस्य छूट पाने के लिए अपना लॉयल्टी कार्ड दिखाएँ।

examples.en: I forgot to bring my loyalty card today.
examples.hi: मैं आज अपना लॉयल्टी कार्ड लाना भूल गया।

examples.en: This store lets you use your phone number instead of a loyalty card.
examples.hi: यह दुकान लॉयल्टी कार्ड की जगह फ़ोन नंबर इस्तेमाल करने देती है।

common_mistake.wrong: I have loyal card of this shop.
common_mistake.right: I have a loyalty card for this shop.
common_mistake.why: Learners confuse the adjective 'loyal' (describing a person) with the noun 'loyalty' (used in the compound noun 'loyalty card'); also the preposition should be 'for,' not 'of.'

cloze.sentence: Swipe your ____ here to earn points on today's purchase.

en_def: a card that proves a person belongs to a club, store, or organization, often needed to access certain benefits or prices.
hi_def: एक कार्ड जो साबित करता है कि व्यक्ति किसी क्लब, स्टोर या संगठन का सदस्य है, जो अक्सर विशेष लाभ या कीमतों तक पहुँचने के लिए ज़रूरी होता है।
hi_nuance: In wholesale clubs like Metro or Costco-style stores in India, a membership card is mandatory to enter and shop, unlike a loyalty card, which is optional and just gives rewards at a regular retail shop — Indian learners sometimes mix up the two.

examples.en: You need a membership card to enter this wholesale store.
examples.hi: इस थोक स्टोर में जाने के लिए आपको मेंबरशिप कार्ड चाहिए।

examples.en: My membership card expired last month.
examples.hi: मेरा मेंबरशिप कार्ड पिछले महीने खत्म हो गया।

examples.en: Show your membership card at the entrance, please.
examples.hi: कृपया प्रवेश द्वार पर अपना मेंबरशिप कार्ड दिखाएँ।

examples.en: I renewed my gym membership card yesterday.
examples.hi: मैंने कल अपना जिम का मेंबरशिप कार्ड नवीनीकृत किया।

examples.en: Can a friend use my membership card to shop here?
examples.hi: क्या कोई दोस्त यहाँ खरीदारी करने के लिए मेरा मेंबरशिप कार्ड इस्तेमाल कर सकता है?

common_mistake.wrong: I am member of this shop, I have card.
common_mistake.right: I am a member of this shop, and I have a membership card.
common_mistake.why: Dropping articles ('a member,' 'a card') is a common Hindi-influenced error, since Hindi doesn't use articles; both nouns need 'a' in English.

cloze.sentence: You can't enter the wholesale store without showing your ____ at the gate.

en_def: decorative paper (or the service of wrapping an item in it) used to wrap a present.
hi_def: सजावटी कागज़ (या किसी वस्तु को उसमें लपेटने की सेवा) जो उपहार लपेटने के लिए इस्तेमाल होता है।
hi_nuance: 'Gift wrap' can be a noun (the paper itself) or a verb ('gift-wrap this for me'); Indian shops often offer this as a free or paid service during festivals, and 'give me gift wrapping' (mixing noun forms oddly) is a common learner error instead of the cleaner 'please gift-wrap this.'

examples.en: Can you gift wrap this for me, please?
examples.hi: क्या आप कृपया इसे उपहार के लिए लपेट सकते हैं?

examples.en: The shop offers free gift wrap during Diwali.
examples.hi: दुकान दिवाली के दौरान मुफ्त गिफ्ट रैप की सुविधा देती है।

examples.en: I bought some gift wrap paper for the birthday present.
examples.hi: मैंने जन्मदिन के उपहार के लिए कुछ गिफ्ट रैप पेपर खरीदा।

examples.en: The gift wrap counter is near the exit.
examples.hi: गिफ्ट रैप काउंटर निकास के पास है।

examples.en: She wrapped it herself instead of paying for gift wrap.
examples.hi: उसने खुद ही इसे लपेटा, गिफ्ट रैप के लिए पैसे नहीं दिए।

common_mistake.wrong: Please do gift pack of this item.
common_mistake.right: Please gift-wrap this item.
common_mistake.why: 'Gift pack' is often used in Indian English but usually refers to a pre-packaged product bundle, not the act of wrapping; the correct verb phrase for wrapping something as a present is 'gift-wrap.'

cloze.sentence: Could you ____ this box? It's a birthday present for my sister.

en_def: Point of Sale machine — the small device shopkeepers use to process card payments (insert, swipe, or tap).
hi_def: प्वाइंट ऑफ सेल मशीन — वह छोटा उपकरण जिसे दुकानदार कार्ड से भुगतान लेने (डालने, स्वाइप करने या टैप करने) के लिए इस्तेमाल करते हैं।
hi_nuance: 'POS machine' is standard Indian retail terminology; internationally, people more often just say 'card machine' or 'card reader' without spelling out 'POS.' Indian shopkeepers frequently shorten it further to just 'machine' ('machine se pay kar do').

examples.en: The POS machine isn't working, can you pay by UPI instead?
examples.hi: पीओएस मशीन काम नहीं कर रही, क्या आप इसके बजाय यूपीआई से भुगतान कर सकते हैं?

examples.en: Please insert your card into the POS machine.
examples.hi: कृपया अपना कार्ड पीओएस मशीन में डालें।

examples.en: The shopkeeper carries a portable POS machine.
examples.hi: दुकानदार एक पोर्टेबल पीओएस मशीन साथ रखता है।

examples.en: The POS machine printed a receipt automatically.
examples.hi: पीओएस मशीन ने अपने-आप एक रसीद छाप दी।

examples.en: Our POS machine only accepts chip cards now.
examples.hi: हमारी पीओएस मशीन अब केवल चिप कार्ड स्वीकार करती है।

common_mistake.wrong: Machine is hang, try after some time.
common_mistake.right: The machine has hung, please try again in a moment.
common_mistake.why: 'Is hang' is a direct calque from Hindi habitual present (हैंग है); English needs the past participle 'has hung' or a different phrasing, since raw 'hang' as an adjective isn't standard.

cloze.sentence: Just tap your card on the ____ to complete the payment.

en_def: a mobile app or online account that stores money digitally and is used to make payments without cash or a physical card.
hi_def: एक मोबाइल ऐप या ऑनलाइन खाता जो डिजिटल रूप से पैसे रखता है और बिना नकद या भौतिक कार्ड के भुगतान करने के लिए इस्तेमाल होता है।
hi_nuance: In India, an e-wallet (like Paytm or PhonePe wallet balance) is technically distinct from UPI (which links directly to your bank account) — many learners use the two terms interchangeably, but an e-wallet needs to be 'loaded' with money first, whereas UPI transfers directly.

examples.en: I keep some money in my e-wallet for small payments.
examples.hi: मैं छोटे भुगतानों के लिए अपने ई-वॉलेट में कुछ पैसे रखता हूँ।

examples.en: Can I pay with my e-wallet instead of UPI?
examples.hi: क्या मैं यूपीआई की जगह अपने ई-वॉलेट से भुगतान कर सकता हूँ?

examples.en: My e-wallet balance is too low for this purchase.
examples.hi: इस खरीदारी के लिए मेरे ई-वॉलेट का बैलेंस बहुत कम है।

examples.en: I topped up my e-wallet before the trip.
examples.hi: यात्रा से पहले मैंने अपना ई-वॉलेट रीचार्ज किया।

examples.en: Some shops only accept a specific e-wallet, not all of them.
examples.hi: कुछ दुकानें केवल एक खास ई-वॉलेट स्वीकार करती हैं, सभी नहीं।

common_mistake.wrong: I loaded money in wallet app, so it is same as UPI.
common_mistake.right: I loaded money into my e-wallet, but that's different from UPI, which pays directly from my bank.
common_mistake.why: Learners assume all digital payment methods are identical; e-wallets hold a stored balance you must top up, while UPI moves money directly between bank accounts each time.

cloze.sentence: I don't have enough balance in my ____, so let me pay by UPI instead.

en_def: any payment made electronically, such as by card, UPI, or e-wallet, instead of cash.
hi_def: कार्ड, यूपीआई या ई-वॉलेट जैसे किसी भी इलेक्ट्रॉनिक माध्यम से किया गया भुगतान, नकद के बजाय।
hi_nuance: 'Digital payment' is the umbrella term covering UPI, cards, net banking, and e-wallets together; Indian English learners sometimes use 'online payment' and 'digital payment' as exact synonyms, but 'online' technically implies internet-based transactions specifically, while 'digital' is broader (including offline card taps).

examples.en: This shop only accepts digital payments now, no cash.
examples.hi: यह दुकान अब केवल डिजिटल भुगतान स्वीकार करती है, नकद नहीं।

examples.en: Digital payments have become very common in small towns too.
examples.hi: छोटे शहरों में भी डिजिटल भुगतान बहुत आम हो गए हैं।

examples.en: I prefer digital payment for safety reasons.
examples.hi: मैं सुरक्षा कारणों से डिजिटल भुगतान को तरजीह देता हूँ।

examples.en: The government is encouraging digital payment across India.
examples.hi: सरकार पूरे भारत में डिजिटल भुगतान को बढ़ावा दे रही है।

examples.en: Digital payment failed due to a network issue.
examples.hi: नेटवर्क की समस्या के कारण डिजिटल भुगतान असफल हो गया।

common_mistake.wrong: I am doing digital payment only, no using cash.
common_mistake.right: I only use digital payment, not cash.
common_mistake.why: Overuse of the continuous '-ing' form ('am doing,' 'using') for a general habitual truth is a common Indian English pattern carried over from Hindi's habitual aspect; English states general habits with the simple present.

cloze.sentence: More small vendors now prefer ____ over handling cash.

en_def: Equated Monthly Instalment — a fixed monthly payment used to pay off a loan or purchase over time, very common in Indian retail and finance.
hi_def: इक्वेटेड मंथली इंस्टॉलमेंट — किसी ऋण या खरीदारी को समय के साथ चुकाने के लिए तय की गई एक निश्चित मासिक किस्त।
hi_nuance: EMI is central to Indian shopping culture (phones, appliances, furniture are commonly bought 'on EMI'); learners should distinguish it from 'installment' used generally elsewhere — Indian English almost always says 'EMI,' while American English would more likely say 'monthly payment plan' or 'financing.'

examples.en: I bought this phone on EMI over six months.
examples.hi: मैंने यह फ़ोन छह महीने की ईएमआई पर खरीदा।

examples.en: The store offers zero-interest EMI on this TV.
examples.hi: दुकान इस टीवी पर बिना ब्याज की ईएमआई देती है।

examples.en: My EMI for the fridge is due on the fifth of every month.
examples.hi: फ्रिज की मेरी ईएमआई हर महीने की पाँच तारीख को देय है।

examples.en: Can I convert this purchase into EMI later?
examples.hi: क्या मैं बाद में इस खरीदारी को ईएमआई में बदल सकता हूँ?

examples.en: I missed one EMI payment and got a penalty.
examples.hi: मैंने एक ईएमआई भुगतान चूक गया और जुर्माना लगा।

common_mistake.wrong: I will pay in EMI of three months.
common_mistake.right: I will pay in three monthly EMIs.
common_mistake.why: Learners misplace the number, saying 'EMI of three months' instead of the natural order 'three-month EMI' or 'three EMIs,' mirroring Hindi's तीन महीने की ईएमआई word order.

cloze.sentence: Since I couldn't pay the full amount, I bought the fridge on ____.

en_def: an initial, upfront payment made when buying something expensive on credit or installments, with the rest paid later.
hi_def: कोई महँगी वस्तु उधार या किस्तों पर खरीदते समय पहले दिया गया प्रारंभिक भुगतान, बाकी बाद में चुकाया जाता है।
hi_nuance: In India, 'down payment' is common for big-ticket items (car, house, appliances) and works alongside EMI — you pay a down payment first, then the rest via EMI. Some learners use 'advance' and 'down payment' interchangeably, but 'advance' is a broader term, while 'down payment' specifically precedes an installment plan.

examples.en: We paid a twenty percent down payment on the car.
examples.hi: हमने कार पर बीस प्रतिशत डाउन पेमेंट दी।

examples.en: Can I reduce my down payment and pay more in EMI?
examples.hi: क्या मैं अपनी डाउन पेमेंट कम करके ईएमआई में ज़्यादा दे सकता हूँ?

examples.en: The showroom asked for a down payment before booking.
examples.hi: शोरूम ने बुकिंग से पहले डाउन पेमेंट माँगी।

examples.en: I saved up for two years for the house down payment.
examples.hi: मैंने घर की डाउन पेमेंट के लिए दो साल तक बचत की।

examples.en: Without a down payment, the monthly EMI would be much higher.
examples.hi: डाउन पेमेंट के बिना, मासिक ईएमआई कहीं ज़्यादा होगी।

common_mistake.wrong: I gave advance payment down for the bike.
common_mistake.right: I made a down payment for the bike.
common_mistake.why: Learners sometimes reorder the fixed phrase or replace it with 'advance payment down,' but the correct fixed collocation in English is 'down payment' — the word order can't be rearranged.

cloze.sentence: We need to make a ____ of fifty thousand rupees before the loan is approved.

en_def: completely sold, with no more available to buy.
hi_def: पूरी तरह बिक चुका, अब खरीदने के लिए और उपलब्ध नहीं।
hi_nuance: 'Sold out' specifically implies something that was popular and got bought up (often temporary, e.g., a festival sale item), whereas 'out of stock' is more neutral and can just mean poor restocking; Indian learners often use them interchangeably, but native speakers sometimes read 'sold out' as more urgent or exciting.

examples.en: The new phone was sold out within an hour of launch.
examples.hi: नया फ़ोन लॉन्च होने के एक घंटे के भीतर ही बिक गया।

examples.en: Sorry, this design is sold out, would you like a similar one?
examples.hi: माफ़ कीजिए, यह डिज़ाइन बिक चुका है, क्या आपको कोई मिलता-जुलता चाहिए?

examples.en: Festival discounts made everything sold out by evening.
examples.hi: त्योहार की छूट के कारण शाम तक सब कुछ बिक गया।

examples.en: The concert tickets were sold out in minutes.
examples.hi: कॉन्सर्ट के टिकट कुछ ही मिनटों में बिक गए।

examples.en: That bakery's special cake is always sold out by noon.
examples.hi: उस बेकरी का खास केक हमेशा दोपहर तक बिक जाता है।

common_mistake.wrong: All is sold out, sir, no more coming today.
common_mistake.right: Everything is sold out, sir; no more stock is coming today.
common_mistake.why: 'All is' is an unnatural calque of सब कुछ है; English typically uses 'everything is' for uncountable general reference, and 'all' alone sounds incomplete as a subject here.

cloze.sentence: By the time we reached the shop, the festival sweets were already ____.

en_def: looking at goods displayed in shop windows or browsing shops for enjoyment, without intending to buy anything.
hi_def: बिना कुछ खरीदने के इरादे से, सिर्फ मनोरंजन के लिए दुकान की खिड़कियों में सामान देखना या दुकानों में घूमना।
hi_nuance: 'Window shopping' is a fixed idiom — learners sometimes try to literally translate 'sirf dekhne aaya hoon' as 'I only came for seeing,' when the natural, idiomatic English phrase is simply 'I'm just window shopping.'

examples.en: We went window shopping at the mall over the weekend.
examples.hi: हम सप्ताहांत में मॉल में विंडो शॉपिंग करने गए।

examples.en: I'm just window shopping today, not buying anything.
examples.hi: मैं आज सिर्फ विंडो शॉपिंग कर रहा हूँ, कुछ खरीद नहीं रहा।

examples.en: Window shopping online can be just as tempting as in a mall.
examples.hi: ऑनलाइन विंडो शॉपिंग भी मॉल जितनी ही लुभावनी हो सकती है।

examples.en: She loves window shopping for jewellery even when she can't afford it.
examples.hi: उसे गहनों की विंडो शॉपिंग करना पसंद है, भले ही वह उन्हें खरीद न सके।

examples.en: After window shopping for an hour, we finally bought a small gift.
examples.hi: एक घंटे विंडो शॉपिंग करने के बाद, हमने आखिरकार एक छोटा तोहफा खरीदा।

common_mistake.wrong: I am only seeing, not purchasing anything, no shopping.
common_mistake.right: I'm just window shopping, not buying anything.
common_mistake.why: Direct translation of 'sirf dekh raha hoon' as 'only seeing' sounds unnatural; the idiomatic English equivalent for browsing without buying is 'window shopping.'

cloze.sentence: We spent the whole evening ____ at the new mall without buying a single thing.

en_def: to actively search for the lowest possible prices or best deals while shopping.
hi_def: खरीदारी के दौरान सबसे कम कीमत या सबसे अच्छे सौदे की सक्रिय खोज करना।
hi_nuance: 'Bargain hunt' (as a verb phrase 'to bargain hunt' or noun 'a bargain hunt') describes an active, deliberate search across multiple shops or sites for the best price, distinct from simply 'haggling' at one shop — learners often use only 'bargain' and miss this related, slightly different collocation about actively comparing deals.

examples.en: I love to bargain hunt during the festival season.
examples.hi: मुझे त्योहारों के मौसम में सस्ते सौदे ढूँढ़ना पसंद है।

examples.en: She went on a bargain hunt for the best mobile phone deal.
examples.hi: वह सबसे अच्छे मोबाइल फोन सौदे की तलाश में निकली।

examples.en: Bargain hunters flock to this market every winter.
examples.hi: हर सर्दी में मोल-भाव करने वाले इस बाज़ार में उमड़ पड़ते हैं।

examples.en: We spent the whole day bargain hunting for furniture.
examples.hi: हमने पूरा दिन फर्नीचर के लिए सस्ते सौदे ढूँढ़ने में बिताया।

examples.en: Online bargain hunting is easier with price comparison apps.
examples.hi: प्राइस कम्पेरिज़न ऐप के साथ ऑनलाइन सस्ते सौदे ढूँढ़ना आसान है।

common_mistake.wrong: I am doing bargain hunt for shoes since morning.
common_mistake.right: I've been bargain hunting for shoes since morning.
common_mistake.why: Learners use 'doing' with the noun form instead of the natural continuous verb form 'bargain hunting'; English prefers treating 'bargain hunt' as a compound verb in the '-ing' form, not 'do plus noun.'

cloze.sentence: During the sale season, I love going ____ for good deals on electronics.

en_def: a bound pad of pre-printed receipt slips, often with a carbon copy, used by small shopkeepers to record sales.
hi_def: पहले से छपी रसीद पर्चियों की एक बंधी हुई किताब, जिसमें अक्सर कार्बन कॉपी होती है, जिसका इस्तेमाल छोटे दुकानदार बिक्री दर्ज करने के लिए करते हैं।
hi_nuance: Small Indian shops, tailors, and local vendors still use a physical receipt book (with carbon paper duplicates) instead of printed digital receipts; learners should know this term specifically refers to the physical bound pad, not any single receipt.

examples.en: The tailor noted my order in his receipt book.
examples.hi: दर्ज़ी ने मेरा ऑर्डर अपनी रसीद बुक में लिख लिया।

examples.en: He tore a page from the receipt book and handed it to me.
examples.hi: उसने रसीद बुक से एक पन्ना फाड़कर मुझे दे दिया।

examples.en: The shop still uses a handwritten receipt book.
examples.hi: दुकान अभी भी हाथ से लिखी रसीद बुक इस्तेमाल करती है।

examples.en: I bought a new receipt book for my small stall.
examples.hi: मैंने अपने छोटे स्टॉल के लिए एक नई रसीद बुक खरीदी।

examples.en: Check the receipt book for the carbon copy of your bill.
examples.hi: अपने बिल की कार्बन कॉपी के लिए रसीद बुक देखें।

collocations: tear a page from the receipt book

common_mistake.wrong: Please write in bill book my name.
common_mistake.right: Please write my name in the receipt book.
common_mistake.why: Word order error placing the object ('my name') after the location, mirroring Hindi's flexible order; standard English places the direct object right after the verb, before the location phrase.

cloze.sentence: The vendor tore a slip from his ____ and handed me my copy.

en_def: a device used to measure the weight of goods, such as fruits, vegetables, or a person's body weight.
hi_def: वस्तुओं, जैसे फल, सब्ज़ी, या किसी व्यक्ति के शरीर के वज़न को मापने के लिए इस्तेमाल होने वाला उपकरण।
hi_nuance: In Indian shops, especially vegetable and fruit vendors, watching the weighing scale carefully is culturally significant (concerns about tampered scales are common); learners should know 'weighing scale' (or just 'scale') is standard, while 'weight machine' is a common but slightly non-standard Indian English calque, especially for bathroom or body scales.

examples.en: Please check the weighing scale before you weigh the tomatoes.
examples.hi: टमाटर तौलने से पहले कृपया तराज़ू जांच लें।

examples.en: The vendor's weighing scale looked a little off.
examples.hi: विक्रेता का तराज़ू थोड़ा गड़बड़ लग रहा था।

examples.en: I bought a digital weighing scale for the kitchen.
examples.hi: मैंने रसोई के लिए एक डिजिटल तराज़ू खरीदा।

examples.en: The market inspector checked every weighing scale in the row.
examples.hi: बाज़ार निरीक्षक ने कतार की हर तराज़ू की जांच की।

examples.en: Put the fruit on the weighing scale, please.
examples.hi: कृपया फल तराज़ू पर रखें।

common_mistake.wrong: Check on weight machine how much this is.
common_mistake.right: Check on the weighing scale how much this weighs.
common_mistake.why: 'Weight machine' is a common Indian English calque (often used for body-weight scales too), but 'weighing scale' or simply 'scale' is the more standard and widely understood English term for shop use.

cloze.sentence: The vegetable seller placed the onions on the ____ to check the weight.

en_def: something given away for free, often as a promotional gift with a purchase.
hi_def: कुछ ऐसा जो मुफ्त में दिया जाता है, अक्सर खरीदारी के साथ प्रचार के तौर पर दिया गया उपहार।
hi_nuance: 'Freebie' is informal and casual, common in spoken English and advertising ('get a freebie with every purchase'); Indian English learners sometimes use the more formal 'free gift' in all contexts, which is fine too, but 'freebie' sounds more natural in casual conversation.

examples.en: I got a nice freebie with my shampoo purchase.
examples.hi: मुझे अपने शैम्पू की खरीदारी के साथ एक अच्छी मुफ्त चीज़ मिली।

examples.en: The store gave out freebies to the first hundred customers.
examples.hi: दुकान ने पहले सौ ग्राहकों को मुफ्त उपहार बाँटे।

examples.en: This magazine comes with a freebie this month.
examples.hi: इस महीने इस पत्रिका के साथ एक मुफ्त चीज़ मिलती है।

examples.en: Everyone loves a good freebie during festival sales.
examples.hi: त्योहारों की सेल के दौरान सभी को एक अच्छी मुफ्त चीज़ पसंद आती है।

examples.en: I only bought this brand for the freebie included.
examples.hi: मैंने सिर्फ शामिल मुफ्त चीज़ के लिए यह ब्रांड खरीदा।

common_mistake.wrong: This shop is giving free of cost item with purchase.
common_mistake.right: This shop gives a freebie with every purchase.
common_mistake.why: 'Free of cost' is a common but overly formal or redundant Indian English phrase for something already implied by 'free'; casual spoken English simply says 'freebie' or 'free gift.'

cloze.sentence: I picked this brand mainly because of the ____ that came with it.

en_def: a promotional deal in which two or more products are sold together at a special combined price.
hi_def: एक प्रचारात्मक सौदा जिसमें दो या अधिक उत्पाद एक साथ विशेष संयुक्त कीमत पर बेचे जाते हैं।
hi_nuance: 'Combo offer' is widely used in Indian retail and food outlets (e.g., a burger-and-fries combo offer); it's understood internationally but Indian usage often extends it beyond fast food to almost any bundled product deal, including a phone-and-case bundle or a shampoo-and-conditioner set.

examples.en: There's a combo offer on shampoo and conditioner this week.
examples.hi: इस हफ़्ते शैम्पू और कंडीशनर पर एक कॉम्बो ऑफर है।

examples.en: I got the burger and drink combo offer for less.
examples.hi: मुझे बर्गर और ड्रिंक का कॉम्बो ऑफर कम कीमत में मिला।

examples.en: The phone came with a combo offer including a case and earphones.
examples.hi: फ़ोन एक कवर और ईयरफोन के कॉम्बो ऑफर के साथ आया।

examples.en: Check if there's a combo offer before buying them separately.
examples.hi: अलग-अलग खरीदने से पहले देखो कि कोई कॉम्बो ऑफर है क्या।

examples.en: The combo offer saved us almost two hundred rupees.
examples.hi: कॉम्बो ऑफर ने हमारे करीब दो सौ रुपये बचाए।

common_mistake.wrong: Buy both together, it is combo, cheap price for two.
common_mistake.right: There's a combo offer — buying both together is cheaper.
common_mistake.why: The learner's sentence is a rough, ungrammatical description rather than using the established fixed English term 'combo offer,' which already conveys 'bundled and discounted.'

cloze.sentence: The restaurant has a ____ where you get a burger, fries, and a drink for one price.

en_def: a small pouch or wallet used to carry coins and small notes.
hi_def: सिक्के और छोटे नोट रखने के लिए इस्तेमाल होने वाला एक छोटा थैला या पर्स।
hi_nuance: 'Change purse' (or 'coin purse') is less commonly used in everyday Indian speech than in Western English, since many Indians simply keep loose change in a regular wallet or pocket; when reading Western texts, don't confuse 'purse' here (small coin pouch) with the British meaning of 'purse' as a woman's handbag.

examples.en: She keeps all her coins in a small change purse.
examples.hi: वह अपने सारे सिक्के एक छोटे चेंज पर्स में रखती है।

examples.en: My change purse is full of one-rupee coins.
examples.hi: मेरा चेंज पर्स एक-रुपये के सिक्कों से भरा है।

examples.en: I bought a leather change purse from the market.
examples.hi: मैंने बाज़ार से एक चमड़े का चेंज पर्स खरीदा।

examples.en: He keeps his change purse in his shirt pocket.
examples.hi: वह अपना चेंज पर्स अपनी शर्ट की जेब में रखता है।

examples.en: The change purse zipper is broken.
examples.hi: चेंज पर्स की ज़िप टूटी हुई है।

common_mistake.wrong: Put in my purse the coins, I have small bag.
common_mistake.right: Put the coins in my change purse — I have a small pouch for them.
common_mistake.why: Word order error and vague vocabulary ('small bag') instead of the specific, natural English term 'change purse'; also object-location order needs correcting, as in other similar examples.

cloze.sentence: I keep all my spare coins in a little ____ so they don't get lost in my bag.

en_def: to purchase a large quantity of something at once, often to get a lower price per unit.
hi_def: एक साथ किसी चीज़ की बड़ी मात्रा खरीदना, अक्सर प्रति इकाई कम कीमत पाने के लिए।
hi_nuance: 'Bulk buy' can be a verb ('we bulk buy rice every month') or a noun ('a bulk buy of rice'); Indian households commonly bulk buy staples like rice, dal, and oil monthly — learners sometimes only know 'wholesale' and don't realize 'bulk buy' describes the consumer act of buying a lot at once, even at a regular retail shop.

examples.en: We bulk buy rice and lentils every month to save money.
examples.hi: हम पैसे बचाने के लिए हर महीने चावल और दाल थोक में खरीदते हैं।

examples.en: It's cheaper to bulk buy toiletries online.
examples.hi: टॉयलेटरीज़ को ऑनलाइन थोक में खरीदना सस्ता पड़ता है।

examples.en: The shop gives a discount if you bulk buy soap.
examples.hi: अगर आप साबुन थोक में खरीदें तो दुकान छूट देती है।

examples.en: We did a bulk buy of notebooks before the school year started.
examples.hi: स्कूल शुरू होने से पहले हमने नोटबुक की थोक खरीदारी की।

examples.en: Bulk buying reduces the number of trips to the store.
examples.hi: थोक में खरीदने से दुकान के चक्कर कम लगते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I purchase in much quantity to get less price.
common_mistake.right: I buy in bulk to get a lower price.
common_mistake.why: This is an awkward literal translation avoiding the natural fixed phrase 'buy in bulk' or 'bulk buy'; English has a specific idiomatic expression for this that direct word-for-word translation misses.

cloze.sentence: We always ____ rice and pulses once a month to save on the per-kilo price.

en_def: the date printed on packaged food indicating the period during which it is expected to be at its best quality (different from a strict expiry date).
hi_def: पैक किए गए खाद्य पदार्थ पर छपी वह तारीख जो बताती है कि किस अवधि तक वह अपनी सर्वोत्तम गुणवत्ता में रहेगा, यह सख्त एक्सपायरी तारीख से अलग है।
hi_nuance: Many Indian consumers treat 'best before' and 'expiry date' as identical, but technically 'best before' means quality may decline after that date, not that the food is necessarily unsafe, while an 'expiry date' (or 'use by') on medicines and some perishables is a stricter safety cutoff — worth knowing the distinction when reading labels.

examples.en: Check the best before date on the milk packet.
examples.hi: दूध के पैकेट पर बेस्ट बिफोर डेट देख लो।

examples.en: This best before date has already passed, but it might still be fine.
examples.hi: यह बेस्ट बिफोर डेट पहले ही निकल चुकी है, पर शायद फिर भी ठीक हो।

examples.en: The shopkeeper checks the best before date before restocking.
examples.hi: दुकानदार दोबारा स्टॉक करने से पहले बेस्ट बिफोर डेट जांचता है।

examples.en: Always look at the best before date, not just the price, when buying snacks.
examples.hi: नाश्ता खरीदते समय हमेशा सिर्फ कीमत नहीं, बेस्ट बिफोर डेट भी देखो।

examples.en: The biscuits are close to their best before date, so they're on discount.
examples.hi: बिस्किट अपनी बेस्ट बिफोर डेट के करीब हैं, इसलिए वे छूट पर हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: This item date is finish, don't buy, it is bad.
common_mistake.right: This item's best before date has passed, so its quality might not be ideal.
common_mistake.why: 'Date is finish' is a rough Hindi calque (तारीख खत्म हो गई) without proper English grammar; also, passing the best-before date doesn't always mean the item is unsafe, unlike a true expiry date.

cloze.sentence: Always check the ____ on packaged snacks before buying them.

en_def: the rules a store sets for accepting returned or exchanged goods, including time limits and conditions.
hi_def: वे नियम जो कोई दुकान वापस या बदले गए सामान को स्वीकार करने के लिए तय करती है, जिसमें समय सीमा और शर्तें शामिल होती हैं।
hi_nuance: Return policies vary widely between Indian shops — many small stores have a strict no-return, no-exchange policy, especially on sale items, while large retailers and e-commerce sites offer generous return windows; learners should always ask what the return policy is before assuming they can return something, since assumptions from one store don't carry over to another.

examples.en: What's your return policy on electronics?
examples.hi: इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स पर आपकी वापसी नीति क्या है?

examples.en: This store has a strict no-return policy on sale items.
examples.hi: इस दुकान की सेल के सामान पर सख्त नो-रिटर्न नीति है।

examples.en: The return policy allows exchanges within fifteen days.
examples.hi: वापसी नीति के तहत पंद्रह दिनों के भीतर बदलाव किया जा सकता है।

examples.en: Read the return policy carefully before buying online.
examples.hi: ऑनलाइन खरीदने से पहले वापसी नीति ध्यान से पढ़ लो।

examples.en: Their return policy requires the original packaging.
examples.hi: उनकी वापसी नीति के लिए मूल पैकिंग ज़रूरी है।

common_mistake.wrong: What is return, if I don't like?
common_mistake.right: What is your return policy if I don't like the item?
common_mistake.why: Dropping the noun 'policy' and articles produces a fragmented, unclear question; English requires the full phrase 'return policy' to sound like a proper, complete question in this context.

cloze.sentence: Before buying online, I always check the ____ in case the item doesn't fit.

en_def: a formal, detailed document listing goods or services provided, their prices, and the total amount due, often used for business or larger purchases.
hi_def: सामान या सेवाओं, उनकी कीमतों और देय कुल राशि को सूचीबद्ध करने वाला एक औपचारिक, विस्तृत दस्तावेज़, जो अक्सर व्यापार या बड़ी खरीदारी के लिए इस्तेमाल होता है।
hi_nuance: 'Invoice' is more formal and detailed than a simple cash memo or receipt — it typically includes a GST or tax breakdown, itemized costs, and business details, and is often needed for warranty claims, reimbursements, or company expense reports, whereas a plain receipt is just proof of payment.

examples.en: Please email me the GST invoice for this purchase.
examples.hi: कृपया इस खरीदारी की जीएसटी इनवॉइस मुझे ईमेल कर दें।

examples.en: I need the invoice to claim reimbursement from my office.
examples.hi: मुझे अपने ऑफिस से रीइम्बर्समेंट क्लेम करने के लिए इनवॉइस चाहिए।

examples.en: The invoice shows a separate line for tax.
examples.hi: इनवॉइस में टैक्स के लिए अलग लाइन दिखाई गई है।

examples.en: Keep the invoice safe for warranty purposes.
examples.hi: वारंटी के लिए इनवॉइस संभालकर रखें।

examples.en: The supplier sent the invoice a week after delivery.
examples.hi: आपूर्तिकर्ता ने डिलीवरी के एक हफ़्ते बाद इनवॉइस भेजी।

common_mistake.wrong: Give me bill only, not this invoice thing, same-same.
common_mistake.right: The invoice and the bill can be similar, but an invoice is usually more detailed, with tax and item breakdowns.
common_mistake.why: Learners treat 'bill,' 'receipt,' and 'invoice' as fully interchangeable ('same-same'), but in professional or business contexts, 'invoice' specifically implies a detailed, itemized document, often needed for accounting or reimbursement.

cloze.sentence: For office reimbursement, I need a proper GST ____, not just a simple receipt.

en_def: the place, often a window, where you buy travel tickets
hi_def: टिकट काउंटर (टिकट खरीदने की जगह/खिड़की)
hi_nuance: Indian speakers often say 'ticket window' interchangeably with 'ticket counter'; both are understood locally, but 'counter' is the more standard word for a booth internationally. Some learners drop the word 'counter' entirely and just say 'ticket', which sounds incomplete in full English sentences.

examples.en: The queue at the ticket counter was very long this morning.
examples.hi: आज सुबह टिकट काउंटर पर बहुत लंबी लाइन थी।

examples.en: Please buy your ticket from counter number 3, not counter 5.
examples.hi: कृपया काउंटर नंबर 3 से टिकट लें, काउंटर नंबर 5 से नहीं।

examples.en: I reached the station early to avoid the rush at the ticket counter.
examples.hi: मैं टिकट काउंटर की भीड़ से बचने के लिए स्टेशन जल्दी पहुँचा।

examples.en: The ticket counter closes ten minutes before the train departs.
examples.hi: टिकट काउंटर ट्रेन के चलने से दस मिनट पहले बंद हो जाता है।

examples.en: She asked the clerk at the ticket counter for a window seat.
examples.hi: उसने टिकट काउंटर पर क्लर्क से खिड़की वाली सीट माँगी।

common_mistake.wrong: Go and stand in ticket.
common_mistake.right: Go and stand in the queue at the ticket counter.
common_mistake.why: Hindi speakers sometimes drop 'counter'/'queue' and just say 'ticket', assuming context is clear, but English needs the full noun phrase.

cloze.sentence: We waited twenty minutes at the ____ before we got our tickets.

en_def: to reserve and pay for a ticket in advance
hi_def: टिकट बुक करना (पहले से टिकट आरक्षित करना)
hi_nuance: Many Hindi speakers say 'I will book my ticket' correctly, but also mix it up with 'reserve'; in India 'reservation' is used specifically for train berths, while 'book' is used more generally for flights and buses. Saying 'I booked' alone without any object also sounds incomplete in English.

examples.en: I need to book a ticket for the Rajdhani Express to Delhi.
examples.hi: मुझे दिल्ली जाने वाली राजधानी एक्सप्रेस के लिए टिकट बुक करनी है।

examples.en: Can you book a ticket for me on the six o'clock flight?
examples.hi: क्या तुम मेरे लिए छह बजे की फ़्लाइट का टिकट बुक कर सकते हो?

examples.en: We booked our tickets online three months before the trip.
examples.hi: हमने यात्रा से तीन महीने पहले ऑनलाइन टिकट बुक कर लिए थे।

examples.en: He forgot to book a ticket, so he had to travel in the general compartment.
examples.hi: वह टिकट बुक करना भूल गया, इसलिए उसे जनरल डिब्बे में यात्रा करनी पड़ी।

examples.en: I always book my train tickets on the IRCTC app.
examples.hi: मैं हमेशा अपने ट्रेन के टिकट IRCTC ऐप पर बुक करता हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: I will book my ticket in the last moment.
common_mistake.right: I will book my ticket at the last moment.
common_mistake.why: Hindi speakers often say 'in the last moment' translating the Hindi phrase literally; the correct English idiom is 'at the last moment'.

cloze.sentence: I forgot to ____ for the concert, so now there are no seats left.

en_def: the raised path beside the railway track where passengers wait for and board trains
hi_def: प्लेटफ़ॉर्म (रेलवे स्टेशन पर वह जगह जहाँ यात्री ट्रेन का इंतज़ार करते हैं)
hi_nuance: Indian English commonly says 'platform number' when checking arrivals, and platform numbers can change suddenly close to departure, so learners should be comfortable with 'the platform has changed' rather than the incorrect 'the platform is change'. British English uses 'platform', while American English usually says 'track' for the same concept.

examples.en: Which platform does the Shatabdi Express leave from?
examples.hi: शताब्दी एक्सप्रेस किस प्लेटफ़ॉर्म से जाती है?

examples.en: We ran across the bridge to reach platform number two.
examples.hi: हम प्लेटफ़ॉर्म नंबर दो तक पहुँचने के लिए पुल पार दौड़े।

examples.en: The train arrived on platform four instead of platform one.
examples.hi: ट्रेन प्लेटफ़ॉर्म एक की बजाय प्लेटफ़ॉर्म चार पर आई।

examples.en: Please wait on the platform; the train is ten minutes late.
examples.hi: कृपया प्लेटफ़ॉर्म पर इंतज़ार करें; ट्रेन दस मिनट देर से है।

examples.en: Announcements said the platform had changed at the last minute.
examples.hi: घोषणा में बताया गया कि प्लेटफ़ॉर्म आख़िरी समय पर बदल गया।

common_mistake.wrong: The platform is change.
common_mistake.right: The platform has changed.
common_mistake.why: Hindi speakers often drop the auxiliary verb and past participle ending, saying 'is change' instead of 'has changed'.

cloze.sentence: The Mumbai train will now leave from ____ number six instead of two.

en_def: a separate section inside a train coach where passengers sit or sleep
hi_def: डिब्बा, कम्पार्टमेंट (ट्रेन के कोच का एक हिस्सा)
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often use 'compartment' and 'coach' interchangeably, but strictly 'coach' names the whole carriage (like S4 or B2), while 'compartment' refers to a section inside it. The word is also used for storage areas in cars, such as the 'glove compartment', a sense some learners don't recognise.

examples.en: Our compartment had eight berths and a small window.
examples.hi: हमारे डिब्बे में आठ बर्थ और एक छोटी खिड़की थी।

examples.en: The ladies' compartment is usually near the middle of the train.
examples.hi: महिलाओं का डिब्बा आमतौर पर ट्रेन के बीच में होता है।

examples.en: We found our seats in compartment S4 after checking the chart.
examples.hi: चार्ट देखने के बाद हमें डिब्बा S4 में अपनी सीटें मिलीं।

examples.en: The compartment was crowded, so we stood near the door.
examples.hi: डिब्बा भीड़भाड़ वाला था, इसलिए हम दरवाज़े के पास खड़े हो गए।

examples.en: Please keep the compartment door closed when the train is moving.
examples.hi: जब ट्रेन चल रही हो तो कृपया डिब्बे का दरवाज़ा बंद रखें।

common_mistake.wrong: I am sitting in coach compartment number S4.
common_mistake.right: I am sitting in coach S4.
common_mistake.why: Hindi speakers often say 'coach compartment' together, but in Indian Railways usage 'coach' already names the section (S4, B2); 'compartment' is not usually added before the code.

cloze.sentence: There were only four passengers in our ____ , so we all had space to sleep.

en_def: a fixed bed or bunk for a passenger on a train or ship
hi_def: बर्थ, सीट (ट्रेन या जहाज़ पर सोने की जगह)
hi_nuance: Indian Railways uses specific terms like 'lower berth', 'upper berth' and 'side lower' that don't have a single direct Hindi equivalent, so learners sometimes translate awkwardly, saying 'upper seat' instead of 'upper berth'. Confusing the spelling of 'berth' (a sleeping place) with 'birth' (being born) is also extremely common since the two words sound identical.

examples.en: I always request a lower berth because climbing up is difficult for my mother.
examples.hi: मैं हमेशा लोअर बर्थ माँगता हूँ क्योंकि मेरी माँ के लिए ऊपर चढ़ना मुश्किल है।

examples.en: We got side upper and side lower berths for the overnight journey.
examples.hi: रात भर की यात्रा के लिए हमें साइड अपर और साइड लोअर बर्थ मिलीं।

examples.en: The TT asked to see our tickets before confirming the berth.
examples.hi: TT ने बर्थ कन्फ़र्म करने से पहले हमारे टिकट देखने को कहा।

examples.en: Please fold up the middle berth during the day so people can sit.
examples.hi: दिन में कृपया बीच वाली बर्थ मोड़ दें ताकि लोग बैठ सकें।

examples.en: My berth was right next to the window, so I could see the sunrise.
examples.hi: मेरी बर्थ खिड़की के ठीक बगल में थी, इसलिए मैं सूर्योदय देख सका।

common_mistake.wrong: I have a confirmed birth on the Duronto Express.
common_mistake.right: I have a confirmed berth on the Duronto Express.
common_mistake.why: 'Berth' (a sleeping place) and 'birth' (being born) sound identical but are spelled differently; Hindi speakers often confuse the spelling in writing.

cloze.sentence: Could you please swap seats with me? I have the upper ____ and my knee is injured.

en_def: an arrangement made in advance to secure a seat, berth or table
hi_def: आरक्षण, रिज़र्वेशन (पहले से सीट या जगह सुनिश्चित करना)
hi_nuance: In Indian English, 'reservation' is used heavily for train seats and also for caste-based quota systems in education and jobs, which can confuse learners about which meaning applies in a given context. Saying 'I did reservation' instead of 'I made a reservation' is a common calque from the Hindi phrase 'रिज़र्वेशन किया'.

examples.en: I made a reservation for two berths on the Howrah Mail.
examples.hi: मैंने हावड़ा मेल में दो बर्थ के लिए रिज़र्वेशन करवाया।

examples.en: Without reservation, you may have to stand for the whole journey.
examples.hi: रिज़र्वेशन के बिना, आपको पूरी यात्रा खड़े होकर करनी पड़ सकती है।

examples.en: Our reservation was confirmed only a day before departure.
examples.hi: हमारा रिज़र्वेशन प्रस्थान से केवल एक दिन पहले कन्फ़र्म हुआ।

examples.en: She checked her reservation status online before leaving for the station.
examples.hi: स्टेशन जाने से पहले उसने अपने रिज़र्वेशन का स्टेटस ऑनलाइन देखा।

examples.en: The restaurant would not seat us without a reservation on weekends.
examples.hi: सप्ताहांत में रेस्टोरेंट बिना रिज़र्वेशन के हमें सीट नहीं देता था।

common_mistake.wrong: I did the reservation yesterday.
common_mistake.right: I made the reservation yesterday.
common_mistake.why: Hindi speakers often translate 'किया' as 'did', but the correct collocation in English is 'make a reservation', not 'do a reservation'.

cloze.sentence: You should ____ early for Diwali, because trains fill up fast.

en_def: a list of people who will get a seat or ticket only if someone else cancels
hi_def: प्रतीक्षा सूची, वेटिंग लिस्ट (जिन लोगों को टिकट रद्द होने पर ही सीट मिलेगी)
hi_nuance: Indian Railways uses precise sub-terms like RAC, GNWL and PQWL that learners often lump together simply as 'waiting list', which is fine casually but can confuse foreign colleagues if not explained. Indian English colloquially shortens 'on the waiting list' to 'in waiting', a phrase non-Indian English speakers may not understand.

examples.en: My ticket is on the waiting list, number twelve.
examples.hi: मेरा टिकट वेटिंग लिस्ट में है, नंबर बारह।

examples.en: The waiting list usually clears once a few passengers cancel.
examples.hi: कुछ यात्रियों के टिकट रद्द होते ही वेटिंग लिस्ट आमतौर पर साफ़ हो जाती है।

examples.en: We checked the waiting list status every hour before the journey.
examples.hi: यात्रा से पहले हम हर घंटे वेटिंग लिस्ट का स्टेटस देखते रहे।

examples.en: Being on the waiting list means we might not get a confirmed seat.
examples.hi: वेटिंग लिस्ट में होने का मतलब है कि हमें कन्फ़र्म सीट नहीं भी मिल सकती।

examples.en: He moved up the waiting list after two cancellations.
examples.hi: दो टिकट रद्द होने के बाद वह वेटिंग लिस्ट में आगे बढ़ गया।

common_mistake.wrong: I am in waiting for this train.
common_mistake.right: I am on the waiting list for this train.
common_mistake.why: Indian English colloquially shortens 'on the waiting list' to 'in waiting', which non-Indian English speakers may not understand.

cloze.sentence: Don't worry if your ticket shows ____ — it often gets confirmed by the day of travel.

en_def: an emergency train ticket booked shortly before departure at a higher fare, through Indian Railways' quick-booking scheme
hi_def: तत्काल टिकट (यात्रा से एक दिन पहले अधिक शुल्क देकर बुक किया गया आपातकालीन टिकट)
hi_nuance: This is an India-specific term with no exact English equivalent, so learners can use it as-is even in English conversation, but should be ready to explain it to foreigners as 'an emergency, last-minute ticket'. Some learners also drop 'ticket' after 'tatkal', or use unnatural phrasing like 'in the last time' instead of 'at the last minute'.

examples.en: We had to book a tatkal ticket because the regular quota was full.
examples.hi: हमें तत्काल टिकट बुक करनी पड़ी क्योंकि सामान्य कोटा भरा हुआ था।

examples.en: Tatkal tickets open exactly at ten in the morning, one day before travel.
examples.hi: तत्काल टिकट यात्रा से एक दिन पहले ठीक सुबह दस बजे खुलती हैं।

examples.en: The tatkal ticket cost almost double the normal fare.
examples.hi: तत्काल टिकट की कीमत सामान्य किराए से लगभग दोगुनी थी।

examples.en: I set an alarm to book the tatkal ticket the moment the window opened.
examples.hi: मैंने विंडो खुलते ही तत्काल टिकट बुक करने के लिए अलार्म लगाया।

examples.en: Even the tatkal ticket showed a waiting list for that train.
examples.hi: उस ट्रेन के लिए तत्काल टिकट में भी वेटिंग लिस्ट दिख रही थी।

common_mistake.wrong: I got a tatkal in the last time.
common_mistake.right: I got a tatkal ticket at the last minute.
common_mistake.why: Learners often drop 'ticket' after 'tatkal' and use 'in the last time' instead of the correct idiom 'at the last minute'.

cloze.sentence: The regular tickets were sold out, so we booked a ____ instead.

en_def: a document, paper or digital, that allows a passenger to board a flight
hi_def: बोर्डिंग पास (हवाई जहाज़ में चढ़ने की अनुमति देने वाला दस्तावेज़)
hi_nuance: Confusion between 'ticket' and 'boarding pass' is common; the flight ticket is proof of booking, while the boarding pass is issued at check-in and required at the gate. Some learners say 'boarding ticket' instead of the correct term 'boarding pass'.

examples.en: Please keep your boarding pass ready before security check.
examples.hi: सुरक्षा जाँच से पहले कृपया अपना बोर्डिंग पास तैयार रखें।

examples.en: I printed my boarding pass at the kiosk to save time.
examples.hi: मैंने समय बचाने के लिए कियोस्क पर अपना बोर्डिंग पास प्रिंट किया।

examples.en: The gate number is printed clearly on the boarding pass.
examples.hi: गेट नंबर बोर्डिंग पास पर साफ़ छपा होता है।

examples.en: She lost her boarding pass and had to get a new one from the counter.
examples.hi: उसका बोर्डिंग पास खो गया और उसे काउंटर से नया लेना पड़ा।

examples.en: You cannot enter the security area without a boarding pass.
examples.hi: बोर्डिंग पास के बिना आप सुरक्षा क्षेत्र में नहीं जा सकते।

common_mistake.wrong: Show me your boarding ticket, sir.
common_mistake.right: Show me your boarding pass, sir.
common_mistake.why: Learners often mix 'ticket' and 'pass'; the correct term used at airports worldwide is 'boarding pass', not 'boarding ticket'.

cloze.sentence: Don't forget to download your ____ before you reach the airport.

en_def: happening or arriving later than the scheduled time
hi_def: विलंबित, देरी से (तय समय से देर से)
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'the flight is late' and 'the flight is delayed' as if identical, but 'delayed' specifically implies a scheduled change announced in advance, while 'late' can just mean it has not arrived yet. A common error is 'my flight got late' instead of the correct 'my flight was delayed'.

examples.en: Our flight to Bengaluru was delayed by two hours due to fog.
examples.hi: कोहरे के कारण बेंगलुरु जाने वाली हमारी फ़्लाइट दो घंटे देरी से चली।

examples.en: The train is delayed and will now arrive at platform three.
examples.hi: ट्रेन देरी से है और अब प्लेटफ़ॉर्म तीन पर आएगी।

examples.en: Passengers on the delayed flight were given food vouchers.
examples.hi: देरी वाली फ़्लाइट के यात्रियों को खाने के वाउचर दिए गए।

examples.en: Heavy rain in Mumbai delayed several flights this morning.
examples.hi: मुंबई में भारी बारिश के कारण आज सुबह कई फ़्लाइटें देर से हुईं।

examples.en: I messaged my manager that I would be delayed because of the traffic jam.
examples.hi: मैंने अपने मैनेजर को मैसेज किया कि ट्रैफ़िक जाम के कारण मुझे देर हो जाएगी।

common_mistake.wrong: My flight got late by three hours.
common_mistake.right: My flight was delayed by three hours.
common_mistake.why: Hindi speakers translate 'देर हो गई' as 'got late', but the standard English collocation for flights and trains is 'was delayed'.

cloze.sentence: The 9 a.m. flight to Delhi has been ____ due to bad weather.

en_def: a flight that will not operate as scheduled and is called off entirely
hi_def: उड़ान रद्द (फ़्लाइट का पूरी तरह से रद्द होना)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes confuse 'delayed' (still happening, just later) with 'cancelled' (not happening at all), using them interchangeably when panicking at the airport. Note the British spelling 'cancelled' (used in India) versus the American spelling 'canceled'.

examples.en: Our flight was cancelled at the last minute because of a technical fault.
examples.hi: तकनीकी खराबी के कारण हमारी फ़्लाइट आख़िरी समय पर रद्द हो गई।

examples.en: The airline sent an SMS saying the evening flight to Chennai was cancelled.
examples.hi: एयरलाइन ने SMS भेजा कि चेन्नई जाने वाली शाम की फ़्लाइट रद्द कर दी गई है।

examples.en: When the flight got cancelled, we had to book train tickets instead.
examples.hi: जब फ़्लाइट रद्द हुई, तो हमें इसके बजाय ट्रेन के टिकट बुक करने पड़े।

examples.en: Many flights were cancelled during the heavy Delhi fog last winter.
examples.hi: पिछली सर्दियों में दिल्ली के घने कोहरे के दौरान कई फ़्लाइटें रद्द हुई थीं।

examples.en: I asked for a full refund since my flight was cancelled by the airline.
examples.hi: चूँकि मेरी फ़्लाइट एयरलाइन ने रद्द कर दी थी, मैंने पूरा रिफ़ंड माँगा।

common_mistake.wrong: My flight was cancel because of fog.
common_mistake.right: My flight was cancelled because of fog.
common_mistake.why: Learners often drop the past participle '-ed' ending in passive constructions, saying the base form 'cancel' instead of 'cancelled'.

cloze.sentence: We looked at the departure board and saw '____' next to our flight number.

en_def: a second flight that continues your journey to the final destination after changing planes
hi_def: संयोजक उड़ान, कनेक्टिंग फ़्लाइट (जहाँ यात्री विमान बदलकर आगे की यात्रा करते हैं)
hi_nuance: Learners often confuse 'connecting flight' with 'direct flight', or assume any flight with a stop is automatically a 'connecting flight' even when passengers don't change planes. Also common to say 'connection flight' instead of the correct adjective form 'connecting flight'.

examples.en: I have a connecting flight from Dubai to London after landing there.
examples.hi: दुबई पहुँचने के बाद मुझे लंदन के लिए एक कनेक्टिंग फ़्लाइट पकड़नी है।

examples.en: We missed our connecting flight because the first one was delayed.
examples.hi: हमारी कनेक्टिंग फ़्लाइट छूट गई क्योंकि पहली फ़्लाइट देरी से थी।

examples.en: Please check whether your ticket includes a connecting flight or is direct.
examples.hi: कृपया देख लें कि आपके टिकट में कनेक्टिंग फ़्लाइट है या यह सीधी है।

examples.en: The airline rebooked us on the next connecting flight to Frankfurt.
examples.hi: एयरलाइन ने हमें फ्रैंकफ़र्ट की अगली कनेक्टिंग फ़्लाइट में दोबारा बुक कर दिया।

examples.en: Our layover was only forty minutes, so we ran to catch the connecting flight.
examples.hi: हमारा लेओवर केवल चालीस मिनट का था, इसलिए हम कनेक्टिंग फ़्लाइट पकड़ने के लिए दौड़े।

common_mistake.wrong: I have a connection flight to London.
common_mistake.right: I have a connecting flight to London.
common_mistake.why: Learners often use the noun 'connection' as an adjective; the correct adjective form before 'flight' is 'connecting'.

cloze.sentence: Because our first flight landed late, we almost missed our ____ to Singapore.

en_def: a period of waiting between two flights at a connecting airport
hi_def: लेओवर, ठहराव (दो उड़ानों के बीच हवाई अड्डे पर इंतज़ार का समय)
hi_nuance: American English prefers 'layover'; British English often uses 'stopover', so an Indian learner may hear both depending on the airline. Learners sometimes confuse a layover (short wait, usually can't leave the transit area) with a stopover (can be longer, sometimes overnight, may leave the airport).

examples.en: We had a six-hour layover in Dubai on our way to New York.
examples.hi: न्यूयॉर्क जाते समय हमारा दुबई में छह घंटे का लेओवर था।

examples.en: During the layover, we grabbed some food near the gate.
examples.hi: लेओवर के दौरान हमने गेट के पास कुछ खाना खाया।

examples.en: A long layover let us rest before the second leg of the trip.
examples.hi: लंबे लेओवर ने हमें यात्रा के दूसरे हिस्से से पहले आराम करने दिया।

examples.en: The airline gave us a hotel voucher for the overnight layover.
examples.hi: एयरलाइन ने रात भर के लेओवर के लिए हमें होटल वाउचर दिया।

examples.en: I always carry a book for long layovers at busy airports.
examples.hi: मैं व्यस्त हवाई अड्डों पर लंबे लेओवर के लिए हमेशा एक किताब साथ रखता हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: We have a two hours layover in Doha.
common_mistake.right: We have a two-hour layover in Doha.
common_mistake.why: Hindi speakers often forget to hyphenate and singularise the number-noun compound; before a noun it should be 'two-hour', not 'two hours'.

cloze.sentence: Our ____ in Singapore was so long that we left the airport to see the city.

en_def: the airline desk where passengers show their ticket and ID and drop off luggage before a flight
hi_def: चेक-इन काउंटर (हवाई अड्डे पर सामान जमा करने और यात्रा दस्तावेज़ दिखाने की जगह)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'check-in' alone without 'counter', which is fine informally, but the full phrase is clearer for beginners. Confusing airport 'check-in' (before departure) with hotel 'check-out' (when leaving) is another common slip.

examples.en: The check-in counter for our flight opens two hours before departure.
examples.hi: हमारी फ़्लाइट का चेक-इन काउंटर प्रस्थान से दो घंटे पहले खुलता है।

examples.en: We reached the check-in counter just before it closed.
examples.hi: हम चेक-इन काउंटर बंद होने से ठीक पहले पहुँचे।

examples.en: Please have your passport ready at the check-in counter.
examples.hi: कृपया चेक-इन काउंटर पर अपना पासपोर्ट तैयार रखें।

examples.en: The airline has separate check-in counters for business class passengers.
examples.hi: एयरलाइन के पास बिज़नेस क्लास यात्रियों के लिए अलग चेक-इन काउंटर हैं।

examples.en: There was a long queue at the check-in counter during the holiday rush.
examples.hi: छुट्टियों की भीड़ के दौरान चेक-इन काउंटर पर लंबी लाइन थी।

common_mistake.wrong: We reached the check-out for our flight.
common_mistake.right: We reached the check-in counter for our flight.
common_mistake.why: Learners confuse hotel 'check-out' with airport 'check-in'; at airports before a flight, passengers always 'check in', not 'check out'.

cloze.sentence: International passengers must reach the ____ at least three hours before the flight.

en_def: the area in an airport where passengers collect their checked luggage after landing
hi_def: बैगेज क्लेम (हवाई अड्डे पर सामान लेने की जगह)
hi_nuance: British English often says 'baggage reclaim', while American English says 'baggage claim'; Indian airports typically use 'baggage claim' on signage. Some learners say 'luggage collection', which is understandable but less standard on international signage.

examples.en: Our suitcases took almost thirty minutes to appear at baggage claim.
examples.hi: हमारे सूटकेस बैगेज क्लेम पर आने में लगभग तीस मिनट लगे।

examples.en: Follow the signs to baggage claim after immigration.
examples.hi: इमिग्रेशन के बाद बैगेज क्लेम की तरफ़ इशारों का पालन करें।

examples.en: I waited at baggage claim number four for my bag.
examples.hi: मैं अपने बैग के लिए बैगेज क्लेम नंबर चार पर इंतज़ार करता रहा।
