hi_nuance: OTP is used correctly almost everywhere in India, but security-conscious speakers should be careful with the surrounding sentence: people often say 'share your OTP' casually, even though banks and IT security teams repeatedly warn 'never share your OTP with anyone' — worth using precisely in professional/security contexts, e.g. distinguishing 'enter the OTP' (correct, self) from 'share the OTP' (risky, gives it to someone else).

examples.en: I didn't receive the OTP, so I couldn't complete the payment.
examples.hi: मुझे ओटीपी नहीं मिला, इसलिए मैं भुगतान पूरा नहीं कर पाया।

examples.en: Never share your OTP with anyone, even if they claim to be from the bank.
examples.hi: अपना ओटीपी किसी के साथ साझा मत करो, चाहे वे बैंक से होने का दावा करें।

examples.en: Please enter the OTP sent to your registered mobile number.
examples.hi: कृपया अपने पंजीकृत मोबाइल नंबर पर भेजा गया ओटीपी दर्ज करें।

examples.en: The OTP expired before I could type it in.
examples.hi: मैं टाइप कर पाता, उससे पहले ही ओटीपी की समय-सीमा ख़त्म हो गई।

examples.en: As a security engineer, I always tell my family not to share OTPs on calls.
examples.hi: एक सिक्योरिटी इंजीनियर होने के नाते, मैं हमेशा अपने परिवार को कॉल पर ओटीपी साझा न करने के लिए कहता हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: He asked for my OTP, so I told him.
common_mistake.right: He asked for my OTP, but I refused to share it.
common_mistake.why: A common and dangerous mistake is treating an OTP request as a normal favour; genuine banks never ask you to share an OTP over a call, so the safe sentence always pairs 'OTP' with refusing to share it, not giving it out.

cloze.sentence: The bank sent a six-digit ____ to confirm the transaction.

en_def: the process of confirming identity by entering a one-time password sent to a phone or email
hi_def: ओटीपी सत्यापन (फ़ोन या ईमेल पर भेजे गए वन-टाइम पासवर्ड को दर्ज करके पहचान की पुष्टि करने की प्रक्रिया)
hi_nuance: This is a fairly technical compound and Hindi speakers generally use it correctly, but some say 'OTP verify' instead of 'OTP verification', treating it like a verb directly — in English 'verification' (noun) is needed after 'OTP', while 'verify' is the verb used separately, as in 'verify the OTP', not 'do OTP verify'.

examples.en: The app requires OTP verification every time I log in from a new device.
examples.hi: यह ऐप हर बार नए डिवाइस से लॉगिन करने पर ओटीपी सत्यापन माँगता है।

examples.en: OTP verification failed because I entered the code too late.
examples.hi: ओटीपी सत्यापन असफल हो गया क्योंकि मैंने कोड बहुत देर से डाला।

examples.en: Banks use OTP verification as a second layer of security.
examples.hi: बैंक सुरक्षा की दूसरी परत के रूप में ओटीपी सत्यापन का इस्तेमाल करते हैं।

examples.en: After OTP verification, you'll be redirected to your account dashboard.
examples.hi: ओटीपी सत्यापन के बाद, तुम्हें तुम्हारे अकाउंट डैशबोर्ड पर भेज दिया जाएगा।

examples.en: Our security team recommends OTP verification for all sensitive apps.
examples.hi: हमारी सिक्योरिटी टीम सभी संवेदनशील ऐप्स के लिए ओटीपी सत्यापन की सलाह देती है।

common_mistake.wrong: Please do OTP verify first.
common_mistake.right: Please complete the OTP verification first.
common_mistake.why: 'Verify' is a verb and 'verification' is a noun; the fixed phrase uses the noun form after 'OTP' — you 'complete OTP verification' or 'verify the OTP', not 'do OTP verify'.

cloze.sentence: You can't reset your password until you finish ____.

en_def: to create a new password for an account, usually after forgetting the old one
hi_def: पासवर्ड रीसेट करना (पुराना पासवर्ड भूल जाने पर नया पासवर्ड बनाना)
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes say 'change your password' when they actually mean starting fresh after forgetting it — 'reset' specifically implies you couldn't remember the old one and need a new process (often via OTP/email link), while 'change' implies you already know the old password and are simply updating it voluntarily. Security engineers should keep this distinction clear.

examples.en: I forgot my password, so I had to reset it using my email.
examples.hi: मैं अपना पासवर्ड भूल गया, इसलिए मुझे उसे अपने ईमेल के ज़रिए रीसेट करना पड़ा।

examples.en: Click here to reset your password if you can't log in.
examples.hi: अगर तुम लॉगिन नहीं कर पा रहे हो तो यहाँ क्लिक करके अपना पासवर्ड रीसेट करो।

examples.en: The IT team asked everyone to reset their passwords after the breach.
examples.hi: आईटी टीम ने डेटा सेंध के बाद सबको अपना पासवर्ड रीसेट करने को कहा।

examples.en: You'll receive a link to reset your password within a few minutes.
examples.hi: कुछ ही मिनटों में तुम्हें पासवर्ड रीसेट करने का लिंक मिल जाएगा।

examples.en: I reset my password three times because I kept mistyping it.
examples.hi: मैंने अपना पासवर्ड तीन बार रीसेट किया क्योंकि मैं बार-बार ग़लत टाइप कर रहा था।

common_mistake.wrong: I want to change my password because I forgot it.
common_mistake.right: I want to reset my password because I forgot it.
common_mistake.why: 'Change' assumes you still know the old password and are voluntarily updating it, while 'reset' is used specifically when you've forgotten it and need the system to issue a new one.

cloze.sentence: If you can't remember your login details, click here to ____.

en_def: a phone or internet call where the people involved can see each other through the camera
hi_def: वीडियो कॉल (फ़ोन या इंटरनेट कॉल जिसमें कैमरे के ज़रिए एक-दूसरे को देखा जा सकता है)
hi_nuance: This term is used correctly by most speakers, but many Indians overuse the specific brand name 'video call on WhatsApp' as if it were the only kind, saying things like 'do a WhatsApp' to mean 'make a video call' — it's clearer in professional English to say 'let's do a video call' generally, and only mention the app/platform when it's actually relevant (Zoom, Teams, WhatsApp, etc.).

examples.en: Let's have a video call instead of typing everything out.
examples.hi: चलो सब कुछ टाइप करने के बजाय एक वीडियो कॉल कर लेते हैं।

examples.en: I made a video call to my parents every Sunday when I lived abroad.
examples.hi: जब मैं विदेश में रहता था तो हर रविवार को अपने माता-पिता को वीडियो कॉल करता था।

examples.en: The interview will be conducted over a video call this time.
examples.hi: इस बार इंटरव्यू वीडियो कॉल के ज़रिए लिया जाएगा।

examples.en: Our video call kept freezing because of the poor internet speed.
examples.hi: इंटरनेट स्पीड ख़राब होने की वजह से हमारी वीडियो कॉल बार-बार अटक रही थी।

examples.en: Can we schedule a video call with the client tomorrow morning?
examples.hi: क्या हम कल सुबह क्लाइंट के साथ वीडियो कॉल शेड्यूल कर सकते हैं?

common_mistake.wrong: Let's do a WhatsApp to discuss this.
common_mistake.right: Let's do a video call on WhatsApp to discuss this.
common_mistake.why: 'WhatsApp' is the name of the app, not a verb for calling; the correct phrasing names the action first — 'video call' or 'call' — and mentions the app only as the platform used.

cloze.sentence: It's hard to explain over text — let's just have a ____.

en_def: a recorded spoken message sent through a phone or messaging app instead of typed text
hi_def: वॉइस मैसेज (फ़ोन या मैसेजिंग ऐप के ज़रिए भेजा गया रिकॉर्ड किया हुआ बोला हुआ संदेश)
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'voice note' interchangeably with 'voice message', and both are actually acceptable in casual speech — 'voice note' is common on WhatsApp specifically, while 'voice message' is the more general and formal term, also used for voicemail systems on regular calls.

examples.en: I sent a voice message instead of typing a long reply.
examples.hi: मैंने लंबा जवाब टाइप करने के बजाय एक वॉइस मैसेज भेज दिया।

examples.en: Please listen to my voice message when you get a chance.
examples.hi: जब भी मौक़ा मिले, मेरा वॉइस मैसेज सुन लेना।

examples.en: She left a voice message explaining why she couldn't come to office.
examples.hi: उसने वॉइस मैसेज छोड़ा जिसमें बताया कि वह ऑफ़िस क्यों नहीं आ सकी।

examples.en: I couldn't understand his voice message because the network was bad.
examples.hi: मैं उसका वॉइस मैसेज समझ नहीं पाया क्योंकि नेटवर्क ख़राब था।

examples.en: My manager prefers voice messages over long emails.
examples.hi: मेरे मैनेजर को लंबी ईमेल के बजाय वॉइस मैसेज पसंद हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: He recorded a voice mail on WhatsApp.
common_mistake.right: He recorded a voice message on WhatsApp.
common_mistake.why: 'Voicemail' specifically refers to messages left through the phone network's answering system when a call isn't picked up; recordings sent via chat apps like WhatsApp are called 'voice messages' or 'voice notes', not 'voicemail'.

cloze.sentence: I was driving, so I sent a ____ instead of typing.

en_def: a short written message sent from one phone to another
hi_def: टेक्स्ट मैसेज (एक फ़ोन से दूसरे फ़ोन पर भेजा गया छोटा लिखित संदेश)
hi_nuance: In India, people often just say 'message' or 'SMS' rather than 'text message'; 'SMS' specifically means the message sent through the telecom network (not the internet), while 'text message' is the general American/international term. British English also commonly says just 'text' as a verb: 'I'll text you'.

examples.en: I sent you a text message with the office address.
examples.hi: मैंने तुम्हें ऑफ़िस के पते वाला टेक्स्ट मैसेज भेजा है।

examples.en: Did you get my text message about the meeting time?
examples.hi: क्या तुम्हें मीटिंग के समय के बारे में मेरा टेक्स्ट मैसेज मिला?

examples.en: I'll text message you the OTP if the call doesn't connect.
examples.hi: अगर कॉल नहीं लगती तो मैं तुम्हें ओटीपी टेक्स्ट मैसेज कर दूँगा।

examples.en: She replies to text messages faster than emails.
examples.hi: वह ईमेल से ज़्यादा तेज़ी से टेक्स्ट मैसेज का जवाब देती है।

examples.en: My phone alerts me with a sound for every text message.
examples.hi: हर टेक्स्ट मैसेज पर मेरा फ़ोन आवाज़ के साथ सूचित करता है।

common_mistake.wrong: I will message on your number.
common_mistake.right: I will send you a text message. / I will text you.
common_mistake.why: 'Message on your number' is a literal translation from Hindi; natural English says 'text you', 'message you' (without 'on'), or 'send a text message to your number'.

cloze.sentence: Instead of calling, just send me a ____ with the details.

en_def: a feature on phones and computers that automatically fixes spelling mistakes while typing
hi_def: ऑटोकरेक्ट (फ़ोन या कंप्यूटर का एक फ़ीचर जो टाइप करते समय स्पेलिंग की ग़लतियाँ अपने आप सुधार देता है)
hi_nuance: This word is borrowed directly and used correctly, but many Hindi speakers don't realise autocorrect can cause funny or embarrassing errors, especially with names or Hindi words typed in English script — a common joke topic in Indian office chat groups is 'autocorrect fail', which is a fully natural English expression too.

examples.en: Autocorrect changed my colleague's name to something completely wrong.
examples.hi: ऑटोकरेक्ट ने मेरे सहकर्मी का नाम बदलकर बिल्कुल ग़लत कर दिया।

examples.en: I always double-check messages because autocorrect makes silly mistakes.
examples.hi: मैं हमेशा मैसेज दोबारा जांचता हूँ क्योंकि ऑटोकरेक्ट अजीब ग़लतियाँ करता है।

examples.en: Turn off autocorrect if you're typing technical terms often.
examples.hi: अगर तुम अक्सर तकनीकी शब्द टाइप करते हो तो ऑटोकरेक्ट बंद कर दो।

examples.en: That embarrassing text was an autocorrect mistake, I promise!
examples.hi: वह शर्मनाक मैसेज ऑटोकरेक्ट की ग़लती थी, मैं वादा करता हूँ!

examples.en: My phone's autocorrect keeps changing 'office' to 'orifice'.
examples.hi: मेरे फ़ोन का ऑटोकरेक्ट बार-बार 'office' को 'orifice' में बदल देता है।

common_mistake.wrong: My autocorrect is showing wrong meaning.
common_mistake.right: My autocorrect keeps changing the word to something wrong.
common_mistake.why: 'Showing wrong meaning' misuses 'showing'; autocorrect doesn't display meanings, it silently replaces or changes words, so the natural verb is 'change' or 'correct to', not 'show'.

cloze.sentence: Sorry for that odd word in my last text — blame ____.

en_def: the amount of time a device can run on battery power, or a device that stores extra power for later use
hi_def: बैटरी बैकअप (डिवाइस कितनी देर बैटरी पर चल सकता है, या अतिरिक्त बिजली स्टोर करने वाला उपकरण)
hi_nuance: In Indian English, 'battery backup' commonly refers to how long a phone's charge lasts ('this phone has good battery backup'), which is understood locally but slightly unusual internationally — in standard English, people more often say 'battery life' for this meaning; 'battery backup' internationally usually refers to a separate backup power device (like a UPS), not the phone's own endurance.

examples.en: This phone has excellent battery backup, easily lasting two days.
examples.hi: इस फ़ोन का बैटरी बैकअप बहुत बढ़िया है, आसानी से दो दिन चलता है।

examples.en: I bought this model mainly for its long battery backup.
examples.hi: मैंने यह मॉडल मुख्य रूप से इसके लंबे बैटरी बैकअप के लिए ख़रीदा।

examples.en: Heavy gaming reduces the battery backup significantly.
examples.hi: ज़्यादा गेमिंग बैटरी बैकअप को काफ़ी कम कर देती है।

examples.en: We installed a battery backup for the router during power cuts.
examples.hi: बिजली कटौती के दौरान हमने राउटर के लिए बैटरी बैकअप लगाया।

examples.en: The office server room has battery backup that lasts four hours.
examples.hi: ऑफ़िस के सर्वर रूम में बैटरी बैकअप है जो चार घंटे तक चलता है।

common_mistake.wrong: This phone's battery backup finishes in five hours.
common_mistake.right: This phone's battery life lasts about five hours.
common_mistake.why: Internationally, 'battery life' describes how long a charge lasts on a single device, while 'battery backup' more often refers to a separate backup power source; using 'battery life' avoids confusion outside India.

cloze.sentence: I chose this phone mainly because of its excellent ____.

en_def: a socket or place designed for plugging in a device or vehicle to charge it
hi_def: चार्जिंग पॉइंट (डिवाइस या वाहन को चार्ज करने के लिए बना सॉकेट या स्थान)
hi_nuance: Indian English uses 'charging point' for both a wall socket for phones and a public station for electric vehicles; American English tends to say 'outlet' for a simple wall socket and reserves 'charging point/station' mainly for EVs — worth knowing 'outlet' when travelling to the US, since 'point' alone can sound unusual there.

examples.en: Is there a charging point near my seat on this train?
examples.hi: क्या इस ट्रेन में मेरी सीट के पास कोई चार्जिंग पॉइंट है?

examples.en: The airport has several charging points near the waiting area.
examples.hi: एयरपोर्ट में वेटिंग एरिया के पास कई चार्जिंग पॉइंट हैं।

examples.en: My office desk has a charging point built into the table.
examples.hi: मेरी ऑफ़िस डेस्क में टेबल के अंदर ही एक चार्जिंग पॉइंट लगा है।

examples.en: We need more charging points for electric cars in this city.
examples.hi: इस शहर में इलेक्ट्रिक कारों के लिए और चार्जिंग पॉइंट्स की ज़रूरत है।

examples.en: The café lets customers use the charging point for free.
examples.hi: कैफ़े ग्राहकों को चार्जिंग पॉइंट मुफ़्त में इस्तेमाल करने देता है।

common_mistake.wrong: Is there a charging point socket in the wall?
common_mistake.right: Is there a charging point (outlet) on the wall?
common_mistake.why: 'Charging point' already implies a socket, so adding 'socket' again is redundant; in American English, simply say 'outlet' for a wall socket rather than combining both words.

cloze.sentence: My phone is almost dead — is there a ____ around here?

en_def: a small portable battery device used to charge phones and other gadgets when not near a plug
hi_def: पावर बैंक (एक छोटा पोर्टेबल बैटरी उपकरण, जो प्लग के पास न होने पर फ़ोन और अन्य गैजेट चार्ज करने के लिए इस्तेमाल होता है)
hi_nuance: 'Power bank' is used correctly and is actually the standard international term too (unlike some other India-specific phrases), so there's little confusion here — the main tip for learners is that Americans sometimes just call it a 'portable charger', which means exactly the same thing as 'power bank'.

examples.en: I always carry a power bank when I travel for long meetings.
examples.hi: जब मैं लंबी मीटिंग्स के लिए यात्रा करता हूँ तो हमेशा एक पावर बैंक साथ रखता हूँ।

examples.en: My power bank ran out of charge during the flight delay.
examples.hi: फ़्लाइट में देरी के दौरान मेरे पावर बैंक की चार्जिंग ख़त्म हो गई।

examples.en: Can I borrow your power bank for a few minutes?
examples.hi: क्या मैं तुम्हारा पावर बैंक कुछ मिनट के लिए उधार ले सकता हूँ?

examples.en: This power bank can charge two phones at the same time.
examples.hi: यह पावर बैंक एक साथ दो फ़ोन चार्ज कर सकता है।

examples.en: I forgot to charge my power bank before the trek.
examples.hi: ट्रेक से पहले मैं अपना पावर बैंक चार्ज करना भूल गया।

common_mistake.wrong: I need to charge my power bank with the mobile.
common_mistake.right: I need to charge my mobile with the power bank.
common_mistake.why: The direction gets reversed by mistake — the power bank supplies charge to the phone, not the other way around, so the phone is charged 'with' or 'using' the power bank.

cloze.sentence: My phone died during the trip, so I used my ____ to charge it.

en_def: a phone setting that turns off all wireless signals, usually required during flights
hi_def: एयरप्लेन मोड (एक फ़ोन सेटिंग जो सभी वायरलेस सिग्नल बंद कर देती है, आमतौर पर उड़ान के दौरान ज़रूरी)
hi_nuance: Most Hindi speakers use this term correctly, but 'flight mode' is equally common in Indian English and British English, while 'airplane mode' is more the American term — both are acceptable and understood everywhere, so it's a case of regional variation rather than a real mistake.

examples.en: Please switch your phone to airplane mode before takeoff.
examples.hi: टेकऑफ़ से पहले कृपया अपना फ़ोन एयरप्लेन मोड पर डाल दें।

examples.en: I put my phone on airplane mode to save battery overnight.
examples.hi: मैंने रातभर बैटरी बचाने के लिए फ़ोन को एयरप्लेन मोड पर रखा।

examples.en: In airplane mode, you can't receive calls or messages.
examples.hi: एयरप्लेन मोड में तुम कॉल या मैसेज नहीं पा सकते।

examples.en: I forgot to turn off airplane mode after landing.
examples.hi: उतरने के बाद मैं एयरप्लेन मोड बंद करना भूल गया।

examples.en: You can still listen to downloaded songs in airplane mode.
examples.hi: एयरप्लेन मोड में भी तुम डाउनलोड किए गाने सुन सकते हो।

common_mistake.wrong: Put your phone in flight mood.
common_mistake.right: Put your phone in airplane mode (or flight mode).
common_mistake.why: 'Mood' and 'mode' sound similar but mean different things — a phone setting is a 'mode', while 'mood' refers to a feeling or emotional state.

cloze.sentence: The flight attendant asked everyone to switch to ____.

en_def: a phone setting where all sounds and ringtones are switched off
hi_def: साइलेंट मोड (एक फ़ोन सेटिंग जिसमें सभी आवाज़ें और रिंगटोन बंद हो जाते हैं)
hi_nuance: This is used correctly by most speakers, but many confuse 'silent mode' (no sound at all, not even vibration on some phones) with 'vibrate mode' (silent ringtone but phone vibrates) — in precise usage, these are two distinct settings, and mixing them up can cause someone to miss urgent calls in a meeting.

examples.en: Please put your phone on silent mode during the interview.
examples.hi: इंटरव्यू के दौरान कृपया अपना फ़ोन साइलेंट मोड पर रखें।

examples.en: I keep my phone on silent mode at night so it doesn't wake anyone.
examples.hi: मैं रात में अपना फ़ोन साइलेंट मोड पर रखता हूँ ताकि किसी की नींद न टूटे।

examples.en: My phone was on silent mode, so I missed my manager's call.
examples.hi: मेरा फ़ोन साइलेंट मोड पर था, इसलिए मैं अपने मैनेजर की कॉल चूक गया।

examples.en: During the exam, all phones must be on silent mode.
examples.hi: परीक्षा के दौरान सभी फ़ोन साइलेंट मोड पर होने चाहिए।

examples.en: I switched to silent mode as soon as the movie started.
examples.hi: फ़िल्म शुरू होते ही मैंने साइलेंट मोड कर दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: My phone was on vibrate, so I couldn't hear it at all.
common_mistake.right: My phone was on silent mode, so I couldn't hear it at all.
common_mistake.why: 'Vibrate mode' still produces a physical buzz you can often feel or hear against a table; true silence with absolutely no sound or vibration is 'silent mode' — the two settings shouldn't be used interchangeably.

cloze.sentence: Remember to switch your phone to ____ before the meeting starts.

en_def: a phone setting or request that blocks notifications and calls so a person isn't interrupted
hi_def: डू नॉट डिस्टर्ब / परेशान न करें (एक फ़ोन सेटिंग या अनुरोध जो सूचनाओं और कॉल को रोक देता है ताकि किसी को बाधा न पहुँचे)
hi_nuance: This phrase (often shortened to 'DND') is used correctly in Indian English, both for the phone feature and for the telecom registry that blocks promotional calls ('DND registration'). One common confusion is treating 'DND' only as blocking spam calls, without realising it's also a general phone-wide focus setting on smartphones that silences everything, including personal calls, unless marked as an exception.

examples.en: I registered my number for DND to stop promotional calls.
examples.hi: मैंने प्रचार कॉल रोकने के लिए अपना नंबर डीएनडी में रजिस्टर करवाया।

examples.en: I turned on Do Not Disturb during the exam so nothing would ping.
examples.hi: परीक्षा के दौरान मैंने डू नॉट डिस्टर्ब चालू किया ताकि कुछ भी नोटिफ़ाई न हो।

examples.en: Even with Do Not Disturb on, calls from my family still come through.
examples.hi: डू नॉट डिस्टर्ब चालू होने पर भी, मेरे परिवार की कॉल आ जाती हैं।

examples.en: Please set your status to Do Not Disturb while presenting.
examples.hi: प्रेजेंटेशन के दौरान कृपया अपना स्टेटस डू नॉट डिस्टर्ब पर सेट कर लें।

examples.en: My phone automatically switches to Do Not Disturb at midnight.
examples.hi: मेरा फ़ोन आधी रात को अपने आप डू नॉट डिस्टर्ब पर चला जाता है।

common_mistake.wrong: I did DND my number for telemarketing calls.
common_mistake.right: I registered my number for DND to stop telemarketing calls.
common_mistake.why: 'DND' is a noun/setting, not a verb; you 'register for DND' or 'activate DND', you don't 'DND' a number as an action word.

cloze.sentence: I keep getting spam calls — I should register my number for ____.

en_def: to stop a specific phone number from being able to call or message you
hi_def: नंबर ब्लॉक करना (किसी विशेष फ़ोन नंबर को कॉल या मैसेज करने से रोकना)
hi_nuance: This phrase is used correctly, though some Hindi speakers say 'I banned his number' instead — 'ban' sounds odd applied to a phone number; the correct verb is always 'block' in this context ('block a number', 'block a contact'), while 'ban' is reserved for people from places, platforms, or organisations, not individual numbers.

examples.en: I blocked that number after getting repeated spam calls.
examples.hi: बार-बार स्पैम कॉल आने के बाद मैंने वह नंबर ब्लॉक कर दिया।

examples.en: Can you show me how to block a number on this phone?
examples.hi: क्या तुम मुझे दिखा सकते हो कि इस फ़ोन पर नंबर कैसे ब्लॉक करते हैं?

examples.en: She blocked her ex's number to stop the messages.
examples.hi: उसने मैसेज रोकने के लिए अपने एक्स का नंबर ब्लॉक कर दिया।

examples.en: I accidentally blocked my colleague's number instead of the spammer's.
examples.hi: मैंने ग़लती से स्पैमर के बजाय अपने सहकर्मी का नंबर ब्लॉक कर दिया।

examples.en: You can unblock a number anytime from the settings menu.
examples.hi: तुम सेटिंग्स मेनू से किसी भी समय नंबर को अनब्लॉक कर सकते हो।

common_mistake.wrong: I banned his number from calling me.
common_mistake.right: I blocked his number from calling me.
common_mistake.why: 'Ban' is used for restricting people, places or organisations (e.g. 'banned from the club'), while the correct verb for a phone number is 'block' — 'ban a number' is not standard English.

cloze.sentence: These spam calls are so annoying, I'm going to ____.

en_def: an unwanted phone call, usually trying to sell something or scam the receiver
hi_def: स्पैम कॉल (एक अवांछित फ़ोन कॉल, आमतौर पर कुछ बेचने या धोखा देने की कोशिश करती है)
hi_nuance: This term is used correctly, but security-conscious learners should note the related, more serious term 'scam call' — a spam call is simply unwanted (like a sales pitch), while a scam call specifically tries to deceive or steal money/information; not all spam calls are scams, but all scam calls are a kind of spam call.

examples.en: I get at least five spam calls a day about loan offers.
examples.hi: मुझे लोन ऑफ़र के बारे में रोज़ कम से कम पाँच स्पैम कॉल आती हैं।

examples.en: My phone now flags spam calls automatically before I answer.
examples.hi: मेरा फ़ोन अब जवाब देने से पहले ही स्पैम कॉल को अपने आप चिन्हित कर देता है।

examples.en: That spam call claimed to be from the electricity department.
examples.hi: उस स्पैम कॉल ने बिजली विभाग से होने का दावा किया।

examples.en: I reported the spam call to my telecom provider.
examples.hi: मैंने उस स्पैम कॉल की शिकायत अपने टेलिकॉम प्रोवाइडर से की।

examples.en: Spam calls have increased a lot since my number got leaked online.
examples.hi: मेरा नंबर ऑनलाइन लीक होने के बाद से स्पैम कॉल काफ़ी बढ़ गई हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I got a scam call from an insurance company selling policies.
common_mistake.right: I got a spam call from an insurance company selling policies.
common_mistake.why: An unsolicited sales call, even if annoying, is 'spam' rather than a 'scam' unless it specifically tries to deceive or steal from you — the two words shouldn't be used as if identical.

cloze.sentence: I never answer unknown numbers because most of them are ____.

en_def: a fast, always-on internet connection, usually delivered through a fixed line to a home or office
hi_def: ब्रॉडबैंड कनेक्शन (एक तेज़, हमेशा चालू रहने वाला इंटरनेट कनेक्शन, आमतौर पर घर या ऑफ़िस में एक निश्चित लाइन के ज़रिए मिलता है)
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes use 'broadband' and 'Wi-Fi' interchangeably, saying 'my broadband is not working' when the actual issue is the Wi-Fi router; technically, 'broadband' is the internet service coming into the building, while 'Wi-Fi' is just the wireless way of sharing that connection around the house — the two can fail independently.

examples.en: We switched our broadband connection because it kept disconnecting.
examples.hi: हमने अपना ब्रॉडबैंड कनेक्शन बदल दिया क्योंकि वह बार-बार डिस्कनेक्ट हो रहा था।

examples.en: Working from home needs a stable broadband connection.
examples.hi: घर से काम करने के लिए एक स्थिर ब्रॉडबैंड कनेक्शन ज़रूरी है।

examples.en: Our broadband connection got cut because the bill wasn't paid.
examples.hi: बिल न भरने की वजह से हमारा ब्रॉडबैंड कनेक्शन कट गया।

examples.en: The technician came to install a new broadband connection today.
examples.hi: तकनीशियन आज नया ब्रॉडबैंड कनेक्शन लगाने आया।

examples.en: A fibre broadband connection is much faster than the old copper one.
examples.hi: फ़ाइबर ब्रॉडबैंड कनेक्शन पुराने कॉपर वाले से कहीं ज़्यादा तेज़ है।

common_mistake.wrong: My broadband is slow, I need to restart the Wi-Fi.
common_mistake.right: My broadband is slow, I need to restart the router.
common_mistake.why: 'Wi-Fi' is the wireless signal itself, not a physical device; you restart the 'router' or 'modem', not 'the Wi-Fi', since Wi-Fi isn't a thing that can be switched off and on physically.

cloze.sentence: We need a faster ____ for all these video calls.

en_def: a device that connects to the internet line and shares Wi-Fi with phones, laptops and other gadgets
hi_def: राउटर (एक उपकरण जो इंटरनेट लाइन से जुड़कर फ़ोन, लैपटॉप और अन्य गैजेट्स के साथ वाई-फ़ाई साझा करता है)
hi_nuance: Many Hindi speakers use 'router' and 'modem' as if they mean the same thing, saying 'restart the modem' for a Wi-Fi problem. Technically, a modem connects to the internet line from the provider, while a router shares that connection wirelessly — many home devices combine both in one box, which is why the confusion is common, but engineers should know the distinction.

examples.en: I restarted the router, and the internet started working again.
examples.hi: मैंने राउटर रीस्टार्ट किया, और इंटरनेट फिर से काम करने लगा।

examples.en: Our router is kept in the hall, so the bedroom Wi-Fi is weak.
examples.hi: हमारा राउटर हॉल में रखा है, इसलिए बेडरूम में वाई-फ़ाई कमज़ोर है।

examples.en: The blinking red light on the router usually means there's a connection issue.
examples.hi: राउटर पर टिमटिमाती लाल लाइट आमतौर पर कनेक्शन की समस्या दिखाती है।

examples.en: I bought a new router with better range for the whole flat.
examples.hi: मैंने पूरे फ़्लैट के लिए बेहतर रेंज वाला नया राउटर ख़रीदा।

examples.en: Please unplug the router for ten seconds and plug it back in.
examples.hi: कृपया राउटर को दस सेकंड के लिए अनप्लग करें और फिर से लगाएँ।

common_mistake.wrong: I'll restart the modem to fix the Wi-Fi speed.
common_mistake.right: I'll restart the router to fix the Wi-Fi speed.
common_mistake.why: The modem connects to the provider's internet line, while the router creates and manages the Wi-Fi signal; a slow Wi-Fi problem is usually fixed by restarting the router, not necessarily the modem.

cloze.sentence: The Wi-Fi light is red — try restarting the ____.

en_def: the pause in a video or audio stream while the device loads more data before continuing to play
hi_def: बफ़रिंग (वीडियो या ऑडियो स्ट्रीम में रुकावट, जब डिवाइस आगे चलने से पहले और डेटा लोड करता है)
hi_nuance: This word is used correctly and quite naturally by Indian speakers, but many use it only as a verb ('it's buffering') without realising it can also work as a noun describing the problem itself, e.g. 'there's too much buffering on this app' — both forms are correct English.

examples.en: The video kept buffering because the internet speed was too slow.
examples.hi: वीडियो बार-बार बफ़र हो रहा था क्योंकि इंटरनेट स्पीड बहुत धीमी थी।

examples.en: There's a lot of buffering during peak hours in our area.
examples.hi: हमारे इलाक़े में पीक ऑवर्स के दौरान काफ़ी बफ़रिंग होती है।

examples.en: I switched to a lower video quality to avoid buffering.
examples.hi: बफ़रिंग से बचने के लिए मैंने वीडियो की क्वालिटी कम कर दी।

examples.en: The match streamed smoothly with no buffering at all.
examples.hi: मैच बिना किसी बफ़रिंग के आसानी से स्ट्रीम हुआ।

examples.en: Buffering is really annoying during an important video call.
examples.hi: किसी ज़रूरी वीडियो कॉल के दौरान बफ़रिंग होना काफ़ी परेशान करने वाला होता है।

common_mistake.wrong: The video is hanging because of slow internet.
common_mistake.right: The video is buffering because of slow internet.
common_mistake.why: 'Hanging' in Indian English usually describes a device or app that has frozen completely and stopped responding; the specific pause-and-load pattern in streaming video is called 'buffering', a more precise term.

cloze.sentence: The stream keeps pausing and loading — so much ____ today.

en_def: how fast data can be downloaded or uploaded over an internet connection
hi_def: इंटरनेट स्पीड (इंटरनेट कनेक्शन पर डेटा कितनी तेज़ी से डाउनलोड या अपलोड हो सकता है)
hi_nuance: This phrase is used correctly, but many Hindi speakers confuse 'speed' with 'data limit' — saying 'my internet speed is over' when they've actually run out of the fast-speed data quota for the day and switched to a slower, throttled speed, which is a different concept from the connection's speed being technically incapable.

examples.en: My internet speed drops a lot in the evening when everyone is online.
examples.hi: शाम को जब सब ऑनलाइन होते हैं तो मेरी इंटरनेट स्पीड काफ़ी गिर जाती है।

examples.en: I checked my internet speed, and it's much slower than promised.
examples.hi: मैंने अपनी इंटरनेट स्पीड चेक की, और वह वादा किए गए से काफ़ी धीमी है।

examples.en: You need a good internet speed for smooth video calls at work.
examples.hi: ऑफ़िस की वीडियो कॉल्स सही से चलाने के लिए अच्छी इंटरनेट स्पीड चाहिए।

examples.en: The internet speed test showed only 2 Mbps instead of 50.
examples.hi: इंटरनेट स्पीड टेस्ट में 50 की जगह सिर्फ़ 2 एमबीपीएस दिखाया।

examples.en: Our company upgraded the internet speed for the whole office.
examples.hi: हमारी कंपनी ने पूरे ऑफ़िस के लिए इंटरनेट स्पीड अपग्रेड कर दी।

common_mistake.wrong: My internet speed is over for today, so it's slow now.
common_mistake.right: My high-speed data is over for today, so my internet speed is slower now.
common_mistake.why: 'Internet speed' describes a rate, not a quantity that runs out; what actually finishes is the daily high-speed data quota, after which the provider throttles the speed — being precise here matters for a security/IT professional troubleshooting connectivity.

cloze.sentence: Let me run a quick test to check the ____ before the call.

en_def: a small chip inserted into a phone that identifies the user and connects them to a mobile network
hi_def: सिम कार्ड (फ़ोन में लगाई जाने वाली एक छोटी चिप, जो उपयोगकर्ता की पहचान करती है और उसे मोबाइल नेटवर्क से जोड़ती है)
hi_nuance: This term is used correctly across India, but some speakers say 'insert the SIM' as 'put the SIM', which is fine informally though 'insert' is the more precise/technical verb used in manuals and by telecom staff — useful to know both registers, informal 'put in' versus technical 'insert'.

examples.en: I need a new SIM card after losing my old phone.
examples.hi: पुराना फ़ोन खोने के बाद मुझे नया सिम कार्ड चाहिए।

examples.en: Please insert the SIM card correctly, or the phone won't detect it.
examples.hi: कृपया सिम कार्ड सही तरीक़े से डालें, वरना फ़ोन उसे पहचानेगा नहीं।

examples.en: My SIM card stopped working after I dropped my phone in water.
examples.hi: फ़ोन पानी में गिरने के बाद मेरा सिम कार्ड काम करना बंद कर गया।

examples.en: I bought a local SIM card as soon as I landed abroad.
examples.hi: विदेश में उतरते ही मैंने एक स्थानीय सिम कार्ड ख़रीदा।

examples.en: You need ID proof to get a new SIM card in India.
examples.hi: भारत में नया सिम कार्ड लेने के लिए पहचान प्रमाण चाहिए।

common_mistake.wrong: My SIM card is not working, my phone doesn't have network.
common_mistake.right: My SIM card isn't working, so my phone has no network.
common_mistake.why: The two clauses need a connecting word to show cause and effect ('so'); stringing them together without one, as is common when translating directly from Hindi, sounds like a run-on sentence in English.

cloze.sentence: Before travelling abroad, remember to buy a local ____.

en_def: a phone feature that lets two SIM cards work in the same device at the same time
hi_def: ड्यूल सिम (एक फ़ोन फ़ीचर जो एक ही डिवाइस में एक साथ दो सिम कार्ड इस्तेमाल करने देता है)
hi_nuance: This term is used correctly, but Hindi speakers sometimes assume 'dual SIM' automatically means both SIMs get full network (4G/5G) at the same time — in many phones, only one SIM gets high-speed data while the other stays limited to calls, a detail known as 'dual SIM dual standby', worth clarifying when discussing phone specs.

examples.en: I use a dual SIM phone — one number for work, one for personal calls.
examples.hi: मैं ड्यूल सिम फ़ोन इस्तेमाल करता हूँ — एक नंबर काम के लिए, एक निजी कॉल के लिए।

examples.en: This dual SIM phone lets me keep my office and personal numbers separate.
examples.hi: यह ड्यूल सिम फ़ोन मुझे अपने ऑफ़िस और निजी नंबर अलग रखने देता है।

examples.en: Not all dual SIM phones support two SIMs on high-speed data together.
examples.hi: सभी ड्यूल सिम फ़ोन दोनों सिम पर एक साथ हाई-स्पीड डेटा सपोर्ट नहीं करते।

examples.en: I switched to a dual SIM phone so I don't need two devices.
examples.hi: मैं ड्यूल सिम फ़ोन पर आ गया ताकि मुझे दो डिवाइस न रखने पड़ें।

examples.en: My dual SIM setup helps me manage roaming charges better while travelling.
examples.hi: मेरा ड्यूल सिम सेटअप यात्रा के दौरान रोमिंग चार्ज बेहतर तरीक़े से संभालने में मदद करता है।

common_mistake.wrong: My dual SIM phone gives full 4G on both SIMs together.
common_mistake.right: My dual SIM phone doesn't give full 4G on both SIMs at the same time.
common_mistake.why: Many dual SIM phones only support high-speed data on one SIM at a time (dual SIM dual standby), so assuming both automatically get full speed together is a common but incorrect assumption.

cloze.sentence: I keep my office and personal numbers on one ____ phone.

en_def: a tall structure with antennas that sends and receives mobile phone signals for an area
hi_def: नेटवर्क टावर (एंटीना वाला एक ऊँचा ढाँचा, जो किसी इलाक़े के लिए मोबाइल फ़ोन सिग्नल भेजता और प्राप्त करता है)
hi_nuance: This term is used correctly, but the technical/international name is 'cell tower' or 'mobile tower', while 'network tower' is more of an Indian-English usage — all are understood, but 'cell tower' is what appears in most global technical documentation and news articles, useful to recognise.

examples.en: There's no network tower near our village, so signal is always weak.
examples.hi: हमारे गाँव के पास कोई नेटवर्क टावर नहीं है, इसलिए सिग्नल हमेशा कमज़ोर रहता है।

examples.en: A new network tower was installed on the building behind our office.
examples.hi: हमारे ऑफ़िस के पीछे वाली इमारत पर एक नया नेटवर्क टावर लगाया गया।

examples.en: People worry about radiation from network towers near homes.
examples.hi: घरों के पास लगे नेटवर्क टावरों से निकलने वाले विकिरण को लेकर लोग चिंतित रहते हैं।

examples.en: Signal strength depends on how close you are to a network tower.
examples.hi: सिग्नल की ताक़त इस पर निर्भर करती है कि तुम नेटवर्क टावर के कितने पास हो।

examples.en: The storm damaged a network tower, causing an outage in the area.
examples.hi: तूफ़ान से एक नेटवर्क टावर ख़राब हो गया, जिससे उस इलाक़े में सेवा बाधित हुई।

common_mistake.wrong: The network satellite near our house is very strong.
common_mistake.right: The network tower near our house gives a very strong signal.
common_mistake.why: Mobile signal for everyday calls and data comes from ground-based 'network/cell towers', not satellites; satellite phones are a separate, much less common technology.

cloze.sentence: Signal is great here because there's a ____ right on that hill.

en_def: to install the newest version of an application on your device
hi_def: ऐप अपडेट करना (डिवाइस पर किसी एप्लिकेशन का नवीनतम संस्करण इंस्टॉल करना)
hi_nuance: This phrase is used correctly, but many Hindi speakers say 'upgrade the app' instead of 'update' — in everyday tech English, 'update' is the routine action for regular new versions/bug fixes, while 'upgrade' is reserved for a bigger change, like moving to a completely new paid tier or major version; using 'upgrade' for a routine app update sounds slightly off.

examples.en: Please update the app to fix the login issue.
examples.hi: लॉगिन की समस्या ठीक करने के लिए कृपया ऐप अपडेट करें।

examples.en: I couldn't log in until I updated the app to the latest version.
examples.hi: जब तक मैंने ऐप को नवीनतम संस्करण में अपडेट नहीं किया, तब तक मैं लॉगिन नहीं कर पाया।

examples.en: The bank asked all users to update the app before the new OTP system.
examples.hi: बैंक ने नए ओटीपी सिस्टम से पहले सभी उपयोगकर्ताओं से ऐप अपडेट करने को कहा।

examples.en: My phone updates the app automatically overnight.
examples.hi: मेरा फ़ोन रात में अपने आप ऐप को अपडेट कर देता है।

examples.en: I always read the changes before I update the app.
examples.hi: मैं ऐप अपडेट करने से पहले हमेशा बदलाव पढ़ता हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: I need to upgrade the app to fix this small bug.
common_mistake.right: I need to update the app to fix this small bug.
common_mistake.why: 'Upgrade' suggests a significant change, like a paid plan or major version; a routine bug-fix or minor version change is called an 'update', the more common and appropriate word here.

cloze.sentence: This bug was fixed in the newest version — go ____.

en_def: to install an application onto a phone or computer from the internet
hi_def: ऐप डाउनलोड करना (इंटरनेट से किसी फ़ोन या कंप्यूटर पर एप्लिकेशन इंस्टॉल करना)
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes say 'load the app' or 'install the app from Google' loosely — while 'install' is technically correct too (download brings the file, install sets it up, and on phones these often happen together automatically), 'download the app' is the standard casual phrase used in everyday speech and instructions.

examples.en: Download the app from the Play Store to book your tickets.
examples.hi: टिकट बुक करने के लिए प्ले स्टोर से ऐप डाउनलोड करो।

examples.en: I downloaded the app, but it's asking for too many permissions.
examples.hi: मैंने ऐप डाउनलोड किया, लेकिन यह बहुत सारी अनुमतियाँ माँग रहा है।

examples.en: You need to download the app before you can scan the QR code.
examples.hi: क्यूआर कोड स्कैन करने से पहले तुम्हें ऐप डाउनलोड करना होगा।

examples.en: My mother asked me to download the app for her on my phone.
examples.hi: मेरी माँ ने मुझसे उनके लिए अपने फ़ोन में ऐप डाउनलोड करने को कहा।

examples.en: The app took forever to download because of the weak internet.
examples.hi: कमज़ोर इंटरनेट की वजह से ऐप डाउनलोड होने में बहुत समय लगा।

common_mistake.wrong: I loaded the app on my phone yesterday.
common_mistake.right: I downloaded the app on my phone yesterday.
common_mistake.why: 'Load' is used for opening files or webpages that are already on the device ('the page is loading'), while getting a new app from an app store is 'downloading' it, not 'loading' it.

cloze.sentence: Before the flight, remember to ____ for tracking your baggage.

en_def: used to describe a phone or device that has no more space left to save files, photos or apps
hi_def: स्टोरेज फ़ुल (एक फ़ोन या डिवाइस जिसमें फ़ाइलें, फ़ोटो या ऐप सेव करने के लिए और जगह नहीं बची)
hi_nuance: This phrase is used correctly, but many Hindi speakers say 'my memory is full' instead of 'my storage is full' — 'memory' technically refers to RAM (which affects speed/multitasking), while 'storage' refers to the space for files and apps; the two are different components, and mixing them up can confuse tech support conversations.

examples.en: My phone says storage full, so I can't take any more photos.
examples.hi: मेरे फ़ोन में स्टोरेज फ़ुल दिखा रहा है, इसलिए मैं और फ़ोटो नहीं ले पा रहा।

examples.en: I deleted old videos because my storage was full.
examples.hi: मैंने पुरानी वीडियो डिलीट कर दीं क्योंकि मेरा स्टोरेज फ़ुल था।

examples.en: The app won't update because your storage is full.
examples.hi: ऐप अपडेट नहीं होगा क्योंकि तुम्हारा स्टोरेज फ़ुल है।

examples.en: I moved my photos to the cloud when my storage got full.
examples.hi: जब मेरा स्टोरेज फ़ुल हो गया तो मैंने अपनी फ़ोटो क्लाउड पर डाल दीं।

examples.en: Storage full warnings kept popping up during the trip.
examples.hi: यात्रा के दौरान बार-बार स्टोरेज फ़ुल की चेतावनी आती रही।

common_mistake.wrong: My phone's memory is full, so it's very slow now.
common_mistake.right: My phone's storage is full, so it's very slow now.
common_mistake.why: 'Memory' (RAM) affects how many things run smoothly at once, while 'storage' is the space for saved files and apps; a phone slowing down because it can't save new data is a storage issue, not strictly a memory one.

cloze.sentence: I can't download anything new because my ____ warning keeps appearing.

en_def: to delete temporary files an app has saved, usually to fix problems or free up space
hi_def: कैश साफ़ करना (किसी ऐप द्वारा सेव की गई अस्थायी फ़ाइलों को हटाना, आमतौर पर समस्याएँ ठीक करने या जगह बनाने के लिए)
hi_nuance: This is a fairly technical phrase and generally used correctly by IT-literate speakers, but many non-technical Hindi speakers confuse 'clear the cache' with 'delete the app data' or 'uninstall the app' — clearing cache is a lighter action that removes only temporary files and keeps your logins/settings, unlike clearing data or uninstalling, which remove much more.

examples.en: Clear the cache if the app keeps crashing on your phone.
examples.hi: अगर ऐप बार-बार क्रैश हो रहा है तो कैश साफ़ कर दो।

examples.en: I cleared the cache, and the app started working normally again.
examples.hi: मैंने कैश साफ़ किया, और ऐप फिर से सामान्य रूप से काम करने लगा।

examples.en: Clearing the cache regularly can free up some storage space.
examples.hi: नियमित रूप से कैश साफ़ करने से थोड़ी स्टोरेज जगह खाली हो सकती है।

examples.en: Support told me to clear the cache before reinstalling the app.
examples.hi: सपोर्ट ने मुझसे ऐप दोबारा इंस्टॉल करने से पहले कैश साफ़ करने को कहा।

examples.en: I clear the cache of my browser once a week.
examples.hi: मैं अपने ब्राउज़र का कैश हफ़्ते में एक बार साफ़ करता हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: I deleted the app data, so my login is safe and cache is gone.
common_mistake.right: I cleared the cache, so my login is safe and the temporary files are gone.
common_mistake.why: 'Clear cache' keeps your saved logins and settings and removes only temporary files, while 'clear data' or 'uninstall' removes everything, including your login — the two actions have very different consequences.

cloze.sentence: The app is acting strange — try to ____ before reinstalling it.

en_def: a security feature that requires a PIN, pattern, password or biometric to unlock a phone's screen
hi_def: स्क्रीन लॉक (एक सुरक्षा फ़ीचर जिसके लिए फ़ोन की स्क्रीन खोलने हेतु पिन, पैटर्न, पासवर्ड या बायोमेट्रिक चाहिए)
hi_nuance: This is used correctly, but many Hindi speakers use 'password' loosely to describe any screen lock, even when it's actually a pattern or PIN — as a security engineer's learner, it's worth being precise: 'screen lock' is the general feature, while 'PIN', 'pattern', 'password' and 'fingerprint/face unlock' are the specific methods under it.

examples.en: I forgot my screen lock pattern and had to reset the phone.
examples.hi: मैं अपना स्क्रीन लॉक पैटर्न भूल गया और मुझे फ़ोन रीसेट करना पड़ा।

examples.en: Always set a screen lock so no one can access your apps.
examples.hi: हमेशा एक स्क्रीन लॉक सेट करो ताकि कोई तुम्हारे ऐप्स तक न पहुँच सके।

examples.en: My office requires a screen lock on every company phone.
examples.hi: मेरे ऑफ़िस को हर कंपनी फ़ोन पर स्क्रीन लॉक ज़रूरी है।

examples.en: I changed my screen lock from a PIN to a longer password.
examples.hi: मैंने अपना स्क्रीन लॉक पिन से बदलकर लंबा पासवर्ड कर दिया।

examples.en: A strong screen lock is the first line of defence for your phone.
examples.hi: एक मज़बूत स्क्रीन लॉक तुम्हारे फ़ोन की सुरक्षा की पहली परत है।

common_mistake.wrong: My screen password is a pattern, not letters.
common_mistake.right: My screen lock is a pattern, not a password.
common_mistake.why: 'Password' technically means letters/numbers/symbols; a swipe pattern is a different kind of lock and is more accurately called a 'pattern lock', a specific type under the broader term 'screen lock'.

cloze.sentence: As a security precaution, always set a strong ____ on your phone.

en_def: a phone security feature that unlocks the device by recognising the owner's face
hi_def: फ़ेस अनलॉक (एक फ़ोन सुरक्षा फ़ीचर जो मालिक का चेहरा पहचानकर डिवाइस अनलॉक करता है)
hi_nuance: This term is used correctly, but many users don't realise (and security engineers should clarify to family members) that face unlock on many budget phones is less secure than a fingerprint or strong PIN, since it can sometimes be fooled by a photo — worth mentioning 'face unlock' as convenient but not always the most secure option, unlike more advanced depth-sensing versions.

examples.en: Face unlock doesn't work well in the dark on my phone.
examples.hi: अँधेरे में मेरे फ़ोन का फ़ेस अनलॉक ठीक से काम नहीं करता।

examples.en: I prefer face unlock because it's faster than typing a PIN.
examples.hi: मुझे फ़ेस अनलॉक पसंद है क्योंकि यह पिन टाइप करने से तेज़ है।

examples.en: Face unlock failed because I was wearing a mask.
examples.hi: मास्क पहने होने की वजह से फ़ेस अनलॉक फेल हो गया।

examples.en: As a security engineer, I still keep a strong PIN alongside face unlock.
examples.hi: सिक्योरिटी इंजीनियर होने के नाते, मैं फ़ेस अनलॉक के साथ एक मज़बूत पिन भी रखता हूँ।

examples.en: Not every phone's face unlock is equally secure against photos.
examples.hi: हर फ़ोन का फ़ेस अनलॉक फ़ोटो के ख़िलाफ़ समान रूप से सुरक्षित नहीं होता।

common_mistake.wrong: My phone unlocked with my brother's face, so it's very secure.
common_mistake.right: My phone unlocked with my brother's face, so it isn't very secure.
common_mistake.why: If a device can be unlocked by someone else's face, that's a sign of weak, not strong, security — some budget-phone face unlock systems are easily fooled, which is the opposite of what many users assume.

cloze.sentence: I just look at my phone and it opens instantly with ____.

en_def: a system that automatically pays a bill from your account on the due date without manual action
hi_def: ऑटोपे (एक ऐसा सिस्टम जो नियत तिथि पर तुम्हारे खाते से बिल का भुगतान अपने आप कर देता है, बिना मैनुअल कार्रवाई के)
hi_nuance: This term is used correctly, but many Hindi speakers say 'automatic payment' in full every time rather than the shorter, standard term 'autopay' used by banks and apps — both are fine, but 'autopay' is the specific product name commonly seen as a button/toggle in apps, so recognising it helps when setting things up in English-language interfaces.

examples.en: I set up autopay so I never miss my mobile recharge date.
examples.hi: मैंने ऑटोपे सेट कर लिया ताकि मैं कभी अपनी मोबाइल रिचार्ज की तारीख़ न चूकूँ।

examples.en: Autopay failed because there wasn't enough balance in my account.
examples.hi: मेरे खाते में पर्याप्त बैलेंस न होने की वजह से ऑटोपे असफल हो गया।

examples.en: I turned off autopay for my credit card to review each bill manually.
examples.hi: मैंने अपने क्रेडिट कार्ड के लिए ऑटोपे बंद कर दिया ताकि हर बिल ख़ुद जाँच सकूँ।

examples.en: With autopay enabled, my electricity bill gets paid automatically every month.
examples.hi: ऑटोपे चालू होने पर, मेरा बिजली बिल हर महीने अपने आप भर जाता है।

examples.en: I got an alert that my autopay for the broadband bill was successful.
examples.hi: मुझे सूचना मिली कि मेरे ब्रॉडबैंड बिल का ऑटोपे सफल रहा।

common_mistake.wrong: I did the autopay manually this month.
common_mistake.right: I paid the bill manually this month instead of using autopay.
common_mistake.why: 'Autopay' by definition is an automatic process; 'doing autopay manually' is contradictory — if you pay it yourself, that's simply a manual payment, not autopay.

cloze.sentence: I never worry about late fees since I turned on ____ for this bill.

en_def: using mobile internet data on another network, usually in a different city or country, at extra cost
hi_def: डेटा रोमिंग (किसी दूसरे नेटवर्क पर, आमतौर पर अलग शहर या देश में, अतिरिक्त शुल्क पर मोबाइल इंटरनेट डेटा इस्तेमाल करना)
hi_nuance: This term is used correctly, but many Indian travellers don't distinguish between domestic roaming (moving between Indian states/circles, often free now) and international data roaming (moving abroad, usually expensive unless a specific pack is bought) — assuming both work the same way can lead to a very costly phone bill.

examples.en: Turn off data roaming abroad unless you've bought an international pack.
examples.hi: विदेश में डेटा रोमिंग बंद रखो, जब तक तुमने कोई इंटरनेशनल पैक न लिया हो।

examples.en: I forgot to switch off data roaming and got a huge bill.
examples.hi: मैं डेटा रोमिंग बंद करना भूल गया और मुझे भारी बिल आया।

examples.en: Check your data roaming charges before you travel internationally.
examples.hi: अंतरराष्ट्रीय यात्रा से पहले अपने डेटा रोमिंग चार्ज ज़रूर जाँच लो।

examples.en: I bought a data roaming pack for my trip to Singapore.
examples.hi: सिंगापुर की यात्रा के लिए मैंने एक डेटा रोमिंग पैक ख़रीदा।

examples.en: With data roaming on, my apps kept updating and using expensive data.
examples.hi: डेटा रोमिंग चालू होने पर, मेरे ऐप्स अपडेट होते रहे और महँगा डेटा इस्तेमाल होता रहा।

common_mistake.wrong: I kept data roaming on abroad since I have unlimited data at home.
common_mistake.right: I turned off data roaming abroad because my unlimited plan doesn't apply there.
common_mistake.why: A domestic unlimited data plan generally does not cover international data roaming, which is billed separately and often very expensive — assuming home benefits carry over abroad is a costly mistake.

cloze.sentence: Remember to switch off ____ as soon as you land in another country.

en_def: a phone feature that redirects incoming calls from one number to another
hi_def: कॉल फ़ॉरवर्डिंग (एक फ़ोन फ़ीचर जो आने वाली कॉल को एक नंबर से दूसरे नंबर पर भेज देता है)
hi_nuance: This term is used correctly, but many Hindi speakers say 'call diverting' informally, which is understood but 'call forwarding' is the standard formal/technical term used by telecom operators and in phone settings menus in English.

examples.en: I set up call forwarding to my personal number while my office phone is off.
examples.hi: मैंने ऑफ़िस फ़ोन बंद होने के दौरान अपने निजी नंबर पर कॉल फ़ॉरवर्डिंग सेट कर दी।

examples.en: Call forwarding is active, so all calls now go to my colleague.
examples.hi: कॉल फ़ॉरवर्डिंग चालू है, इसलिए अब सभी कॉल मेरे सहकर्मी के पास जा रही हैं।

examples.en: Please disable call forwarding once you're back at your desk.
examples.hi: एक बार तुम अपनी डेस्क पर वापस आ जाओ तो कॉल फ़ॉरवर्डिंग बंद कर देना।

examples.en: I use call forwarding when my phone is being repaired.
examples.hi: जब मेरा फ़ोन ठीक हो रहा होता है तब मैं कॉल फ़ॉरवर्डिंग इस्तेमाल करता हूँ।

examples.en: The operator explained the steps to activate call forwarding.
examples.hi: ऑपरेटर ने कॉल फ़ॉरवर्डिंग सक्रिय करने के चरण समझाए।

common_mistake.wrong: I diverted my SIM to another number.
common_mistake.right: I set up call forwarding from my SIM to another number.
common_mistake.why: You don't 'divert a SIM' as if it moves the card itself; the correct phrasing is that you 'set up call forwarding' or 'divert calls' from one number to another — the number/calls are forwarded, not the SIM.

cloze.sentence: While I'm on leave, all office calls will use ____ to my assistant.

en_def: a recorded message left by a caller when the person they called doesn't answer
hi_def: वॉइसमेल (जब बुलाया गया व्यक्ति जवाब नहीं देता तो कॉल करने वाले द्वारा छोड़ा गया रिकॉर्ड किया हुआ संदेश)
hi_nuance: Voicemail is far less commonly used in everyday Indian mobile culture compared to the West, since missed calls and WhatsApp voice notes serve a similar purpose — Hindi speakers sometimes confuse 'voicemail' with any recorded voice message on chat apps, but true voicemail is specifically tied to the phone network's answering system for unanswered calls.

examples.en: I left a voicemail since he didn't pick up my call.
examples.hi: मैंने वॉइसमेल छोड़ा क्योंकि उसने मेरी कॉल नहीं उठाई।

examples.en: Check your voicemail — the client called while you were in the meeting.
examples.hi: अपना वॉइसमेल चेक करो — जब तुम मीटिंग में थे तब क्लाइंट ने कॉल किया था।

examples.en: My voicemail box is full, so new messages aren't being saved.
examples.hi: मेरा वॉइसमेल बॉक्स भरा हुआ है, इसलिए नए संदेश सेव नहीं हो रहे।

examples.en: I rarely check my voicemail; I prefer texting people back.
examples.hi: मैं शायद ही कभी अपना वॉइसमेल चेक करता हूँ; मुझे लोगों को वापस टेक्स्ट करना पसंद है।

examples.en: Set up your voicemail greeting before you travel abroad.
examples.hi: विदेश जाने से पहले अपना वॉइसमेल ग्रीटिंग सेट कर लो।

common_mistake.wrong: He sent a voicemail on WhatsApp.
common_mistake.right: He sent a voice message on WhatsApp.
common_mistake.why: 'Voicemail' is tied specifically to the telecom network's call-answering system, not chat apps; a recorded audio clip sent through WhatsApp or similar apps is called a 'voice message' or 'voice note', not 'voicemail'.

cloze.sentence: He wasn't answering, so I just left him a ____.

en_def: the sound a phone makes when it receives an incoming call
hi_def: रिंगटोन (फ़ोन पर आने वाली कॉल के समय बजने वाली आवाज़)
hi_nuance: This term is used correctly, but many Hindi speakers use 'ringtone' loosely for notification sounds too, saying 'change the ringtone for messages' — technically, the call-alert sound is the 'ringtone', while the sound for texts/app alerts is called a 'notification tone' or 'notification sound', a useful distinction.

examples.en: I changed my ringtone to something less loud for the office.
examples.hi: मैंने ऑफ़िस के लिए अपनी रिंगटोन कम तेज़ आवाज़ वाली रख ली।

examples.en: His ringtone went off loudly in the middle of the meeting.
examples.hi: मीटिंग के बीच में उसकी रिंगटोन ज़ोर से बज उठी।

examples.en: I set a different ringtone for my manager's calls.
examples.hi: मैंने अपने मैनेजर की कॉल के लिए अलग रिंगटोन सेट कर रखी है।

examples.en: This old song is still one of the most popular ringtones.
examples.hi: यह पुराना गाना अब भी सबसे लोकप्रिय रिंगटोन में से एक है।

examples.en: I couldn't hear my ringtone over the noise of the traffic.
examples.hi: ट्रैफ़िक के शोर में मुझे अपनी रिंगटोन सुनाई ही नहीं दी।

common_mistake.wrong: Please change the ringtone for WhatsApp messages.
common_mistake.right: Please change the notification tone for WhatsApp messages.
common_mistake.why: 'Ringtone' technically refers only to the sound for incoming calls; the sound for texts and app alerts should be called a 'notification tone' or 'notification sound' instead.

cloze.sentence: I heard his phone's ____ from across the room.

en_def: a notification sent by an application to inform the user of something
hi_def: ऐप अलर्ट (किसी एप्लिकेशन द्वारा उपयोगकर्ता को किसी बात की सूचना देने के लिए भेजा गया संदेश)
hi_nuance: This is a reasonably technical phrase and Hindi speakers generally get it right, but many use 'notification' and 'alert' interchangeably without noticing that 'alert' often implies something more urgent or important (like a security alert or fraud alert), while general routine pop-ups are more commonly just called 'notifications'.

examples.en: I got an app alert saying someone logged into my account.
examples.hi: मुझे एक ऐप अलर्ट मिला जिसमें बताया गया कि किसी ने मेरे खाते में लॉगिन किया।

examples.en: Turn off app alerts for games so they don't disturb you at work.
examples.hi: काम के दौरान परेशान होने से बचने के लिए गेम्स के ऐप अलर्ट बंद कर दो।

examples.en: My banking app sends an alert for every transaction.
examples.hi: मेरा बैंकिंग ऐप हर लेन-देन के लिए एक अलर्ट भेजता है।

examples.en: I missed an important app alert because my phone was on silent.
examples.hi: मैंने एक ज़रूरी ऐप अलर्ट छोड़ दिया क्योंकि मेरा फ़ोन साइलेंट पर था।

examples.en: The security app sent an alert about a suspicious login attempt.
examples.hi: सिक्योरिटी ऐप ने एक संदिग्ध लॉगिन प्रयास के बारे में अलर्ट भेजा।

common_mistake.wrong: I get too many alerts from my games, they're so urgent.
common_mistake.right: I get too many notifications from my games, but they're not urgent.
common_mistake.why: 'Alert' generally implies importance or urgency (e.g. security or fraud alerts), while routine pop-ups from games or social apps are better described simply as 'notifications' — calling every pop-up an 'alert' overstates their importance.

cloze.sentence: My banking app sent an ____ about an unusual login from a new device.

en_def: a service that lets your phone make calls and use data on foreign networks while travelling abroad
hi_def: इंटरनेशनल रोमिंग (एक सेवा जो विदेश यात्रा के दौरान फ़ोन को विदेशी नेटवर्क पर कॉल करने और डेटा इस्तेमाल करने देती है)
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers use this term correctly, but many assume roaming activates automatically once they land abroad — in reality, you usually need to activate an international roaming pack from your Indian operator before departure, or your phone will simply have no service at all rather than expensive-but-working service.

examples.en: I activated international roaming before my flight to Dubai.
examples.hi: दुबई की उड़ान से पहले मैंने इंटरनेशनल रोमिंग सक्रिय कर लिया।

examples.en: International roaming charges can be very high without a proper pack.
examples.hi: सही पैक के बिना इंटरनेशनल रोमिंग शुल्क काफ़ी ज़्यादा हो सकता है।

examples.en: My phone showed no service because I forgot to activate international roaming.
examples.hi: मेरे फ़ोन में सेवा नहीं आ रही थी क्योंकि मैं इंटरनेशनल रोमिंग सक्रिय करना भूल गया।

examples.en: The airline app reminded me to buy an international roaming plan.
examples.hi: एयरलाइन ऐप ने मुझे इंटरनेशनल रोमिंग प्लान ख़रीदने की याद दिलाई।

examples.en: International roaming lets me use WhatsApp calls even without local Wi-Fi.
examples.hi: इंटरनेशनल रोमिंग की वजह से मैं बिना स्थानीय वाई-फ़ाई के भी व्हाट्सएप कॉल कर पाता हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: My phone will automatically get service abroad without doing anything.
common_mistake.right: I need to activate international roaming before my phone gets service abroad.
common_mistake.why: International roaming usually needs to be manually activated with your home operator before travelling; assuming it works automatically often leads to having no signal at all on arrival.

cloze.sentence: Don't forget to activate ____ before your flight lands abroad.

en_def: a phone service provided by a company for customers to get help or report problems
hi_def: कस्टमर हेल्पलाइन (ग्राहकों को मदद पाने या समस्या दर्ज कराने के लिए किसी कंपनी द्वारा दी जाने वाली फ़ोन सेवा)
hi_nuance: This term is used correctly, but many Hindi speakers say 'call the customer care number' and 'customer helpline' interchangeably — both are fine and widely understood, though 'helpline' often specifically implies a dedicated support number (sometimes toll-free), while 'customer care' can refer more broadly to the whole support department, not just the phone line.

examples.en: I called the customer helpline to complain about the network issue.
examples.hi: मैंने नेटवर्क की समस्या की शिकायत करने के लिए कस्टमर हेल्पलाइन पर कॉल किया।

examples.en: The customer helpline kept me on hold for almost twenty minutes.
examples.hi: कस्टमर हेल्पलाइन ने मुझे लगभग बीस मिनट तक होल्ड पर रखा।

examples.en: You can find the customer helpline number printed on your bill.
examples.hi: कस्टमर हेल्पलाइन नंबर तुम्हारे बिल पर छपा हुआ मिल जाएगा।

examples.en: The customer helpline resolved my SIM activation issue quickly.
examples.hi: कस्टमर हेल्पलाइन ने मेरी सिम सक्रियण की समस्या जल्दी सुलझा दी।

examples.en: I saved the customer helpline number in case my card is ever lost.
examples.hi: मैंने कस्टमर हेल्पलाइन नंबर सेव कर लिया, ताकि अगर मेरा कार्ड कभी खो जाए।

common_mistake.wrong: I called the customer care to ask about my recharge.
common_mistake.right: I called customer care (or the customer helpline) to ask about my recharge.
common_mistake.why: 'Customer care' is usually used without 'the' as a general uncountable service name in fixed phrases like 'call customer care', while 'the customer helpline' (with 'the') refers to the specific number — mixing articles between the two can sound slightly off.

cloze.sentence: If your recharge fails, call the ____ printed on your SIM packet.

en_def: a facility with a bank where you keep your money and can deposit or withdraw it
hi_def: बैंक खाता (जहाँ आप पैसा जमा या निकाल सकते हैं)
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'I have account in SBI' dropping the article 'a'. The correct form needs 'a bank account': 'I have a bank account with SBI.' Also 'open an account' is right, not 'open account' or 'make an account'.

examples.en: I opened a bank account at the SBI branch near my office.
examples.hi: मैंने अपने ऑफ़िस के पास एसबीआई शाखा में बैंक खाता खुलवाया।

examples.en: You need a bank account to receive your salary.
examples.hi: सैलरी पाने के लिए आपके पास बैंक खाता होना ज़रूरी है।

examples.en: She closed her old bank account after moving to Pune.
examples.hi: पुणे शिफ़्ट होने के बाद उसने अपना पुराना बैंक खाता बंद कर दिया।

examples.en: Please link your Aadhaar to your bank account.
examples.hi: कृपया अपने आधार को अपने बैंक खाते से लिंक करें।

examples.en: Can you send the refund to my bank account directly?
examples.hi: क्या आप रिफ़ंड सीधे मेरे बैंक खाते में भेज सकते हैं?

common_mistake.wrong: I have account in HDFC bank.
common_mistake.right: I have a bank account with HDFC bank.
common_mistake.why: Hindi allows dropping the article, but English needs 'a' before a singular countable noun like 'account'; also we say 'an account with a bank', not 'in a bank' for ownership.

cloze.sentence: I need to open a ____ before my company can transfer my salary.

en_def: a bank account that earns interest and is meant for keeping money rather than daily transactions
hi_def: बचत खाता (जिसमें ब्याज मिलता है)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'saving account' (singular) instead of 'savings account' (with -s), because in Hindi there is no such marker. The standard English term always keeps the 's': 'savings account', 'savings bank'.

examples.en: I keep my emergency money in a savings account.
examples.hi: मैं अपना आपातकालीन पैसा बचत खाते में रखता हूँ।

examples.en: The bank pays four percent interest on a savings account.
examples.hi: बैंक बचत खाते पर चार प्रतिशत ब्याज देता है।

examples.en: My salary account is actually a savings account.
examples.hi: मेरा सैलरी खाता असल में एक बचत खाता है।

examples.en: You must maintain a minimum balance in a savings account.
examples.hi: बचत खाते में आपको न्यूनतम बैलेंस बनाए रखना होता है।

examples.en: He transferred five thousand rupees to his savings account.
examples.hi: उसने अपने बचत खाते में पाँच हज़ार रुपये ट्रांसफ़र किए।

common_mistake.wrong: I opened a saving account last week.
common_mistake.right: I opened a savings account last week.
common_mistake.why: The term is always plural: 'savings account', not 'saving account', even though only one account is meant.

cloze.sentence: Unlike a current account, a ____ pays you interest on your balance.

en_def: a bank account, usually for businesses, meant for frequent transactions and normally without interest
hi_def: चालू खाता (व्यापार के लिए, बार-बार लेन-देन वाला खाता)
hi_nuance: Indian English keeps the British term 'current account'; American English calls this a 'checking account'. Learners writing to international colleagues should know both terms mean roughly the same thing, but mixing them ('current checking account') sounds odd.

examples.en: My uncle runs a shop, so he uses a current account for business.
examples.hi: मेरे चाचा दुकान चलाते हैं, इसलिए वे व्यापार के लिए चालू खाता इस्तेमाल करते हैं।

examples.en: A current account usually does not pay any interest.
examples.hi: चालू खाते पर आमतौर पर कोई ब्याज नहीं मिलता।

examples.en: The company's current account handles hundreds of transactions a day.
examples.hi: कंपनी का चालू खाता रोज़ाना सैकड़ों लेन-देन संभालता है।

examples.en: You need more documents to open a current account than a savings account.
examples.hi: चालू खाता खोलने के लिए बचत खाते से ज़्यादा दस्तावेज़ चाहिए होते हैं।

examples.en: The bank manager suggested a current account for my freelance income.
examples.hi: बैंक मैनेजर ने मेरे फ्रीलांस आय के लिए चालू खाता सुझाया।

common_mistake.wrong: I use current account for my personal salary.
common_mistake.right: I use a savings account for my personal salary; a current account is mainly for business.
common_mistake.why: Learners sometimes confuse the two account types; current accounts are meant for frequent business transactions, not for individual salary or savings.

cloze.sentence: Shopkeepers usually prefer a ____ because it allows unlimited daily transactions.

en_def: a small printed book that records the deposits, withdrawals, and balance of a bank account
hi_def: पासबुक (बैंक खाते की लेन-देन दर्ज करने वाली छोटी किताब)
hi_nuance: Passbooks are common in Indian banking but rare abroad, so international colleagues may not know the word. Learners sometimes say 'bank book', which is understood but 'passbook' is the correct standard term.

examples.en: I need to get my passbook updated at the branch.
examples.hi: मुझे शाखा में जाकर अपनी पासबुक अपडेट करवानी है।

examples.en: The passbook shows every deposit and withdrawal.
examples.hi: पासबुक में हर जमा और निकासी दर्ज होती है।

examples.en: She lost her passbook and had to request a new one.
examples.hi: उसकी पासबुक खो गई और उसे नई पासबुक के लिए आवेदन करना पड़ा।

examples.en: Bring your passbook and Aadhaar card for the KYC update.
examples.hi: केवाईसी अपडेट के लिए अपनी पासबुक और आधार कार्ड लाएँ।

examples.en: My grandmother still prefers a passbook over online banking.
examples.hi: मेरी दादी अभी भी ऑनलाइन बैंकिंग से ज़्यादा पासबुक पसंद करती हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Please give me a bank book for my account.
common_mistake.right: Please give me a passbook for my account.
common_mistake.why: 'Bank book' is not the standard English term used by banks; 'passbook' is the correct word, though 'bank book' is understandable informally.

cloze.sentence: The clerk printed the latest transactions into my ____.

en_def: a printed form on which you write an amount and sign, instructing a bank to pay someone from your account
hi_def: चेक (बैंक से भुगतान का आदेश देने वाला काग़ज़)
hi_nuance: Indian English uses the British spelling 'cheque'; American English uses 'check'. Both are pronounced the same. In writing formal documents for international companies, learners should check which spelling their audience expects.

examples.en: I wrote a cheque for the office rent.
examples.hi: मैंने ऑफ़िस के किराए के लिए एक चेक लिखा।

examples.en: Please deposit this cheque in my savings account.
examples.hi: कृपया यह चेक मेरे बचत खाते में जमा करें।

examples.en: The landlord asked for a cheque instead of cash.
examples.hi: मकान मालिक ने कैश की जगह चेक माँगा।

examples.en: Sign the cheque exactly as it appears on your bank records.
examples.hi: चेक पर वैसे ही हस्ताक्षर करें जैसे बैंक के रिकॉर्ड में हैं।

examples.en: It usually takes two working days to clear a cheque.
examples.hi: चेक क्लियर होने में आमतौर पर दो कार्यदिवस लगते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I will check you tomorrow for the rent.
common_mistake.right: I will give you a cheque tomorrow for the rent.
common_mistake.why: Learners sometimes confuse the noun 'cheque' (payment instrument) with the verb 'check' (to verify); they are pronounced the same but mean different things.

cloze.sentence: He signed the ____ and handed it to the cashier.

en_def: the situation when a cheque is rejected by the bank, usually because there is not enough money in the account
hi_def: चेक बाउंस होना (खाते में पैसे कम होने के कारण चेक का अस्वीकृत हो जाना)
hi_nuance: Indian English commonly says 'my cheque got bounced', which is grammatically odd in standard English; the natural form is 'my cheque bounced' (bounce is already an intransitive verb here, so 'got' is unnecessary).

examples.en: My cheque bounced because of insufficient balance.
examples.hi: बैलेंस कम होने की वजह से मेरा चेक बाउंस हो गया।

examples.en: A cheque bounce can lead to a legal notice under Indian law.
examples.hi: चेक बाउंस होने पर भारतीय कानून के तहत कानूनी नोटिस मिल सकता है।

examples.en: The bank charged a penalty for the cheque bounce.
examples.hi: बैंक ने चेक बाउंस होने पर जुर्माना लगाया।

examples.en: If your cheque bounces twice, the bank may flag your account.
examples.hi: अगर आपका चेक दो बार बाउंस होता है, तो बैंक आपके खाते को फ्लैग कर सकता है।

examples.en: We had a cheque bounce case at work related to a vendor payment.
examples.hi: ऑफ़िस में वेंडर भुगतान से जुड़ा एक चेक बाउंस मामला हुआ था।

common_mistake.wrong: My cheque got bounced due to low balance.
common_mistake.right: My cheque bounced due to low balance.
common_mistake.why: 'Bounce' functions as an active intransitive verb for a rejected cheque; adding 'got' before it is unnecessary and non-standard, though very common in Indian English.

cloze.sentence: The vendor called to say our payment ____ because of a wrong account number.

en_def: a prepaid, guaranteed payment instrument issued by a bank that cannot bounce, used instead of a cheque
hi_def: डिमांड ड्राफ़्ट (बैंक द्वारा जारी गारंटीशुदा भुगतान पत्र, जो बाउंस नहीं होता)
hi_nuance: Demand drafts are common in Indian institutional and government paperwork; the term is rarely used abroad, so it may need explaining to non-Indian colleagues. Learners sometimes shorten it incorrectly to just 'draft' in formal writing, which can be ambiguous.

examples.en: The university asked for a demand draft for the exam fee.
examples.hi: यूनिवर्सिटी ने परीक्षा शुल्क के लिए डिमांड ड्राफ़्ट माँगा।

examples.en: I got a demand draft made in favour of the college.
examples.hi: मैंने कॉलेज के नाम पर डिमांड ड्राफ़्ट बनवाया।

examples.en: A demand draft cannot bounce like a normal cheque.
examples.hi: डिमांड ड्राफ़्ट एक सामान्य चेक की तरह बाउंस नहीं हो सकता।

examples.en: The bank charged a small fee for issuing the demand draft.
examples.hi: बैंक ने डिमांड ड्राफ़्ट जारी करने के लिए मामूली शुल्क लिया।

examples.en: Please submit the demand draft along with the application form.
examples.hi: कृपया आवेदन फ़ॉर्म के साथ डिमांड ड्राफ़्ट जमा करें।

common_mistake.wrong: Please make a draft of ten thousand rupees.
common_mistake.right: Please make a demand draft of ten thousand rupees.
common_mistake.why: In banking English, 'draft' alone is ambiguous (it can mean a rough version of a document); the full term 'demand draft' is needed for the financial instrument.

cloze.sentence: For the government exam fee, you must submit a ____, not a personal cheque.

en_def: moving money electronically from one bank account to another
hi_def: बैंक ट्रांसफ़र (एक खाते से दूसरे खाते में इलेक्ट्रॉनिक तरीके से पैसा भेजना)
hi_nuance: In India, learners often say 'I will do the transfer' or 'I will send you money' without specifying method; in formal work contexts it's clearer to say 'I'll make a bank transfer' or name the method, like NEFT, IMPS, or UPI.

examples.en: I made a bank transfer to pay the electricity bill.
examples.hi: मैंने बिजली का बिल चुकाने के लिए बैंक ट्रांसफ़र किया।

examples.en: The company pays salaries by bank transfer on the last day of the month.
examples.hi: कंपनी महीने के आख़िरी दिन बैंक ट्रांसफ़र से सैलरी देती है।

examples.en: A bank transfer between two Indian banks usually takes a few minutes now.
examples.hi: अब दो भारतीय बैंकों के बीच बैंक ट्रांसफ़र में आमतौर पर कुछ ही मिनट लगते हैं।

examples.en: Can you confirm the bank transfer went through?
examples.hi: क्या आप बता सकते हैं कि बैंक ट्रांसफ़र सफलतापूर्वक हो गया?

examples.en: International bank transfers can take two to three working days.
examples.hi: अंतरराष्ट्रीय बैंक ट्रांसफ़र में दो से तीन कार्यदिवस लग सकते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I will transfer you the money tomorrow.
common_mistake.right: I will transfer the money to you tomorrow.
common_mistake.why: 'Transfer' needs the preposition 'to' before the recipient in standard English; Hindi sentence structure often gets carried over without it.

cloze.sentence: Instead of cash, he asked for a ____ to his savings account.

en_def: an eleven-character code that identifies a specific bank branch in India, used for electronic fund transfers
hi_def: आईएफ़एससी कोड (भारत में किसी बैंक शाखा की पहचान करने वाला कोड, फंड ट्रांसफ़र के लिए ज़रूरी)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes write 'IFSC number' instead of 'IFSC code', since it looks like a numeric code but actually contains letters too. Also remember IFSC already stands for 'Indian Financial System Code', so saying 'IFSC code' is technically repetitive, but it's the accepted everyday usage.

examples.en: I need your account number and IFSC code to transfer the money.
examples.hi: पैसे ट्रांसफ़र करने के लिए मुझे आपका खाता नंबर और आईएफ़एससी कोड चाहिए।

examples.en: You can find the IFSC code printed on your cheque book.
examples.hi: आईएफ़एससी कोड आपकी चेक बुक पर छपा मिलता है।

examples.en: Each bank branch has its own unique IFSC code.
examples.hi: हर बैंक शाखा का अपना अलग आईएफ़एससी कोड होता है।

examples.en: I entered the wrong IFSC code, so the NEFT transfer failed.
examples.hi: मैंने गलत आईएफ़एससी कोड डाल दिया, इसलिए एनईएफ़टी ट्रांसफ़र विफल हो गया।

examples.en: The salary form asks for the IFSC code of the beneficiary bank.
examples.hi: सैलरी फ़ॉर्म में लाभार्थी बैंक का आईएफ़एससी कोड माँगा जाता है।

common_mistake.wrong: Please share your IFSC number for the transfer.
common_mistake.right: Please share your IFSC code for the transfer.
common_mistake.why: Although it looks numeric, the correct term is 'IFSC code' (Indian Financial System Code), not 'IFSC number'.

cloze.sentence: The NEFT form requires the account number, bank name, and ____.

en_def: a machine, usually outside or inside a bank, that lets you withdraw cash or check your balance using a card
hi_def: एटीएम (नकद निकालने या बैलेंस देखने की मशीन)
hi_nuance: Indian English often says 'I will withdraw money from ATM', dropping the article; standard English needs 'from the ATM' or 'at an ATM'. Also note 'ATM machine' is redundant since 'M' already means 'machine', though it is extremely common in everyday Indian speech.

examples.en: I withdrew two thousand rupees from the ATM near my house.
examples.hi: मैंने अपने घर के पास के एटीएम से दो हज़ार रुपये निकाले।

examples.en: The ATM was out of cash, so I had to go to another branch.
examples.hi: एटीएम में कैश खत्म था, इसलिए मुझे दूसरी शाखा जाना पड़ा।

examples.en: Always cover the keypad while entering your PIN at an ATM.
examples.hi: एटीएम पर पिन डालते समय हमेशा कीपैड को ढक कर रखें।

examples.en: There's a new ATM right outside the metro station.
examples.hi: मेट्रो स्टेशन के ठीक बाहर एक नया एटीएम है।

examples.en: She checked her balance at the ATM before shopping.
examples.hi: उसने खरीदारी से पहले एटीएम पर अपना बैलेंस चेक किया।

common_mistake.wrong: I need to go ATM machine to withdraw cash.
common_mistake.right: I need to go to the ATM to withdraw cash.
common_mistake.why: The preposition 'to' and article 'the' are required before 'ATM'; also 'ATM machine' is redundant because ATM already means 'automated teller machine'.

cloze.sentence: There is no cash left in the ____, so I'll try another branch.

en_def: a secret four to six digit number used to confirm your identity for a card or account
hi_def: पिन नंबर (कार्ड या खाते के लिए गुप्त चार-छह अंकों का नंबर)
hi_nuance: 'PIN' already stands for 'Personal Identification Number', so 'PIN number' technically repeats 'number' twice; this is called an RAS syndrome error, but it is extremely common and widely accepted in everyday Indian and global English.

examples.en: Never share your PIN number with anyone, even bank staff.
examples.hi: अपना पिन नंबर किसी के साथ साझा न करें, बैंक कर्मचारियों के साथ भी नहीं।

examples.en: I forgot my PIN number and had to reset it at the branch.
examples.hi: मैं अपना पिन नंबर भूल गया और मुझे शाखा में जाकर उसे रीसेट करवाना पड़ा।

examples.en: Enter your four-digit PIN number to complete the transaction.
examples.hi: लेन-देन पूरा करने के लिए अपना चार अंकों का पिन नंबर डालें।

examples.en: The bank sent a new PIN number by post.
examples.hi: बैंक ने डाक से नया पिन नंबर भेजा।

examples.en: As a security engineer, I always tell people not to write down their PIN number.
examples.hi: एक सुरक्षा इंजीनियर होने के नाते, मैं हमेशा लोगों को कहता हूँ कि अपना पिन नंबर कहीं लिखकर न रखें।

common_mistake.wrong: What is your PIN number number for the card?
common_mistake.right: What is your PIN for the card?
common_mistake.why: Since PIN already means 'Personal Identification Number', adding 'number' after it is redundant; 'PIN' alone is technically more correct, though 'PIN number' is common in casual speech.

cloze.sentence: You need to enter your four-digit ____ before withdrawing cash.

en_def: a bank card that lets you pay directly from your own account balance
hi_def: डेबिट कार्ड (जिससे सीधे आपके खाते से पैसा कटता है)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes mix up 'debit card' and 'credit card' since both look similar; remember debit takes money directly from your account, while credit is borrowed money you repay later. Also say 'swipe the card' or 'tap the card', not 'punch the card'.

examples.en: I paid for the groceries with my debit card.
examples.hi: मैंने अपने डेबिट कार्ड से किराने का सामान खरीदा।

examples.en: My debit card expired last month, so I ordered a new one.
examples.hi: मेरा डेबिट कार्ड पिछले महीने एक्सपायर हो गया, इसलिए मैंने नया मँगवाया।

examples.en: Please block my debit card immediately, I think it was cloned.
examples.hi: कृपया मेरा डेबिट कार्ड तुरंत ब्लॉक करें, मुझे लगता है इसकी क्लोनिंग हुई है।
