examples.en: The shop only accepts a debit card above two hundred rupees.
examples.hi: यह दुकान दो सौ रुपये से ज़्यादा की खरीद पर ही डेबिट कार्ड स्वीकार करती है।

examples.en: I tapped my debit card on the machine to pay for the ticket.
examples.hi: मैंने टिकट के भुगतान के लिए मशीन पर अपना डेबिट कार्ड टैप किया।

common_mistake.wrong: I punched my debit card at the counter.
common_mistake.right: I swiped my debit card at the counter.
common_mistake.why: The correct verb for using a card at a machine is 'swipe' or 'tap', not 'punch', which describes a different physical action entirely.

cloze.sentence: Unlike a credit card, a ____ deducts money straight from your bank balance.

en_def: a card that lets you borrow money from a bank to make purchases, which you repay later, often with interest
hi_def: क्रेडिट कार्ड (जिससे उधार लेकर खरीदारी की जाती है, बाद में चुकाना पड़ता है)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'I have taken a credit card', treating it like a loan; the natural phrasing is 'I have a credit card' or 'I got a credit card'. Also, in Indian English people often say 'swipe the credit card', which is fine, but formal contexts prefer 'use the credit card'.

examples.en: I booked the flight tickets using my credit card.
examples.hi: मैंने अपने क्रेडिट कार्ड से फ्लाइट टिकट बुक की।

examples.en: Pay off your credit card bill before the due date to avoid interest.
examples.hi: ब्याज से बचने के लिए देय तिथि से पहले अपना क्रेडिट कार्ड बिल चुकाएँ।

examples.en: The bank increased my credit card limit after a year.
examples.hi: एक साल बाद बैंक ने मेरी क्रेडिट कार्ड की सीमा बढ़ा दी।

examples.en: He applied for a new credit card with better cashback offers.
examples.hi: उसने बेहतर कैशबैक ऑफ़र वाले नए क्रेडिट कार्ड के लिए आवेदन किया।

examples.en: Report a lost credit card to the bank right away.
examples.hi: खोए हुए क्रेडिट कार्ड की सूचना तुरंत बैंक को दें।

common_mistake.wrong: I have taken a credit card from the bank.
common_mistake.right: I have a credit card from the bank.
common_mistake.why: 'Taken a credit card' sounds like borrowing an object; in natural English you 'have', 'get', or 'apply for' a credit card, not 'take' one.

cloze.sentence: He used his ____ to pay for the flight and will repay it next month.

en_def: a monthly statement showing how much you owe on your credit card and must repay
hi_def: क्रेडिट कार्ड बिल (हर महीने आने वाला बकाया राशि का विवरण)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'my credit card bill has come' using present perfect for a routine arrival; more natural is 'my credit card bill arrived' or 'I got my credit card bill'. Also distinguish 'bill' (amount due) from 'statement' (detailed transaction list); Indian English often uses them interchangeably.

examples.en: My credit card bill this month is higher than usual.
examples.hi: इस महीने मेरा क्रेडिट कार्ड बिल हमेशा से ज़्यादा है।

examples.en: I pay my credit card bill in full every month to avoid interest.
examples.hi: ब्याज से बचने के लिए मैं हर महीने अपना पूरा क्रेडिट कार्ड बिल चुकाता हूँ।

examples.en: The credit card bill included a charge I didn't recognise.
examples.hi: क्रेडिट कार्ड बिल में एक ऐसा चार्ज था जो मुझे पहचान में नहीं आया।

examples.en: You can set up auto-debit for your credit card bill payment.
examples.hi: आप अपने क्रेडिट कार्ड बिल के भुगतान के लिए ऑटो-डेबिट सेट कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: She forgot to pay her credit card bill and got charged a late fee.
examples.hi: वह अपना क्रेडिट कार्ड बिल चुकाना भूल गई और उस पर लेट फ़ीस लग गई।

common_mistake.wrong: My credit card bill has come, I need to pay it today.
common_mistake.right: My credit card bill arrived, I need to pay it today.
common_mistake.why: For a routine, completed event like a bill arriving, simple past ('arrived') is more natural in English than present perfect ('has come'), which Hindi structure often prompts.

cloze.sentence: I always check my ____ carefully before paying it, in case of wrong charges.

en_def: the last date by which a payment or task must be completed
hi_def: देय तिथि (भुगतान या काम पूरा करने की आख़िरी तारीख़)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes confuse 'due date' with 'deadline'; they overlap but 'due date' is used specifically for payments and bills, while 'deadline' is more general for tasks. Also note the preposition is 'before the due date' or 'by the due date', not 'in the due date'.

examples.en: Pay your electricity bill before the due date to avoid a late fee.
examples.hi: लेट फ़ीस से बचने के लिए देय तिथि से पहले बिजली का बिल चुकाएँ।

examples.en: The due date for the credit card payment is the fifth of every month.
examples.hi: क्रेडिट कार्ड भुगतान की देय तिथि हर महीने की पाँच तारीख़ है।

examples.en: I missed the due date and had to pay an extra charge.
examples.hi: मुझसे देय तिथि छूट गई और मुझे अतिरिक्त शुल्क देना पड़ा।

examples.en: Can you extend the due date for this form submission?
examples.hi: क्या आप इस फ़ॉर्म जमा करने की देय तिथि बढ़ा सकते हैं?

examples.en: The bank sends a reminder a few days before the due date.
examples.hi: बैंक देय तिथि से कुछ दिन पहले याद दिलाता है।

common_mistake.wrong: Please pay in the due date.
common_mistake.right: Please pay by the due date.
common_mistake.why: The correct preposition with 'due date' is 'by' (meaning no later than), not 'in', which does not fit this time expression.

cloze.sentence: If you don't pay by the ____, a late fee will be added.

en_def: the smallest amount of money a bank requires you to keep in your account at all times
hi_def: न्यूनतम बैलेंस (खाते में हमेशा रखी जाने वाली सबसे कम राशि)
hi_nuance: Learners often say 'maintain minimum balance' without the article; correct usage is 'maintain a minimum balance' or 'maintain the minimum balance' when referring to a specific bank's requirement. Non-maintenance charge is often called 'penalty' informally, though banks officially call it a 'non-maintenance charge'.

examples.en: This account requires a minimum balance of five thousand rupees.
examples.hi: इस खाते में पाँच हज़ार रुपये न्यूनतम बैलेंस रखना ज़रूरी है।

examples.en: I was charged a penalty for not maintaining the minimum balance.
examples.hi: न्यूनतम बैलेंस न रखने के कारण मुझ पर जुर्माना लगाया गया।

examples.en: Some zero-balance accounts don't require any minimum balance.
examples.hi: कुछ ज़ीरो-बैलेंस खातों में किसी न्यूनतम बैलेंस की ज़रूरत नहीं होती।

examples.en: Please check the minimum balance rules before opening this account.
examples.hi: यह खाता खोलने से पहले न्यूनतम बैलेंस के नियम ज़रूर जाँच लें।

examples.en: My balance fell below the minimum balance last month.
examples.hi: पिछले महीने मेरा बैलेंस न्यूनतम बैलेंस से नीचे चला गया।

common_mistake.wrong: You must maintain minimum balance in this account.
common_mistake.right: You must maintain a minimum balance in this account.
common_mistake.why: The countable noun phrase 'minimum balance' needs an article ('a' or 'the') in standard English; Hindi does not require an equivalent marker, so learners often drop it.

cloze.sentence: If you don't maintain the ____, the bank deducts a penalty.

en_def: an arrangement that lets you withdraw more money than you have in your account, up to an agreed limit
hi_def: ओवरड्राफ़्ट (खाते में जमा राशि से ज़्यादा पैसा निकालने की सुविधा)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes use 'overdraft' as a verb ('I overdrafted my account'); the standard verb form is 'to overdraw' ('I overdrew my account'), while 'overdraft' itself is normally a noun for the facility or the amount owed.

examples.en: The bank gave my company an overdraft facility for cash flow needs.
examples.hi: बैंक ने मेरी कंपनी को कैश फ़्लो ज़रूरतों के लिए ओवरड्राफ़्ट सुविधा दी।

examples.en: I used the overdraft to pay salaries before client payments arrived.
examples.hi: क्लाइंट भुगतान आने से पहले सैलरी देने के लिए मैंने ओवरड्राफ़्ट का इस्तेमाल किया।

examples.en: An overdraft usually charges a higher interest rate than a loan.
examples.hi: ओवरड्राफ़्ट पर आमतौर पर लोन से ज़्यादा ब्याज दर लगती है।

examples.en: Please clear the overdraft amount by the end of the month.
examples.hi: कृपया महीने के अंत तक ओवरड्राफ़्ट की राशि चुका दें।

examples.en: The bank reviews your overdraft limit every year.
examples.hi: बैंक हर साल आपकी ओवरड्राफ़्ट सीमा की समीक्षा करता है।

common_mistake.wrong: I overdrafted my account last week.
common_mistake.right: I overdrew my account last week.
common_mistake.why: 'Overdraft' is normally a noun; the verb form is 'overdraw' (past tense 'overdrew'), not 'overdraft' used as a verb.

cloze.sentence: The business relies on an ____ to cover short-term expenses.

en_def: an official document listing all the transactions and balance of a bank account over a period of time
hi_def: बैंक स्टेटमेंट (एक निश्चित अवधि के सभी लेन-देन और बैलेंस का आधिकारिक विवरण)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'give me the statement of my bank' instead of the correct compound noun 'bank statement'. Also many Indian offices ask for the 'last six months' bank statement' for loan or visa applications; the phrasing 'bank statement of last six months' is common but 'from the last six months' is more natural.

examples.en: I downloaded my bank statement for the visa application.
examples.hi: मैंने वीज़ा आवेदन के लिए अपना बैंक स्टेटमेंट डाउनलोड किया।

examples.en: The bank statement shows every transaction from last month.
examples.hi: बैंक स्टेटमेंट में पिछले महीने का हर लेन-देन दिखता है।

examples.en: Please attach a bank statement from the last three months.
examples.hi: कृपया पिछले तीन महीनों का बैंक स्टेटमेंट संलग्न करें।

examples.en: I noticed an unfamiliar charge on my bank statement.
examples.hi: मुझे अपने बैंक स्टेटमेंट में एक अनजान चार्ज दिखा।

examples.en: You can get a printed bank statement at the branch counter.
examples.hi: आप शाखा काउंटर पर बैंक स्टेटमेंट प्रिंट करवा सकते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Give me the statement of my bank for last month.
common_mistake.right: Give me my bank statement for last month.
common_mistake.why: 'Bank statement' is a fixed compound noun; English does not use 'statement of my bank' the way Hindi structure might suggest through direct translation.

cloze.sentence: The loan officer asked for a ____ from the last six months.

en_def: 'Know Your Customer', the process banks and companies use to verify a customer's identity using documents
hi_def: केवाईसी (ग्राहक की पहचान सत्यापित करने की प्रक्रिया, 'नो योर कस्टमर')
hi_nuance: KYC is used constantly in Indian banking and telecom, but learners sometimes say 'do my KYC' when the correct phrasing is 'complete my KYC' or 'update my KYC'; banks also say 'KYC verification' or 'KYC documents', not 'KYC papers'.

examples.en: I need to complete my KYC before the account gets activated.
examples.hi: खाता सक्रिय होने से पहले मुझे अपना केवाईसी पूरा करना है।

examples.en: The bank asked for updated KYC documents this year.
examples.hi: बैंक ने इस साल अपडेटेड केवाईसी दस्तावेज़ माँगे।

examples.en: My mobile number got blocked because my KYC was pending.
examples.hi: मेरा मोबाइल नंबर ब्लॉक हो गया क्योंकि मेरा केवाईसी लंबित था।

examples.en: You can do video KYC now instead of visiting the branch.
examples.hi: अब आप शाखा जाने की बजाय वीडियो केवाईसी करवा सकते हैं।

examples.en: Aadhaar and PAN card are commonly used for KYC verification.
examples.hi: आधार और पैन कार्ड आमतौर पर केवाईसी सत्यापन के लिए इस्तेमाल होते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I have to do my KYC papers at the branch.
common_mistake.right: I have to submit my KYC documents at the branch.
common_mistake.why: The standard collocation is 'KYC documents' (or 'KYC verification'), not 'KYC papers', which sounds informal and non-standard in official banking English.

cloze.sentence: The bank froze the account because the customer's ____ was not updated.

en_def: a twelve-digit unique identity card issued by the Indian government, based on biometric and demographic data
hi_def: आधार कार्ड (भारत सरकार द्वारा जारी बारह अंकों का विशिष्ट पहचान पत्र)
hi_nuance: Learners often say 'Aadhar card' or 'Adhaar card' with inconsistent spelling; the official spelling is 'Aadhaar' (with double 'a'). Also note it's called an 'Aadhaar number' when referring only to the digits, and 'Aadhaar card' when referring to the physical or digital document.

examples.en: Please carry a photocopy of your Aadhaar card for the appointment.
examples.hi: अपॉइंटमेंट के लिए कृपया अपने आधार कार्ड की फोटोकॉपी साथ लाएँ।

examples.en: I linked my Aadhaar card to my mobile number.
examples.hi: मैंने अपना आधार कार्ड अपने मोबाइल नंबर से लिंक किया।

examples.en: The bank uses the Aadhaar card as valid proof of identity.
examples.hi: बैंक पहचान प्रमाण के रूप में आधार कार्ड का इस्तेमाल करता है।

examples.en: You can download an e-Aadhaar card from the UIDAI website.
examples.hi: आप यूआईडीएआई की वेबसाइट से ई-आधार कार्ड डाउनलोड कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: My Aadhaar card address is different from my current address.
examples.hi: मेरे आधार कार्ड का पता मेरे वर्तमान पते से अलग है।

common_mistake.wrong: Please bring your Adhar card tomorrow.
common_mistake.right: Please bring your Aadhaar card tomorrow.
common_mistake.why: The correct official spelling has a double 'a' in the middle: 'Aadhaar', not 'Adhar' or 'Aadhar', which are common misspellings.

cloze.sentence: For KYC, the bank accepted my ____ as proof of identity and address.

en_def: a ten-character alphanumeric identity card issued by the Indian Income Tax Department, used for financial transactions
hi_def: पैन कार्ड (आयकर विभाग द्वारा जारी दस अंकों वाला पहचान पत्र, वित्तीय लेन-देन के लिए)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes explain 'PAN' as if it stands for 'Personal Account Number'; it actually means 'Permanent Account Number'. Also remember the correct phrase is 'PAN card number', not 'PAN card no.' in formal writing, though the abbreviation is common informally.

examples.en: You need a PAN card to open a bank account in India.
examples.hi: भारत में बैंक खाता खोलने के लिए पैन कार्ड ज़रूरी है।

examples.en: I forgot to carry my PAN card for the loan application.
examples.hi: मैं लोन आवेदन के लिए अपना पैन कार्ड लाना भूल गया।

examples.en: Please link your PAN card with your Aadhaar card by the deadline.
examples.hi: कृपया समय सीमा के भीतर अपने पैन कार्ड को आधार कार्ड से लिंक करें।

examples.en: A PAN card is mandatory for transactions above a certain amount.
examples.hi: एक निश्चित राशि से ज़्यादा के लेन-देन के लिए पैन कार्ड अनिवार्य है।

examples.en: I applied for a duplicate PAN card after losing the original.
examples.hi: मूल कार्ड खोने के बाद मैंने डुप्लीकेट पैन कार्ड के लिए आवेदन किया।

common_mistake.wrong: PAN card stands for Personal Account Number.
common_mistake.right: PAN card stands for Permanent Account Number.
common_mistake.why: A common mix-up in India is confusing 'Permanent' with 'Personal'; the official expansion is 'Permanent Account Number'.

cloze.sentence: The bank asked for both an Aadhaar card and a ____ to open the account.

en_def: a bill for a basic service such as electricity, water, or gas that you use regularly at home
hi_def: यूटिलिटी बिल (बिजली, पानी या गैस जैसी बुनियादी सेवाओं का बिल)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'household bill' instead of the standard term 'utility bill'. Note that a utility bill is also frequently accepted as address proof for KYC in India, which is worth mentioning in office or bank contexts.

examples.en: I use a utility bill as address proof for KYC.
examples.hi: मैं केवाईसी के लिए पते के प्रमाण के रूप में यूटिलिटी बिल इस्तेमाल करता हूँ।

examples.en: Our utility bills increased after we started working from home.
examples.hi: घर से काम करना शुरू करने के बाद हमारे यूटिलिटी बिल बढ़ गए।

examples.en: Please pay the utility bill online before the due date.
examples.hi: कृपया देय तिथि से पहले यूटिलिटी बिल ऑनलाइन चुकाएँ।

examples.en: The landlord asked us to submit a recent utility bill.
examples.hi: मकान मालिक ने हमसे हाल का यूटिलिटी बिल जमा करने को कहा।

examples.en: I set reminders for all my utility bills so I never miss one.
examples.hi: मैंने अपने सभी यूटिलिटी बिलों के लिए रिमाइंडर सेट किए हैं ताकि कोई छूटे नहीं।

common_mistake.wrong: Submit any household bill as address proof.
common_mistake.right: Submit any utility bill as address proof.
common_mistake.why: In official Indian forms, the accepted standard term is 'utility bill' (electricity, water, gas), not the more general 'household bill'.

cloze.sentence: As address proof, you can attach a recent electricity or water ____.

en_def: a bill sent by the power company showing the amount you must pay for electricity used
hi_def: बिजली का बिल (बिजली कंपनी द्वारा भेजा गया भुगतान का बिल)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'light bill', a direct translation from Hindi/regional usage ('लाइट का बिल'); the standard English term is 'electricity bill', though 'light bill' is understood colloquially in India.

examples.en: I pay my electricity bill through a mobile app every month.
examples.hi: मैं हर महीने मोबाइल ऐप के ज़रिए अपना बिजली का बिल चुकाता हूँ।

examples.en: Our electricity bill was unusually high this summer.
examples.hi: इस गर्मी में हमारा बिजली का बिल असामान्य रूप से ज़्यादा था।

examples.en: The electricity bill shows the meter reading and units consumed.
examples.hi: बिजली के बिल में मीटर रीडिंग और इस्तेमाल की गई यूनिट्स दिखती हैं।

examples.en: Please don't forget to pay the electricity bill before the due date.
examples.hi: कृपया देय तिथि से पहले बिजली का बिल चुकाना न भूलें।

examples.en: I set up auto-debit for my electricity bill to avoid late fees.
examples.hi: मैंने लेट फ़ीस से बचने के लिए अपने बिजली बिल के लिए ऑटो-डेबिट सेट किया।

common_mistake.wrong: I need to pay the light bill today.
common_mistake.right: I need to pay the electricity bill today.
common_mistake.why: 'Light bill' is a direct translation from Hindi/regional expressions and is understood informally in India, but 'electricity bill' is the standard English term.

cloze.sentence: The meter reading determines how much you owe on your ____.

en_def: a bill charging for the amount of water supplied to your home over a period
hi_def: पानी का बिल (घर में इस्तेमाल हुए पानी का भुगतान बिल)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes use 'water tax' instead of 'water bill', since municipal corporations in India sometimes call it a tax; in everyday English, 'water bill' is the more natural, general term for the recurring payment.

examples.en: The municipal corporation sends the water bill every quarter.
examples.hi: नगर निगम हर तिमाही पानी का बिल भेजता है।

examples.en: I paid the water bill online instead of standing in a queue.
examples.hi: मैंने कतार में खड़े होने की बजाय पानी का बिल ऑनलाइन चुकाया।

examples.en: Our water bill went up because of a leaking pipe.
examples.hi: पाइप में रिसाव होने की वजह से हमारा पानी का बिल बढ़ गया।

examples.en: Please keep last year's water bill for the address proof.
examples.hi: कृपया पते के प्रमाण के लिए पिछले साल का पानी का बिल रखें।

examples.en: I forgot to pay the water bill and got a reminder notice.
examples.hi: मैं पानी का बिल चुकाना भूल गया और मुझे रिमाइंडर नोटिस मिला।

common_mistake.wrong: I have to pay water tax this month.
common_mistake.right: I have to pay the water bill this month.
common_mistake.why: While some municipal bodies label it a 'tax', standard everyday English usually calls this recurring payment a 'water bill', similar to 'electricity bill'.

cloze.sentence: A leaking tap can noticeably increase your monthly ____.

en_def: an extra charge added when a payment is made after the due date
hi_def: लेट फ़ीस (देय तिथि के बाद भुगतान करने पर लगने वाला अतिरिक्त शुल्क)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'late charge' or 'penalty fee'; both are understandable, but 'late fee' is the most common standard term for bills and credit cards, while 'penalty' is more common for loans or legal matters.

examples.en: I paid the bill one day late and was charged a late fee.
examples.hi: मैंने बिल एक दिन देरी से चुकाया और मुझ पर लेट फ़ीस लगी।

examples.en: The credit card company waived the late fee since it was my first delay.
examples.hi: क्रेडिट कार्ड कंपनी ने लेट फ़ीस माफ़ कर दी क्योंकि यह मेरी पहली देरी थी।

examples.en: Avoid the late fee by setting a reminder before the due date.
examples.hi: देय तिथि से पहले रिमाइंडर सेट करके लेट फ़ीस से बचें।

examples.en: The late fee for this bill is fifty rupees per day.
examples.hi: इस बिल पर लेट फ़ीस पचास रुपये प्रति दिन है।

examples.en: I called customer care to ask about the late fee on my statement.
examples.hi: मैंने अपने स्टेटमेंट पर लगी लेट फ़ीस के बारे में पूछने के लिए कस्टमर केयर को फ़ोन किया।

common_mistake.wrong: They added a late charge fee on my bill.
common_mistake.right: They added a late fee to my bill.
common_mistake.why: 'Late charge fee' is redundant, combining two words that both mean 'fee'; the standard single term is 'late fee' or 'late charge', not both together.

cloze.sentence: If you pay after the due date, the bank adds a ____.

en_def: an automatic deduction of money from your bank account on a fixed date, usually to pay a recurring bill
hi_def: ऑटो-डेबिट (तय तारीख़ पर खाते से स्वतः कटने वाली राशि, आमतौर पर बिल भुगतान के लिए)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'auto debit' as a verb directly ('the bank auto debited my account'), which is understood but the more standard phrasing is 'the bill was auto-debited' or 'I set up auto-debit for the bill'. Hyphenation varies; 'auto-debit' and 'auto debit' are both seen.

examples.en: I set up auto-debit for my electricity bill last month.
examples.hi: मैंने पिछले महीने अपने बिजली बिल के लिए ऑटो-डेबिट सेट किया।

examples.en: The auto-debit failed because my account balance was low.
examples.hi: बैलेंस कम होने की वजह से ऑटो-डेबिट विफल हो गया।

examples.en: With auto-debit, I never miss the credit card due date.
examples.hi: ऑटो-डेबिट की वजह से मैं कभी क्रेडिट कार्ड की देय तिथि नहीं चूकता।

examples.en: You can cancel the auto-debit mandate from the bank's app.
examples.hi: आप बैंक के ऐप से ऑटो-डेबिट का मैंडेट रद्द कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: The insurance premium is paid through auto-debit every year.
examples.hi: बीमा प्रीमियम हर साल ऑटो-डेबिट के ज़रिए चुकाया जाता है।

common_mistake.wrong: The bank auto debited my account without permission.
common_mistake.right: The bank auto-debited my account based on the mandate I approved.
common_mistake.why: Auto-debit only happens after the customer sets up a mandate or standing instruction; saying it happened 'without permission' misunderstands how the facility legally works.

cloze.sentence: I set up an ____ so my rent gets paid automatically every month.

en_def: to write the required information in the blank spaces of a document
hi_def: फ़ॉर्म भरना (दस्तावेज़ की खाली जगहों में ज़रूरी जानकारी लिखना)
hi_nuance: Indian English commonly uses 'fill the form' (transitive without preposition), while standard British/American English prefers 'fill in the form' or 'fill out the form'. Also common filler office phrasing 'do one thing, fill this form and submit it' is very Indian-English and sounds informal or awkward in international settings.

examples.en: Please fill in this form before you meet the bank manager.
examples.hi: बैंक मैनेजर से मिलने से पहले कृपया यह फ़ॉर्म भरें।

examples.en: I filled in the account opening form at the counter.
examples.hi: मैंने काउंटर पर खाता खोलने का फ़ॉर्म भरा।

examples.en: She filled in the form in capital letters as instructed.
examples.hi: उसने निर्देशानुसार फ़ॉर्म को बड़े अक्षरों में भरा।

examples.en: Can you help me fill in this KYC form?
examples.hi: क्या आप मुझे यह केवाईसी फ़ॉर्म भरने में मदद कर सकते हैं?

examples.en: I forgot to fill in my mobile number on the form.
examples.hi: मैं फ़ॉर्म में अपना मोबाइल नंबर भरना भूल गया।

common_mistake.wrong: Please fill the form and submit it at the counter.
common_mistake.right: Please fill in the form and submit it at the counter.
common_mistake.why: Indian English commonly drops the preposition ('fill the form'), but standard English requires 'fill in' or 'fill out' before 'the form'.

cloze.sentence: Before your appointment, please ____ with your name and account number.

en_def: an official document you complete to formally request something, such as a service, job, or account
hi_def: आवेदन पत्र (किसी सेवा, नौकरी या खाते के लिए औपचारिक अनुरोध वाला फ़ॉर्म)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'apply form' instead of 'application form'; 'apply' is a verb, and the noun form needed here is 'application'. Also remember 'submit an application form', not 'give an application form' to the officer.

examples.en: I need to submit an application form to open a new account.
examples.hi: नया खाता खोलने के लिए मुझे एक आवेदन पत्र जमा करना है।

examples.en: The application form asks for your PAN card details.
examples.hi: आवेदन पत्र में आपके पैन कार्ड की जानकारी माँगी जाती है।

examples.en: Please attach a photograph with the application form.
examples.hi: कृपया आवेदन पत्र के साथ एक फोटो संलग्न करें।

examples.en: She downloaded the application form from the bank's website.
examples.hi: उसने बैंक की वेबसाइट से आवेदन पत्र डाउनलोड किया।

examples.en: Make sure you sign the application form before submitting it.
examples.hi: जमा करने से पहले सुनिश्चित करें कि आपने आवेदन पत्र पर हस्ताक्षर किए हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I need to fill the apply form for a new card.
common_mistake.right: I need to fill in the application form for a new card.
common_mistake.why: 'Apply' is a verb; the noun for the document is 'application', so the correct compound is 'application form', not 'apply form'.

cloze.sentence: You must sign the ____ before the branch can process your request.

en_def: an exact copy of a document made using a photocopying machine
hi_def: फोटोकॉपी (मशीन से बनाई गई दस्तावेज़ की सटीक प्रति)
hi_nuance: Indian English uses 'photocopy' both as a noun and a verb ('please photocopy this'), which is correct; but learners sometimes say 'xerox' as a generic verb (from the brand name Xerox), which is very common in India but not understood internationally as a verb.

examples.en: Please attach a photocopy of your Aadhaar card with the form.
examples.hi: कृपया फ़ॉर्म के साथ अपने आधार कार्ड की फोटोकॉपी संलग्न करें।

examples.en: I need a photocopy of my PAN card for the bank.
examples.hi: मुझे बैंक के लिए अपने पैन कार्ड की एक फोटोकॉपी चाहिए।

examples.en: The shop near the branch makes photocopies for two rupees a page.
examples.hi: शाखा के पास की दुकान दो रुपये प्रति पेज फोटोकॉपी बनाती है।

examples.en: Can you get a photocopy of this document before the appointment?
examples.hi: क्या आप अपॉइंटमेंट से पहले इस दस्तावेज़ की फोटोकॉपी करवा सकते हैं?

examples.en: I always keep a photocopy of important documents at home.
examples.hi: मैं हमेशा महत्वपूर्ण दस्तावेज़ों की एक फोटोकॉपी घर पर रखता हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: Please xerox my Aadhaar card at the shop.
common_mistake.right: Please photocopy my Aadhaar card at the shop.
common_mistake.why: 'Xerox' is a brand name used informally as a verb in India, but internationally the correct general verb is 'photocopy'.

cloze.sentence: The clerk asked for a self-attested ____ of my PAN card.

en_def: describes a copy of a document that the document owner has signed to certify it is a true copy, without needing an official's stamp
hi_def: स्व-सत्यापित (जिस दस्तावेज़ की प्रति दस्तावेज़ के मालिक ने खुद हस्ताक्षर करके सही होने का प्रमाण दिया हो)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'self-attest' as a noun ('give a self-attest copy'); the correct adjective form is 'self-attested copy'. Also don't confuse this with 'notarised', which requires a notary's official stamp, a stricter form of certification.

examples.en: Please submit self-attested photocopies of your Aadhaar and PAN card.
examples.hi: कृपया अपने आधार और पैन कार्ड की स्व-सत्यापित फोटोकॉपी जमा करें।

examples.en: A self-attested document means you sign it yourself as proof it's genuine.
examples.hi: स्व-सत्यापित दस्तावेज़ का मतलब है कि आप खुद हस्ताक्षर करके उसे असली प्रमाणित करते हैं।

examples.en: The HR department only accepts self-attested copies for the file.
examples.hi: एचआर विभाग फ़ाइल के लिए केवल स्व-सत्यापित प्रतियाँ ही स्वीकार करता है।

examples.en: I wrote 'self-attested' and signed on each photocopy.
examples.hi: मैंने हर फोटोकॉपी पर 'स्व-सत्यापित' लिखकर हस्ताक्षर किए।

examples.en: Unlike notarised documents, self-attested ones don't need a lawyer's stamp.
examples.hi: नोटरीकृत दस्तावेज़ों के विपरीत, स्व-सत्यापित दस्तावेज़ों पर वकील की मुहर की ज़रूरत नहीं होती।

common_mistake.wrong: Please give a self-attest copy of your ID.
common_mistake.right: Please give a self-attested copy of your ID.
common_mistake.why: 'Self-attest' is the verb form; the adjective describing the document must be 'self-attested', with the '-ed' ending.

cloze.sentence: The form requires a ____ photocopy of your Aadhaar card, signed by you.

en_def: a number given to a customer to show their place in a queue at a bank, hospital, or office
hi_def: टोकन नंबर (बैंक, अस्पताल या दफ़्तर में कतार में स्थान दिखाने वाला नंबर)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'my number' or 'my turn number', which is understood, but the standard term used at Indian banks and offices is 'token number'. Also say 'my token number is called', not 'my token number comes'.

examples.en: I collected a token number as soon as I entered the branch.
examples.hi: मैंने शाखा में घुसते ही एक टोकन नंबर लिया।

examples.en: Please wait until your token number is called.
examples.hi: कृपया तब तक इंतज़ार करें जब तक आपका टोकन नंबर न बुलाया जाए।

examples.en: My token number was forty-two, and they were on number thirty.
examples.hi: मेरा टोकन नंबर बयालीस था, और वे नंबर तीस पर थे।

examples.en: The display screen shows the current token number being served.
examples.hi: डिस्प्ले स्क्रीन पर सेवा दिया जा रहा वर्तमान टोकन नंबर दिखता है।

examples.en: I checked my token number on the app before leaving home.
examples.hi: मैंने घर से निकलने से पहले ऐप पर अपना टोकन नंबर जाँचा।

common_mistake.wrong: My token number will come in ten minutes.
common_mistake.right: My token number will be called in ten minutes.
common_mistake.why: In this context, English uses 'called' (announced by the counter) rather than 'come', which sounds like the number itself is arriving somewhere.

cloze.sentence: Take a seat and wait until the screen shows your ____.

en_def: to collect a numbered ticket that marks your place in a queue
hi_def: टोकन लेना (कतार में जगह दिखाने वाला नंबर वाला टोकन लेना)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'take token' without the article, following Hindi. Standard English requires 'take a token'. Also note the phrase used at the counter is 'take a token and have a seat', which is common in bank and hospital settings across India.

examples.en: Take a token from the machine near the entrance.
examples.hi: प्रवेश द्वार के पास मशीन से एक टोकन लें।

examples.en: I forgot to take a token and had to go back to the counter.
examples.hi: मैं टोकन लेना भूल गया और मुझे काउंटर पर वापस जाना पड़ा।

examples.en: Please take a token before you sit down to wait.
examples.hi: बैठकर इंतज़ार करने से पहले कृपया एक टोकन लें।

examples.en: She took a token for the passport office queue.
examples.hi: उसने पासपोर्ट कार्यालय की कतार के लिए एक टोकन लिया।

examples.en: You don't need to take a token if you already have an appointment.
examples.hi: अगर आपके पास पहले से अपॉइंटमेंट है, तो आपको टोकन लेने की ज़रूरत नहीं।

common_mistake.wrong: Please take token before sitting.
common_mistake.right: Please take a token before sitting.
common_mistake.why: Standard English requires the indefinite article 'a' before the singular countable noun 'token'; Hindi does not need an equivalent word here.

cloze.sentence: As soon as you enter the branch, ____ from the machine and wait for your turn.

en_def: the desk in a bank branch where customers are served by staff for transactions and enquiries
hi_def: बैंक काउंटर (शाखा में ग्राहकों की सेवा के लिए बना डेस्क)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'go to bank window' (a direct translation influenced by ticket counters); the standard term in English is 'bank counter' or simply 'counter'. Also 'cash counter' refers specifically to the desk for depositing or withdrawing cash.

examples.en: I stood in line at the bank counter for almost an hour.
examples.hi: मैं करीब एक घंटे तक बैंक काउंटर पर कतार में खड़ा रहा।

examples.en: Please submit the withdrawal slip at the bank counter.
examples.hi: कृपया निकासी पर्ची बैंक काउंटर पर जमा करें।

examples.en: The bank counter closes at four in the evening.
examples.hi: बैंक काउंटर शाम चार बजे बंद हो जाता है।

examples.en: I asked the staff at the bank counter about my cheque status.
examples.hi: मैंने बैंक काउंटर पर स्टाफ़ से अपने चेक की स्थिति के बारे में पूछा।

examples.en: There were only two staff members at the bank counter today.
examples.hi: आज बैंक काउंटर पर केवल दो कर्मचारी थे।

common_mistake.wrong: I went to the bank window to deposit cash.
common_mistake.right: I went to the bank counter to deposit cash.
common_mistake.why: Although Hindi speakers sometimes say 'window' by analogy with ticket windows, the standard English term for a bank service desk is 'counter'.

cloze.sentence: You'll need to submit the deposit slip at the ____.

en_def: the hours during which an office, bank, or business is open and operating
hi_def: कार्य समय (जिस दौरान कार्यालय, बैंक या व्यवसाय खुला रहता है)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'office time' or 'duty hours', which are understood but less standard; the common English term is 'working hours' or 'business hours'. Also note the plural form is always used: 'working hours', not 'working hour'.

examples.en: The bank's working hours are from ten to four on weekdays.
examples.hi: बैंक का कार्य समय सप्ताह के दिनों में सुबह दस से शाम चार बजे तक है।

examples.en: Please visit the branch during working hours only.
examples.hi: कृपया केवल कार्य समय के दौरान ही शाखा जाएँ।

examples.en: Our support team is available during working hours from Monday to Friday.
examples.hi: हमारी सहायता टीम सोमवार से शुक्रवार तक कार्य समय के दौरान उपलब्ध होती है।

examples.en: The office extended its working hours before the tax deadline.
examples.hi: टैक्स की समय सीमा से पहले ऑफ़िस ने अपना कार्य समय बढ़ा दिया।

examples.en: I called the bank outside working hours, so no one answered.
examples.hi: मैंने कार्य समय के बाहर बैंक को फ़ोन किया, इसलिए किसी ने जवाब नहीं दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: The bank's working hour is nine to five.
common_mistake.right: The bank's working hours are nine to five.
common_mistake.why: 'Working hours' is always plural in English, even when referring to a single daily schedule; the singular 'working hour' is incorrect here.

cloze.sentence: Please try to visit the branch within its normal ____.

en_def: a local office of a bank or company in a particular area, separate from its head office
hi_def: शाखा (किसी बैंक या कंपनी का किसी क्षेत्र में स्थित स्थानीय कार्यालय)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'my bank branch office' which is redundant; simply 'my bank branch' or 'the branch' is sufficient. Also note 'home branch' refers to the specific branch where your account was originally opened.

examples.en: I need to visit my home branch to update my KYC.
examples.hi: मुझे अपना केवाईसी अपडेट करवाने के लिए अपनी होम ब्रांच जाना है।

examples.en: The nearest branch is just two streets away from my office.
examples.hi: सबसे नज़दीकी शाखा मेरे ऑफ़िस से बस दो गलियाँ दूर है।

examples.en: This branch doesn't handle passport-related banking services.
examples.hi: यह शाखा पासपोर्ट संबंधी बैंकिंग सेवाएँ नहीं संभालती।

examples.en: I transferred my account to a branch closer to my new house.
examples.hi: मैंने अपना खाता अपने नए घर के नज़दीक की शाखा में स्थानांतरित करवाया।

examples.en: The branch manager helped me resolve the cheque bounce issue.
examples.hi: शाखा प्रबंधक ने चेक बाउंस की समस्या सुलझाने में मेरी मदद की।

common_mistake.wrong: I went to my bank's branch office to submit the form.
common_mistake.right: I went to my bank's branch to submit the form.
common_mistake.why: 'Branch' already implies a local office, so adding 'office' after it is redundant; 'branch office' is used more for companies in general, less for describing a specific visit.

cloze.sentence: I had to visit my home ____ to update my Aadhaar details.

en_def: a person officially named to receive the money or benefits of an account or policy after the account holder's death
hi_def: नामांकित व्यक्ति (जिसे खाताधारक की मृत्यु के बाद खाते का लाभ मिलता है)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes confuse 'nominee' with 'nomination'; the person is the 'nominee', while the act or form is the 'nomination'. Also don't confuse this banking sense with the more common English sense of 'nominee' as a candidate for an award, which is a different context entirely.

examples.en: I added my mother as the nominee for my savings account.
examples.hi: मैंने अपनी माँ को अपने बचत खाते के लिए नामांकित व्यक्ति के रूप में जोड़ा।

examples.en: Please fill in the nominee details on this form.
examples.hi: कृपया इस फ़ॉर्म में नामांकित व्यक्ति का विवरण भरें।

examples.en: The bank asked me to update my nominee after marriage.
examples.hi: शादी के बाद बैंक ने मुझसे अपना नामांकित व्यक्ति अपडेट करने को कहा।

examples.en: Without a registered nominee, claiming the money can take longer.
examples.hi: पंजीकृत नामांकित व्यक्ति के बिना, पैसे का दावा करने में ज़्यादा समय लग सकता है।

examples.en: My insurance policy also requires a nominee's name and address.
examples.hi: मेरी बीमा पॉलिसी में भी नामांकित व्यक्ति का नाम और पता चाहिए होता है।

common_mistake.wrong: I need to update my nomination in the bank records.
common_mistake.right: I need to update my nominee in the bank records.
common_mistake.why: 'Nomination' refers to the act or process of naming someone; the person named to receive the benefit is called the 'nominee'.

cloze.sentence: You should always name a ____ when you open a bank account.

en_def: a person's name written by hand in a distinctive style, used to prove identity or agreement on a document
hi_def: हस्ताक्षर (किसी व्यक्ति द्वारा हाथ से लिखा गया विशिष्ट नाम, पहचान या सहमति दर्शाने के लिए)
hi_nuance: Learners often confuse the noun 'signature' with the verb 'sign'; the correct sentence is 'please sign here', not 'please signature here'. Also 'put your signature' is common Indian English phrasing, while native speakers more often just say 'sign here'.

examples.en: Your signature on the cheque must match your bank records.
examples.hi: चेक पर आपका हस्ताक्षर आपके बैंक रिकॉर्ड से मेल खाना चाहिए।

examples.en: Please check the signature before accepting the document.
examples.hi: दस्तावेज़ स्वीकार करने से पहले कृपया हस्ताक्षर जाँच लें।

examples.en: I updated my signature at the branch after it changed.
examples.hi: मैंने बदलाव के बाद शाखा में अपना हस्ताक्षर अपडेट करवाया।

examples.en: The form was rejected because the signature didn't match.
examples.hi: हस्ताक्षर मेल न खाने के कारण फ़ॉर्म को अस्वीकार कर दिया गया।

examples.en: He forgot his signature style and had to practise it again.
examples.hi: वह अपने हस्ताक्षर की शैली भूल गया और उसे दोबारा अभ्यास करना पड़ा।

common_mistake.wrong: Please signature this form here.
common_mistake.right: Please sign this form here.
common_mistake.why: 'Signature' is a noun (the written mark), while 'sign' is the verb (the action); learners sometimes use the noun where a verb is needed.

cloze.sentence: The bank rejected my cheque because my ____ didn't match their records.

en_def: to sign your name on a document
hi_def: हस्ताक्षर करना (दस्तावेज़ पर अपना नाम हस्ताक्षरित करना)
hi_nuance: This phrase is very common in Indian English, but native speakers more naturally say simply 'sign here' or 'sign the form'. 'Put your signature' is understandable but sounds slightly formal or roundabout in casual conversation.

examples.en: Please put your signature at the bottom of the form.
examples.hi: कृपया फ़ॉर्म के नीचे अपना हस्ताक्षर करें।

examples.en: The officer asked me to put my signature on each page.
examples.hi: अधिकारी ने मुझे हर पन्ने पर हस्ताक्षर करने को कहा।

examples.en: I need to put my signature next to the correction.
examples.hi: मुझे सुधार के पास हस्ताक्षर करना है।

examples.en: She put her signature and date on the withdrawal slip.
examples.hi: उसने निकासी पर्ची पर हस्ताक्षर और तारीख़ लिखी।

examples.en: Don't forget to put your signature before submitting the passbook.
examples.hi: पासबुक जमा करने से पहले हस्ताक्षर करना न भूलें।

collocations: put your signature on each page

common_mistake.wrong: Kindly put signature in the box below.
common_mistake.right: Kindly put your signature in the box below.
common_mistake.why: The possessive 'your' is required before 'signature' in this fixed phrase; dropping it, as often happens in Indian office English, sounds incomplete.

cloze.sentence: The bank clerk asked me to ____ next to the correction.

en_def: a visit or customer that arrives without a prior appointment or booking
hi_def: वॉक-इन (बिना पहले से अपॉइंटमेंट लिए आया ग्राहक या विज़िट)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes use 'walk-in' only as an adjective ('walk-in customer') but it can also be a noun ('we accept walk-ins'). Note that many Indian banks and government offices increasingly require appointments, so 'walk-ins' may not always be accepted, which is worth clarifying before visiting.

examples.en: The passport office no longer accepts walk-ins without an appointment.
examples.hi: पासपोर्ट कार्यालय अब बिना अपॉइंटमेंट के वॉक-इन स्वीकार नहीं करता।

examples.en: I was a walk-in customer, so I had to wait longer.
examples.hi: मैं वॉक-इन ग्राहक था, इसलिए मुझे ज़्यादा इंतज़ार करना पड़ा।

examples.en: Some bank branches allow walk-ins for simple KYC updates.
examples.hi: कुछ बैंक शाखाएँ साधारण केवाईसी अपडेट के लिए वॉक-इन की अनुमति देती हैं।

examples.en: Check online first; walk-ins might not be accepted today.
examples.hi: पहले ऑनलाइन देख लें; आज वॉक-इन स्वीकार नहीं भी हो सकते।

examples.en: The clinic reserves a few slots every day for walk-ins.
examples.hi: क्लिनिक हर दिन कुछ स्लॉट वॉक-इन के लिए रखता है।

common_mistake.wrong: I went as a walk without booking.
common_mistake.right: I went as a walk-in without booking.
common_mistake.why: The fixed noun form here is 'walk-in' (with the hyphen), not simply 'walk'; dropping 'in' changes or loses the intended meaning.

cloze.sentence: Since the office doesn't take ____ anymore, I had to book a slot online first.

en_def: to reserve a specific time for an appointment or visit in advance
hi_def: स्लॉट बुक करना (अपॉइंटमेंट या विज़िट के लिए पहले से समय आरक्षित करना)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'take an appointment' (a direct translation influenced by Hindi 'अपॉइंटमेंट लेना'); standard English says 'book an appointment' or 'book a slot', not 'take an appointment'.

examples.en: I booked a slot online for the Aadhaar update.
examples.hi: मैंने आधार अपडेट के लिए ऑनलाइन स्लॉट बुक किया।

examples.en: You can book a slot for passport verification through the website.
examples.hi: आप वेबसाइट के ज़रिए पासपोर्ट सत्यापन के लिए स्लॉट बुक कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: She booked a slot for the visa interview two weeks in advance.
examples.hi: उसने वीज़ा साक्षात्कार के लिए दो हफ़्ते पहले ही स्लॉट बुक किया।

examples.en: I couldn't find an available slot until next Monday.
examples.hi: मुझे अगले सोमवार तक कोई उपलब्ध स्लॉट नहीं मिला।

examples.en: Please book a slot before visiting the RTO office.
examples.hi: आरटीओ कार्यालय जाने से पहले कृपया एक स्लॉट बुक करें।

common_mistake.wrong: I will take an appointment for tomorrow.
common_mistake.right: I will book an appointment for tomorrow.
common_mistake.why: Standard English uses the verb 'book' (or 'make') with 'appointment', not 'take', which is a direct carry-over from Hindi phrasing.

cloze.sentence: You need to ____ online before visiting the Aadhaar centre.

en_def: to change an appointment, meeting, or event to a different time or date
hi_def: पुनर्निर्धारित करना, फिर से समय तय करना
hi_nuance: A very common Indian English error is using the non-standard word 'prepone' to mean moving something earlier; standard English has no such word — say 'reschedule to an earlier time', 'move it earlier', or 'bring it forward' instead. 'Reschedule' itself is correct and works for both earlier and later changes.

examples.en: I had to reschedule my bank appointment due to a client call.
examples.hi: क्लाइंट कॉल की वजह से मुझे अपनी बैंक अपॉइंटमेंट पुनर्निर्धारित करनी पड़ी।

examples.en: Can we reschedule the meeting to next Thursday?
examples.hi: क्या हम मीटिंग को अगले गुरुवार के लिए पुनर्निर्धारित कर सकते हैं?

examples.en: The branch called to reschedule my KYC appointment.
examples.hi: शाखा ने मेरी केवाईसी अपॉइंटमेंट पुनर्निर्धारित करने के लिए फ़ोन किया।

examples.en: I rescheduled my visa interview because of a family emergency.
examples.hi: पारिवारिक आपातकाल के कारण मैंने अपना वीज़ा साक्षात्कार पुनर्निर्धारित किया।

examples.en: Please let me know if you need to reschedule the demo.
examples.hi: कृपया बताएँ अगर आपको डेमो पुनर्निर्धारित करने की ज़रूरत हो।

common_mistake.wrong: Let's prepone the meeting to Monday instead of Wednesday.
common_mistake.right: Let's move the meeting earlier, to Monday instead of Wednesday.
common_mistake.why: 'Prepone' is a widely used Indian English coinage but is not standard English; internationally, say 'reschedule to an earlier date' or 'bring the meeting forward'.

cloze.sentence: I need to ____ my branch visit since I have an urgent call at that time.

en_def: the length of time a person must wait before being served or attended to
hi_def: प्रतीक्षा समय (सेवा मिलने से पहले इंतज़ार करने का समय)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'waiting period', which actually refers to a fixed rule-based delay (like an insurance waiting period before a claim is valid), not the everyday queue wait at a counter; for counters and appointments, 'waiting time' is the correct term.

examples.en: The waiting time at the bank was almost forty minutes today.
examples.hi: आज बैंक में प्रतीक्षा समय लगभग चालीस मिनट था।

examples.en: You can check the average waiting time on the branch's app.
examples.hi: आप शाखा के ऐप पर औसत प्रतीक्षा समय जाँच सकते हैं।

examples.en: Booking a slot online reduces the waiting time significantly.
examples.hi: ऑनलाइन स्लॉट बुक करने से प्रतीक्षा समय काफी कम हो जाता है।

examples.en: The waiting time was shorter because I had already booked an appointment.
examples.hi: प्रतीक्षा समय कम था क्योंकि मैंने पहले ही अपॉइंटमेंट बुक कर रखी थी।

examples.en: Staff shortage increased the waiting time at the counter.
examples.hi: कर्मचारियों की कमी ने काउंटर पर प्रतीक्षा समय बढ़ा दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: The waiting period at the ATM was very long.
common_mistake.right: The waiting time at the ATM was very long.
common_mistake.why: 'Waiting period' usually refers to a formal, rule-based delay (like an insurance policy clause), while everyday queue delays are called 'waiting time'.

cloze.sentence: Booking an online slot cut my ____ at the branch to just ten minutes.

en_def: a system in which customers receive numbered tokens to determine the order in which they are served
hi_def: टोकन प्रणाली (जिसमें ग्राहकों को क्रमानुसार सेवा देने के लिए नंबर वाले टोकन दिए जाते हैं)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes describe this as 'number system' or 'queue system'; while understandable, 'token system' is the specific, standard term used in Indian banks, hospitals, and government offices for this numbered-ticket process.

examples.en: This branch follows a token system to manage the queue.
examples.hi: यह शाखा कतार को व्यवस्थित करने के लिए टोकन प्रणाली अपनाती है।

examples.en: The token system displays waiting numbers on a screen.
examples.hi: टोकन प्रणाली स्क्रीन पर प्रतीक्षा नंबर दिखाती है।

examples.en: Since they introduced the token system, the counter is much more organised.
examples.hi: जब से उन्होंने टोकन प्रणाली शुरू की है, काउंटर काफी व्यवस्थित हो गया है।

examples.en: The hospital also uses a token system for outpatient appointments.
examples.hi: अस्पताल भी बाह्य रोगी अपॉइंटमेंट के लिए टोकन प्रणाली इस्तेमाल करता है।

examples.en: Under the token system, you don't need to stand in a physical queue.
examples.hi: टोकन प्रणाली के तहत, आपको भौतिक कतार में खड़े होने की ज़रूरत नहीं।

common_mistake.wrong: This bank uses a number system for customers.
common_mistake.right: This bank uses a token system for customers.
common_mistake.why: The standard term for this numbered-ticket queue process in Indian banks and offices is 'token system', not the more generic 'number system'.

cloze.sentence: Thanks to the ____, I didn't have to stand in a physical line at all.

en_def: a phone number you can call for help, information, or to report a problem with a service
hi_def: हेल्पलाइन नंबर (सहायता, जानकारी या शिकायत के लिए फ़ोन नंबर)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'help number' instead of the standard compound 'helpline number'. Also note the correct phrase is 'call the helpline number' or 'dial the helpline number', not 'phone to the helpline number'.

examples.en: I called the bank's helpline number to block my card.
examples.hi: मैंने अपना कार्ड ब्लॉक करने के लिए बैंक के हेल्पलाइन नंबर पर फ़ोन किया।

examples.en: The helpline number is printed on the back of your debit card.
examples.hi: हेल्पलाइन नंबर आपके डेबिट कार्ड के पीछे छपा होता है।

examples.en: You can find the toll-free helpline number on the bank's website.
examples.hi: आप बैंक की वेबसाइट पर टोल-फ्री हेल्पलाइन नंबर पा सकते हैं।

examples.en: I stayed on hold for ten minutes after dialling the helpline number.
examples.hi: हेल्पलाइन नंबर डायल करने के बाद मैं दस मिनट होल्ड पर रहा।

examples.en: The helpline number was busy, so I raised a complaint online instead.
examples.hi: हेल्पलाइन नंबर व्यस्त था, इसलिए मैंने इसके बजाय ऑनलाइन शिकायत दर्ज की।

common_mistake.wrong: I will phone to the helpline number tomorrow.
common_mistake.right: I will call the helpline number tomorrow.
common_mistake.why: 'Phone' as a verb does not take 'to' before the object in standard English; the natural verb here is simply 'call' (or 'phone' without 'to').

cloze.sentence: To report the fraud, I immediately called the bank's ____.

en_def: a department or service that helps customers with questions, complaints, or problems
hi_def: ग्राहक सेवा (ग्राहकों की समस्याओं और शिकायतों में मदद करने वाला विभाग)
hi_nuance: Indian English commonly uses 'customer care', while American English more often says 'customer service'. Both are understood internationally, but learners writing to global colleagues should know 'customer service' is the more universally recognised term.

examples.en: I contacted customer care about the failed transaction.
examples.hi: मैंने असफल लेन-देन के बारे में ग्राहक सेवा से संपर्क किया।

examples.en: Customer care confirmed that my complaint had been registered.
examples.hi: ग्राहक सेवा ने पुष्टि की कि मेरी शिकायत दर्ज हो गई है।

examples.en: The customer care executive asked for my registered mobile number.
examples.hi: ग्राहक सेवा अधिकारी ने मेरे पंजीकृत मोबाइल नंबर के बारे में पूछा।

examples.en: I waited on the line for customer care for almost fifteen minutes.
examples.hi: मैं ग्राहक सेवा की लाइन पर लगभग पंद्रह मिनट इंतज़ार करता रहा।

examples.en: You can also chat with customer care through the bank's app.
examples.hi: आप बैंक के ऐप के ज़रिए भी ग्राहक सेवा से चैट कर सकते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I will mail to customer care about this issue.
common_mistake.right: I will email customer care about this issue.
common_mistake.why: 'Email' functions as a direct transitive verb in English ('email someone'), so 'mail to' with 'email' is redundant and non-standard; also note 'mail' typically means postal mail unless clearly used as 'email'.

cloze.sentence: I called ____ to complain about the delayed refund.

en_def: a unique number given to you when you file a complaint, used to track its progress
hi_def: शिकायत नंबर (शिकायत दर्ज करने पर मिलने वाला विशिष्ट नंबर, जिससे प्रगति ट्रैक होती है)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'complaint ID' or just 'ticket number'; all are used in different companies, but banks in India commonly issue a 'complaint number' specifically. Keep this distinct from 'reference number', which can apply more broadly to transactions too.

examples.en: Please note down your complaint number for future reference.
examples.hi: भविष्य के संदर्भ के लिए कृपया अपना शिकायत नंबर लिख लें।

examples.en: I quoted my complaint number when I called customer care again.
examples.hi: जब मैंने दोबारा ग्राहक सेवा को फ़ोन किया, तो मैंने अपना शिकायत नंबर बताया।

examples.en: The bank resolved the issue within three days of the complaint number being generated.
examples.hi: शिकायत नंबर जनरेट होने के तीन दिनों के भीतर बैंक ने मुद्दा हल कर दिया।

examples.en: You can track your complaint status using the complaint number online.
examples.hi: आप शिकायत नंबर का इस्तेमाल करके ऑनलाइन अपनी शिकायत की स्थिति देख सकते हैं।

examples.en: Make sure you receive an SMS with the complaint number after filing.
examples.hi: सुनिश्चित करें कि शिकायत दर्ज करने के बाद आपको शिकायत नंबर वाला एसएमएस मिले।

common_mistake.wrong: Please give me my complain number for tracking.
common_mistake.right: Please give me my complaint number for tracking.
common_mistake.why: 'Complain' is the verb; the noun form needed here is 'complaint', so the correct compound is 'complaint number', not 'complain number'.

cloze.sentence: Keep your ____ safe so you can follow up on the issue later.

en_def: a unique number assigned to a transaction, request, or application, used to identify and track it later
hi_def: संदर्भ संख्या (किसी लेन-देन, अनुरोध या आवेदन को पहचानने और ट्रैक करने के लिए दिया गया विशिष्ट नंबर)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'reference no.' informally in speech, which is fine in writing but should be spoken in full as 'reference number' in formal conversation. Also this term applies broadly to UPI transactions, courier tracking, and applications, not just banking.

examples.en: Please quote this reference number if you call the bank later.
examples.hi: अगर आप बाद में बैंक को फ़ोन करें, तो कृपया यह संदर्भ संख्या बताएँ।

examples.en: The UPI transaction failed, but I still got a reference number.
examples.hi: यूपीआई लेन-देन विफल हो गया, लेकिन फिर भी मुझे एक संदर्भ संख्या मिली।

examples.en: I noted the reference number from the SMS confirmation.
examples.hi: मैंने एसएमएस पुष्टि से संदर्भ संख्या नोट कर ली।

examples.en: Without the reference number, tracking the refund becomes difficult.
examples.hi: संदर्भ संख्या के बिना, रिफ़ंड ट्रैक करना मुश्किल हो जाता है।

examples.en: The customer care executive asked for the reference number of my complaint.
examples.hi: ग्राहक सेवा अधिकारी ने मेरी शिकायत की संदर्भ संख्या माँगी।

common_mistake.wrong: What is the reference of this payment?
common_mistake.right: What is the reference number of this payment?
common_mistake.why: In banking and office English, 'reference' alone usually means a person who vouches for you; the tracking code specifically needs 'reference number'.

cloze.sentence: Even though the transfer failed, the app still generated a ____ for tracking.

en_def: a document or receipt that shows a payment has been made, such as a transaction slip or screenshot
hi_def: भुगतान प्रमाण (भुगतान हो जाने की पुष्टि करने वाला दस्तावेज़ या रसीद)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'payment proof' and 'payment receipt' interchangeably, but a receipt is one specific type of payment proof; a bank statement entry or screenshot can also serve as proof. In formal emails, say 'please attach proof of payment' rather than 'send me payment proof file'.

examples.en: Please attach the payment proof along with the application form.
examples.hi: कृपया आवेदन पत्र के साथ भुगतान प्रमाण संलग्न करें।

examples.en: I sent a screenshot of the UPI transaction as payment proof.
examples.hi: मैंने भुगतान प्रमाण के रूप में यूपीआई लेन-देन का स्क्रीनशॉट भेजा।

examples.en: Keep the payment proof safe in case there's a dispute later.
examples.hi: बाद में विवाद होने की स्थिति में भुगतान प्रमाण संभाल कर रखें।

examples.en: Without payment proof, the vendor refused to confirm the order.
examples.hi: भुगतान प्रमाण के बिना, वेंडर ने ऑर्डर की पुष्टि करने से मना कर दिया।

examples.en: The office asked for payment proof for the exam fee submission.
examples.hi: कार्यालय ने परीक्षा शुल्क जमा करने के लिए भुगतान प्रमाण माँगा।

common_mistake.wrong: Send me the payment proof file on WhatsApp for confirm.
common_mistake.right: Please send me the payment proof on WhatsApp to confirm.
common_mistake.why: The phrase 'for confirm' is a direct, ungrammatical translation; standard English needs the infinitive 'to confirm' after the main clause.

cloze.sentence: The registration desk asked for ____ before issuing the receipt.

en_def: a digital version of a document, such as a PDF or scanned file, rather than a printed version
hi_def: सॉफ़्ट कॉपी (दस्तावेज़ का डिजिटल संस्करण, जैसे पीडीएफ़ या स्कैन की गई फ़ाइल)
hi_nuance: 'Soft copy' is common and understood in Indian English workplaces, but note that it's less used internationally, where people just say 'a digital copy', 'a scan', or 'a PDF'. Using it with global colleagues is fine, but be ready to clarify if they seem unfamiliar with the term.

examples.en: Please email me the soft copy of the signed form.
examples.hi: कृपया हस्ताक्षरित फ़ॉर्म की सॉफ़्ट कॉपी मुझे ईमेल करें।

examples.en: I keep a soft copy of all my important documents on my laptop.
examples.hi: मैं अपने सभी महत्वपूर्ण दस्तावेज़ों की सॉफ़्ट कॉपी अपने लैपटॉप पर रखता हूँ।

examples.en: A soft copy of the Aadhaar card is accepted for this online form.
examples.hi: इस ऑनलाइन फ़ॉर्म के लिए आधार कार्ड की सॉफ़्ट कॉपी स्वीकार की जाती है।

examples.en: Can you upload a soft copy of your PAN card here?
examples.hi: क्या आप यहाँ अपने पैन कार्ड की सॉफ़्ट कॉपी अपलोड कर सकते हैं?

examples.en: I scanned the document to create a soft copy for the email.
examples.hi: मैंने ईमेल के लिए एक सॉफ़्ट कॉपी बनाने के लिए दस्तावेज़ स्कैन किया।

common_mistake.wrong: I will send you the soft copy by post.
common_mistake.right: I will send you the soft copy by email.
common_mistake.why: A 'soft copy' is digital by definition and cannot be sent by physical post; only a 'hard copy' (printed document) can be posted.

cloze.sentence: You can upload a ____ of your passbook instead of visiting the branch.

en_def: a printed, physical version of a document, as opposed to a digital file
hi_def: हार्ड कॉपी (दस्तावेज़ का छपा हुआ, भौतिक संस्करण)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'print copy' instead of the standard term 'hard copy'. In Indian offices and banks, forms often specifically require a 'hard copy' with an original wet-ink signature, distinct from a scanned soft copy.

examples.en: The bank requires a hard copy of the application form, not a scanned one.
examples.hi: बैंक को आवेदन पत्र की हार्ड कॉपी चाहिए, स्कैन की गई कॉपी नहीं।

examples.en: Please bring a hard copy of your bank statement to the appointment.
examples.hi: कृपया अपॉइंटमेंट पर अपने बैंक स्टेटमेंट की हार्ड कॉपी लाएँ।

examples.en: I always keep a hard copy of important contracts in a file.
examples.hi: मैं हमेशा महत्वपूर्ण अनुबंधों की हार्ड कॉपी एक फ़ाइल में रखता हूँ।

examples.en: She printed a hard copy of the form since the office doesn't accept digital submissions.
examples.hi: उसने फ़ॉर्म की हार्ड कॉपी प्रिंट की क्योंकि कार्यालय डिजिटल जमा स्वीकार नहीं करता।

examples.en: Submit both a soft copy by email and a hard copy in person.
examples.hi: कृपया ईमेल से सॉफ़्ट कॉपी और व्यक्तिगत रूप से हार्ड कॉपी दोनों जमा करें।

common_mistake.wrong: Please give me the print copy of the receipt.
common_mistake.right: Please give me the hard copy of the receipt.
common_mistake.why: The standard English term for a printed document (as opposed to digital) is 'hard copy', not 'print copy', which is not a standard fixed phrase.

cloze.sentence: The office insisted on a signed ____, so I couldn't just email a PDF.

en_def: feeling like everything is spinning and you might lose your balance
hi_def: चक्कर आना (सिर घूमना, संतुलन बिगड़ना)
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often keep the continuous tense even when describing a state that has lasted a while, saying 'I am feeling dizzy since morning' instead of 'I have been feeling dizzy since morning'. Also, 'dizzy' describes the person, not the room, so 'the room is dizzy' is wrong — you say 'I feel dizzy' or 'my head is spinning'.

examples.en: I felt dizzy when I stood up too quickly after the meeting.
examples.hi: मीटिंग के बाद जल्दी से खड़ा होते ही मुझे चक्कर आने लगा।

examples.en: She has been feeling dizzy since this morning, so she stayed home.
examples.hi: उसे आज सुबह से चक्कर आ रहे हैं, इसलिए वह घर पर ही रुकी।

examples.en: The doctor asked if I feel dizzy when I climb stairs.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने पूछा कि क्या मुझे सीढ़ियाँ चढ़ते समय चक्कर आता है।

examples.en: Don't drive if the tablets make you feel dizzy.
examples.hi: अगर गोलियों से चक्कर आ रहा हो तो गाड़ी मत चलाओ।

examples.en: I suddenly went dizzy in the server room and had to sit down.
examples.hi: सर्वर रूम में अचानक मुझे चक्कर आ गया और मुझे बैठना पड़ा।

common_mistake.wrong: The room was dizzy after I stood up.
common_mistake.right: I felt dizzy after I stood up.
common_mistake.why: 'Dizzy' describes how a person feels, not the room; the common Hindi-influenced phrase 'the room is spinning around me' is fine, but 'the room is dizzy' is not correct English.

cloze.sentence: Stand up slowly — you might feel ____ if you get up too fast.

en_def: pain or a burning feeling in the throat, often from an infection
hi_def: गले में खराश/दर्द (गला दुखना)
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'my throat is paining' by translating 'गला दुख रहा है' word for word; standard English says 'I have a sore throat' or 'My throat hurts', not 'is paining'. Also remember it is 'a sore throat' with the article, not just 'sore throat' as a bare noun in a sentence.

examples.en: I have a sore throat and I can hardly swallow anything.
examples.hi: मेरे गले में खराश है और मुझसे कुछ भी निगला नहीं जा रहा।

examples.en: My throat has been sore since I shouted during the match yesterday.
examples.hi: कल मैच में चिल्लाने के बाद से मेरा गला दुख रहा है।

examples.en: Gargle with warm salt water if you have a sore throat.
examples.hi: अगर गले में खराश हो तो गुनगुने नमक के पानी से गरारे करो।

examples.en: He called in sick because of a bad sore throat and fever.
examples.hi: उसने गले में तेज़ खराश और बुखार की वजह से छुट्टी की खबर दी।

examples.en: The chemist gave me some lozenges for my sore throat.
examples.hi: केमिस्ट ने मुझे गले की खराश के लिए कुछ लोज़ेंज दिए।

common_mistake.wrong: My throat is paining since two days.
common_mistake.right: I've had a sore throat for two days.
common_mistake.why: 'Paining' is not standard English for this; use 'sore throat', 'hurts', or 'aches', and use 'for two days' rather than 'since two days' with a duration.

cloze.sentence: I have a ____ and can't talk properly today.

en_def: a mild but uncomfortable problem with digestion, such as pain or loose motions
hi_def: पेट खराब होना (पेट में गड़बड़ी)
hi_nuance: Indian English often keeps the present tense with 'since', saying 'my stomach is upset since morning' instead of the correct present perfect 'my stomach has been upset since morning'. Also, 'stomach upset' can be used as a noun ('a stomach upset') or as an adjective phrase ('my stomach is upset'); mixing the two, like 'I am having stomach upset', sounds unnatural.

examples.en: My stomach has been upset since I ate that roadside food last night.
examples.hi: कल रात वह सड़क किनारे का खाना खाने के बाद से मेरा पेट खराब है।

examples.en: I had a stomach upset during the flight and felt terrible.
examples.hi: उड़ान के दौरान मेरा पेट खराब हो गया और मुझे बहुत बुरा महसूस हुआ।

examples.en: Drink boiled water only, or you'll end up with a stomach upset.
examples.hi: सिर्फ़ उबला हुआ पानी पिओ, वरना पेट खराब हो जाएगा।

examples.en: The doctor said it's just a mild stomach upset, not food poisoning.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने कहा कि यह सिर्फ़ हल्का पेट खराब है, फ़ूड पॉइज़निंग नहीं।

examples.en: My son has had a stomach upset all week, so I took him to the clinic.
examples.hi: मेरे बेटे का पूरे हफ़्ते पेट खराब रहा, इसलिए मैं उसे क्लिनिक ले गया।

common_mistake.wrong: My stomach is upset since morning.
common_mistake.right: My stomach has been upset since morning.
common_mistake.why: With 'since', English needs the present perfect ('has been'), not the simple present ('is'), because the problem started in the past and continues now.

cloze.sentence: That spicy street food gave me a ____ last night.

en_def: frequent, watery bowel movements; diarrhoea
hi_def: दस्त, लूज़ मोशन (बार-बार पतला मल आना)
hi_nuance: 'Loose motions' is common Indian English for diarrhoea, but it is rarely used in Britain or the US, where 'diarrhoea' (BrE) or 'diarrhea' (AmE) is the standard word, especially with a foreign doctor or on an English medicine label. It is almost always used in the plural: 'I have loose motions', not 'a loose motion'.

examples.en: I've had loose motions since last night, so I'm drinking ORS.
examples.hi: कल रात से मुझे दस्त लगे हैं, इसलिए मैं ORS पी रहा हूँ।

examples.en: The doctor asked how many times I had loose motions today.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने पूछा कि आज कितनी बार दस्त हुआ।

examples.en: My daughter had loose motions after the school picnic.
examples.hi: स्कूल की पिकनिक के बाद मेरी बेटी को दस्त हो गए।

examples.en: If you get loose motions abroad, tell the doctor it's diarrhoea, not just 'loose motions'.
examples.hi: विदेश में दस्त हो जाएँ तो डॉक्टर को 'diarrhoea' कहना, सिर्फ़ 'loose motions' नहीं।

examples.en: Avoid oily food when you have loose motions.
examples.hi: जब दस्त लगे हों तो तेल वाला खाना मत खाओ।

common_mistake.wrong: I am suffering from loose motion since yesterday.
common_mistake.right: I've had loose motions since yesterday.
common_mistake.why: The term is almost always plural ('loose motions'), and outside India people may not understand it at all — 'diarrhoea' is the internationally understood word.

cloze.sentence: He couldn't come to office because of ____ and stomach pain.

en_def: bringing up food or liquid from the stomach through the mouth
hi_def: उल्टी (उल्टी करना, वमन)
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes turn 'vomiting' into a separate action verb, saying 'I did vomiting three times' instead of 'I vomited three times' or 'I have been vomiting'. Remember 'vomit' is the verb ('to vomit'), and 'vomiting' is the -ing/noun form used after 'be' or as a noun ('a bout of vomiting').

examples.en: The baby has been vomiting since midnight, so we're going to the emergency ward.
examples.hi: बच्चे को आधी रात से उल्टियाँ हो रही हैं, इसलिए हम इमरजेंसी वार्ड जा रहे हैं।

examples.en: I vomited twice after breakfast and felt very weak.
examples.hi: नाश्ते के बाद मुझे दो बार उल्टी हुई और मुझे बहुत कमज़ोरी महसूस हुई।

examples.en: Vomiting and loose motions together can cause dehydration quickly.
examples.hi: उल्टी और दस्त एक साथ होने से जल्दी डीहाइड्रेशन हो सकता है।

examples.en: Tell the doctor if there is blood when you are vomiting.
examples.hi: अगर उल्टी में खून आए तो डॉक्टर को बताओ।

examples.en: She felt nauseous on the bus but managed not to vomit.
examples.hi: बस में उसे जी मिचला रहा था लेकिन उल्टी नहीं हुई।

common_mistake.wrong: I did vomiting two times last night.
common_mistake.right: I vomited twice last night.
common_mistake.why: 'Vomiting' is not used as a separate action verb with 'do'; use the verb form 'vomited' or say 'I have been vomiting'.

cloze.sentence: The medicine stopped my ____ within an hour.

en_def: a feeling of sickness in the stomach, as if you are about to vomit
hi_def: मितली, जी मिचलाना (उल्टी जैसा महसूस होना)
hi_nuance: Learners often say 'I am having nausea' instead of the more natural 'I feel nauseous' or 'I feel sick'. 'Nausea' is the noun for the feeling itself, while 'nauseous' is the adjective describing how a person feels — mixing them up is a very common Indian-English error.

examples.en: I felt nausea as soon as the plane started to descend.
examples.hi: प्लेन नीचे उतरना शुरू होते ही मुझे मितली आने लगी।

examples.en: The tablet can cause nausea, so take it after food.
examples.hi: इस गोली से मितली हो सकती है, इसलिए इसे खाने के बाद लेना।

examples.en: She feels nauseous every morning during her pregnancy.
examples.hi: गर्भावस्था के दौरान उसे हर सुबह मितली महसूस होती है।

examples.en: A strong smell of petrol always gives me nausea.
examples.hi: पेट्रोल की तेज़ गंध से मुझे हमेशा जी मिचला जाता है।

examples.en: If the nausea doesn't go away, ask the chemist for something mild.
examples.hi: अगर मितली ठीक न हो तो केमिस्ट से कोई हल्की दवा माँग लो।

common_mistake.wrong: I am having nausea since the morning.
common_mistake.right: I've been feeling nauseous since the morning.
common_mistake.why: Native speakers usually say 'feel nauseous' rather than 'have nausea' in everyday speech; 'have nausea' sounds overly clinical when describing your own symptoms to a doctor.

cloze.sentence: The medicine's side effects include headache and ____.

en_def: a nose that keeps producing liquid, usually because of a cold or allergy
hi_def: नाक बहना (नाक से पानी आना)
hi_nuance: Indian English commonly uses 'running nose' as a fixed noun phrase, but standard English usually says 'a runny nose' as the adjective form, or 'my nose is running' as the verb form. Saying 'I have running nose' without an article also sounds unnatural — it should be 'a runny nose' or 'my nose is running'.

examples.en: I've had a runny nose and a slight fever since yesterday.
examples.hi: कल से मेरी नाक बह रही है और हल्का बुखार भी है।

examples.en: My nose has been running all day because of the dust in the office.
examples.hi: ऑफ़िस की धूल की वजह से आज पूरे दिन मेरी नाक बहती रही।

examples.en: Keep some tissues handy if you have a running nose.
examples.hi: अगर नाक बह रही हो तो कुछ टिशू पास रखो।

examples.en: The child has a runny nose, so the teacher sent her home.
examples.hi: बच्ची की नाक बह रही थी, इसलिए टीचर ने उसे घर भेज दिया।

examples.en: A runny nose and sneezing are the first signs of my cold.
examples.hi: नाक बहना और छींक आना मेरी सर्दी के पहले लक्षण हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I have running nose from two days.
common_mistake.right: I've had a runny nose for two days.
common_mistake.why: The standard adjective form is 'runny nose', it needs an article ('a runny nose'), and duration is expressed with 'for', not 'from'.

cloze.sentence: This weather always gives me a ____ and a headache.

en_def: a nose that is difficult to breathe through because it is full of mucus
hi_def: नाक बंद होना (नाक जाम होना)
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes drop the past-participle ending and say 'my nose is block' instead of 'my nose is blocked'. Note also the regional difference: British and Indian English say 'blocked nose', while American English usually says 'stuffy nose' — useful to know when talking to an American colleague.

examples.en: I can't smell anything because of my blocked nose.
examples.hi: नाक बंद होने की वजह से मुझे कुछ भी सूँघ नहीं आ रहा।

examples.en: Steam inhalation helps clear a blocked nose quickly.
examples.hi: भाप लेने से बंद नाक जल्दी खुल जाती है।

examples.en: My nose gets blocked every time the air conditioner runs all night.
examples.hi: जब भी AC पूरी रात चलता है, मेरी नाक बंद हो जाती है।

examples.en: He sounded strange on the call because of his blocked nose.
examples.hi: कॉल पर उसकी आवाज़ अजीब लग रही थी क्योंकि उसकी नाक बंद थी।

examples.en: The nasal spray gave quick relief from her blocked nose.
examples.hi: नेज़ल स्प्रे से उसकी बंद नाक को जल्दी आराम मिला।

common_mistake.wrong: My nose is block since morning.
common_mistake.right: My nose has been blocked since morning.
common_mistake.why: 'Block' is the base verb; as a description of your nose you need the past participle 'blocked', and duration with 'since' takes the present perfect.

cloze.sentence: I can hardly breathe — I have a completely ____ nose.

en_def: a common illness with a blocked or runny nose together with coughing
hi_def: सर्दी-ज़ुकाम और खाँसी (कोल्ड और कफ़ की शिकायत)
hi_nuance: Indian English often bundles the two symptoms as a set phrase 'cold and cough', but native speakers usually mention them separately: 'I have a cold and a cough', with an article before each noun. Saying just 'I have cold and cough' without articles is a very common Indian-English pattern.

examples.en: I have a cold and a cough, so I'm working from home today.
examples.hi: मुझे सर्दी-ज़ुकाम और खाँसी है, इसलिए आज मैं घर से काम कर रहा हूँ।

examples.en: The whole family caught a cold and a cough after the trip to the hills.
examples.hi: पहाड़ों की यात्रा के बाद पूरे परिवार को सर्दी-ज़ुकाम और खाँसी हो गई।

examples.en: My son has had a cold and cough for three days now.
examples.hi: मेरे बेटे को तीन दिन से सर्दी-ज़ुकाम और खाँसी है।

examples.en: The chemist gave me tablets for my cold and cough.
examples.hi: केमिस्ट ने मुझे सर्दी-ज़ुकाम और खाँसी के लिए गोलियाँ दीं।

examples.en: Drink warm water and honey if you have a cold and a cough.
examples.hi: अगर सर्दी-ज़ुकाम और खाँसी हो तो गुनगुना पानी और शहद पिओ।

collocations: have a cold and a cough

common_mistake.wrong: I have cold and cough since two days.
common_mistake.right: I've had a cold and a cough for two days.
common_mistake.why: Each countable noun normally needs an article ('a cold', 'a cough'), and duration uses 'for', not 'since', when a length of time (not a starting point) is given.

cloze.sentence: He stayed home because of a bad ____.

en_def: a dull pain felt through most of the body, often with fever
hi_def: बदन दर्द (शरीर में दर्द)
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'I am having body ache' instead of the more natural 'My body aches' or 'I have body aches all over'. Note also that 'body ache' is usually uncountable in this context (no article needed), while 'aches and pains' is the common plural expression.

examples.en: I have body ache and a mild fever, so I might see the doctor.
examples.hi: मुझे बदन दर्द और हल्का बुखार है, इसलिए मैं शायद डॉक्टर के पास जाऊँ।

examples.en: My whole body aches after that long flight to Singapore.
examples.hi: सिंगापुर की उस लंबी उड़ान के बाद मेरे पूरे बदन में दर्द है।

examples.en: The flu usually starts with body ache and a sore throat.
examples.hi: फ़्लू आमतौर पर बदन दर्द और गले की खराश से शुरू होता है।

examples.en: Take a painkiller if the body ache doesn't go away by evening.
examples.hi: अगर शाम तक बदन दर्द ठीक न हो तो एक पेनकिलर ले लेना।

examples.en: I woke up with severe body ache after the gym session.
examples.hi: जिम सेशन के बाद मैं तेज़ बदन दर्द के साथ उठा।

common_mistake.wrong: I am having body ache since two days.
common_mistake.right: I've had body ache for two days.
common_mistake.why: 'Body ache' pairs naturally with 'have' rather than the continuous 'am having', and duration uses 'for' with a length of time, not 'since'.

cloze.sentence: Fever, ____ and a sore throat are common flu symptoms.

en_def: an area of the body that has become larger than normal, usually because of injury or infection
hi_def: सूजन (शरीर के किसी हिस्से का फूल जाना)
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often keep the Hindi word order 'swelling is there in my leg' (from 'मेरे पैर में सूजन है'), instead of the natural English pattern 'There is swelling in my leg' or 'My leg is swollen'. 'Swelling' is the noun, while 'swollen' is the adjective used to describe the body part itself.

examples.en: There is swelling around the ankle after the fall.
examples.hi: गिरने के बाद टखने के आसपास सूजन है।

examples.en: The swelling on his foot went down after two days of rest.
examples.hi: दो दिन आराम करने के बाद उसके पैर की सूजन कम हो गई।

examples.en: My gums have swelling, so the dentist gave me an antibiotic.
examples.hi: मेरे मसूड़ों में सूजन है, इसलिए दंत चिकित्सक ने मुझे एक एंटीबायोटिक दी।

examples.en: Ice packs help reduce swelling right after an injury.
examples.hi: चोट लगने के तुरंत बाद बर्फ़ की सिकाई सूजन कम करने में मदद करती है।

examples.en: The doctor checked for swelling in my knee before suggesting an X-ray.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने X-ray की सलाह देने से पहले मेरे घुटने में सूजन जाँची।

common_mistake.wrong: Swelling is there in my ankle.
common_mistake.right: There is swelling in my ankle.
common_mistake.why: This is a direct calque of the Hindi word order; the natural English 'there is/are' construction is used to state that something exists at a place.

cloze.sentence: There is some ____ around the injury, so let's ice it.

en_def: a dark mark on the skin caused by an injury that doesn't break the skin
hi_def: चोट का नीला/काला निशान (मेढ़)
hi_nuance: The word is pronounced /bruːz/, not letter by letter, so learners sometimes mispronounce it like 'brush'. Also, Hindi speakers may say 'I got a mark' for any injury; in English, a coloured mark from a knock is specifically a 'bruise', while a cut that breaks the skin is a 'wound'.

examples.en: I got a bruise on my arm after bumping into the office door.
examples.hi: ऑफ़िस के दरवाज़े से टकराने के बाद मेरी बाँह पर एक नीला निशान पड़ गया।

examples.en: The bruise on his shin turned purple by the next day.
examples.hi: अगले दिन तक उसकी पिंडली पर पड़ा निशान बैंगनी हो गया।

examples.en: Apply a cold compress to a fresh bruise to reduce the swelling.
examples.hi: ताज़े निशान पर सूजन कम करने के लिए ठंडी सिकाई करो।

examples.en: She had a small bruise under her eye after the badminton match.
examples.hi: बैडमिंटन मैच के बाद उसकी आँख के नीचे छोटा-सा निशान आ गया।

examples.en: The bruise faded within a week and left no mark.
examples.hi: एक हफ़्ते में निशान हल्का हो गया और कोई दाग़ नहीं रहा।

common_mistake.wrong: I have a wound on my leg where I hit the table.
common_mistake.right: I have a bruise on my leg where I hit the table.
common_mistake.why: A 'wound' involves broken skin and bleeding; a simple knock that leaves a coloured mark without breaking the skin is a 'bruise'.

cloze.sentence: The football hit my thigh and left a big ____.

en_def: an injury in which the skin is cut or broken, often caused by a weapon, tool, or accident
hi_def: घाव (त्वचा कट जाना या फट जाना)
hi_nuance: 'Wound' meaning an injury is pronounced /wuːnd/, but the past tense of the verb 'wind' is spelled the same way and pronounced /waʊnd/ ('he wound the bandage around his arm') — many learners don't realise it's a heteronym. Also, for small cuts Indian English often just says 'cut', while 'wound' suggests something more serious.

examples.en: Clean the wound with an antiseptic before putting on a bandage.
examples.hi: पट्टी बाँधने से पहले घाव को एंटीसेप्टिक से साफ़ करो।

examples.en: The knife left a deep wound on his finger.
examples.hi: चाकू से उसकी उँगली पर एक गहरा घाव हो गया।

examples.en: The nurse checked whether the wound needed stitches.
examples.hi: नर्स ने जाँचा कि घाव में टाँके लगाने की ज़रूरत है या नहीं।

examples.en: Keep the wound dry and covered for a few days.
examples.hi: कुछ दिनों तक घाव को सूखा और ढका हुआ रखो।

examples.en: The wound is healing well, and the doctor said no infection has developed.
examples.hi: घाव अच्छे से भर रहा है और डॉक्टर ने कहा कि कोई संक्रमण नहीं हुआ है।

common_mistake.wrong: He wounded the bandage tightly around the cut.
common_mistake.right: He wound the bandage tightly around the cut.
common_mistake.why: 'Wound' the noun/adjective for an injury is /wuːnd/, but the past tense of the verb 'wind' (to wrap something around) is spelled 'wound' too but said /waʊnd/ — mixing them up creates confusion.

cloze.sentence: Please clean the ____ before you put a bandage on it.

en_def: a strip of cloth used to cover or wrap an injured part of the body
hi_def: पट्टी (चोट पर बाँधी जाने वाली पट्टी)
hi_nuance: In Indian and British English a small adhesive strip is called a 'plaster' or 'sticking plaster', while American English calls it a 'Band-Aid' (a brand name used generally). 'Bandage' itself is understood everywhere, but it usually means the longer strip wrapped around a wound, not the small adhesive strip.
