examples.en: The nurse put a bandage on my son's knee after he fell off his bicycle.
examples.hi: साइकिल से गिरने के बाद नर्स ने मेरे बेटे के घुटने पर पट्टी बाँधी।

examples.en: Change the bandage every day to keep the wound clean.
examples.hi: घाव को साफ़ रखने के लिए हर दिन पट्टी बदलो।

examples.en: He wrapped a bandage around his sprained ankle before the match.
examples.hi: मैच से पहले उसने अपने मुड़े हुए टखने पर पट्टी बाँध ली।

examples.en: We keep bandages and antiseptic in the first aid kit at home.
examples.hi: हम घर पर फ़र्स्ट एड किट में पट्टियाँ और एंटीसेप्टिक रखते हैं।

examples.en: The bandage was too tight, so the doctor loosened it a little.
examples.hi: पट्टी बहुत कसी हुई थी, इसलिए डॉक्टर ने उसे थोड़ा ढीला कर दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: Put a bandage on this small cut on my finger.
common_mistake.right: Put a plaster on this small cut on my finger.
common_mistake.why: For a tiny cut, English speakers usually ask for a 'plaster' (BrE/Indian) or 'Band-Aid' (AmE); 'bandage' is reserved for a longer strip wrapped around a bigger wound or sprain.

cloze.sentence: The clinic wrapped a ____ around my sprained wrist.

en_def: a medicine that reduces or removes pain
hi_def: दर्द निवारक दवा (पेनकिलर)
hi_nuance: The standard spelling is one word, 'painkiller', though many learners write it as two words 'pain killer' from directly translating 'दर्द मारने वाली दवा'. Also, when asking a chemist, it's more natural to say 'Can you give me something for the pain?' rather than the very direct 'Give me a painkiller.'

examples.en: I took a painkiller for my headache before the client call.
examples.hi: क्लाइंट कॉल से पहले मैंने सिरदर्द के लिए एक पेनकिलर ली।

examples.en: Don't take painkillers on an empty stomach.
examples.hi: खाली पेट पेनकिलर मत लो।

examples.en: The doctor prescribed a mild painkiller for my back pain.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने मेरे कमर दर्द के लिए एक हल्की पेनकिलर लिखी।

examples.en: Can you give me something for the pain? Just a normal painkiller will do.
examples.hi: दर्द के लिए कुछ दे दोगे? कोई साधारण पेनकिलर ही ठीक रहेगी।

examples.en: I keep a strip of painkillers in my travel bag for emergencies.
examples.hi: मैं इमरजेंसी के लिए अपने ट्रैवल बैग में पेनकिलर की एक पत्ती रखता हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: Give me one pain killer for headache, please.
common_mistake.right: Could you give me a painkiller for my headache, please?
common_mistake.why: 'Painkiller' is spelled as one word, not two; also a polite request in English usually softens the request with 'could you' rather than the very direct 'give me'.

cloze.sentence: Take a ____ if the pain gets worse tonight.

en_def: a written instruction from a doctor telling a chemist what medicine to give a patient
hi_def: पर्ची, प्रिस्क्रिप्शन (डॉक्टर की लिखी दवा की सूची)
hi_nuance: Indian English often drops the article, saying 'doctor gave me prescription' instead of 'the doctor gave me a prescription'. Also, some medicines that need 'a prescription' in one country are sold 'over the counter' in India without one — worth clarifying when travelling.

examples.en: The doctor gave me a prescription for antibiotics and rest.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने मुझे एंटीबायोटिक्स और आराम की पर्ची दी।

examples.en: I need to get this prescription filled at the medical store.
examples.hi: मुझे यह पर्ची मेडिकल स्टोर से भरवानी है।

examples.en: This medicine is only available with a valid prescription.
examples.hi: यह दवा सिर्फ़ मान्य पर्ची के साथ ही मिलती है।

examples.en: Please keep the old prescriptions in case the doctor asks for them.
examples.hi: पुरानी पर्चियाँ सँभालकर रखो, अगर डॉक्टर उन्हें माँगे।

examples.en: The pharmacist checked the prescription carefully before giving the tablets.
examples.hi: फ़ार्मासिस्ट ने गोलियाँ देने से पहले पर्ची ध्यान से जाँची।

common_mistake.wrong: Doctor gave me prescription for three medicines.
common_mistake.right: The doctor gave me a prescription for three medicines.
common_mistake.why: English requires an article before a singular countable noun like 'prescription', and 'the doctor' usually needs a definite article too when referring to a specific doctor.

cloze.sentence: You'll need a ____ from the doctor to buy this medicine.

en_def: the amount and frequency of a medicine that should be taken
hi_def: खुराक (दवा की मात्रा और समय की व्यवस्था)
hi_nuance: Learners often confuse 'dose' and 'dosage': a 'dose' is one single amount you take at one time, while 'dosage' refers to the overall system — how much and how often. Saying 'What is my dose?' when you mean the full instructions works, but 'follow the correct dosage' is more natural for the complete schedule.

examples.en: Please follow the dosage written on the label carefully.
examples.hi: कृपया लेबल पर लिखी खुराक का ध्यान से पालन करें।

examples.en: The doctor reduced the dosage after my blood pressure improved.
examples.hi: मेरा ब्लड प्रेशर सुधरने के बाद डॉक्टर ने खुराक कम कर दी।

examples.en: Ask the chemist about the correct dosage for a child.
examples.hi: बच्चे के लिए सही खुराक के बारे में केमिस्ट से पूछो।

examples.en: An overdose can happen if you don't stick to the prescribed dosage.
examples.hi: अगर तय की गई खुराक का पालन न करें तो ओवरडोज़ हो सकता है।

examples.en: The syrup's dosage depends on the child's weight.
examples.hi: सिरप की खुराक बच्चे के वज़न पर निर्भर करती है।

common_mistake.wrong: What is the dosage for one time?
common_mistake.right: What is the dose for one time?
common_mistake.why: 'Dose' means the single amount taken at one time; 'dosage' refers to the overall schedule (how much and how often), so 'dosage for one time' mixes the two terms.

cloze.sentence: Never increase the ____ without asking your doctor first.

en_def: a small, solid, round piece of medicine that you swallow
hi_def: गोली, टैबलेट (दवा की गोली)
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes forget to add the plural -s, saying 'take two tablet after food' instead of 'take two tablets after food'. In everyday Indian English, 'tablet' and 'pill' are used almost interchangeably, though 'tablet' can also mean an electronic device, so context matters.

examples.en: Take one tablet twice a day after food.
examples.hi: एक गोली दिन में दो बार खाने के बाद लो।

examples.en: I forgot to take my blood pressure tablet this morning.
examples.hi: आज सुबह मैं अपनी ब्लड प्रेशर की गोली लेना भूल गया।

examples.en: The chemist gave me ten tablets for the full course.
examples.hi: केमिस्ट ने पूरे कोर्स के लिए मुझे दस गोलियाँ दीं।

examples.en: Swallow the tablet with plenty of water, not milk.
examples.hi: गोली को दूध से नहीं, बल्कि खूब पानी के साथ निगलो।

examples.en: My father takes a sugar tablet every night before dinner.
examples.hi: मेरे पिता रात के खाने से पहले हर रात शुगर की गोली लेते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Doctor told me to take two tablet daily.
common_mistake.right: The doctor told me to take two tablets daily.
common_mistake.why: The plural form 'tablets' is needed after the number 'two'; also 'the doctor' generally takes an article when referring to a specific person.

cloze.sentence: Take one ____ every morning with breakfast.

en_def: a thick, sweet liquid medicine, often used for coughs and colds
hi_def: सिरप (मीठी तरल दवा, विशेषकर खाँसी के लिए)
hi_nuance: In Indian English, 'syrup' is sometimes used loosely for any liquid medicine, while in standard English it's usually specific, as in 'cough syrup'. Note the pronunciation is /ˈsɪrəp/, closer to 'sirrup', not 'sy-rup' as the spelling might suggest.

examples.en: Give the child one spoon of cough syrup before bedtime.
examples.hi: सोने से पहले बच्चे को खाँसी के सिरप का एक चम्मच दो।

examples.en: This syrup tastes sweet, so my daughter takes it without a fuss.
examples.hi: यह सिरप मीठा है, इसलिए मेरी बेटी बिना नखरे किए इसे ले लेती है।

examples.en: The doctor prescribed a syrup instead of tablets for my son.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने मेरे बेटे के लिए गोलियों की जगह सिरप लिखी।

examples.en: Shake the bottle well before pouring out the syrup.
examples.hi: सिरप डालने से पहले बोतल को अच्छी तरह हिलाओ।

examples.en: Store the syrup in the fridge once it's opened.
examples.hi: बोतल खुलने के बाद सिरप को फ़्रिज में रखो।

common_mistake.wrong: Take this syrup two spoon after dinner.
common_mistake.right: Take two spoons of this syrup after dinner.
common_mistake.why: The measure word order should be 'spoons of syrup', with the plural on 'spoons', not attached directly before 'syrup' without 'of'.

cloze.sentence: The chemist recommended a cough ____ for the child.

en_def: a device that slowly puts fluid or medicine directly into a patient's vein
hi_def: आईवी ड्रिप (नस के ज़रिए दिया जाने वाला तरल/दवा)
hi_nuance: The correct preposition is 'on a drip' or 'on an IV drip' ('he was put on a drip'), not 'in a drip'. In British and Indian hospitals, staff often just say 'drip' informally; in American hospitals, 'IV' (intravenous line) is the more common short form, so both terms are useful to know.

examples.en: The doctor put him on an IV drip because he was badly dehydrated.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने उसे आईवी ड्रिप पर लगा दिया क्योंकि वह बुरी तरह डीहाइड्रेटेड था।

examples.en: I was on a drip for two hours after the food poisoning.
examples.hi: फ़ूड पॉइज़निंग के बाद मैं दो घंटे ड्रिप पर था।

examples.en: The nurse checked the IV drip every fifteen minutes.
examples.hi: नर्स हर पंद्रह मिनट में आईवी ड्रिप जाँचती रही।

examples.en: My father needed an IV drip during his hospital stay last month.
examples.hi: पिछले महीने अस्पताल में भर्ती रहने के दौरान मेरे पिता को आईवी ड्रिप की ज़रूरत पड़ी।

examples.en: They gave her glucose through an IV drip in the emergency ward.
examples.hi: इमरजेंसी वार्ड में उसे आईवी ड्रिप के ज़रिए ग्लूकोज़ दिया गया।

common_mistake.wrong: The doctor put the drip in my hand for two hours.
common_mistake.right: The doctor put me on a drip for two hours.
common_mistake.why: The natural phrase is 'put someone on a drip', with 'on' as the preposition; 'the drip in my hand' describes only its physical location, not the standard medical phrase.

cloze.sentence: He was so dehydrated that the nurse put him on an ____.

en_def: a medical examination to make sure a person is healthy
hi_def: जाँच, चेकअप (स्वास्थ्य की नियमित जाँच)
hi_nuance: As a noun, this word is written as one word, 'checkup' (or 'check-up' in British spelling), but as a verb it is two words with a preposition: 'to check up on someone'. Confusing the two, as in 'I will check-up you tomorrow', is a common learner mistake.

examples.en: I have my annual checkup with the company doctor next week.
examples.hi: अगले हफ़्ते मेरा कंपनी के डॉक्टर के साथ सालाना चेकअप है।

examples.en: The doctor said everything looked fine in my full body checkup.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने कहा कि मेरे फ़ुल बॉडी चेकअप में सब कुछ ठीक लग रहा है।

examples.en: Don't skip your regular checkups just because you feel fine.
examples.hi: सिर्फ़ ठीक महसूस करने की वजह से अपने नियमित चेकअप मत छोड़ो।

examples.en: My father goes for a heart checkup every six months.
examples.hi: मेरे पिता हर छह महीने में हृदय की जाँच के लिए जाते हैं।

examples.en: The clinic offers a free checkup for new employees.
examples.hi: क्लिनिक नए कर्मचारियों के लिए मुफ़्त चेकअप देता है।

common_mistake.wrong: The doctor will check-up me tomorrow morning.
common_mistake.right: The doctor will check me up / give me a checkup tomorrow morning.
common_mistake.why: As a noun, 'checkup' means the examination itself; as a verb, the natural phrase is 'check someone up' or, more commonly for a doctor's visit, 'do a checkup', not 'check-up' used as a transitive verb.

cloze.sentence: I need to book a full body ____ this month.

en_def: a medical test in which a sample of blood is examined in a laboratory
hi_def: खून की जाँच (ब्लड टेस्ट)
hi_nuance: Indian English often uses the 'get done' construction, saying 'I got my blood test done', which is fine and common, but many learners drop the article entirely and say 'I did blood test' — the more natural phrasing is 'I had a blood test' or 'I got a blood test done'.

examples.en: I had a blood test this morning, and the report will come tomorrow.
examples.hi: आज सुबह मेरा खून का टेस्ट हुआ, और रिपोर्ट कल आएगी।

examples.en: The doctor asked me to get a fasting blood test done.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने मुझसे फ़ास्टिंग ब्लड टेस्ट करवाने को कहा।

examples.en: My blood test showed a slightly high sugar level.
examples.hi: मेरे खून के टेस्ट में शुगर लेवल थोड़ा ज़्यादा दिखा।

examples.en: They took a blood sample for the blood test early in the morning.
examples.hi: ब्लड टेस्ट के लिए सुबह-सुबह उन्होंने खून का सैंपल लिया।

examples.en: I need a blood test before my visa medical examination.
examples.hi: मुझे अपनी वीज़ा मेडिकल जाँच से पहले खून का टेस्ट करवाना है।

common_mistake.wrong: I did blood test yesterday for my checkup.
common_mistake.right: I had a blood test yesterday for my checkup.
common_mistake.why: The natural collocation with 'blood test' is 'have' (or 'get done'), and the countable noun needs an article: 'a blood test'.

cloze.sentence: The lab called to say my ____ results are ready.

en_def: not eating or drinking anything for a period of time, often before a medical test
hi_def: उपवास, फ़ास्टिंग (भोजन-पानी से परहेज़ करना, विशेषकर टेस्ट से पहले)
hi_nuance: Learners often keep the present continuous with 'since', saying 'I am fasting since last night' instead of the correct present perfect continuous 'I have been fasting since last night'. Also, in a medical context, 'fasting' just means not eating before a test, unlike religious fasting, which can involve other rules too.

examples.en: I have been fasting since last night for my blood sugar test.
examples.hi: अपने ब्लड शुगर टेस्ट के लिए मैं कल रात से उपवास पर हूँ।

examples.en: You need to be fasting for at least eight hours before this test.
examples.hi: इस टेस्ट से पहले कम से कम आठ घंटे उपवास ज़रूरी है।

examples.en: Is this a fasting blood test or can I eat breakfast first?
examples.hi: क्या यह फ़ास्टिंग ब्लड टेस्ट है, या मैं पहले नाश्ता कर सकता हूँ?

examples.en: He felt weak after fasting all morning for the checkup.
examples.hi: चेकअप के लिए पूरी सुबह उपवास करने के बाद वह कमज़ोर महसूस करने लगा।

examples.en: The lab technician confirmed I had been fasting properly before drawing blood.
examples.hi: खून लेने से पहले लैब टेक्निशियन ने पक्का किया कि मैंने ठीक से उपवास किया है।

common_mistake.wrong: I am fasting since yesterday night for the test.
common_mistake.right: I've been fasting since yesterday night for the test.
common_mistake.why: With 'since' marking a starting point, English needs the present perfect continuous 'have been fasting', not the simple present continuous 'am fasting'.

cloze.sentence: You must be ____ for twelve hours before this blood test.

en_def: having a bad physical reaction to a particular substance
hi_def: से एलर्जी होना (किसी चीज़ से शरीर की प्रतिक्रिया होना)
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often use the wrong preposition, saying 'allergic with' or 'allergic from' a substance, instead of the correct 'allergic to'. Note also it always needs a specific object: 'I am allergic to peanuts', not just 'I am allergic' on its own, unless the substance is already clear from context.

examples.en: I'm allergic to penicillin, so please note that in my file, doctor.
examples.hi: मुझे पेनिसिलिन से एलर्जी है, डॉक्टर, कृपया इसे मेरी फ़ाइल में नोट कर लें।

examples.en: She is allergic to dust and sneezes a lot in old buildings.
examples.hi: उसे धूल से एलर्जी है और पुरानी इमारतों में उसे बहुत छींक आती है।

examples.en: My son is allergic to peanuts, so we check every food label carefully.
examples.hi: मेरे बेटे को मूँगफली से एलर्जी है, इसलिए हम हर खाने के लेबल को ध्यान से जाँचते हैं।

examples.en: Tell the chemist if you're allergic to any medicine before buying it.
examples.hi: दवा खरीदने से पहले केमिस्ट को बता दो अगर तुम्हें किसी दवा से एलर्जी है।

examples.en: I found out I was allergic to a certain painkiller after a skin rash.
examples.hi: त्वचा पर चकत्ते होने के बाद मुझे पता चला कि मुझे एक खास पेनकिलर से एलर्जी है।

common_mistake.wrong: I am allergic with this medicine, so don't give it to me.
common_mistake.right: I am allergic to this medicine, so don't give it to me.
common_mistake.why: The fixed preposition after 'allergic' is always 'to', never 'with' or 'from', even though Hindi prepositions for this idea don't map directly onto English ones.

cloze.sentence: Please check the label — I'm ____ shellfish.

en_def: unwanted or harmful effects of a medicine, in addition to its main effect
hi_def: साइड इफ़ेक्ट, दुष्प्रभाव (दवा के अवांछित प्रभाव)
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often drop the plural, saying 'this medicine has side effect' instead of 'this medicine has side effects', since the concept is normally expressed in the plural in English even when discussing one type of drug. Also useful: 'to have side effects' is standard, while 'to give side effects' sounds odd.

examples.en: This antibiotic can have side effects like nausea and dizziness.
examples.hi: इस एंटीबायोटिक के साइड इफ़ेक्ट में मितली और चक्कर आना शामिल हो सकते हैं।

examples.en: Ask the doctor about the side effects before starting a new medicine.
examples.hi: कोई नई दवा शुरू करने से पहले डॉक्टर से उसके साइड इफ़ेक्ट के बारे में पूछो।

examples.en: I stopped the tablet because of its side effects on my stomach.
examples.hi: मैंने पेट पर उसके साइड इफ़ेक्ट की वजह से वह गोली लेनी बंद कर दी।

examples.en: The pamphlet lists all the possible side effects of this syrup.
examples.hi: पर्चे में इस सिरप के सभी संभावित साइड इफ़ेक्ट दिए गए हैं।

examples.en: Most people don't experience any side effects from this vaccine.
examples.hi: ज़्यादातर लोगों को इस वैक्सीन से कोई साइड इफ़ेक्ट नहीं होता।

common_mistake.wrong: This tablet has side effect, so read the pamphlet first.
common_mistake.right: This tablet has side effects, so read the pamphlet first.
common_mistake.why: 'Side effects' is almost always used in the plural in English, even when talking about one medicine, because a drug typically has more than one unwanted effect.

cloze.sentence: Read the leaflet carefully for possible ____ of this drug.

en_def: a phrase used to describe pain that happens during a particular movement or action
hi_def: जब भी... तो दर्द होता है (एक वाक्यांश जो किसी खास हरकत के दौरान होने वाले दर्द को बताता है)
hi_nuance: Indian speakers often over-use the continuous with 'getting pain', saying 'I am getting pain when I bend' instead of the more natural 'It hurts when I bend' or 'My back hurts when I bend'. 'It hurts when...' is the simplest, most common way native speakers describe pain triggered by an action.

examples.en: It hurts when I bend down to tie my shoelaces.
examples.hi: जब मैं झुककर जूते के फीते बाँधता हूँ तो दर्द होता है।

examples.en: It hurts when I press this part of my stomach.
examples.hi: जब मैं पेट के इस हिस्से को दबाता हूँ तो दर्द होता है।

examples.en: Does it hurt when you breathe deeply, the doctor asked.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने पूछा, क्या गहरी साँस लेने पर दर्द होता है?

examples.en: It hurts when I climb the stairs to the third floor.
examples.hi: जब मैं तीसरी मंज़िल तक सीढ़ियाँ चढ़ता हूँ तो दर्द होता है।

examples.en: It only hurts when I turn my neck to the left.
examples.hi: दर्द सिर्फ़ तब होता है जब मैं गर्दन को बाईं ओर घुमाता हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: I am getting pain when I bend my back.
common_mistake.right: It hurts when I bend my back.
common_mistake.why: 'Getting pain' is a direct calque from Hindi 'दर्द हो रहा है'; the natural English pattern is 'it hurts when...' or 'my back hurts when...'.

cloze.sentence: ____ I lift anything heavy, so I've stopped going to the gym.

en_def: pain felt in the chest, which can be a sign of a serious heart or lung problem
hi_def: छाती में दर्द (सीने में दर्द, गंभीर स्थिति का संकेत हो सकता है)
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'I am having chest pain', copying continuous forms from Hindi progressive tenses, whereas native speakers usually simply say 'I have chest pain' or 'I'm experiencing chest pain'. Because chest pain can signal a heart attack, it's important to describe it clearly and urgently — for example, 'I have sudden chest pain', not a vague continuous form.

examples.en: He suddenly had chest pain and was rushed to the emergency ward.
examples.hi: उसे अचानक छाती में दर्द हुआ और उसे तुरंत इमरजेंसी वार्ड ले जाया गया।

examples.en: If you feel chest pain along with sweating, call an ambulance immediately.
examples.hi: अगर छाती में दर्द के साथ पसीना भी आए, तो तुरंत एम्बुलेंस बुलाओ।

examples.en: I've had mild chest pain since I climbed the stairs quickly.
examples.hi: तेज़ी से सीढ़ियाँ चढ़ने के बाद से मुझे हल्का छाती में दर्द हो रहा है।

examples.en: The doctor asked if the chest pain got worse when I breathed in.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने पूछा कि क्या साँस लेने पर छाती का दर्द बढ़ जाता है।

examples.en: My father's chest pain turned out to be acidity, not a heart problem.
examples.hi: मेरे पिता का छाती का दर्द दिल की बीमारी नहीं, बल्कि एसिडिटी निकला।

common_mistake.wrong: I am having chest pain since morning, doctor.
common_mistake.right: I've had chest pain since this morning, doctor.
common_mistake.why: With 'since' marking when the symptom started, the natural tense is the present perfect ('I've had'), not the present continuous ('am having').

cloze.sentence: Call an ambulance immediately if someone has sudden ____.

en_def: the force of blood pushing against the walls of the blood vessels, measured as an indicator of health
hi_def: ब्लड प्रेशर, रक्तचाप (धमनियों में खून के दबाव की माप)
hi_nuance: In everyday Indian speech, people often shorten this to 'BP' ('my BP is high'), which is understood in India but may not always be clear to a doctor abroad who expects the full phrase 'blood pressure'. Also, remember the collocation is 'high/low blood pressure', not 'big/small blood pressure'.

examples.en: My blood pressure was a little high at today's checkup.
examples.hi: आज के चेकअप में मेरा ब्लड प्रेशर थोड़ा ज़्यादा था।

examples.en: The nurse measured my blood pressure before the doctor came in.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर के आने से पहले नर्स ने मेरा ब्लड प्रेशर नापा।

examples.en: He takes a tablet every morning to control his blood pressure.
examples.hi: वह अपने ब्लड प्रेशर को नियंत्रित रखने के लिए हर सुबह एक गोली लेता है।

examples.en: Stress at work can raise your blood pressure over time.
examples.hi: काम का तनाव समय के साथ आपका ब्लड प्रेशर बढ़ा सकता है।

examples.en: Low blood pressure sometimes makes people feel dizzy when they stand up.
examples.hi: कम ब्लड प्रेशर से कभी-कभी खड़े होते समय चक्कर आने लगता है।

common_mistake.wrong: My BP is very big these days.
common_mistake.right: My blood pressure is very high these days.
common_mistake.why: Blood pressure is described as 'high' or 'low', not 'big' or 'small'; also spelling out 'blood pressure' is clearer than 'BP' with someone unfamiliar with the abbreviation.

cloze.sentence: The doctor checked my ____ and said it was normal.

en_def: the amount of glucose in a person's blood, especially important for diabetics
hi_def: शुगर लेवल (खून में ग्लूकोज़ की मात्रा)
hi_nuance: 'Sugar' alone is very common colloquial Indian English for blood glucose ('my sugar is high'), but doctors internationally use the fuller phrase 'blood sugar level'. It's useful to use 'blood sugar' rather than just 'sugar' when speaking to a doctor unfamiliar with Indian usage, since 'sugar' alone could be misunderstood as the food.

examples.en: My sugar level was quite high in this morning's blood test.
examples.hi: आज सुबह के ब्लड टेस्ट में मेरा शुगर लेवल काफ़ी ज़्यादा था।

examples.en: The doctor asked me to check my sugar level before every meal.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने मुझसे हर भोजन से पहले शुगर लेवल जाँचने को कहा।

examples.en: Regular exercise helps keep your sugar level under control.
examples.hi: नियमित व्यायाम आपके शुगर लेवल को नियंत्रण में रखने में मदद करता है।

examples.en: My grandmother monitors her sugar level with a small machine at home.
examples.hi: मेरी दादी घर पर एक छोटी मशीन से अपना शुगर लेवल नापती हैं।

examples.en: Skipping meals can suddenly drop your sugar level.
examples.hi: भोजन छोड़ने से आपका शुगर लेवल अचानक गिर सकता है।

common_mistake.wrong: My sugar is high, so I avoided sweets today.
common_mistake.right: My blood sugar level is high, so I avoided sweets today.
common_mistake.why: Saying just 'sugar' for blood glucose is common in Indian English but can confuse a foreign doctor; the internationally clear phrase is 'blood sugar' or 'sugar level'.

cloze.sentence: The nurse pricked my finger to test my ____.

en_def: having a body temperature higher than normal; having a fever
hi_def: बुखार होना, तापमान बढ़ा होना (शरीर का तापमान सामान्य से ज़्यादा होना)
hi_nuance: The classic Indian-English mistake is 'I am having fever', copying the Hindi pattern; the correct native forms are 'I have a fever' or the more idiomatic 'I'm running a temperature'. 'Running a temperature' is a fixed expression — you can't say 'walking a temperature' or change the verb.

examples.en: I'm running a temperature, so I won't be coming to office today.
examples.hi: मुझे बुखार है, इसलिए आज मैं ऑफ़िस नहीं आ पाऊँगा।

examples.en: The baby has been running a temperature since last night.
examples.hi: बच्चे को कल रात से बुखार आ रहा है।

examples.en: She was running a slight temperature, so the doctor asked her to rest.
examples.hi: उसे हल्का बुखार था, इसलिए डॉक्टर ने उसे आराम करने को कहा।

examples.en: Call me if you start running a temperature during the trip.
examples.hi: अगर यात्रा के दौरान तुम्हें बुखार आने लगे तो मुझे कॉल करना।

examples.en: He is running a high temperature and needs to see a doctor today.
examples.hi: उसे तेज़ बुखार है और आज उसे डॉक्टर को दिखाना ज़रूरी है।

common_mistake.wrong: I am having fever since yesterday, so I will work from home.
common_mistake.right: I've had a fever since yesterday, so I'll work from home.
common_mistake.why: English does not use 'having fever' as a continuous state description; use 'have a fever' or the idiom 'run a temperature', and 'since' requires the present perfect tense.

cloze.sentence: My daughter is ____ , so I'm keeping her home from school.

en_def: a very severe headache, often with nausea and sensitivity to light, that can last for hours
hi_def: माइग्रेन (तेज़ सिरदर्द जो अक्सर मितली और रोशनी की संवेदनशीलता के साथ आता है)
hi_nuance: The word is pronounced /ˈmaɪɡreɪn/, close to 'my-grain', not spelled out phonetically as many learners assume. Also, in everyday Indian English people sometimes use 'migraine' loosely for any bad headache, but medically a migraine is a specific, recurring condition, different from an ordinary headache.

examples.en: I get a migraine almost every time I skip breakfast.
examples.hi: जब भी मैं नाश्ता छोड़ता हूँ, लगभग हर बार मुझे माइग्रेन हो जाता है।

examples.en: Bright screens at work trigger her migraines badly.
examples.hi: काम के दौरान तेज़ रोशनी वाली स्क्रीनें उसके माइग्रेन को बुरी तरह बढ़ा देती हैं।

examples.en: During a migraine, I have to lie down in a dark, quiet room.
examples.hi: माइग्रेन के दौरान मुझे एक अंधेरे, शांत कमरे में लेटना पड़ता है।

examples.en: The neurologist gave me a specific tablet for migraine attacks.
examples.hi: न्यूरोलॉजिस्ट ने माइग्रेन के दौरे के लिए मुझे एक खास गोली दी।

examples.en: Not every headache is a migraine, but a migraine is always more severe.
examples.hi: हर सिरदर्द माइग्रेन नहीं होता, लेकिन माइग्रेन हमेशा ज़्यादा गंभीर होता है।

common_mistake.wrong: I have a small migraine today, nothing serious.
common_mistake.right: I have a mild headache today, nothing serious.
common_mistake.why: A migraine is by definition a severe, specific type of headache; calling an ordinary mild headache a 'small migraine' misuses the medical term.

cloze.sentence: Bright lights and loud noise usually trigger her ____.

en_def: the measured heat of a person's body, normally around 37°C, used to check for fever
hi_def: शरीर का तापमान (सामान्यतः लगभग 37°C, बुखार जाँचने के लिए मापा जाता है)
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes say 'my temperature is coming' (a literal calque of 'तापमान आ रहा है') instead of the correct 'My temperature is going up' or 'My temperature is high'. Note the difference between 'temperature' alone (often meaning fever in casual speech) and 'body temperature' (the actual measured value, which can be normal, high, or low).

examples.en: The nurse used a digital thermometer to check my body temperature.
examples.hi: नर्स ने डिजिटल थर्मामीटर से मेरा शरीर का तापमान जाँचा।

examples.en: Normal body temperature is usually around thirty-seven degrees Celsius.
examples.hi: सामान्य शरीर का तापमान आमतौर पर लगभग सैंतीस डिग्री सेल्सियस होता है।

examples.en: His body temperature was slightly high, so the doctor suggested a paracetamol.
examples.hi: उसका शरीर का तापमान थोड़ा ज़्यादा था, इसलिए डॉक्टर ने पैरासिटामॉल की सलाह दी।

examples.en: Cold weather can also cause a drop in body temperature.
examples.hi: ठंडा मौसम भी शरीर के तापमान में गिरावट ला सकता है।

examples.en: Please note down the patient's body temperature every four hours.
examples.hi: कृपया हर चार घंटे में मरीज़ का शरीर का तापमान लिखते रहो।

common_mistake.wrong: My temperature is coming since morning.
common_mistake.right: My temperature has been high since morning.
common_mistake.why: 'Temperature is coming' is a direct Hindi calque; the natural expression describes the state or trend, such as 'is high', 'is going up', or 'has been high'.

cloze.sentence: The thermometer showed my ____ was 39 degrees.

en_def: a shop where medicines are sold, often also selling toiletries and basic health items
hi_def: केमिस्ट की दुकान (दवाइयों की दुकान)
hi_nuance: 'Chemist' (or 'chemist's shop') is the standard British and Indian term, while American English almost always says 'pharmacy' or 'drugstore'. When speaking to Americans, using 'chemist' for the shop can be confusing, since in the US 'chemist' usually means a scientist who studies chemistry.

examples.en: I need to run to the chemist shop before it closes.
examples.hi: दुकान बंद होने से पहले मुझे केमिस्ट के यहाँ जाना है।

examples.en: The chemist shop near my house is open twenty-four hours.
examples.hi: मेरे घर के पास की केमिस्ट की दुकान चौबीस घंटे खुली रहती है।

examples.en: Ask the chemist shop if they have this tablet in stock.
examples.hi: केमिस्ट की दुकान पर पूछो कि क्या यह गोली उनके पास है।

examples.en: I picked up a thermometer from the chemist shop on the way home.
examples.hi: घर आते समय मैंने केमिस्ट की दुकान से एक थर्मामीटर लिया।

examples.en: The chemist shop is right next to the clinic, so it's convenient.
examples.hi: केमिस्ट की दुकान क्लिनिक के ठीक बगल में है, इसलिए सुविधाजनक है।

common_mistake.wrong: I am a chemist shop nearby, so I will get the tablets.
common_mistake.right: There's a chemist's shop nearby, so I'll get the tablets.
common_mistake.why: This mistake mixes up the subject and location; also note the possessive form 'chemist's shop' (like 'a doctor's clinic') is common in British-style English.

cloze.sentence: Can you buy some ORS from the ____ on your way home?

en_def: describing medicine that can be bought without a doctor's prescription
hi_def: बिना पर्ची के मिलने वाली दवा (ओवर द काउंटर)
hi_nuance: Learners often translate this literally as 'without prescription medicine' or 'counter medicine' instead of using the fixed, hyphenated adjective 'over-the-counter medicine' before a noun. As a standalone phrase after 'available', it isn't hyphenated: 'this is available over the counter'.

examples.en: This painkiller is available over the counter, so you don't need a prescription.
examples.hi: यह पेनकिलर बिना पर्ची के मिल जाती है।

examples.en: Over-the-counter cold medicines are usually enough for a mild cough.
examples.hi: हल्की खाँसी के लिए आमतौर पर बिना पर्ची वाली सर्दी की दवाइयाँ काफ़ी होती हैं।

examples.en: Some antibiotics are sold over the counter here, unlike in many other countries.
examples.hi: कुछ एंटीबायोटिक्स यहाँ बिना पर्ची के भी मिल जाती हैं, जबकि कई अन्य देशों में नहीं।

examples.en: I bought an over-the-counter antacid for my acidity.
examples.hi: मैंने अपनी एसिडिटी के लिए बिना पर्ची वाली एंटासिड दवा खरीदी।

examples.en: Ask the chemist which over-the-counter option is best for a headache.
examples.hi: केमिस्ट से पूछो कि सिरदर्द के लिए कौन-सी बिना पर्ची वाली दवा सबसे अच्छी है।

common_mistake.wrong: This is a counter medicine, no prescription needed.
common_mistake.right: This is available over the counter, no prescription needed.
common_mistake.why: 'Counter medicine' is not a standard English term; the fixed phrase is 'over the counter' (or hyphenated 'over-the-counter' before a noun).

cloze.sentence: You can buy this cough syrup ____ without a prescription.

en_def: a traditional treatment made and used at home, without seeing a doctor
hi_def: घरेलू नुस्खा (डॉक्टर के बिना घर पर किया जाने वाला इलाज)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'homely remedy' or 'home made remedy', but the correct fixed phrase is simply 'home remedy' (plural 'home remedies'). Indian households have many well-known home remedies (like turmeric milk for a cold), and it's useful to be able to describe them clearly in English to a doctor or foreign colleague.

examples.en: My grandmother has a home remedy for almost every small illness.
examples.hi: मेरी दादी के पास लगभग हर छोटी बीमारी के लिए एक घरेलू नुस्खा है।

examples.en: Turmeric milk is a common home remedy for a sore throat in India.
examples.hi: भारत में गले की खराश के लिए हल्दी वाला दूध एक आम घरेलू नुस्खा है।

examples.en: I tried a home remedy first before going to the chemist.
examples.hi: केमिस्ट के पास जाने से पहले मैंने पहले एक घरेलू नुस्खा आज़माया।

examples.en: Some home remedies work well, but a bad infection still needs medicine.
examples.hi: कुछ घरेलू नुस्खे अच्छे से काम करते हैं, लेकिन गंभीर संक्रमण के लिए दवा ही ज़रूरी है।

examples.en: Ginger tea is my go-to home remedy for a mild stomach upset.
examples.hi: हल्के पेट खराब होने के लिए अदरक की चाय मेरा पसंदीदा घरेलू नुस्खा है।

common_mistake.wrong: She used a homely remedy for the cough.
common_mistake.right: She used a home remedy for the cough.
common_mistake.why: 'Homely' in English means plain or unattractive (or, in American English, cosy); the correct set phrase for a traditional household treatment is 'home remedy'.

cloze.sentence: Ginger and honey tea is a popular ____ for a cold.

en_def: the common medical advice of sleeping and drinking plenty of liquids to recover from a minor illness
hi_def: आराम और तरल पदार्थ (आराम करना और खूब पानी/तरल पीना)
hi_nuance: Indian speakers sometimes translate this too literally as 'take rest and water', missing the more natural collocation 'drink plenty of fluids' and 'get plenty of rest'. 'Fluids' here is the standard medical word covering water, juice, soup, and other liquids, not just plain water.

examples.en: The doctor said I just need rest and fluids for this viral fever.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने कहा कि इस वायरल बुखार के लिए मुझे बस आराम और तरल पदार्थ चाहिए।

examples.en: Get plenty of rest and drink lots of fluids until the fever breaks.
examples.hi: जब तक बुखार न उतरे, खूब आराम करो और खूब तरल पदार्थ पिओ।

examples.en: With rest and fluids, most colds clear up within a week.
examples.hi: आराम और तरल पदार्थों की मदद से ज़्यादातर सर्दी-ज़ुकाम एक हफ़्ते में ठीक हो जाते हैं।

examples.en: The nurse advised rest and fluids instead of antibiotics for this infection.
examples.hi: नर्स ने इस संक्रमण के लिए एंटीबायोटिक्स की जगह आराम और तरल पदार्थों की सलाह दी।

examples.en: He recovered quickly with proper rest and fluids over the weekend.
examples.hi: सप्ताहांत में ठीक से आराम और तरल पदार्थ लेने से वह जल्दी ठीक हो गया।

common_mistake.wrong: Doctor told me to take rest and water only.
common_mistake.right: The doctor told me to get plenty of rest and drink lots of fluids.
common_mistake.why: The natural collocations are 'get rest' and 'drink fluids', and 'fluids' is broader than just 'water', covering juice, soup, and other liquids recommended during illness.

cloze.sentence: For a mild viral infection, the doctor usually just recommends ____.

en_def: a friendly phrase said or written to someone who is ill, wishing them a quick recovery
hi_def: जल्दी ठीक हो जाओ (बीमार व्यक्ति के लिए शुभकामना)
hi_nuance: This is a fixed expression and cannot be modified with intensifiers like 'fastly' or reordered, so 'soon get well' or 'get well fastly' sound wrong. It's used both in speech and in written messages or cards, and works for colleagues, friends, and family alike, regardless of how serious the illness is.

examples.en: I sent my colleague a message saying 'get well soon' after he got dengue.
examples.hi: डेंगू होने के बाद मैंने अपने सहकर्मी को 'जल्दी ठीक हो जाओ' का मैसेज भेजा।

examples.en: Get well soon — take proper rest and don't rush back to office.
examples.hi: जल्दी ठीक हो जाओ — ठीक से आराम करो और जल्दबाज़ी में ऑफ़िस मत आना।

examples.en: We all signed a card that said 'Get well soon' for our sick teammate.
examples.hi: हम सबने एक कार्ड पर हस्ताक्षर किए जिस पर लिखा था 'जल्दी ठीक हो जाओ' अपने बीमार साथी के लिए।

examples.en: Get well soon, uncle — the whole family is thinking of you.
examples.hi: जल्दी ठीक हो जाइए, चाचा जी — पूरा परिवार आपके बारे में सोच रहा है।

examples.en: She wished him a quick recovery and said, 'Get well soon.'
examples.hi: उसने उसे जल्दी ठीक होने की शुभकामना दी और कहा, 'जल्दी ठीक हो जाओ।'

common_mistake.wrong: Get well fastly, my friend, don't worry.
common_mistake.right: Get well soon, my friend, don't worry.
common_mistake.why: 'Get well soon' is a fixed phrase; 'fastly' is not a standard English word at all — the correct adverb here is simply 'soon'.

cloze.sentence: I texted her "____, take care of yourself!" after hearing she was ill.

en_def: time off from work that an employee takes because of illness
hi_def: बीमारी की छुट्टी (सिक लीव)
hi_nuance: Indian workplaces sometimes use 'medical leave' and 'sick leave' interchangeably, but internationally 'sick leave' is the more standard HR term. Also, note the collocation: you usually say 'I'm on sick leave' (a current state) or 'I applied for sick leave', not 'I took a sick leave' with an article.

examples.en: I'm on sick leave today because of a bad fever.
examples.hi: मैं आज तेज़ बुखार की वजह से सिक लीव पर हूँ।

examples.en: He applied for two days of sick leave after his surgery.
examples.hi: उसने अपनी सर्जरी के बाद दो दिनों की सिक लीव के लिए आवेदन किया।

examples.en: You'll need a medical certificate to claim sick leave for more than two days.
examples.hi: दो दिन से ज़्यादा सिक लीव लेने के लिए मेडिकल सर्टिफ़िकेट चाहिए होगा।

examples.en: Our company gives twelve days of paid sick leave every year.
examples.hi: हमारी कंपनी हर साल बारह दिनों की सवैतनिक सिक लीव देती है।

examples.en: I emailed my manager to say I was taking sick leave for the day.
examples.hi: मैंने अपने मैनेजर को ईमेल किया कि मैं आज सिक लीव पर रहूँगा।

common_mistake.wrong: I will take a sick leave tomorrow because of fever.
common_mistake.right: I'll be on sick leave tomorrow because of fever.
common_mistake.why: 'Sick leave' is usually uncountable in this expression, so it doesn't take 'a'; the natural collocations are 'be on sick leave' or 'take sick leave' without an article.

cloze.sentence: He's been on ____ all week with a bad case of flu.

en_def: an official document from a doctor confirming a person's illness, often needed to justify sick leave
hi_def: मेडिकल सर्टिफ़िकेट (डॉक्टर द्वारा जारी बीमारी का प्रमाण पत्र)
hi_nuance: In India this is commonly shortened to 'MC' at the workplace ('please submit your MC'), which is well understood locally but not always abroad, where 'doctor's note' (American English) or 'sick note' (British English) is more common. Use the full phrase 'medical certificate' when writing formally, especially in an email to HR.

examples.en: Please submit a medical certificate if you're absent for more than two days.
examples.hi: अगर आप दो दिन से ज़्यादा अनुपस्थित रहते हैं तो कृपया मेडिकल सर्टिफ़िकेट जमा करें।

examples.en: The clinic issued a medical certificate for my three days of leave.
examples.hi: क्लिनिक ने मेरी तीन दिनों की छुट्टी के लिए मेडिकल सर्टिफ़िकेट जारी किया।

examples.en: HR asked for a medical certificate before approving my sick leave.
examples.hi: मेरी सिक लीव मंज़ूर करने से पहले HR ने मेडिकल सर्टिफ़िकेट माँगा।

examples.en: I forgot to get a medical certificate when I visited the clinic yesterday.
examples.hi: कल क्लिनिक जाते समय मैं मेडिकल सर्टिफ़िकेट लेना भूल गया।

examples.en: The doctor signed and stamped the medical certificate before I left.
examples.hi: जाने से पहले डॉक्टर ने मेडिकल सर्टिफ़िकेट पर हस्ताक्षर और मुहर लगाई।

common_mistake.wrong: I will send you my MC by email, sir.
common_mistake.right: I will send you my medical certificate by email, sir.
common_mistake.why: 'MC' is a common Indian workplace abbreviation but is not widely understood outside India; using the full term 'medical certificate' avoids confusion, especially in formal or international communication.

cloze.sentence: You need to submit a ____ to HR for any leave over two days.

en_def: the part of a hospital where patients with sudden, serious illnesses or injuries are treated urgently
hi_def: इमरजेंसी वार्ड, आपातकालीन विभाग (गंभीर या अचानक बीमारी वालों के लिए अस्पताल का हिस्सा)
hi_nuance: 'Emergency ward' is common Indian English; American English usually says 'emergency room' or the abbreviation 'ER', while British English typically says 'A&E' (Accident and Emergency). Knowing all three terms is useful, since a foreign colleague or a travel insurance form might use a different one than you're used to.

examples.en: We rushed him to the emergency ward after the road accident.
examples.hi: सड़क दुर्घटना के बाद हम उसे इमरजेंसी वार्ड ले गए।

examples.en: The emergency ward was crowded on Sunday night.
examples.hi: रविवार रात को इमरजेंसी वार्ड में काफ़ी भीड़ थी।

examples.en: The doctor in the emergency ward asked about his symptoms immediately.
examples.hi: इमरजेंसी वार्ड के डॉक्टर ने तुरंत उसके लक्षणों के बारे में पूछा।

examples.en: If you have severe chest pain, go straight to the emergency ward.
examples.hi: अगर छाती में तेज़ दर्द हो तो सीधे इमरजेंसी वार्ड जाओ।

examples.en: My insurance covers treatment in the emergency ward too.
examples.hi: मेरा बीमा इमरजेंसी वार्ड के इलाज को भी कवर करता है।

collocations: rush someone to the emergency ward

common_mistake.wrong: In America, tell them you need the emergency ward.
common_mistake.right: In America, tell them you need the emergency room (ER).
common_mistake.why: 'Emergency ward' is standard in India and understood, but American hospital staff more commonly say 'emergency room' or 'ER', and British hospitals say 'A&E' — worth knowing when travelling.

cloze.sentence: After the accident, he was taken straight to the ____.

en_def: basic medical help given immediately to an injured or ill person before proper treatment
hi_def: प्राथमिक चिकित्सा, फ़र्स्ट एड (चोट या बीमारी में दी जाने वाली तुरंत की मदद)
hi_nuance: Indian speakers often say 'first aid box' from directly translating the idea of a container, but the standard English term is 'first aid kit'. Also, 'first aid' itself is uncountable and doesn't take an article: you 'give first aid' or 'know first aid', not 'give a first aid'.

examples.en: We keep a first aid kit in the car for emergencies.
examples.hi: हम इमरजेंसी के लिए गाड़ी में एक फ़र्स्ट एड किट रखते हैं।

examples.en: Everyone in our security team is trained in basic first aid.
examples.hi: हमारी सुरक्षा टीम में हर कोई बुनियादी फ़र्स्ट एड में प्रशिक्षित है।

examples.en: He gave first aid to the injured man before the ambulance arrived.
examples.hi: एम्बुलेंस आने से पहले उसने घायल आदमी को फ़र्स्ट एड दी।

examples.en: The office keeps a first aid kit near the reception desk.
examples.hi: ऑफ़िस रिसेप्शन डेस्क के पास एक फ़र्स्ट एड किट रखता है।

examples.en: Knowing first aid can help you handle small injuries at home.
examples.hi: फ़र्स्ट एड जानना घर पर छोटी चोटों को सँभालने में मदद कर सकता है।

common_mistake.wrong: Bring the first aid box, he has cut his hand.
common_mistake.right: Bring the first aid kit, he has cut his hand.
common_mistake.why: The standard English term for the container of emergency medical supplies is 'first aid kit', not 'first aid box'.

cloze.sentence: Every office should have a ____ kit within easy reach.

en_def: a vehicle specially equipped to carry sick or injured people to a hospital quickly
hi_def: एम्बुलेंस (मरीज़ों को अस्पताल ले जाने वाली विशेष गाड़ी)
hi_nuance: The stress falls on the first syllable, /ˈæmbjʊləns/, not on the middle, which some learners get wrong. Also, when asking for help in general, English uses the indefinite article, 'call an ambulance', while a specific one already on the way is 'the ambulance' — 'call the ambulance' before one has even been requested sounds odd.

examples.en: Call an ambulance immediately — he's collapsed and isn't responding!
examples.hi: तुरंत एम्बुलेंस बुलाओ — वह गिर गया है और कोई प्रतिक्रिया नहीं दे रहा!

examples.en: The ambulance arrived within ten minutes of our call.
examples.hi: हमारे कॉल करने के दस मिनट के अंदर एम्बुलेंस आ गई।

examples.en: We heard an ambulance siren outside the office this afternoon.
examples.hi: आज दोपहर हमने ऑफ़िस के बाहर एम्बुलेंस का सायरन सुना।

examples.en: The ambulance took my grandfather to the emergency ward last night.
examples.hi: कल रात एम्बुलेंस मेरे दादा जी को इमरजेंसी वार्ड ले गई।

examples.en: Keep the local ambulance number saved in your phone.
examples.hi: अपने फ़ोन में स्थानीय एम्बुलेंस का नंबर सेव करके रखो।

common_mistake.wrong: Call the ambulance now, someone please!
common_mistake.right: Call an ambulance now, someone please!
common_mistake.why: Since no specific ambulance has been mentioned yet, the indefinite article 'an' is correct here; 'the ambulance' would suggest a particular one already known to both speakers.

cloze.sentence: Someone has collapsed — please call an ____ right now!

en_def: short pieces of thread used by a doctor to sew a wound closed so it can heal
hi_def: टाँके (घाव सिलने के लिए इस्तेमाल किए जाने वाले धागे के टुकड़े)
hi_nuance: This word is almost always used in the plural when talking about medical sutures, so 'I got a stitch on my forehead' sounds odd; the correct phrasing is 'I got stitches on my forehead', even if it's technically just one thread pass. Note also 'a stitch' (singular) has a completely different everyday meaning — a sudden pain in your side while running.

examples.en: I got five stitches on my chin after falling off my bike.
examples.hi: बाइक से गिरने के बाद मेरी ठुड्डी पर पाँच टाँके लगे।

examples.en: The doctor put in stitches and told me to come back in a week to remove them.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने टाँके लगाए और मुझसे उन्हें हटवाने के लिए एक हफ़्ते बाद आने को कहा।

examples.en: Her stitches healed well, leaving only a faint scar.
examples.hi: उसके टाँके अच्छे से भर गए और सिर्फ़ एक हल्का निशान रह गया।

examples.en: He needed stitches after cutting his hand on a broken glass.
examples.hi: टूटे हुए काँच से हाथ कटने के बाद उसे टाँकों की ज़रूरत पड़ी।

examples.en: Don't get the stitches wet until the doctor says it's safe.
examples.hi: जब तक डॉक्टर सुरक्षित न बताए, तब तक टाँकों को गीला मत करो।

common_mistake.wrong: I got one stitch on my forehead yesterday.
common_mistake.right: I got stitches on my forehead yesterday.
common_mistake.why: Medical sutures are almost always referred to in the plural 'stitches', regardless of the exact number; the singular 'a stitch' usually refers to a sudden sharp pain in your side, not a suture.

cloze.sentence: The cut was deep, so the doctor put in three ____.

en_def: a small adhesive strip used to cover and protect a minor cut or wound
hi_def: प्लास्टर, बैंड-एड (छोटी चोट पर लगाई जाने वाली चिपकने वाली पट्टी)
hi_nuance: 'Plaster' (British and Indian English) and 'Band-Aid' (American English, a brand name used generally) refer to the same small adhesive strip — useful to know both when travelling. Note also that 'plaster' has another unrelated meaning, the paste used to cover walls, so context tells you which one is meant.

examples.en: Put a plaster on that small cut before it gets dirty.
examples.hi: उस छोटे कट पर गंदा होने से पहले प्लास्टर लगा लो।

examples.en: I always keep a few plasters in my bag for emergencies.
examples.hi: मैं इमरजेंसी के लिए हमेशा अपने बैग में कुछ प्लास्टर रखता हूँ।

examples.en: The nurse cleaned the cut and stuck a plaster over it.
examples.hi: नर्स ने कट साफ़ किया और उस पर एक प्लास्टर चिपका दिया।

examples.en: Ask an American for a 'Band-Aid' if 'plaster' doesn't make sense to them.
examples.hi: अगर 'plaster' समझ न आए तो किसी अमेरिकी से 'Band-Aid' माँग लेना।

examples.en: My daughter loves the cartoon-print plasters from the chemist.
examples.hi: मेरी बेटी को केमिस्ट की दुकान वाले कार्टून-प्रिंट प्लास्टर बहुत पसंद हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I need a bandage for this tiny paper cut.
common_mistake.right: I need a plaster for this tiny paper cut.
common_mistake.why: For a small cut, English speakers ask for a 'plaster' (BrE/Indian) or 'Band-Aid' (AmE); 'bandage' is normally reserved for a bigger wound or sprain that needs wrapping.

cloze.sentence: That paper cut is bleeding a little — put a ____ on it.

en_def: oral rehydration salts, a mixture dissolved in water to quickly replace lost fluids and salts, especially after diarrhoea or vomiting
hi_def: ओआरएस (ओरल रीहाइड्रेशन साल्ट, पानी में घोलकर पीने वाला घोल जो दस्त-उल्टी के बाद शरीर में पानी-नमक की कमी पूरी करता है)
hi_nuance: 'ORS' is widely known and used in India, but since it's an abbreviation, a foreign doctor or pharmacist may not instantly recognise it — it helps to say 'oral rehydration solution' or 'rehydration salts' in full when abroad. Also, it's used with 'a packet of' or 'a sachet of' ORS, since it comes as a powder to mix with water.

examples.en: Mix a packet of ORS in clean water and drink it slowly.
examples.hi: साफ़ पानी में ORS का एक पैकेट घोलो और धीरे-धीरे पिओ।

examples.en: The doctor recommended ORS for my son's dehydration after loose motions.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने दस्त के बाद मेरे बेटे के डीहाइड्रेशन के लिए ORS की सलाह दी।

examples.en: Always keep a few sachets of ORS at home during the summer.
examples.hi: गर्मियों में घर पर ORS के कुछ पैकेट ज़रूर रखो।

examples.en: I carry ORS packets in my bag whenever I travel to a new city.
examples.hi: जब भी मैं किसी नए शहर की यात्रा करता हूँ, अपने बैग में ORS के पैकेट रखता हूँ।

examples.en: If the pharmacist abroad doesn't know 'ORS', ask for oral rehydration solution instead.
examples.hi: अगर विदेश में फ़ार्मासिस्ट 'ORS' न समझे तो 'oral rehydration solution' माँगना।

common_mistake.wrong: Drink some ORS water, it will fix the vomiting.
common_mistake.right: Drink some ORS solution, it will help with the dehydration.
common_mistake.why: ORS treats dehydration caused by fluid loss (from vomiting or loose motions), not the vomiting or diarrhoea itself; it replaces lost water and salts rather than stopping the symptom.

cloze.sentence: After the loose motions, the doctor told him to drink ____ regularly.

en_def: a harmful lack of water in the body, often caused by not drinking enough or losing too much fluid
hi_def: डीहाइड्रेशन, निर्जलीकरण (शरीर में पानी की कमी होना)
hi_nuance: Learners sometimes say 'I am dehydrate', confusing the noun/verb 'dehydrate' with the adjective; the correct adjective form is 'dehydrated' ('I am dehydrated'). 'Dehydration' is the noun for the overall condition, while 'dehydrated' describes the person or thing affected by it.

examples.en: He was admitted for dehydration after two days of vomiting and loose motions.
examples.hi: दो दिनों की उल्टी और दस्त के बाद उसे डीहाइड्रेशन की वजह से भर्ती किया गया।

examples.en: Severe dehydration can make you feel dizzy and very weak.
examples.hi: गंभीर डीहाइड्रेशन से चक्कर और बहुत ज़्यादा कमज़ोरी महसूस हो सकती है।

examples.en: Drink ORS regularly to avoid dehydration in this heat.
examples.hi: इस गर्मी में डीहाइड्रेशन से बचने के लिए नियमित रूप से ORS पिओ।

examples.en: The doctor said mild dehydration was the reason for my headache.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने कहा कि हल्का डीहाइड्रेशन ही मेरे सिरदर्द की वजह था।

examples.en: Children can reach dangerous levels of dehydration much faster than adults.
examples.hi: बच्चे वयस्कों की तुलना में बहुत जल्दी खतरनाक स्तर के डीहाइड्रेशन तक पहुँच सकते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I am feeling dehydrate after the long trek.
common_mistake.right: I am feeling dehydrated after the long trek.
common_mistake.why: 'Dehydrate' is the base verb; the adjective describing a person's condition is 'dehydrated', formed from the past participle, not the bare verb form.

cloze.sentence: Drink plenty of water in this heat to avoid ____.

en_def: a lack of physical strength or energy, often felt during or after an illness
hi_def: कमज़ोरी (बीमारी के दौरान या बाद में ताकत की कमी महसूस होना)
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'I am feeling weakness' (a calque of 'कमज़ोरी महसूस हो रही है'), but 'weakness' is a noun and doesn't fit naturally after 'feeling' this way — the correct forms are 'I feel weak' (adjective) or 'I have a feeling of weakness' (more formal, less common in speech).

examples.en: I feel weak and tired after the loose motions yesterday.
examples.hi: कल के दस्त के बाद मुझे कमज़ोरी और थकान महसूस हो रही है।

examples.en: There is a general weakness in my legs since the fever came down.
examples.hi: बुखार उतरने के बाद से मेरे पैरों में एक आम कमज़ोरी है।

examples.en: The doctor said the weakness would pass within a few days with proper rest.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने कहा कि उचित आराम के साथ कमज़ोरी कुछ ही दिनों में चली जाएगी।

examples.en: Sudden weakness on one side of the body needs immediate medical attention.
examples.hi: शरीर के एक तरफ़ अचानक कमज़ोरी आना तुरंत चिकित्सा ध्यान माँगता है।

examples.en: Low sugar level can also cause sudden weakness and dizziness.
examples.hi: शुगर लेवल कम होने से भी अचानक कमज़ोरी और चक्कर आ सकते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I am feeling weakness since the fever went away.
common_mistake.right: I feel weak since the fever went away.
common_mistake.why: 'Weakness' is a noun and doesn't collocate naturally with 'feeling' in this pattern; the adjective 'weak' fits directly after 'feel', as in 'I feel weak'.

cloze.sentence: After three days of fever, I'm still left with a lot of ____.

en_def: the process of becoming healthy again after an illness or injury
hi_def: रिकवरी, स्वास्थ्य लाभ (बीमारी या चोट के बाद फिर से ठीक होने की प्रक्रिया)
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes say 'my recovery is going on' as a literal translation of 'रिकवरी चल रही है', but native speakers more naturally say 'I'm recovering' (verb) or 'I'm on the road to recovery' (a set expression), keeping 'recovery' mostly as a noun rather than forcing it into a continuous verb-like structure.

examples.en: His recovery after the surgery was faster than expected.
examples.hi: सर्जरी के बाद उसकी रिकवरी उम्मीद से तेज़ रही।

examples.en: I'm on the road to recovery, though I still feel a bit weak.
examples.hi: मैं धीरे-धीरे ठीक हो रहा हूँ, हालाँकि अभी भी थोड़ी कमज़ोरी महसूस होती है।

examples.en: Proper rest and fluids can speed up recovery from a viral fever.
examples.hi: उचित आराम और तरल पदार्थ वायरल बुखार से रिकवरी को तेज़ कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: The doctor was pleased with my recovery after the fracture healed.
examples.hi: फ़्रैक्चर ठीक होने के बाद डॉक्टर मेरी रिकवरी से खुश थे।

examples.en: Full recovery from the surgery may take about six weeks.
examples.hi: सर्जरी से पूरी तरह रिकवरी में लगभग छह हफ़्ते लग सकते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: My recovery is going on well after the operation.
common_mistake.right: I'm recovering well after the operation.
common_mistake.why: 'Recovery' is a noun and doesn't naturally take a continuous verb form like 'is going on'; the verb 'recover' ('I'm recovering') expresses the ongoing process more naturally.

cloze.sentence: Doctors expect a full ____ within a few weeks.

en_def: a medical image of the inside of the body, especially the bones, made using a type of radiation
hi_def: एक्स-रे (शरीर के अंदर, विशेषकर हड्डियों की तस्वीर)
hi_nuance: The pronunciation is 'eks-ray', not 'iks-ray' as spelling might suggest to a Hindi speaker. Also, 'X-ray' can be a noun ('I need an X-ray') or a verb ('they X-rayed my arm'); learners sometimes only know the noun use and say 'they did X-ray of my arm' instead of the more natural 'they took an X-ray of my arm' or 'they X-rayed my arm'.

examples.en: The doctor asked for an X-ray to check if the bone was fractured.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने यह जाँचने के लिए एक्स-रे माँगा कि हड्डी टूटी है या नहीं।

examples.en: They took an X-ray of my ankle after the fall.
examples.hi: गिरने के बाद उन्होंने मेरे टखने का एक्स-रे लिया।

examples.en: The X-ray showed a small crack in my wrist.
examples.hi: एक्स-रे में मेरी कलाई में एक छोटी दरार दिखी।

examples.en: I need to get a chest X-ray done before the surgery.
examples.hi: सर्जरी से पहले मुझे छाती का एक्स-रे करवाना है।

examples.en: The radiologist reviewed my X-ray and said the bone was healing well.
examples.hi: रेडियोलॉजिस्ट ने मेरा एक्स-रे देखा और कहा कि हड्डी अच्छे से भर रही है।

common_mistake.wrong: They did X-ray of my leg at the clinic.
common_mistake.right: They took an X-ray of my leg at the clinic.
common_mistake.why: The natural collocation is 'take an X-ray', with the article 'an' before the countable noun; 'did X-ray' without an article sounds unnatural in English.

cloze.sentence: The doctor ordered an ____ to check for a fracture.

en_def: an Indian-English term for a shop that sells medicines, similar to a chemist's shop or pharmacy
hi_def: मेडिकल स्टोर (दवाइयाँ बेचने वाली दुकान)
hi_nuance: 'Medical store' is a very common Indian-English term, seen on shop signboards across India, but it isn't used in Britain or the US, where 'chemist's' (BrE) or 'pharmacy'/'drugstore' (AmE) is standard. When speaking with a foreign colleague, it's safer to say 'pharmacy' so they understand immediately.

examples.en: I need to buy some ORS from the medical store downstairs.
examples.hi: मुझे नीचे वाले मेडिकल स्टोर से कुछ ORS खरीदना है।

examples.en: The medical store near my flat delivers medicines at night too.
examples.hi: मेरे फ़्लैट के पास वाला मेडिकल स्टोर रात में भी दवाइयाँ पहुँचाता है।

examples.en: Ask the medical store if they have this tablet in stock.
examples.hi: मेडिकल स्टोर पर पूछो कि क्या यह गोली उनके पास उपलब्ध है।

examples.en: If you say 'medical store' in America, people may not understand you — say 'pharmacy' instead.
examples.hi: अगर तुम अमेरिका में 'medical store' कहोगे तो लोग शायद न समझें — इसकी जगह 'pharmacy' कहना।

examples.en: I keep the medical store's number saved for late-night emergencies.
examples.hi: देर रात की इमरजेंसी के लिए मैंने मेडिकल स्टोर का नंबर सेव करके रखा है।

common_mistake.wrong: In London, ask a taxi driver to take you to a medical store.
common_mistake.right: In London, ask a taxi driver to take you to a chemist's or pharmacy.
common_mistake.why: 'Medical store' is purely Indian-English usage; it isn't understood in Britain or the US, where 'chemist's' or 'pharmacy' is the standard term for a shop selling medicines.

cloze.sentence: The signboard outside said "Sharma ____" in bold red letters.

en_def: to telephone your workplace to say you cannot come to work because you are ill
hi_def: बीमार होने के कारण फ़ोन करके ऑफ़िस को छुट्टी की सूचना देना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'I will do sick leave call' or 'I am informing sick' — English has one fixed phrase, 'call in sick'; you don't 'do' it, you 'call' it in.

examples.en: I have a bad fever, so I'm going to call in sick tomorrow.
examples.hi: मुझे तेज़ बुख़ार है, इसलिए मैं कल बीमारी की छुट्टी के लिए फ़ोन करूँगा।

examples.en: She called in sick twice this month, and her manager noticed.
examples.hi: उसने इस महीने दो बार बीमार होने की सूचना देकर छुट्टी ली, और उसके मैनेजर ने यह नोटिस किया।

examples.en: If you're too unwell to work, just call in sick instead of struggling through the day.
examples.hi: अगर तुम काम करने लायक़ स्वस्थ नहीं हो, तो पूरे दिन जूझने के बजाय बीमारी की छुट्टी के लिए फ़ोन कर दो।

examples.en: He called in sick on Monday because of a stomach infection.
examples.hi: पेट के संक्रमण की वजह से उसने सोमवार को बीमार होने की सूचना देकर छुट्टी ली।

examples.en: I need to call in sick today; I can barely get out of bed.
examples.hi: मुझे आज बीमारी की छुट्टी के लिए फ़ोन करना होगा; मुझसे बिस्तर से उठा भी नहीं जा रहा।

common_mistake.wrong: I will do sick leave call to office.
common_mistake.right: I'll call in sick.
common_mistake.why: Hindi speakers often translate the phrase literally ('sick leave call karna'); English uses the fixed verb phrase 'call in sick', not 'do a sick call'.

cloze.sentence: I have a fever, so I'm going to ____ tomorrow.

en_def: to be behind schedule; to arrive somewhere later than planned
hi_def: देर से पहुँचना, समय से पीछे चल रहा होना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers usually say 'I am late by 10 minutes', but the natural phrase is 'I'm running 10 minutes late' or 'I'm running late' — 'run late' describes the ongoing state, not a fixed amount alone.

examples.en: Sorry, I'm running late — the traffic is terrible today.
examples.hi: माफ़ करना, मुझे देर हो रही है — आज ट्रैफ़िक बहुत ख़राब है।

examples.en: The meeting is running late, so let's push lunch back by half an hour.
examples.hi: मीटिंग में देर हो रही है, इसलिए चलिए लंच आधा घंटा आगे बढ़ा देते हैं।

examples.en: I'm running about fifteen minutes late for the call.
examples.hi: मुझे कॉल के लिए लगभग पंद्रह मिनट की देर हो रही है।

examples.en: She always runs late for her morning stand-up.
examples.hi: वह हमेशा अपनी सुबह की स्टैंड-अप मीटिंग के लिए देर से पहुँचती है।

examples.en: If the flight runs late again, we'll miss our connection.
examples.hi: अगर फ़्लाइट फिर से लेट हुई, तो हमारी कनेक्टिंग फ़्लाइट छूट जाएगी।

common_mistake.wrong: I am late by 10 minutes for the meeting.
common_mistake.right: I'm running 10 minutes late for the meeting.
common_mistake.why: Indian English often says 'late by X minutes'; natural English says 'running X minutes late' to describe an ongoing delay.

cloze.sentence: Sorry, I'm ____ — I got stuck in traffic.

en_def: to do someone's job or take their place temporarily while they are away
hi_def: किसी की अनुपस्थिति में उसका काम या ज़िम्मेदारी अस्थायी रूप से संभालना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'please manage my work' — English speakers say 'can you cover for me', which specifically implies standing in for someone during an absence, not general help.

examples.en: Can you cover for me for an hour? I have a dentist appointment.
examples.hi: क्या तुम एक घंटे के लिए मेरा काम संभाल सकते हो? मेरी डेंटिस्ट अपॉइंटमेंट है।

examples.en: Thanks for covering for me while I was on leave.
examples.hi: छुट्टी पर रहते समय मेरा काम संभालने के लिए धन्यवाद।

examples.en: I'll cover for you tomorrow if you need to leave early.
examples.hi: अगर तुम्हें कल जल्दी निकलना है, तो मैं तुम्हारा काम संभाल लूँगा।

examples.en: She asked a colleague to cover for her during the client call.
examples.hi: उसने क्लाइंट कॉल के दौरान एक सहकर्मी से अपना काम संभालने को कहा।

examples.en: Nobody was free to cover for him, so the shift was short-staffed.
examples.hi: उसका काम संभालने के लिए कोई खाली नहीं था, इसलिए शिफ़्ट में स्टाफ़ की कमी रही।

common_mistake.wrong: Please manage my work today, I am not coming.
common_mistake.right: Can you cover for me today? I'm not coming in.
common_mistake.why: 'Manage my work' sounds like you are handing over management; the natural request when someone will be absent is 'cover for me'.

cloze.sentence: I have a doctor's appointment — can you ____ this afternoon?

en_def: to include someone in an email thread, conversation, or decision so they stay informed
hi_def: किसी को ईमेल, बातचीत या निर्णय में शामिल करना ताकि वह जानकारी से अपडेट रहे
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes say 'add me in the loop' or 'keep me in loop' without articles; the natural forms are 'loop me in' (verb) or 'keep me in the loop' (with 'the').

examples.en: Loop me in on the email so I know what's decided.
examples.hi: मुझे ईमेल में शामिल कर दो ताकि पता रहे कि क्या तय हुआ है।

examples.en: Please loop in the security team before you deploy this change.
examples.hi: यह बदलाव लागू करने से पहले कृपया सिक्योरिटी टीम को भी शामिल कर लीजिए।

examples.en: Can you loop me in next time you talk to the client?
examples.hi: अगली बार जब तुम क्लाइंट से बात करो, तो क्या मुझे भी शामिल कर सकते हो?

examples.en: She looped her manager in as soon as the issue got serious.
examples.hi: जैसे ही मामला गंभीर हुआ, उसने अपने मैनेजर को शामिल कर लिया।

examples.en: I wasn't looped in, so I found out about the change late.
examples.hi: मुझे शामिल नहीं किया गया था, इसलिए मुझे बदलाव के बारे में देर से पता चला।

common_mistake.wrong: Please add me in the loop for this thread.
common_mistake.right: Please loop me in on this thread.
common_mistake.why: Hindi speakers translate 'loop mein daalo' as 'add in the loop'; English uses 'loop someone in' as a single verb phrase.

cloze.sentence: Whatever the client decides, please ____ by email.

en_def: a piece of advance warning or information that helps someone prepare
hi_def: पहले से दी गई सूचना या चेतावनी, ताकि व्यक्ति तैयार रह सके
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'give me information before' instead of the compact noun 'give me a heads-up'; the phrase already contains the idea of 'in advance', so 'heads-up before' can sound repetitive.

examples.en: Just a heads-up: the server will be down for maintenance tonight.
examples.hi: बस एक सूचना: आज रात सर्वर मेंटेनेंस के लिए बंद रहेगा।

examples.en: Thanks for the heads-up about the client visiting tomorrow.
examples.hi: कल क्लाइंट के आने की पहले से सूचना देने के लिए धन्यवाद।

examples.en: Can you give me a heads-up if the meeting time changes?
examples.hi: अगर मीटिंग का समय बदलता है, तो क्या तुम मुझे पहले बता सकते हो?

examples.en: I wanted to give you a heads-up before the audit starts.
examples.hi: ऑडिट शुरू होने से पहले मैं तुम्हें एक चेतावनी देना चाहता था।

examples.en: He gave the team a heads-up about the upcoming deployment.
examples.hi: उसने टीम को आने वाले डिप्लॉयमेंट के बारे में पहले से बता दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: Please give me information in advance about this.
common_mistake.right: Please give me a heads-up about this.
common_mistake.why: Indian English tends to use formal, wordy phrasing; native speakers prefer the short, informal noun 'a heads-up' in everyday work talk.

cloze.sentence: Just a quick ____ — the release is delayed by a day.

en_def: to visit somewhere briefly and informally, usually without a long stay
hi_def: थोड़ी देर के लिए और अनौपचारिक ढंग से किसी जगह जाना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'I will come for two minutes', which sounds odd; English speakers say 'I'll pop by' to mean the same short, casual visit.

examples.en: I'll pop by your desk once I finish this call.
examples.hi: यह कॉल ख़त्म होते ही मैं तुम्हारी डेस्क पर आ जाऊँगा।

examples.en: She popped by the office just to drop off some documents.
examples.hi: वह सिर्फ़ कुछ दस्तावेज़ देने के लिए ऑफ़िस आई थी।

examples.en: Can I pop by around four to discuss the report?
examples.hi: क्या मैं रिपोर्ट पर चर्चा करने के लिए चार बजे के आसपास आ सकता हूँ?

examples.en: He popped by for five minutes and then left for another meeting.
examples.hi: वह पाँच मिनट के लिए आया और फिर दूसरी मीटिंग के लिए चला गया।

examples.en: Feel free to pop by if you have any questions about the project.
examples.hi: अगर प्रोजेक्ट को लेकर कोई सवाल हो, तो बेझिझक आ जाना।

common_mistake.wrong: I will come for two minutes to your desk.
common_mistake.right: I'll pop by your desk for a minute.
common_mistake.why: A word-for-word translation of 'do minute aane ke liye aaunga' sounds unnatural; the idiomatic phrase for a brief, casual visit is 'pop by'.

cloze.sentence: I'll ____ your desk after the stand-up to grab that file.

en_def: to contact someone, usually informally, when you need something or have news
hi_def: ज़रूरत पड़ने पर या कोई ख़बर होने पर किसी से अनौपचारिक ढंग से संपर्क करना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers might say 'shout at me' literally, which sounds like scolding; the idiom actually means a casual, friendly request to contact, not raising your voice.

examples.en: Give me a shout when you're ready to review the design.
examples.hi: जब तुम डिज़ाइन रिव्यू के लिए तैयार हो जाओ, तो मुझे बता देना।

examples.en: If anything comes up over the weekend, just give me a shout.
examples.hi: अगर वीकेंड पर कुछ भी हो, तो बस मुझे बता देना।

examples.en: He gave me a shout as soon as the deployment failed.
examples.hi: जैसे ही डिप्लॉयमेंट फ़ेल हुआ, उसने मुझे तुरंत बता दिया।

examples.en: Give us a shout if you need any help settling into the new role.
examples.hi: अगर नई भूमिका में सेट होने में मदद चाहिए, तो हमें बता देना।

examples.en: She said she'd give me a shout before making the final decision.
examples.hi: उसने कहा कि अंतिम फ़ैसला लेने से पहले वह मुझे बता देगी।

common_mistake.wrong: Please shout at me when you need this file.
common_mistake.right: Please give me a shout when you need this file.
common_mistake.why: 'Shout at me' in English means to scold someone loudly; the friendly idiom for 'contact me' is 'give me a shout'.

cloze.sentence: If the build breaks again tonight, just ____.

en_def: to send someone a quick, short message, usually on chat or email
hi_def: किसी को चैट या ईमेल पर एक छोटा और त्वरित संदेश भेजना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'message me' which is fine, but in tech workplaces 'ping me' is the default word for a quick chat message — using 'call me' instead can suggest a phone call, not a chat.

examples.en: Ping me once the pull request is ready for review.
examples.hi: जब पुल रिक्वेस्ट रिव्यू के लिए तैयार हो जाए, तो मुझे चैट पर बता देना।

examples.en: I'll ping you on Slack if I have any doubts.
examples.hi: अगर मुझे कोई शक़ हो, तो मैं तुम्हें स्लैक पर पिंग करूँगा।

examples.en: She pinged me at midnight about the production issue.
examples.hi: उसने आधी रात को प्रोडक्शन की समस्या के बारे में मुझे चैट पर संदेश भेजा।

examples.en: Just ping me if you can't find the document.
examples.hi: अगर तुम्हें दस्तावेज़ नहीं मिल रहा है, तो बस मुझे चैट पर बता देना।

examples.en: Ping the on-call engineer if the alert doesn't clear.
examples.hi: अगर अलर्ट साफ़ नहीं होता है, तो ऑन-कॉल इंजीनियर को चैट पर बताएँ।

common_mistake.wrong: Please call me on chat when you are free.
common_mistake.right: Please ping me on chat when you are free.
common_mistake.why: 'Call me on chat' mixes phone and chat vocabulary; the correct word for a quick chat message is 'ping me'.

cloze.sentence: ____ me on Slack as soon as the deployment finishes.

en_def: to continue giving someone updates about a situation as it develops
hi_def: किसी स्थिति के बारे में समय-समय पर अपडेट देते रहना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'keep me update' or 'keep updating me', dropping the past participle; the correct fixed phrase is 'keep me posted' or 'keep me updated', both with the -ed form.

examples.en: Keep me posted on how the client meeting goes.
examples.hi: क्लाइंट मीटिंग कैसी रही, यह मुझे बताते रहना।

examples.en: Please keep me posted if the outage gets worse.
examples.hi: अगर आउटेज और बिगड़ता है, तो कृपया मुझे अपडेट देते रहना।

examples.en: I'll keep you posted on the hiring decision by Friday.
examples.hi: मैं तुम्हें शुक्रवार तक भर्ती के फ़ैसले के बारे में बताता रहूँगा।

examples.en: She kept us posted throughout the whole incident.
examples.hi: उसने पूरी घटना के दौरान हमें अपडेट देती रही।

examples.en: Keep me posted, even if there's no news yet.
examples.hi: मुझे बताते रहना, भले ही अभी कोई ख़बर न हो।

common_mistake.wrong: Please keep me update about the ticket status.
common_mistake.right: Please keep me posted about the ticket status.
common_mistake.why: Hindi speakers drop the '-ed'; the fixed English phrase needs 'posted' or 'updated', not the bare verb 'update'.

cloze.sentence: It's a live incident, so please ____ every hour.

en_def: to give someone the information they missed or don't yet know
hi_def: किसी को वह जानकारी देना जो उसने छोड़ दी है या अभी तक नहीं जानता
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes say 'tell me the gap' or 'update me the missing part'; the natural phrase is 'fill me in', meaning give the missing details in a conversation.

examples.en: I missed the first ten minutes — can you fill me in?
examples.hi: मुझे शुरुआती दस मिनट छूट गए — क्या तुम मुझे बता सकते हो?

examples.en: She filled me in on everything that happened while I was away.
examples.hi: मेरी अनुपस्थिति में जो कुछ हुआ, उसने मुझे सब बता दिया।

examples.en: Fill me in on the decision before the client call.
examples.hi: क्लाइंट कॉल से पहले मुझे फ़ैसले के बारे में बता दो।

examples.en: Can someone fill me in on why the release was delayed?
examples.hi: क्या कोई मुझे बता सकता है कि रिलीज़ में देरी क्यों हुई?

examples.en: He filled the new joiner in on the team's workflow.
examples.hi: उसने नए जॉइनर को टीम के वर्कफ़्लो के बारे में समझा दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: Please tell me the gap of yesterday's meeting.
common_mistake.right: Please fill me in on yesterday's meeting.
common_mistake.why: 'Tell me the gap' is a literal translation of an Indian-English expression; the natural phrase for catching someone up is 'fill someone in'.

cloze.sentence: I was on leave yesterday — can you ____ on what I missed?

en_def: to start a process or activity, especially one that involves several steps or people
hi_def: किसी काम या प्रक्रिया की शुरुआत करना, ख़ासकर जिसमें कई चरण या लोग शामिल हों
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'start the work' plainly, which is correct but flat; 'get the ball rolling' is the natural idiom for kicking off a multi-step project with energy.

examples.en: Let's get the ball rolling on the migration project this week.
examples.hi: इस हफ़्ते माइग्रेशन प्रोजेक्ट की शुरुआत करते हैं।

examples.en: Once the budget is approved, we can get the ball rolling.
examples.hi: एक बार बजट मंज़ूर हो जाए, तो हम काम शुरू कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: She sent the first email to get the ball rolling on the hiring process.
examples.hi: उसने भर्ती प्रक्रिया शुरू करने के लिए पहला ईमेल भेजा।

examples.en: To get the ball rolling, someone needs to schedule a kickoff call.
examples.hi: काम शुरू करने के लिए, किसी को एक किकऑफ़ कॉल शेड्यूल करनी होगी।

examples.en: We got the ball rolling early so we wouldn't miss the deadline.
examples.hi: हमने डेडलाइन न चूकें, इसलिए काम जल्दी शुरू कर दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: Let's start the ball for this project.
common_mistake.right: Let's get the ball rolling on this project.
common_mistake.why: Hindi speakers sometimes shorten the idiom incorrectly; the fixed expression is 'get the ball rolling', not 'start the ball'.

cloze.sentence: Someone needs to send the first email to ____ on this project.

en_def: responsible for managing or looking after a task, team, or area
hi_def: किसी काम, टीम या क्षेत्र की ज़िम्मेदारी संभालना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes say 'I am looking this work' or 'I am handling in charge', mixing structures; the correct fixed pattern is 'I am in charge of' + noun, without 'handling'.

examples.en: She's in charge of the security team's on-call rotation.
examples.hi: वह सिक्योरिटी टीम की ऑन-कॉल रोटेशन की ज़िम्मेदार है।

examples.en: Who is in charge of approving these access requests?
examples.hi: इन एक्सेस रिक्वेस्ट्स को मंज़ूर करने की ज़िम्मेदारी किसकी है?

examples.en: I was put in charge of the client onboarding process.
examples.hi: मुझे क्लाइंट ऑनबोर्डिंग प्रक्रिया की ज़िम्मेदारी दी गई।

examples.en: He's in charge of the whole audit this quarter.
examples.hi: इस तिमाही में पूरे ऑडिट की ज़िम्मेदारी उसकी है।

examples.en: Nobody was clearly in charge of the incident, so response was slow.
examples.hi: इस घटना की ज़िम्मेदारी किसी की स्पष्ट रूप से नहीं थी, इसलिए प्रतिक्रिया धीमी रही।

common_mistake.wrong: I am handling in charge of this project.
common_mistake.right: I am in charge of this project.
common_mistake.why: Hindi speakers combine 'handling' and 'in charge'; only one is needed — 'in charge of' already means responsible, so 'handling in charge' is redundant.

cloze.sentence: Who is ____ approving new laptop requests?

en_def: to take on more responsibility or make more effort, especially when it's needed
hi_def: ज़रूरत पड़ने पर ज़्यादा ज़िम्मेदारी लेना या ज़्यादा मेहनत करना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'increase my effort' or 'do more hard work', which is understandable but flat; native speakers say 'step up' to mean rising to a challenge.

examples.en: When the manager left, she stepped up and led the project.
examples.hi: जब मैनेजर चला गया, तो उसने आगे आकर प्रोजेक्ट का नेतृत्व किया।

examples.en: The team really stepped up during the outage last night.
examples.hi: पिछली रात आउटेज के दौरान टीम ने वाक़ई अच्छा प्रदर्शन किया।

examples.en: We need someone to step up and own this decision.
examples.hi: हमें किसी की ज़रूरत है जो आगे आकर यह फ़ैसला अपनाए।

examples.en: He stepped up his effort after the feedback session.
examples.hi: फ़ीडबैक सेशन के बाद उसने अपनी मेहनत बढ़ा दी।

examples.en: It's time for junior engineers to step up and take on bigger tasks.
examples.hi: जूनियर इंजीनियरों के लिए अब आगे आकर बड़े काम संभालने का समय है।

common_mistake.wrong: I will increase my hard work in this project.
common_mistake.right: I'll step up on this project.
common_mistake.why: A direct translation from Hindi sounds heavy; English uses the phrasal verb 'step up' to mean taking on more responsibility.

cloze.sentence: When the lead was on leave, the junior engineer had to ____.

en_def: to help with a task, usually by contributing time, effort, or money along with others
hi_def: दूसरों के साथ मिलकर किसी काम में समय, मेहनत या पैसे से योगदान देना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'give help' plainly; 'pitch in' specifically suggests joining in as a team, often unasked, which sounds more natural in office contexts.

examples.en: Everyone pitched in to get the release out before the deadline.
examples.hi: डेडलाइन से पहले रिलीज़ निकालने के लिए सबने मिलकर योगदान दिया।

examples.en: Can you pitch in with the testing this afternoon?
examples.hi: क्या तुम आज दोपहर टेस्टिंग में हाथ बँटा सकते हो?

examples.en: The whole team pitched in to fix the production bug overnight.
examples.hi: पूरी टीम ने रातोंरात प्रोडक्शन बग ठीक करने में योगदान दिया।

examples.en: We all pitched in for her farewell gift.
examples.hi: उसके विदाई उपहार के लिए हम सबने मिलकर पैसे जमा किए।

examples.en: If everyone pitches in, we can finish this by Friday.
examples.hi: अगर सब मिलकर योगदान दें, तो हम इसे शुक्रवार तक पूरा कर सकते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Everyone gave help for the release.
common_mistake.right: Everyone pitched in for the release.
common_mistake.why: 'Gave help' is grammatically fine but sounds formal and unnatural; 'pitch in' is the everyday phrase for team members jointly contributing.

cloze.sentence: If everyone ____, we'll finish testing before lunch.

en_def: to quickly join a phone or video call, often at short notice
hi_def: थोड़ी सूचना पर जल्दी से फ़ोन या वीडियो कॉल में शामिल होना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers might say 'do a call' or 'take a call', which is fine generally, but 'hop on a call' specifically means joining quickly and informally, common in remote work.

examples.en: Can we hop on a call in five minutes to sort this out?
examples.hi: क्या हम इसे सुलझाने के लिए पाँच मिनट में कॉल पर आ सकते हैं?

examples.en: Let's hop on a quick call instead of writing long emails.
examples.hi: लंबे ईमेल लिखने के बजाय चलिए एक छोटी कॉल पर आ जाते हैं।

examples.en: He hopped on a call with the client to clarify the requirement.
examples.hi: उसने ज़रूरत साफ़ करने के लिए क्लाइंट के साथ कॉल पर बात की।

examples.en: I'll hop on a call with you after the stand-up.
examples.hi: स्टैंड-अप के बाद मैं तुम्हारे साथ कॉल पर आ जाऊँगा।

examples.en: Could you hop on a call now? The issue is urgent.
