common_mistake.why: The literal sentence is correct but plain; the natural, conversational idiom for this feeling is 'time flies'.

cloze.sentence: ____ when you're busy — it's already 7 pm!

en_def: for now, for the present, though the situation may change later
hi_def: अभी के लिए, फ़िलहाल, हालाँकि स्थिति बाद में बदल सकती है
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'for now only'; 'for the time being' is a more formal-sounding but still common phrase meaning a temporary current arrangement.

examples.en: Let's use this workaround for the time being.
examples.hi: फ़िलहाल इस अस्थायी उपाय का इस्तेमाल करते हैं।

examples.en: For the time being, the office will remain hybrid.
examples.hi: फ़िलहाल, ऑफ़िस हाइब्रिड मोड में ही रहेगा।

examples.en: She's staying with her parents for the time being.
examples.hi: वह फ़िलहाल अपने माता-पिता के साथ रह रही है।

examples.en: For the time being, please route all issues through me.
examples.hi: फ़िलहाल, कृपया सभी मुद्दे मेरे ज़रिए भेजें।

examples.en: The old system will stay active for the time being.
examples.hi: पुराना सिस्टम फ़िलहाल सक्रिय रहेगा।

common_mistake.wrong: For now only we will use old system.
common_mistake.right: For the time being, we'll use the old system.
common_mistake.why: 'For now only' is a regional Indian-English phrasing; the standard, slightly more formal equivalent is 'for the time being'.

cloze.sentence: ____, please report all bugs directly to me.

en_def: annoyed and tired of a situation that has been going on too long
hi_def: किसी ऐसी स्थिति से नाराज़ और थका हुआ जो बहुत लंबे समय से चल रही हो
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'I am bored of this' for frustration, but 'bored' means lack of interest; 'fed up' specifically means annoyed and tired of a repeated problem.

examples.en: I'm fed up with these constant power cuts.
examples.hi: मैं इन लगातार बिजली कटौतियों से तंग आ गया हूँ।

examples.en: She's fed up with fixing the same bug over and over.
examples.hi: वह बार-बार एक ही बग को ठीक करते-करते तंग आ गई है।

examples.en: He got fed up and finally complained to the manager.
examples.hi: वह तंग आ गया और आख़िरकार उसने मैनेजर से शिकायत कर दी।

examples.en: I'm fed up of waiting for a reply from the vendor.
examples.hi: मैं वेंडर से जवाब का इंतज़ार करते-करते तंग आ गया हूँ।

examples.en: We're all fed up with the noisy construction outside.
examples.hi: हम सब बाहर के शोर भरे निर्माण कार्य से तंग आ चुके हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I am bored of these constant power cuts.
common_mistake.right: I am fed up with these constant power cuts.
common_mistake.why: 'Bored' means a lack of interest, not frustration; the correct word for being annoyed and tired of a repeated problem is 'fed up'.

cloze.sentence: I'm completely ____ with this slow internet connection.

en_def: feeling less worried or stressed because a problem has been solved or a fear has not come true
hi_def: कम चिंतित या तनावग्रस्त महसूस करना क्योंकि कोई समस्या हल हो गई है या कोई डर सच नहीं हुआ
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes say 'I am happy' for this feeling; 'relieved' is more precise, describing the release of worry, not general happiness.

examples.en: I was so relieved when the server came back online.
examples.hi: जब सर्वर फिर से चालू हुआ, तो मुझे बहुत राहत मिली।

examples.en: She felt relieved after passing the certification exam.
examples.hi: प्रमाणन परीक्षा पास करने के बाद उसे राहत महसूस हुई।

examples.en: We were relieved to hear the flight wasn't cancelled.
examples.hi: यह सुनकर हमें राहत मिली कि फ़्लाइट रद्द नहीं हुई।

examples.en: He looked relieved once the audit was finally over.
examples.hi: ऑडिट आख़िरकार ख़त्म होने के बाद वह राहत महसूस कर रहा था।

examples.en: I'll be relieved once this deployment goes smoothly.
examples.hi: मुझे राहत मिलेगी जब यह डिप्लॉयमेंट बिना किसी दिक़्क़त के हो जाएगा।

common_mistake.wrong: I am happy that the server is working again.
common_mistake.right: I'm relieved that the server is working again.
common_mistake.why: 'Happy' suggests general joy; the more accurate word for the release of worry after a problem is fixed is 'relieved'.

cloze.sentence: She felt completely ____ once she found her lost passport.

en_def: extremely disappointed or upset about something
hi_def: किसी बात को लेकर बेहद निराश या दुखी
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers usually say 'very sad' for disappointment; 'gutted' is a stronger, more informal British word specifically for deep disappointment, often about missed chances.

examples.en: I was gutted when I missed the promotion by one review cycle.
examples.hi: जब मैं एक रिव्यू साइकल से प्रमोशन चूक गया, तो मुझे बहुत बुरा लगा।

examples.en: She was gutted that her flight got cancelled at the last minute.
examples.hi: उसे बहुत बुरा लगा कि उसकी फ़्लाइट आख़िरी क्षण में रद्द हो गई।

examples.en: He's absolutely gutted about losing the client.
examples.hi: क्लाइंट खोने पर वह बिल्कुल टूट गया।

examples.en: We were gutted when the trip got postponed.
examples.hi: जब यात्रा टाल दी गई, तो हमें बहुत निराशा हुई।

examples.en: I'd be gutted if this project got cancelled now.
examples.hi: अगर यह प्रोजेक्ट अभी रद्द हो जाए, तो मुझे बहुत बुरा लगेगा।

common_mistake.wrong: I am very very sad for missing the promotion.
common_mistake.right: I'm gutted about missing the promotion.
common_mistake.why: Repeating 'very' is a common way Hindi speakers add intensity; English has a single strong informal word for deep disappointment, 'gutted'.

cloze.sentence: He was absolutely ____ when the deal fell through.

en_def: extremely happy and pleased about something
hi_def: किसी बात को लेकर बेहद ख़ुश और प्रसन्न
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers usually just add 'very' before 'happy' to show intensity; English has a single strong word, 'overjoyed', for extreme happiness, without needing extra intensifiers.

examples.en: She was overjoyed when she got the job offer.
examples.hi: जब उसे नौकरी का प्रस्ताव मिला, तो वह बेहद ख़ुश हो गई।

examples.en: We were overjoyed to hear the news of her engagement.
examples.hi: उसकी सगाई की ख़बर सुनकर हम बेहद ख़ुश हुए।

examples.en: He was overjoyed when his visa finally got approved.
examples.hi: जब आख़िरकार उसका वीज़ा मंज़ूर हो गया, तो वह बहुत ख़ुश हुआ।

examples.en: The whole team was overjoyed after winning the client's trust.
examples.hi: क्लाइंट का भरोसा जीतने के बाद पूरी टीम बेहद ख़ुश थी।

examples.en: I was overjoyed to see my old friend after so many years.
examples.hi: इतने सालों बाद अपने पुराने दोस्त को देखकर मैं बेहद ख़ुश हुआ।

common_mistake.wrong: I am very very happy for this good news.
common_mistake.right: I'm overjoyed at this good news.
common_mistake.why: Doubling 'very' to intensify happiness is common in Hindi-influenced English; a single strong adjective, 'overjoyed', already conveys extreme happiness.

cloze.sentence: She was ____ when she heard she'd been selected.

en_def: feeling slightly angry or irritated about something
hi_def: किसी बात को लेकर थोड़ा नाराज़ या चिड़चिड़ा महसूस करना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'I am angry' even for small irritations; 'annoyed' is a milder word for mild irritation, while 'angry' or 'furious' suggest something much stronger.

examples.en: I was a bit annoyed that the meeting started late again.
examples.hi: मुझे थोड़ा नाराज़ लगा कि मीटिंग फिर से देर से शुरू हुई।

examples.en: She got annoyed when her code review comments were ignored.
examples.hi: जब उसकी कोड रिव्यू टिप्पणियों को नज़रअंदाज़ किया गया, तो वह चिढ़ गई।

examples.en: He looked annoyed after the third interruption.
examples.hi: तीसरी बार बीच में टोकने के बाद वह चिढ़ा हुआ लग रहा था।

examples.en: I get annoyed when people don't reply to urgent messages.
examples.hi: जब लोग ज़रूरी संदेशों का जवाब नहीं देते, तो मुझे चिढ़ होती है।

examples.en: She was clearly annoyed but didn't say anything.
examples.hi: वह साफ़ तौर पर चिढ़ी हुई थी, लेकिन उसने कुछ कहा नहीं।

common_mistake.wrong: I am very angry that meeting started late.
common_mistake.right: I'm a bit annoyed that the meeting started late.
common_mistake.why: Using 'angry' for a small irritation overstates the feeling; the milder, more accurate word here is 'annoyed'.

cloze.sentence: He looked ____ when the call got disconnected a third time.

en_def: feeling impatient and a little angry, often because of something repeated or minor
hi_def: अधीर और थोड़ा नाराज़ महसूस करना, अक्सर किसी दोहराई गई या छोटी बात की वजह से
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers may use 'irritated' correctly, but sometimes overapply 'irritating' to people rather than actions; usually it's the behaviour or situation that is 'irritating', while the person becomes 'irritated'.

examples.en: I get irritated by notifications popping up constantly.
examples.hi: लगातार आने वाली सूचनाओं से मुझे चिढ़ होती है।

examples.en: She sounded irritated on the call this morning.
examples.hi: आज सुबह की कॉल पर वह चिढ़ी हुई लग रही थी।

examples.en: He was irritated by the repeated questions during the review.
examples.hi: समीक्षा के दौरान बार-बार पूछे गए सवालों से वह चिढ़ गया।

examples.en: The constant background noise left her irritated.
examples.hi: लगातार पृष्ठभूमि के शोर से वह चिढ़ गई थी।

examples.en: I was irritated that no one had updated the ticket.
examples.hi: मुझे इस बात से चिढ़ हुई कि किसी ने टिकट अपडेट नहीं किया था।

common_mistake.wrong: This person is very irritating me since morning.
common_mistake.right: This person's behaviour has been irritating me since morning.
common_mistake.why: 'Person is irritating me' can sound like a personal attack; usually it's someone's behaviour or a situation that 'irritates', so it's clearer to name the action.

cloze.sentence: The constant pop-up notifications left her quite ____.

en_def: feeling sad because you are away from home and missing your family or familiar surroundings
hi_def: घर से दूर होने की वजह से उदास महसूस करना और परिवार या परिचित माहौल की याद आना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes say 'I am missing home' correctly, but the single adjective 'homesick' captures this exact feeling more naturally and is used widely by people living or working away from home.

examples.en: I felt really homesick during my first month abroad.
examples.hi: विदेश में अपने पहले महीने के दौरान मुझे घर की बहुत याद आई।

examples.en: She gets homesick every time she moves to a new city for work.
examples.hi: जब भी वह काम के लिए नए शहर जाती है, उसे घर की याद सताती है।

examples.en: He was homesick, missing his mother's cooking the most.
examples.hi: उसे घर की याद आ रही थी, और सबसे ज़्यादा माँ के खाने की।

examples.en: Video calls with family help when I feel homesick.
examples.hi: जब मुझे घर की याद आती है, तो परिवार के साथ वीडियो कॉल मदद करती है।

examples.en: Being homesick is common during the first few weeks in a new city.
examples.hi: नए शहर में शुरुआती कुछ हफ़्तों के दौरान घर की याद आना आम बात है।

common_mistake.wrong: I am missing my home very much these days.
common_mistake.right: I've been feeling quite homesick these days.
common_mistake.why: The literal sentence is correct, but the natural single-word adjective English speakers use for this exact feeling is 'homesick'.

cloze.sentence: During his first week abroad, he felt really ____.

en_def: unable to stay calm or still because you are anxious, bored, or impatient
hi_def: चिंता, बोरियत या अधीरता की वजह से शांत या स्थिर न रह पाना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes say 'my mind is not stable', which sounds unusual; the natural adjective for this fidgety, uneasy feeling is 'restless'.

examples.en: I felt restless while waiting for the exam results.
examples.hi: परीक्षा के नतीजों का इंतज़ार करते हुए मैं बेचैन महसूस कर रहा था।

examples.en: She got restless sitting through the long meeting.
examples.hi: लंबी मीटिंग में बैठे-बैठे वह बेचैन हो गई।

examples.en: The kids were restless on the long train journey.
examples.hi: लंबी ट्रेन यात्रा के दौरान बच्चे बेचैन थे।

examples.en: He's been restless ever since he heard about the layoffs.
examples.hi: छँटनी के बारे में सुनने के बाद से वह बेचैन है।

examples.en: I couldn't sleep; I was too restless after the incident.
examples.hi: मुझे नींद नहीं आई; उस घटना के बाद मैं बहुत बेचैन था।

common_mistake.wrong: My mind was not stable during the whole wait.
common_mistake.right: I felt restless during the whole wait.
common_mistake.why: 'My mind was not stable' can sound like a serious mental health concern; the everyday word for this uneasy, fidgety feeling is 'restless'.

cloze.sentence: Waiting for the results all week made her quite ____.

en_def: satisfied and at peace with your situation, without wanting much more
hi_def: अपनी स्थिति से संतुष्ट और शांत, बिना बहुत कुछ और चाहे
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'I am satisfied' which is fine, but note the stress: as an adjective it's 'conTENT' (feeling satisfied), while 'CONtent' (with stress on the first syllable) means the material inside something.

examples.en: He seems content with his current role, not looking for a change.
examples.hi: वह अपनी मौजूदा भूमिका से संतुष्ट लगता है, बदलाव की तलाश में नहीं है।

examples.en: I'm quite content living a simple life in this small town.
examples.hi: मैं इस छोटे-से शहर में एक सादा जीवन जीने से काफ़ी संतुष्ट हूँ।

examples.en: She felt content after finally finishing the long project.
examples.hi: लंबे प्रोजेक्ट को आख़िरकार पूरा करने के बाद उसे संतोष महसूस हुआ।

examples.en: We were content just relaxing at home over the weekend.
examples.hi: हम वीकेंड पर बस घर पर आराम करने से ही संतुष्ट थे।

examples.en: He's content with a modest salary as long as the work is meaningful.
examples.hi: अगर काम सार्थक हो, तो वह मामूली तनख़्वाह से भी संतुष्ट है।

common_mistake.wrong: I am satisfied to live small simple life, no complaints.
common_mistake.right: I'm quite content living a simple life; I have no complaints.
common_mistake.why: The literal translation is understandable but wordy; the natural single adjective for this calm satisfaction is 'content'.

cloze.sentence: She seems perfectly ____ with her small apartment and quiet routine.

en_def: easily annoyed and bad-tempered, often showing it through complaints or a sour mood
hi_def: आसानी से नाराज़ हो जाने वाला और चिड़चिड़े स्वभाव का, जो अक्सर शिकायतों या खट्टे मूड से दिखता है
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'he is in bad mood' generally; 'grumpy' describes a milder, often humorous kind of bad temper, especially common when someone is tired or hasn't had coffee.

examples.en: He's always grumpy before his morning coffee.
examples.hi: सुबह की कॉफ़ी से पहले वह हमेशा चिड़चिड़ा रहता है।

examples.en: She got grumpy after staying up late fixing the bug.
examples.hi: बग ठीक करने में देर तक जागने के बाद वह चिड़चिड़ी हो गई।

examples.en: Don't mind him, he's just grumpy today.
examples.hi: उसे नज़रअंदाज़ करो, वह आज बस चिड़चिड़ा है।

examples.en: The kids get grumpy when they're tired.
examples.hi: जब बच्चे थके होते हैं, तो चिड़चिड़े हो जाते हैं।

examples.en: My manager is a bit grumpy on Monday mornings.
examples.hi: मेरा मैनेजर सोमवार की सुबह थोड़ा चिड़चिड़ा रहता है।

common_mistake.wrong: He is in bad mood always in the morning.
common_mistake.right: He's always a bit grumpy in the morning.
common_mistake.why: 'In bad mood' is a common Indian-English phrasing; the natural, everyday adjective for this mild, often tired bad temper is 'grumpy'.

cloze.sentence: He's always a little ____ before his first cup of tea.

en_def: having emotions that change often and unpredictably, sometimes cheerful and sometimes irritable
hi_def: ऐसा स्वभाव जिसमें भावनाएँ अक्सर और अप्रत्याशित रूप से बदलती हों, कभी ख़ुश तो कभी चिड़चिड़ा
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes describe this as 'his mood keeps changing', which is fine, but the single adjective 'moody' captures the same unpredictable emotional pattern more concisely.

examples.en: He can be quite moody, so approach him carefully today.
examples.hi: वह काफ़ी मूडी हो सकता है, इसलिए आज उससे सावधानी से बात करना।

examples.en: She's been moody all week because of the stressful deadline.
examples.hi: तनावपूर्ण डेडलाइन की वजह से वह पूरे हफ़्ते मूडी रही है।

examples.en: Teenagers are often moody, which is completely normal.
examples.hi: किशोर अक्सर मूडी होते हैं, जो बिल्कुल सामान्य है।

examples.en: My manager gets moody when projects are running behind schedule.
examples.hi: जब प्रोजेक्ट शेड्यूल से पीछे चल रहे होते हैं, तो मेरा मैनेजर मूडी हो जाता है।

examples.en: I try not to take it personally when he's moody.
examples.hi: जब वह मूडी होता है, तो मैं इसे व्यक्तिगत रूप से न लेने की कोशिश करता हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: His mood is always changing, sometimes happy sometimes angry.
common_mistake.right: He's quite moody — sometimes happy, sometimes irritable.
common_mistake.why: The literal description works but is longer; the single adjective for this unpredictable emotional pattern is 'moody'.

cloze.sentence: She's been a bit ____ lately because of the tight deadline.

en_def: feeling extreme mental or emotional pressure, often to the point of being unable to relax
hi_def: अत्यधिक मानसिक या भावनात्मक दबाव महसूस करना, अक्सर इतना कि आराम भी न कर पाएँ
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'I have tension' for stress; in English, 'tension' is unusual for personal stress — the natural phrase is 'I'm stressed out' or simply 'stressed'.

examples.en: I'm completely stressed out about the audit next week.
examples.hi: मैं अगले हफ़्ते के ऑडिट को लेकर पूरी तरह से तनाव में हूँ।

examples.en: She's stressed out from managing three projects at once.
examples.hi: एक साथ तीन प्रोजेक्ट संभालने से वह तनाव में है।

examples.en: Try not to get too stressed out about the deadline.
examples.hi: डेडलाइन को लेकर बहुत ज़्यादा तनाव में न आने की कोशिश करो।

examples.en: He looked stressed out after the long client call.
examples.hi: लंबी क्लाइंट कॉल के बाद वह तनाव में दिख रहा था।

examples.en: We were all stressed out during the production outage.
examples.hi: प्रोडक्शन आउटेज के दौरान हम सब तनाव में थे।

common_mistake.wrong: I have so much tension about the audit next week.
common_mistake.right: I'm so stressed out about the audit next week.
common_mistake.why: 'Tension' for personal stress is a direct translation from Hindi; native English uses 'stressed' or 'stressed out' to describe this feeling.

cloze.sentence: She's completely ____ trying to juggle three deadlines at once.

en_def: extremely tired and lacking energy or motivation because of prolonged stress or overwork
hi_def: लंबे समय के तनाव या अत्यधिक काम की वजह से बेहद थका हुआ और ऊर्जा या प्रेरणा की कमी महसूस करना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often just say 'very tired', but 'burnt out' specifically means exhaustion from long-term overwork, often with a loss of motivation, not just physical tiredness after one busy day.

examples.en: I feel completely burnt out after this project.
examples.hi: इस प्रोजेक्ट के बाद मैं पूरी तरह से थका और निराश महसूस कर रहा हूँ।

examples.en: She's burnt out from working every weekend for months.
examples.hi: महीनों से हर वीकेंड काम करने की वजह से वह पूरी तरह थक चुकी है।

examples.en: A lot of engineers get burnt out during crunch periods.
examples.hi: व्यस्ततम दौर में कई इंजीनियर पूरी तरह थक जाते हैं।

examples.en: He took a break because he was clearly burnt out.
examples.hi: उसने ब्रेक लिया क्योंकि वह साफ़ तौर पर पूरी तरह थका हुआ था।

examples.en: Don't push yourself so hard that you get burnt out.
examples.hi: अपने आप को इतना मत खींचो कि तुम पूरी तरह थक जाओ।

common_mistake.wrong: I am very tired since many months of work.
common_mistake.right: I feel completely burnt out after months of overwork.
common_mistake.why: 'Very tired' understates prolonged exhaustion from overwork; the precise term for this deeper, motivation-draining tiredness is 'burnt out'.

cloze.sentence: After three months of crunch, most of the team felt ____.

en_def: nervous, tense, and easily startled or upset, often because of an uncertain situation
hi_def: घबराया हुआ, तनावग्रस्त, और आसानी से चौंक जाने या परेशान होने वाला, अक्सर किसी अनिश्चित स्थिति की वजह से
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'I am tense', which works, but 'on edge' specifically suggests a jumpy, alert nervousness, often while waiting for news or results.

examples.en: The whole team was on edge waiting for the audit results.
examples.hi: ऑडिट के नतीजों का इंतज़ार करते हुए पूरी टीम तनावग्रस्त थी।

examples.en: She's been on edge ever since the layoffs were announced.
examples.hi: छँटनी की घोषणा होने के बाद से वह घबराई हुई है।

examples.en: I was on edge during the whole production incident.
examples.hi: पूरे प्रोडक्शन घटनाक्रम के दौरान मैं तनाव में था।

examples.en: He gets on edge whenever his phone rings late at night.
examples.hi: जब भी उसका फ़ोन रात में देर से बजता है, वह घबरा जाता है।

examples.en: Everyone was on edge before the client's final decision.
examples.hi: क्लाइंट के अंतिम फ़ैसले से पहले सब लोग तनाव में थे।

common_mistake.wrong: I am very much tense waiting for the result.
common_mistake.right: I've been on edge waiting for the result.
common_mistake.why: 'Very much tense' is grammatically odd; the natural idiom for this jumpy, anxious waiting is 'on edge'.

cloze.sentence: Everyone was ____ waiting to hear whether the deal had closed.

en_def: having so much to deal with, emotionally or practically, that you feel unable to cope
hi_def: इतना कुछ संभालना पड़ रहा हो, भावनात्मक या व्यावहारिक रूप से, कि सामना करने में असमर्थ महसूस हो
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes say 'too much work is there', describing the workload but not the feeling; 'overwhelmed' captures the emotional sense of being unable to cope, not just being busy.

examples.en: I felt overwhelmed by the number of tickets in my queue.
examples.hi: मेरी क़तार में इतने टिकट देखकर मुझे संभालना मुश्किल लगा।

examples.en: She was overwhelmed with all the wedding planning.
examples.hi: शादी की सारी योजना बनाने से वह बहुत अभिभूत हो गई थी।

examples.en: New joiners often feel overwhelmed in their first week.
examples.hi: नए जॉइनर अक्सर अपने पहले हफ़्ते में अभिभूत महसूस करते हैं।

examples.en: He looked overwhelmed after the client added more requirements.
examples.hi: क्लाइंट के और आवश्यकताएँ जोड़ने के बाद वह अभिभूत लग रहा था।

examples.en: Don't hesitate to ask for help if you're feeling overwhelmed.
examples.hi: अगर तुम अभिभूत महसूस कर रहे हो, तो मदद माँगने में संकोच मत करो।

common_mistake.wrong: Too much work is there, I cannot manage.
common_mistake.right: I'm feeling overwhelmed; I can't keep up with all this work.
common_mistake.why: Describing only the workload misses the emotional strain; 'overwhelmed' names the feeling of being unable to cope, not just the amount of work.

cloze.sentence: New joiners often feel a little ____ during their first week.

en_def: extremely sad, especially because of the end of a relationship or a great personal loss
hi_def: बेहद दुखी, ख़ासकर किसी रिश्ते के टूटने या किसी बड़े व्यक्तिगत नुक़सान की वजह से
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'my heart is broken', a close literal translation that is also understood, but the single adjective 'heartbroken' is the natural everyday form in English.

examples.en: She was heartbroken when the relationship ended.
examples.hi: जब रिश्ता टूट गया, तो वह बेहद दुखी हो गई।

examples.en: He was heartbroken after losing his childhood dog.
examples.hi: अपने बचपन के कुत्ते को खोने के बाद वह बेहद दुखी था।

examples.en: I felt heartbroken reading about the accident.
examples.hi: उस दुर्घटना के बारे में पढ़कर मुझे बहुत दुख हुआ।

examples.en: She's still heartbroken over losing her grandmother last year.
examples.hi: पिछले साल अपनी दादी को खोने का दुख उसे अब भी है।

examples.en: The whole family was heartbroken by the sudden loss.
examples.hi: अचानक हुए इस नुक़सान से पूरा परिवार बेहद दुखी था।

common_mistake.wrong: My heart is fully broken about this news.
common_mistake.right: I'm heartbroken about this news.
common_mistake.why: The literal phrase works but sounds dramatic in casual speech; English commonly uses the single adjective 'heartbroken'.

cloze.sentence: She was completely ____ when she heard the sad news.

en_def: extremely excited and happy about something
hi_def: किसी बात को लेकर बेहद उत्साहित और ख़ुश
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'very excited', which is understood, but 'thrilled' is the natural strong adjective English speakers use for great excitement, especially about good news.

examples.en: I'm thrilled to announce that we finally closed the deal.
examples.hi: मुझे यह बताते हुए बेहद ख़ुशी हो रही है कि हमने आख़िरकार यह सौदा पक्का कर लिया।

examples.en: She was thrilled when she got accepted into the course.
examples.hi: जब उसे कोर्स में स्वीकार कर लिया गया, तो वह बेहद उत्साहित हो गई।

examples.en: We're thrilled with how the new feature turned out.
examples.hi: नया फ़ीचर जिस तरह से बना, उससे हम बेहद ख़ुश हैं।

examples.en: He was thrilled to be promoted to team lead.
examples.hi: टीम लीड बनाए जाने पर वह बेहद उत्साहित हो गया।

examples.en: The kids were thrilled about the upcoming trip.
examples.hi: आने वाली यात्रा को लेकर बच्चे बेहद उत्साहित थे।

common_mistake.wrong: I am very much excited to tell you this news.
common_mistake.right: I'm thrilled to tell you this news.
common_mistake.why: 'Very much excited' is a bit awkward; the natural strong adjective for great excitement in English is 'thrilled'.

cloze.sentence: We're absolutely ____ that the client renewed the contract.

en_def: extremely angry
hi_def: बेहद क्रोधित
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'very very angry', repeating the word for intensity; English has the single strong adjective 'furious' for extreme anger, without needing repetition.

examples.en: He was furious when he found out about the data leak.
examples.hi: जब उसे डेटा लीक के बारे में पता चला, तो वह बेहद क्रोधित हो गया।

examples.en: She got furious after the third missed deadline.
examples.hi: तीसरी बार डेडलाइन चूकने के बाद वह बेहद क्रोधित हो गई।

examples.en: The client was furious about the delayed delivery.
examples.hi: देरी से हुई डिलीवरी को लेकर क्लाइंट बेहद नाराज़ था।

examples.en: I was furious that no one had told me about the change.
examples.hi: मुझे इस बात पर बेहद ग़ुस्सा आया कि किसी ने मुझे बदलाव के बारे में नहीं बताया।

examples.en: He looked furious but managed to stay calm during the call.
examples.hi: वह बेहद क्रोधित लग रहा था, लेकिन कॉल के दौरान शांत बना रहा।

common_mistake.wrong: I am very very angry about this mistake.
common_mistake.right: I'm furious about this mistake.
common_mistake.why: Doubling 'very' is a common Indian-English way to intensify; English simply uses a stronger single adjective, 'furious', for extreme anger.

cloze.sentence: The client was absolutely ____ about the delayed shipment.

en_def: so surprised or shocked that you cannot think or react normally for a moment
hi_def: इतना हैरान या स्तब्ध कि कुछ पल के लिए सोचने या प्रतिक्रिया देने में असमर्थ हो जाना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'I was very shocked', which is close; 'stunned' adds the sense of being briefly frozen or speechless, stronger than a mild surprise.

examples.en: I was stunned when I heard about the sudden resignation.
examples.hi: अचानक हुए इस्तीफ़े के बारे में सुनकर मैं स्तब्ध रह गया।

examples.en: She stood stunned, unable to say a word.
examples.hi: वह स्तब्ध खड़ी रही, एक शब्द भी नहीं बोल पाई।

examples.en: The team was stunned by the size of the security breach.
examples.hi: सुरक्षा उल्लंघन की गंभीरता से टीम स्तब्ध रह गई।

examples.en: He looked stunned when he saw the final bill.
examples.hi: अंतिम बिल देखकर वह स्तब्ध रह गया।

examples.en: We were stunned to learn the project had been cancelled.
examples.hi: यह जानकर हम स्तब्ध रह गए कि प्रोजेक्ट रद्द कर दिया गया था।

common_mistake.wrong: I was very shocked and could not say anything after that.
common_mistake.right: I was stunned and couldn't say anything for a moment.
common_mistake.why: The literal sentence works, but the natural single adjective for being briefly frozen by shock or surprise is 'stunned'.

cloze.sentence: She stood there completely ____, unable to say a word.

en_def: unable to speak for a moment, usually because of strong surprise, shock, or emotion
hi_def: एक पल के लिए बोल न पाना, आमतौर पर तेज़ आश्चर्य, सदमे या भावना की वजह से
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers might say 'I had no words', which is also natural, but the single adjective 'speechless' is the more common everyday equivalent in English.

examples.en: I was speechless when they announced my promotion.
examples.hi: जब उन्होंने मेरी पदोन्नति की घोषणा की, तो मैं कुछ बोल नहीं पाया।

examples.en: She was speechless after reading the surprising email.
examples.hi: आश्चर्यजनक ईमेल पढ़ने के बाद वह कुछ बोल नहीं पाई।

examples.en: The generosity of the gift left him speechless.
examples.hi: उपहार की उदारता ने उसे स्तब्ध कर दिया।

examples.en: We were speechless at how well the presentation went.
examples.hi: प्रेजेंटेशन इतनी अच्छी तरह से हुई कि हम कुछ बोल नहीं पाए।

examples.en: He was completely speechless after hearing the news.
examples.hi: यह ख़बर सुनकर वह पूरी तरह से बोल नहीं पाया।

common_mistake.wrong: I had no words to say after hearing this news.
common_mistake.right: I was speechless after hearing this news.
common_mistake.why: 'I had no words' is understandable, but the more common everyday adjective for this reaction in English is 'speechless'.

cloze.sentence: The surprise party left her completely ____.

en_def: extremely happy and pleased about something
hi_def: किसी बात को लेकर बेहद ख़ुश और प्रसन्न
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers might not use this idiom naturally, sticking with 'very happy'; 'over the moon' is a common British-English idiom that adds a warm, enthusiastic tone.

examples.en: She's over the moon about her new job offer.
examples.hi: अपने नए नौकरी के प्रस्ताव को लेकर वह बेहद ख़ुश है।

examples.en: We were over the moon when the visa finally came through.
examples.hi: जब आख़िरकार वीज़ा मिल गया, तो हम बेहद ख़ुश हुए।

examples.en: He was over the moon after the client praised his work.
examples.hi: क्लाइंट द्वारा उसके काम की तारीफ़ किए जाने के बाद वह बेहद ख़ुश था।

examples.en: They're over the moon about the new house.
examples.hi: नए घर को लेकर वे बेहद ख़ुश हैं।

examples.en: I'd be over the moon if this project gets approved.
examples.hi: अगर यह प्रोजेक्ट मंज़ूर हो जाए, तो मैं बेहद ख़ुश हो जाऊँगा।

common_mistake.wrong: She is very happy about her new job, extremely.
common_mistake.right: She's over the moon about her new job.
common_mistake.why: Adding 'extremely' after 'very happy' is repetitive; the idiomatic phrase 'over the moon' already conveys extreme happiness in one expression.

cloze.sentence: He was ____ when he heard he'd got the scholarship.

en_def: feeling sad and low, without much energy or enthusiasm, usually for a short period
hi_def: उदास और निराश महसूस करना, बहुत ऊर्जा या उत्साह के बिना, आमतौर पर थोड़े समय के लिए
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'I am feeling low' which works fine; 'down in the dumps' is a slightly more colourful, informal idiom for the same temporary sad mood.

examples.en: She's been feeling a bit down in the dumps since the rejection.
examples.hi: अस्वीकृति के बाद से वह थोड़ा उदास महसूस कर रही है।

examples.en: He was down in the dumps after missing the flight.
examples.hi: फ़्लाइट छूटने के बाद वह उदास हो गया था।

examples.en: Don't be down in the dumps, we'll fix this bug together.
examples.hi: उदास मत हो, हम मिलकर इस बग को ठीक कर लेंगे।

examples.en: I was down in the dumps all week because of the bad review.
examples.hi: ख़राब समीक्षा की वजह से मैं पूरे हफ़्ते उदास रहा।

examples.en: She seemed down in the dumps after the difficult meeting.
examples.hi: कठिन मीटिंग के बाद वह उदास लग रही थी।

collocations: a bit down in the dumps

common_mistake.wrong: I am feeling low from many days, no reason.
common_mistake.right: I've been feeling down in the dumps lately, for no clear reason.
common_mistake.why: 'Feeling low' is correct and understood, but the more colourful, informal phrase native speakers use is 'down in the dumps'.

cloze.sentence: He's been a little ____ ever since the trip got cancelled.

en_def: surprised and slightly shocked, usually in a way you did not expect
hi_def: हैरान और थोड़ा स्तब्ध, आमतौर पर ऐसे तरीक़े से जिसकी उम्मीद नहीं थी
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'I was very surprised', which is fine, but 'taken aback' specifically implies the surprise briefly threw you off balance, often in a conversation.

examples.en: I was taken aback by how blunt her feedback was.
examples.hi: उसकी टिप्पणी कितनी सीधी थी, इससे मैं हैरान रह गया।

examples.en: He was taken aback when the client rejected the proposal outright.
examples.hi: जब क्लाइंट ने सीधे तौर पर प्रस्ताव को अस्वीकार कर दिया, तो वह हैरान रह गया।

examples.en: She seemed taken aback by the sudden question.
examples.hi: अचानक पूछे गए सवाल से वह हैरान लगी।

examples.en: I was a little taken aback by his tone on the call.
examples.hi: कॉल पर उसके लहजे से मैं थोड़ा हैरान रह गया।

examples.en: We were taken aback by how quickly the situation escalated.
examples.hi: स्थिति कितनी जल्दी बिगड़ गई, इससे हम हैरान रह गए।

common_mistake.wrong: I was very surprised, did not expect this at all.
common_mistake.right: I was taken aback; I really didn't expect this.
common_mistake.why: The plain sentence works, but 'taken aback' more precisely captures being briefly thrown off balance by an unexpected reaction or event.

cloze.sentence: I was a bit ____ by how direct her feedback was.

en_def: feeling worried or uncomfortable about a situation, without being able to say exactly why
hi_def: किसी स्थिति को लेकर चिंतित या असहज महसूस करना, बिना यह ठीक-ठीक बता पाए कि क्यों
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'something feels wrong', which conveys the meaning; 'uneasy' is the precise adjective for this vague worry or discomfort about a situation.

examples.en: I felt uneasy about signing the contract so quickly.
examples.hi: इतनी जल्दी अनुबंध पर हस्ताक्षर करने को लेकर मुझे असहज महसूस हुआ।

examples.en: She was uneasy about leaving her laptop unlocked in a cafe.
examples.hi: कैफ़े में अपना लैपटॉप अनलॉक छोड़ने को लेकर वह असहज थी।

examples.en: There's an uneasy silence in the office since the layoffs.
examples.hi: छँटनी के बाद से ऑफ़िस में एक असहज ख़ामोशी है।

examples.en: He felt uneasy about the sudden change in the client's tone.
examples.hi: क्लाइंट के लहजे में अचानक आए बदलाव से वह असहज महसूस कर रहा था।

examples.en: I'm a bit uneasy about sharing my password over email.
examples.hi: ईमेल पर अपना पासवर्ड साझा करने को लेकर मैं थोड़ा असहज हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: Something feels wrong, but I cannot explain why exactly.
common_mistake.right: I feel uneasy about this, though I can't explain exactly why.
common_mistake.why: The literal sentence works, but 'uneasy' is the precise adjective English speakers reach for to describe this vague discomfort or worry.

cloze.sentence: Something about the email felt off, and I stayed ____ all day.

en_def: to become suddenly very anxious, frightened, or upset, often overreacting to a situation
hi_def: अचानक बहुत चिंतित, डरा हुआ या परेशान हो जाना, अक्सर किसी स्थिति पर अत्यधिक प्रतिक्रिया देना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'I became very tense suddenly'; the informal, natural phrasal verb for this sudden panic or overreaction is 'freak out'.

examples.en: Don't freak out, but the server just went down.
examples.hi: घबराओ मत, लेकिन सर्वर अभी बंद हो गया है।

examples.en: She freaked out when she saw the size of the error log.
examples.hi: एरर लॉग का आकार देखकर वह घबरा गई।

examples.en: He tends to freak out over small mistakes.
examples.hi: वह छोटी-छोटी ग़लतियों पर भी बहुत घबरा जाता है।

examples.en: I freaked out for a second when the screen went black.
examples.hi: जब स्क्रीन काली हो गई, तो मैं एक पल के लिए घबरा गया।

examples.en: Try not to freak out; we can fix this calmly.
examples.hi: घबराने की कोशिश मत करो; हम इसे शांति से ठीक कर सकते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I became very very tense suddenly seeing this error.
common_mistake.right: I freaked out for a second when I saw this error.
common_mistake.why: Repeating 'very' sounds heavy; the natural, informal phrasal verb for a sudden panic reaction is 'freak out'.

cloze.sentence: Don't ____ — the backup still has all the data.

en_def: the family of your husband or wife, such as their parents, brothers, and sisters
hi_def: पति या पत्नी का परिवार, जैसे उनके माता-पिता, भाई और बहन
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'my wife's family' or name each relation separately ('mother-in-law', 'brother-in-law'); English also has the umbrella word 'in-laws' for all of them together.

examples.en: We're visiting my in-laws this weekend.
examples.hi: हम इस वीकेंड अपने ससुराल वालों से मिलने जा रहे हैं।

examples.en: My in-laws are coming to stay with us for a week.
examples.hi: मेरे ससुराल वाले एक हफ़्ते के लिए हमारे साथ रहने आ रहे हैं।

examples.en: She gets along really well with her in-laws.
examples.hi: उसकी अपने ससुराल वालों से बहुत अच्छी बनती है।

examples.en: He's cooking a special meal for his in-laws tonight.
examples.hi: वह आज रात अपने ससुराल वालों के लिए ख़ास खाना बना रहा है।

examples.en: Meeting the in-laws for the first time made her nervous.
examples.hi: पहली बार ससुराल वालों से मिलना उसके लिए घबराहट भरा था।

common_mistake.wrong: My wife family is coming this weekend to our house.
common_mistake.right: My in-laws are coming this weekend.
common_mistake.why: 'Wife family' is a literal, ungrammatical translation; the correct umbrella noun for a spouse's family in English is 'in-laws'.

cloze.sentence: We're spending Diwali with my ____ this year.

en_def: the child of your aunt or uncle
hi_def: आपकी चाची, मामी, बुआ या मौसी के बच्चे यानी चचेरा, ममेरा, फुफेरा या मौसेरा भाई-बहन
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers usually say 'cousin brother' or 'cousin sister' to specify gender, but in standard English 'cousin' alone is used for both, without adding 'brother' or 'sister'.

examples.en: My cousin is visiting from Pune next week.
examples.hi: मेरा चचेरा भाई अगले हफ़्ते पुणे से आ रहा है।

examples.en: She's closer to her cousin than to her own siblings.
examples.hi: वह अपने भाई-बहनों से भी ज़्यादा अपनी चचेरी बहन के क़रीब है।

examples.en: I have three cousins on my mother's side.
examples.hi: मेरी माँ की तरफ़ से मेरे तीन चचेरे-ममेरे भाई-बहन हैं।

examples.en: My cousin and I grew up in the same neighbourhood.
examples.hi: मैं और मेरा चचेरा भाई एक ही मोहल्ले में पले-बढ़े।

examples.en: We're planning a trip with all our cousins this Diwali.
examples.hi: हम इस दिवाली सभी चचेरे-ममेरे भाई-बहनों के साथ यात्रा की योजना बना रहे हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: My cousin brother is coming from Pune next week.
common_mistake.right: My cousin is coming from Pune next week.
common_mistake.why: 'Cousin brother/sister' is common in Indian English but not standard elsewhere; in general English, 'cousin' alone covers both genders.

cloze.sentence: My ____ from Pune is staying with us for Diwali.

en_def: a brother or sister
hi_def: भाई या बहन
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'brother-sister' together to mean siblings generally; the single neutral English word covering both is 'sibling', useful when gender doesn't matter.

examples.en: Do you have any siblings, or are you an only child?
examples.hi: क्या तुम्हारे कोई भाई-बहन हैं, या तुम इकलौते हो?

examples.en: She's the eldest of four siblings.
examples.hi: वह चार भाई-बहनों में सबसे बड़ी है।

examples.en: My siblings and I video call our parents every Sunday.
examples.hi: मैं और मेरे भाई-बहन हर रविवार अपने माता-पिता को वीडियो कॉल करते हैं।

examples.en: Sibling rivalry is common between kids close in age.
examples.hi: क़रीबी उम्र के बच्चों के बीच भाई-बहनों की प्रतिस्पर्धा आम बात है।

examples.en: He shares a room with his younger sibling.
examples.hi: वह अपने छोटे भाई-बहन के साथ कमरा साझा करता है।

common_mistake.wrong: Do you have brother sister, or you are single child?
common_mistake.right: Do you have any siblings, or are you an only child?
common_mistake.why: 'Brother sister' as a combined phrase is an Indian-English construction; the standard neutral English word is 'sibling'.

cloze.sentence: Are you the only child, or do you have any ____?

en_def: the son of your brother or sister, or of your husband's or wife's brother or sister
hi_def: आपके भाई या बहन का बेटा, या आपके पति या पत्नी के भाई या बहन का बेटा
hi_nuance: Hindi has separate words for a brother's son versus a sister's son ('bhatija' vs 'bhanja'), but English uses one word, 'nephew', for both, without distinguishing the side.

examples.en: My nephew just started school this year.
examples.hi: मेरा भतीजा इस साल स्कूल जाना शुरू किया है।

examples.en: We bought a gift for our nephew's birthday.
examples.hi: हमने अपने भतीजे के जन्मदिन के लिए एक तोहफ़ा ख़रीदा।

examples.en: Her nephew is studying engineering in Bengaluru.
examples.hi: उसका भतीजा बेंगलुरु में इंजीनियरिंग पढ़ रहा है।

examples.en: I'm taking my nephew to the cricket match this weekend.
examples.hi: मैं इस वीकेंड अपने भतीजे को क्रिकेट मैच दिखाने ले जा रहा हूँ।

examples.en: My nephew looks just like his father.
examples.hi: मेरा भतीजा बिल्कुल अपने पिता जैसा दिखता है।

common_mistake.wrong: My brother's son and my sister's son I call different names.
common_mistake.right: In English, I call both my brother's son and my sister's son 'nephew'.
common_mistake.why: Hindi distinguishes 'bhatija' and 'bhanja' by side of the family; English uses a single word, 'nephew', regardless of which sibling's son it is.

cloze.sentence: My sister's son, my ____, just turned five.

en_def: the daughter of your brother or sister, or of your husband's or wife's brother or sister
hi_def: आपके भाई या बहन की बेटी, या आपके पति या पत्नी के भाई या बहन की बेटी
hi_nuance: Just as with 'nephew', Hindi separates a brother's daughter from a sister's daughter, but English uses only one word, 'niece', for both.

examples.en: My niece is getting married next month.
examples.hi: मेरी भतीजी अगले महीने शादी कर रही है।

examples.en: I love spoiling my niece with gifts whenever I visit.
examples.hi: जब भी मैं मिलने जाता हूँ, मुझे अपनी भतीजी को तोहफ़े देकर लाड़ करना बहुत पसंद है।

examples.en: Her niece just got admission into a good college.
examples.hi: उसकी भतीजी को अभी एक अच्छे कॉलेज में दाख़िला मिला है।

examples.en: We video call my niece every weekend.
examples.hi: हम हर वीकेंड अपनी भतीजी को वीडियो कॉल करते हैं।

examples.en: My niece looks exactly like her mother did at that age.
examples.hi: मेरी भतीजी बिल्कुल वैसी दिखती है जैसी उसकी माँ उस उम्र में दिखती थी।

common_mistake.wrong: My brother daughter is coming to stay with us.
common_mistake.right: My niece is coming to stay with us.
common_mistake.why: 'Brother daughter' is a literal, non-standard translation; the correct English word for this relationship is 'niece'.

cloze.sentence: My brother's daughter, my ____, is getting married next month.

en_def: the child of your son or daughter
hi_def: आपके बेटे या बेटी का बच्चा
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'grandson' or 'granddaughter' directly, which is also fine in English, but 'grandchild' is the neutral word used when gender isn't specified or doesn't matter.

examples.en: My parents love spoiling their grandchildren.
examples.hi: मेरे माता-पिता को अपने पोते-पोतियों को लाड़ करना बहुत पसंद है।

examples.en: She became a grandmother when her first grandchild was born.
examples.hi: जब उसका पहला पोता या पोती पैदा हुआ, तो वह दादी बन गई।

examples.en: Their grandchild visits them every summer holiday.
examples.hi: उनका पोता या पोती हर गर्मी की छुट्टी में उनसे मिलने आता है।

examples.en: He talks about his grandchildren all the time.
examples.hi: वह हर समय अपने पोते-पोतियों के बारे में बात करता है।

examples.en: Watching your grandchild grow up is a special feeling.
examples.hi: अपने पोते या पोती को बड़ा होते देखना एक ख़ास एहसास है।

common_mistake.wrong: They have two grandson and one granddaughter, three grand children total.
common_mistake.right: They have three grandchildren in total: two grandsons and one granddaughter.
common_mistake.why: Using 'grand children' as two words is a common spelling slip; it is written as one word, 'grandchildren', in the plural.

cloze.sentence: She dotes on her only ____, who just turned two.

en_def: a grandmother or grandfather
hi_def: दादा-दादी या नाना-नानी
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers usually name the specific relation ('dada', 'nani'); English also has this neutral umbrella term, 'grandparent', useful when talking generally about either side.

examples.en: My grandparents live with us in a joint family.
examples.hi: मेरे दादा-दादी हमारे साथ संयुक्त परिवार में रहते हैं।

examples.en: Both sets of grandparents came for the baby's naming ceremony.
examples.hi: बच्चे के नामकरण समारोह में दोनों तरफ़ के दादा-दादी और नाना-नानी आए।

examples.en: Kids these days spend less time with their grandparents.
examples.hi: आजकल के बच्चे अपने दादा-दादी के साथ कम समय बिताते हैं।

examples.en: My grandparent taught me how to play chess.
examples.hi: मेरे दादा-दादी में से एक ने मुझे शतरंज खेलना सिखाया।

examples.en: We visit our grandparents in the village every year.
examples.hi: हम हर साल अपने दादा-दादी से मिलने गाँव जाते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: My dada dadi live with us in joint family.
common_mistake.right: My grandparents live with us in a joint family.
common_mistake.why: Mixing Hindi kinship terms into an English sentence is common but not standard; the neutral English word is 'grandparents'.

cloze.sentence: Both sets of ____ came to the baby's naming ceremony.

en_def: a woman who is married to your father but is not your birth mother
hi_def: एक महिला जो आपके पिता से विवाहित है, लेकिन आपकी जन्म देने वाली माँ नहीं है
hi_nuance: Hindi has a general concept here but Indian English speakers sometimes explain it in a full sentence; English has the single compact word 'stepmother' for this relationship.

examples.en: His stepmother raised him after his mother passed away.
examples.hi: उसकी सौतेली माँ ने उसकी माँ के गुज़र जाने के बाद उसे पाला।

examples.en: She has a good relationship with her stepmother.
examples.hi: उसकी अपनी सौतेली माँ के साथ अच्छी बनती है।

examples.en: My stepmother is actually quite similar to my birth mother in personality.
examples.hi: मेरी सौतेली माँ स्वभाव में मेरी जन्म देने वाली माँ से काफ़ी मिलती-जुलती है।

examples.en: He introduced his stepmother to his colleagues at the party.
examples.hi: उसने पार्टी में अपनी सौतेली माँ को अपने सहकर्मियों से मिलवाया।

examples.en: Not every stepmother-and-child relationship is difficult.
examples.hi: हर सौतेली माँ और बच्चे का रिश्ता मुश्किल नहीं होता।

common_mistake.wrong: She is not his real mother, his father's second wife.
common_mistake.right: She's his stepmother, his father's second wife.
common_mistake.why: Explaining the relationship in a full sentence works but is wordy; English has a single compact word, 'stepmother', for this.

cloze.sentence: After his mother passed away, his ____ raised him.

en_def: a man who is married to your mother but is not your birth father
hi_def: एक पुरुष जो आपकी माँ से विवाहित है, लेकिन आपके जन्म देने वाले पिता नहीं है
hi_nuance: Just like 'stepmother', many Indian English speakers describe this relationship in full sentences; the compact standard English word is 'stepfather'.

examples.en: Her stepfather has been very supportive of her career.
examples.hi: उसके सौतेले पिता उसके करियर को लेकर बहुत सहयोगी रहे हैं।

examples.en: He calls his stepfather 'uncle' out of habit.
examples.hi: वह आदतन अपने सौतेले पिता को 'अंकल' कहकर बुलाता है।

examples.en: My stepfather taught me to ride a bicycle.
examples.hi: मेरे सौतेले पिता ने मुझे साइकिल चलाना सिखाया।

examples.en: She introduced her stepfather at the family gathering.
examples.hi: उसने पारिवारिक मिलन समारोह में अपने सौतेले पिता से सबको मिलवाया।

examples.en: Their relationship with their stepfather improved over the years.
examples.hi: सालों के साथ उनके सौतेले पिता से रिश्ते बेहतर हुए।

common_mistake.wrong: He is not my real father, my mother's second husband.
common_mistake.right: He's my stepfather, my mother's second husband.
common_mistake.why: The literal explanation works but is unnecessarily long; standard English has one word for this relationship, 'stepfather'.

cloze.sentence: Her ____ taught her to ride a bicycle when she was six.

en_def: your husband or wife
hi_def: आपके पति या पत्नी
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'my life partner' or 'husband/wife' only; 'spouse' is the neutral, formal word used on official forms and documents regardless of gender.

examples.en: Please fill in your spouse's name on the visa form.
examples.hi: कृपया वीज़ा फ़ॉर्म में अपने पति या पत्नी का नाम भरें।

examples.en: Employees can add their spouse to the health insurance policy.
examples.hi: कर्मचारी अपने पति या पत्नी को स्वास्थ्य बीमा पॉलिसी में जोड़ सकते हैं।

examples.en: Her spouse works in a different city during the week.
examples.hi: उसके पति या पत्नी हफ़्ते के दौरान एक अलग शहर में काम करते हैं।

examples.en: The company invited employees and their spouses to the annual dinner.
examples.hi: कंपनी ने कर्मचारियों और उनके पति-पत्नी को वार्षिक भोज पर आमंत्रित किया।

examples.en: You'll need your spouse's signature on this document.
examples.hi: इस दस्तावेज़ पर आपको अपने पति या पत्नी के हस्ताक्षर की ज़रूरत होगी।

common_mistake.wrong: Please write your life partner name in this government form.
common_mistake.right: Please write your spouse's name on this government form.
common_mistake.why: 'Life partner' sounds romantic and informal; official forms and documents use the neutral, formal word 'spouse' for a husband or wife.

cloze.sentence: Please enter your ____'s name in the insurance form.

en_def: having formally agreed to marry someone in the future
hi_def: भविष्य में किसी से विवाह करने के लिए औपचारिक रूप से सहमत होना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes say 'their engagement is fixed' translating directly; the natural adjective in English is simply 'they got engaged' or 'they are engaged'.

examples.en: They got engaged last month and will marry next year.
examples.hi: वे पिछले महीने सगाई कर चुके हैं और अगले साल शादी करेंगे।

examples.en: She's engaged to a colleague from her previous company.
examples.hi: उसकी सगाई अपनी पिछली कंपनी के एक सहकर्मी से हुई है।

examples.en: We're so happy to hear you're engaged!
examples.hi: हमें यह जानकर बहुत ख़ुशी हुई कि तुम्हारी सगाई हो गई है!

examples.en: They've been engaged for six months now.
examples.hi: उनकी सगाई हुए अब छह महीने हो गए हैं।

examples.en: My cousin just got engaged over the weekend.
examples.hi: मेरी चचेरी बहन की अभी वीकेंड पर सगाई हुई है।

common_mistake.wrong: Their engagement is fixed for next month.
common_mistake.right: They got engaged and are getting married next month.
common_mistake.why: 'Engagement is fixed' is a direct translation of a common Hindi phrase; natural English simply says someone 'got engaged' or 'is engaged'.

cloze.sentence: My cousin just got ____ to her college boyfriend.

en_def: a woman whose husband has died and who has not remarried
hi_def: एक महिला जिसका पति गुज़र चुका है और जिसने दोबारा विवाह नहीं किया है
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes avoid this word out of politeness and describe it indirectly; in English, 'widow' is a neutral, respectful term and is used directly and factually.

examples.en: She became a widow at a young age.
examples.hi: वह कम उम्र में ही विधवा हो गई थी।

examples.en: The widow continued running the family business alone.
examples.hi: विधवा ने अकेले ही पारिवारिक व्यवसाय चलाना जारी रखा।

examples.en: As a widow, she raised both her children by herself.
examples.hi: एक विधवा के तौर पर, उसने अपने दोनों बच्चों को अकेले पाला।

examples.en: The government provides a pension for widows.
examples.hi: सरकार विधवाओं के लिए पेंशन प्रदान करती है।

examples.en: Her grandmother has been a widow for over twenty years.
examples.hi: उसकी दादी बीस साल से ज़्यादा समय से विधवा हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: She lost her husband, now she is alone without husband.
common_mistake.right: She's a widow now; her husband passed away a few years ago.
common_mistake.why: Describing the situation indirectly out of politeness is common in Hindi; English uses the direct, neutral word 'widow' without discomfort.

cloze.sentence: Her grandmother has been a ____ for over twenty years.

en_def: a man whose wife has died and who has not remarried
hi_def: एक पुरुष जिसकी पत्नी गुज़र चुकी है और जिसने दोबारा विवाह नहीं किया है
hi_nuance: Just like 'widow', Hindi speakers may describe this indirectly; English has the direct, neutral counterpart word 'widower' for a man in this situation.

examples.en: My grandfather has been a widower since I was a child.
examples.hi: मेरे दादा तब से विधुर हैं जब मैं बच्चा था।

examples.en: He became a widower after forty years of marriage.
examples.hi: चालीस साल की शादी के बाद वह विधुर हो गया।

examples.en: As a widower, he learned to cook for the first time.
examples.hi: एक विधुर के तौर पर, उसने पहली बार खाना बनाना सीखा।

examples.en: The widower moved in with his son after retirement.
examples.hi: रिटायरमेंट के बाद विधुर अपने बेटे के साथ रहने चला गया।

examples.en: Being a widower, he relied on his daughter for support.
examples.hi: विधुर होने के नाते, वह सहारे के लिए अपनी बेटी पर निर्भर था।

common_mistake.wrong: He lost his wife, now he lives alone without wife.
common_mistake.right: He's a widower now; his wife passed away years ago.
common_mistake.why: The indirect description works but is wordy; the direct, neutral English word for this situation is 'widower'.

cloze.sentence: My grandfather became a ____ after forty years of marriage.

en_def: relatives beyond your parents and siblings, such as grandparents, uncles, aunts, and cousins
hi_def: माता-पिता और भाई-बहनों से आगे के रिश्तेदार, जैसे दादा-दादी, चाचा-चाची, मामा-मामी और चचेरे-ममेरे भाई-बहन
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers may just say 'my whole family' without distinguishing; English separates 'immediate family' (parents, siblings) from 'extended family' (everyone else related).

examples.en: Our extended family gets together every Diwali.
examples.hi: हमारा पूरा विस्तृत परिवार हर दिवाली इकट्ठा होता है।

examples.en: She's very close to her extended family, especially her aunts.
examples.hi: वह अपने विस्तृत परिवार, ख़ासकर अपनी चाचियों के, बहुत क़रीब है।

examples.en: Weddings in our culture usually involve the whole extended family.
examples.hi: हमारी संस्कृति में शादियों में आमतौर पर पूरा विस्तृत परिवार शामिल होता है।

examples.en: His extended family lives across three different states.
examples.hi: उसका विस्तृत परिवार तीन अलग-अलग राज्यों में फैला हुआ है।

examples.en: We invited our extended family to the housewarming ceremony.
examples.hi: हमने अपने विस्तृत परिवार को गृह प्रवेश समारोह में आमंत्रित किया।

common_mistake.wrong: My whole family, more than hundred people, comes for wedding.
common_mistake.right: My extended family, more than a hundred people, comes for the wedding.
common_mistake.why: Saying 'whole family' can be ambiguous about who is included; the precise English term for relatives beyond parents and siblings is 'extended family'.

cloze.sentence: Our ____ gets together for every festival, more than fifty people.

en_def: a family unit consisting of parents and their children only, living separately from other relatives
hi_def: एक परिवार इकाई जिसमें केवल माता-पिता और उनके बच्चे शामिल होते हैं, अन्य रिश्तेदारों से अलग रहते हुए
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes describe this as 'small family'; the specific English term for this arrangement, common in cities, is 'nuclear family', as opposed to a 'joint family'.

examples.en: More young couples in cities are choosing a nuclear family setup.
examples.hi: शहरों में ज़्यादा युवा जोड़े न्यूक्लियर फ़ैमिली की व्यवस्था चुन रहे हैं।

examples.en: We live as a nuclear family, just the four of us.
examples.hi: हम एक न्यूक्लियर फ़ैमिली के रूप में रहते हैं, बस हम चार लोग।

examples.en: Nuclear families are more common now than joint families.
examples.hi: आजकल न्यूक्लियर फ़ैमिली, संयुक्त परिवारों से ज़्यादा आम हैं।

examples.en: Growing up in a nuclear family, she rarely saw her cousins.
examples.hi: न्यूक्लियर फ़ैमिली में पली-बढ़ी होने की वजह से, वह अपने चचेरे भाई-बहनों को कम देख पाती थी।

examples.en: They moved out and started their own nuclear family after marriage.
examples.hi: शादी के बाद वे अलग हो गए और अपना ख़ुद का न्यूक्लियर फ़ैमिली शुरू किया।

common_mistake.wrong: We have small family, only me, wife and children.
common_mistake.right: We live as a nuclear family — just me, my wife, and our children.
common_mistake.why: 'Small family' is understandable but generic; the precise sociological term used in English is 'nuclear family'.

cloze.sentence: Unlike her parents' joint household, she lives in a ____ of just four.

en_def: a family structure in which several generations, including parents, children, grandparents, and sometimes uncles and aunts, live together in one household
hi_def: एक पारिवारिक ढाँचा जिसमें दादा-दादी, माता-पिता, बच्चे और कभी-कभी चाचा-चाची सहित कई पीढ़ियाँ एक ही घर में साथ रहती हैं
hi_nuance: This is a familiar Hindi concept and the English term 'joint family' is widely understood in Indian English, though it is less common outside South Asia, where 'extended family living together' would be used.

examples.en: I grew up in a joint family with my grandparents and uncles.
examples.hi: मैं अपने दादा-दादी और चाचाओं के साथ एक संयुक्त परिवार में पला-बढ़ा।

examples.en: Joint families are still common in smaller towns.
examples.hi: छोटे शहरों में संयुक्त परिवार अब भी आम हैं।

examples.en: Living in a joint family means less privacy but more support.
examples.hi: संयुक्त परिवार में रहने का मतलब है कम निजता, लेकिन ज़्यादा सहारा।

examples.en: Our joint family shares one big kitchen and dining area.
examples.hi: हमारा संयुक्त परिवार एक बड़ी रसोई और भोजन क्षेत्र साझा करता है।

examples.en: She misses the noise and warmth of her joint family after moving out.
examples.hi: घर से बाहर जाने के बाद उसे अपने संयुक्त परिवार का शोर और अपनापन याद आता है।

collocations: grow up in a joint family

common_mistake.wrong: We all relatives live together in same big house.
common_mistake.right: We live together as a joint family in one big house.
common_mistake.why: The descriptive sentence works but is loose; the precise, widely recognised term in Indian English is 'joint family'.

cloze.sentence: She grew up in a ____ with three generations under one roof.

en_def: a relative who is not closely related to you, such as a second cousin or a relative you rarely meet
hi_def: एक ऐसा रिश्तेदार जो आपसे क़रीबी संबंध में नहीं है, जैसे दूसरा चचेरा भाई-बहन या ऐसा रिश्तेदार जिससे आप कम मिलते हैं
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'far relative', which is understood but not standard; the correct English adjective for this weaker family connection is 'distant', as in 'distant relative'.

examples.en: He's actually a distant relative on my mother's side.
examples.hi: वह असल में मेरी माँ की तरफ़ से एक दूर का रिश्तेदार है।

examples.en: A distant relative recommended this job to me.
examples.hi: एक दूर के रिश्तेदार ने मुझे यह नौकरी सुझाई थी।

examples.en: I only meet my distant relatives at weddings.
examples.hi: मैं अपने दूर के रिश्तेदारों से केवल शादियों में मिलता हूँ।

examples.en: She turned out to be a distant relative of my neighbour.
examples.hi: पता चला कि वह मेरे पड़ोसी की एक दूर की रिश्तेदार है।

examples.en: We reconnected with a distant relative through social media.
examples.hi: हम सोशल मीडिया के ज़रिए एक दूर के रिश्तेदार से दोबारा जुड़े।

common_mistake.wrong: He is far relative from my mother side.
common_mistake.right: He's a distant relative on my mother's side.
common_mistake.why: 'Far relative' is a literal, non-standard phrasing; the correct English adjective for a weakly connected relative is 'distant'.

cloze.sentence: It turned out the landlord was actually a ____ of ours.

en_def: no longer close to or in contact with a family member, usually because of a serious disagreement
hi_def: किसी पारिवारिक सदस्य से अब क़रीबी या संपर्क में न होना, आमतौर पर किसी गंभीर मतभेद की वजह से
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'we don't talk anymore' plainly; 'estranged' is a more formal, precise adjective used specifically for a broken family relationship.

examples.en: He's been estranged from his father for over ten years.
examples.hi: वह अपने पिता से दस साल से ज़्यादा समय से अलग-थलग है।

examples.en: She reconnected with her estranged sister after many years.
examples.hi: उसने कई सालों बाद अपनी अलग हुई बहन से दोबारा संपर्क किया।

examples.en: Their family became estranged after a property dispute.
examples.hi: संपत्ति विवाद के बाद उनका परिवार बिखर गया।

examples.en: He rarely talks about his estranged brother.
examples.hi: वह अपने अलग हुए भाई के बारे में कम ही बात करता है।

examples.en: Being estranged from your family can be very isolating.
examples.hi: अपने परिवार से अलग-थलग होना बहुत अकेलापन देने वाला हो सकता है।

common_mistake.wrong: We don't talk anymore since many years, big fight happened.
common_mistake.right: We've been estranged for years, ever since a big argument.
common_mistake.why: The plain description works but is casual; the more precise English adjective for a broken family relationship is 'estranged'.

cloze.sentence: He'd been ____ from his brother for a decade before they finally spoke again.

en_def: to show great and constant love and attention towards someone, especially a child or grandchild
hi_def: किसी पर, ख़ासकर बच्चे या पोते-पोती पर, बहुत अधिक और लगातार प्यार व ध्यान दिखाना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'he loves him too much', which is fine but plain; 'dote on' specifically describes doting, indulgent affection, often from grandparents towards grandchildren.

examples.en: My grandmother dotes on her youngest grandchild.
examples.hi: मेरी दादी अपने सबसे छोटे पोते या पोती पर बहुत लाड़ करती हैं।

examples.en: He dotes on his daughter and gives her everything she wants.
examples.hi: वह अपनी बेटी पर बहुत लाड़ करता है और उसे हर चीज़ देता है जो वह चाहती है।

examples.en: They dote on their only child, sometimes a little too much.
examples.hi: वे अपने इकलौते बच्चे पर बहुत लाड़ करते हैं, कभी-कभी थोड़ा ज़्यादा ही।

examples.en: Grandparents often dote on their grandchildren more than parents do.
examples.hi: दादा-दादी अक्सर अपने पोते-पोतियों पर माता-पिता से भी ज़्यादा लाड़ करते हैं।

examples.en: She dotes on her nephew as if he were her own son.
examples.hi: वह अपने भतीजे पर ऐसे लाड़ करती है जैसे वह उसका ख़ुद का बेटा हो।

common_mistake.wrong: He loves his daughter too much and gives her everything.
common_mistake.right: He dotes on his daughter and gives her everything.
common_mistake.why: The plain sentence is fine, but the precise English phrasal verb for this indulgent, constant affection is 'dote on'.

cloze.sentence: Her grandparents completely ____ their only grandchild.

en_def: to resemble an older relative in appearance, character, or behaviour
hi_def: किसी बड़े रिश्तेदार से रूप-रंग, स्वभाव या व्यवहार में मिलता-जुलता होना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'he is like his father', which is fine, but the specific English phrasal verb for this family resemblance is 'take after', usually used for parents or grandparents.

examples.en: She takes after her mother in almost every way.
examples.hi: वह लगभग हर तरह से अपनी माँ जैसी है।

examples.en: My son takes after his grandfather; he loves reading too.
examples.hi: मेरा बेटा अपने दादा जैसा है; उसे भी पढ़ना बहुत पसंद है।

examples.en: He definitely takes after his father's short temper.
examples.hi: वह निश्चित रूप से अपने पिता के तेज़ स्वभाव पर गया है।

examples.en: Everyone says she takes after her grandmother's cooking skills.
examples.hi: सब कहते हैं कि उसकी खाना पकाने की कला अपनी दादी जैसी है।

examples.en: Does your daughter take after you or your husband more?
examples.hi: क्या तुम्हारी बेटी तुमसे ज़्यादा मिलती है या तुम्हारे पति से?

common_mistake.wrong: She is exactly like her mother in nature and looks.
common_mistake.right: She takes after her mother in nature and looks.
common_mistake.why: The literal description is fine, but the natural English phrasal verb for family resemblance is 'take after'.

cloze.sentence: Everyone says my son ____ his grandfather — same love of books.

en_def: to have a friendly, easy relationship with someone
hi_def: किसी के साथ दोस्ताना और सहज संबंध होना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'my bonding is good with him', which is unusual English; the natural phrase for a friendly relationship is 'I get along well with him'.

examples.en: I get along really well with my in-laws.
examples.hi: मेरी अपने ससुराल वालों से बहुत अच्छी बनती है।

examples.en: She doesn't get along with her stepbrother.
examples.hi: उसकी अपने सौतेले भाई से नहीं बनती है।

examples.en: My cousin and I have always gotten along well.
examples.hi: मेरी और मेरे चचेरे भाई की हमेशा से अच्छी बनी है।

examples.en: It took time, but they finally get along now.
examples.hi: समय लगा, लेकिन अब आख़िरकार उनकी बनने लगी है।

examples.en: Do you get along with your new colleagues?
examples.hi: क्या तुम्हारी अपने नए सहकर्मियों के साथ अच्छी बनती है?

common_mistake.wrong: My bonding is very good with my brother-in-law.
common_mistake.right: I get along really well with my brother-in-law.
common_mistake.why: 'Bonding is good' is a common Indian-English expression; the natural phrase for a friendly relationship in general English is 'get along well with'.

cloze.sentence: I ____ my sister-in-law; we talk almost every day.

en_def: a friend you have known since you were a child
hi_def: एक दोस्त जिसे आप बचपन से जानते हैं
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'my friend from childhood', which is understandable, but the more natural compound noun placed before the word is 'childhood friend'.

examples.en: She's my childhood friend; we've known each other for twenty years.
examples.hi: वह मेरी बचपन की दोस्त है; हम एक-दूसरे को बीस साल से जानते हैं।

examples.en: I met an old childhood friend at the reunion.
examples.hi: मैं पुनर्मिलन समारोह में एक पुराने बचपन के दोस्त से मिला।

examples.en: My childhood friend now lives abroad.
examples.hi: मेरा बचपन का दोस्त अब विदेश में रहता है।

examples.en: We're still close, even though he's just a childhood friend now.
examples.hi: हम अब भी क़रीब हैं, भले ही अब वह सिर्फ़ एक बचपन का दोस्त हो।

examples.en: Losing touch with childhood friends is common after moving cities.
examples.hi: शहर बदलने के बाद बचपन के दोस्तों से संपर्क टूटना आम बात है।

common_mistake.wrong: He is my friend from childhood time, since many years.
common_mistake.right: He's my childhood friend; we've known each other for years.
common_mistake.why: The longer description works but is wordy; the standard compact English phrase is 'childhood friend'.

cloze.sentence: I bumped into a ____ I hadn't seen in fifteen years.

en_def: a gathering where members of an extended family, often from different places, come together after a period apart
hi_def: एक ऐसा समारोह जहाँ विस्तृत परिवार के सदस्य, अक्सर अलग-अलग जगहों से, कुछ समय के अलगाव के बाद फिर से इकट्ठा होते हैं
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often just say 'family function' generally; 'family reunion' specifically means relatives who live apart coming together again, not just any family event.

examples.en: We're planning a big family reunion this Diwali.
examples.hi: हम इस दिवाली एक बड़े पारिवारिक पुनर्मिलन की योजना बना रहे हैं।

examples.en: The family reunion brought together relatives from four different cities.
examples.hi: पारिवारिक पुनर्मिलन में चार अलग-अलग शहरों से रिश्तेदार इकट्ठा हुए।

examples.en: It's been years since our last family reunion.
examples.hi: हमारे आख़िरी पारिवारिक पुनर्मिलन को सालों हो गए हैं।

examples.en: Everyone shared old photos at the family reunion.
examples.hi: पारिवारिक पुनर्मिलन में सबने पुरानी तस्वीरें साझा कीं।

examples.en: My grandmother's ninetieth birthday turned into a huge family reunion.
examples.hi: मेरी दादी का नब्बेवाँ जन्मदिन एक बड़े पारिवारिक पुनर्मिलन में बदल गया।

common_mistake.wrong: We are having family function, all relatives will come.
common_mistake.right: We're planning a family reunion, and all our relatives will come.
common_mistake.why: 'Family function' can mean any celebration; the precise English term for relatives coming together after time apart is 'family reunion'.

cloze.sentence: Cousins from three countries flew in for the ____.

en_def: the man a woman is engaged to marry
hi_def: वह पुरुष जिससे किसी महिला की सगाई हुई हो और जिससे वह विवाह करने वाली है
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often just say 'my would-be husband' or 'my to-be husband'; the standard English word for a male partner one is engaged to is 'fiancé', borrowed from French.

examples.en: She introduced her fiancé to the whole family last weekend.
examples.hi: उसने पिछले वीकेंड अपने मंगेतर को पूरे परिवार से मिलवाया।

examples.en: My fiancé works as a software engineer in Pune.
examples.hi: मेरा मंगेतर पुणे में सॉफ़्टवेयर इंजीनियर के तौर पर काम करता है।

examples.en: Her fiancé proposed to her on a trip to Goa.
examples.hi: उसके मंगेतर ने गोवा की यात्रा के दौरान उससे शादी का प्रस्ताव रखा।

examples.en: We're meeting my fiancé's parents next month.
examples.hi: हम अगले महीने अपने मंगेतर के माता-पिता से मिल रहे हैं।

examples.en: She and her fiancé are planning a small wedding.
examples.hi: वह और उसका मंगेतर एक छोटी शादी की योजना बना रहे हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: This is my would-be husband, we are engaged.
common_mistake.right: This is my fiancé; we're engaged.
common_mistake.why: 'Would-be husband' is understandable but not the standard word; the correct English term for a man one is engaged to is 'fiancé'.

cloze.sentence: She proudly introduced her ____ to all her college friends.

en_def: the woman a man is engaged to marry
hi_def: वह महिला जिससे किसी पुरुष की सगाई हुई हो और जिससे वह विवाह करने वाला है
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'my would-be wife' or 'my to-be wife'; the standard English word for a female partner one is engaged to is 'fiancée', spelled with a double 'e' at the end.

examples.en: He introduced his fiancée to his colleagues at the office party.
examples.hi: उसने ऑफ़िस पार्टी में अपने सहकर्मियों से अपनी मंगेतर से मिलवाया।

examples.en: My fiancée is a doctor working at a hospital in Chennai.
examples.hi: मेरी मंगेतर चेन्नई के एक अस्पताल में डॉक्टर के तौर पर काम करती है।

examples.en: His fiancée is flying in from Delhi for the ceremony.
examples.hi: उसकी मंगेतर समारोह के लिए दिल्ली से आ रही है।

examples.en: We're organising an engagement party for him and his fiancée.
examples.hi: हम उसके और उसकी मंगेतर के लिए एक सगाई की पार्टी आयोजित कर रहे हैं।

examples.en: He proposed to his fiancée in front of both families.
examples.hi: उसने दोनों परिवारों के सामने अपनी मंगेतर को शादी का प्रस्ताव दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: This is my would-be wife, marriage is fixed.
common_mistake.right: This is my fiancée; we're engaged.
common_mistake.why: 'Marriage is fixed' is a common Indian-English phrase, and 'would-be wife' is understandable, but the standard English word is 'fiancée'.

cloze.sentence: He couldn't stop smiling as he introduced his ____ to the team.

en_def: a short period of sleep, especially during the day
hi_def: एक छोटी नींद, ख़ासकर दिन के समय
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'I will sleep for some time' for a short daytime rest; the specific English word for this short sleep is 'nap', as in 'take a nap'.

examples.en: I usually take a short nap after lunch on weekends.
examples.hi: मैं आमतौर पर वीकेंड पर लंच के बाद एक छोटी झपकी लेता हूँ।

examples.en: The baby is taking her afternoon nap right now.
examples.hi: बच्ची इस समय अपनी दोपहर की झपकी ले रही है।

examples.en: A quick nap helped me feel more focused for the call.
examples.hi: एक छोटी झपकी ने मुझे कॉल के लिए ज़्यादा एकाग्र महसूस करने में मदद की।

examples.en: He dozed off into a nap on the couch while watching TV.
examples.hi: टीवी देखते-देखते वह सोफ़े पर झपकी लेने लगा।

examples.en: Don't nap too long, or you won't sleep well tonight.
examples.hi: ज़्यादा देर झपकी मत लो, वरना आज रात तुम्हें ठीक से नींद नहीं आएगी।

common_mistake.wrong: I will sleep small small time after lunch.
common_mistake.right: I'll take a short nap after lunch.
common_mistake.why: Reduplicating 'small' is a Hindi-influenced pattern; the natural English word for a brief daytime sleep is 'nap'.

cloze.sentence: The baby usually takes a two-hour ____ in the afternoon.

en_def: to remove hair from the face or another part of the body using a razor
hi_def: रेज़र की मदद से चेहरे या शरीर के किसी और हिस्से से बाल हटाना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes say 'I will make my beard' or 'cut my beard', which is odd; the correct verb for removing facial hair with a razor is simply 'shave'.

examples.en: I need to shave before the client meeting.
examples.hi: क्लाइंट मीटिंग से पहले मुझे शेव करने की ज़रूरत है।

examples.en: He shaves every morning before going to work.
examples.hi: वह काम पर जाने से पहले हर सुबह शेव करता है।

examples.en: She shaved her legs before the wedding.
examples.hi: उसने शादी से पहले अपने पैरों के बाल हटाए।

examples.en: I forgot to shave, so I look a bit scruffy today.
examples.hi: मैं शेव करना भूल गया, इसलिए आज थोड़ा बिखरा-बिखरा लग रहा हूँ।

examples.en: Some men prefer to shave with an electric razor.
examples.hi: कुछ पुरुष इलेक्ट्रिक रेज़र से शेव करना पसंद करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I forgot to cut my beard today, sorry for the look.
common_mistake.right: I forgot to shave today, sorry for the look.
common_mistake.why: 'Cut my beard' can wrongly suggest trimming with scissors; the standard verb for removing facial hair with a razor is 'shave'.

cloze.sentence: I overslept and didn't even have time to ____ this morning.

en_def: the regular journey you make between your home and your workplace
hi_def: घर और कार्यस्थल के बीच नियमित रूप से की जाने वाली यात्रा
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'my travel to office' or 'my daily up-down', a regional phrase; the standard English noun for this daily journey is 'commute', also used as a verb, 'to commute'.

examples.en: My commute to the office takes almost an hour each way.
examples.hi: ऑफ़िस तक मेरी यात्रा हर तरफ़ लगभग एक घंटे की होती है।

examples.en: She commutes by metro every day to avoid traffic.
examples.hi: वह ट्रैफ़िक से बचने के लिए हर दिन मेट्रो से आती-जाती है।

examples.en: A shorter commute would give me more time at home.
examples.hi: एक छोटी यात्रा से मुझे घर पर ज़्यादा समय मिलेगा।

examples.en: His daily commute is one of the reasons he wants to work from home.
examples.hi: उसकी रोज़ की आवाजाही उन कारणों में से एक है जिनकी वजह से वह घर से काम करना चाहता है।

examples.en: The commute gets much worse during the monsoon.
examples.hi: मानसून के दौरान यह रोज़ की यात्रा और भी बदतर हो जाती है।

common_mistake.wrong: My daily up-down to office takes one hour.
common_mistake.right: My daily commute to the office takes an hour.
common_mistake.why: 'Up-down' is a regional Indian-English term for a round trip; the standard English word for a regular journey to work is 'commute'.

cloze.sentence: With the new metro line, my ____ has dropped to twenty minutes.

en_def: to fall asleep unintentionally, usually for a short time and often while you're supposed to be doing something else
hi_def: अनजाने में सो जाना, आमतौर पर थोड़ी देर के लिए और अक्सर तब जब कुछ और करना चाहिए हो
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'sleep came suddenly'; the natural phrasal verb for briefly, unintentionally falling asleep is 'doze off', often used for meetings, lectures, or long journeys.

examples.en: I dozed off during the second half of the meeting.
examples.hi: मीटिंग के दूसरे हिस्से के दौरान मुझे अनजाने में नींद आ गई।

examples.en: He dozed off on the train and missed his stop.
examples.hi: वह ट्रेन में झपकी लेने लगा और उसका स्टेशन छूट गया।

examples.en: She dozed off in front of the TV again last night.
examples.hi: वह पिछली रात फिर टीवी के सामने झपकी लेने लगी।

examples.en: Try not to doze off during the safety briefing.
examples.hi: सुरक्षा ब्रीफ़िंग के दौरान झपकी लेने से बचने की कोशिश करो।

examples.en: I nearly dozed off while reading that long report.
examples.hi: वह लंबी रिपोर्ट पढ़ते-पढ़ते मुझे लगभग झपकी आने लगी थी।

common_mistake.wrong: Sleep came suddenly to me during the lecture.
common_mistake.right: I dozed off during the lecture.
common_mistake.why: The literal translation is understandable but unusual; the natural phrasal verb for briefly, unintentionally falling asleep is 'doze off'.

cloze.sentence: He kept ____ during the safety briefing after his night shift.

en_def: to sleep longer than you intended, often causing you to be late
hi_def: जितना इरादा था उससे ज़्यादा देर तक सोना, अक्सर देर होने का कारण बनते हुए
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes say 'my sleep broke late', translating loosely; the correct single verb for sleeping past your intended wake-up time is 'oversleep'.

examples.en: I overslept and missed my morning stand-up.
examples.hi: मुझसे ज़्यादा देर तक सोया गया और मेरा सुबह का स्टैंड-अप छूट गया।

examples.en: She overslept because her alarm didn't go off.
examples.hi: वह ज़्यादा देर तक सोई क्योंकि उसका अलार्म नहीं बजा।

examples.en: If you oversleep tomorrow, we'll miss the flight.
examples.hi: अगर तुम कल ज़्यादा देर तक सोए, तो हमारी फ़्लाइट छूट जाएगी।

examples.en: I set three alarms so I don't oversleep.
examples.hi: मैंने तीन अलार्म लगाए हैं ताकि मैं ज़्यादा देर तक न सोऊँ।

examples.en: He overslept after working late into the night.
examples.hi: देर रात तक काम करने के बाद वह ज़्यादा देर तक सो गया।

common_mistake.wrong: My sleep broke very late today, sorry I am late.
common_mistake.right: I overslept today, sorry I'm late.
common_mistake.why: The literal phrase 'my sleep broke late' is a Hindi translation; the correct English verb for sleeping past your intended time is 'oversleep'.

cloze.sentence: I forgot to set my alarm and completely ____.

en_def: to extend your arms, legs, or body to make your muscles longer, often to relieve stiffness
hi_def: मांसपेशियों को लंबा करने के लिए हाथों, पैरों या शरीर को फैलाना, अक्सर अकड़न दूर करने के लिए
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers might just say 'I did some exercise'; when specifically extending the body to relax muscles, the correct verb is 'stretch', distinct from general exercise.

examples.en: I always stretch for a few minutes before sitting at my desk.
examples.hi: मैं डेस्क पर बैठने से पहले हमेशा कुछ मिनट स्ट्रेच करता हूँ।

examples.en: She stretched her arms after sitting for hours at the computer.
examples.hi: कंप्यूटर पर घंटों बैठने के बाद उसने अपने हाथ फैलाकर स्ट्रेच किया।

examples.en: Stretching your back can help with stiffness after a long flight.
examples.hi: लंबी फ़्लाइट के बाद पीठ को स्ट्रेच करना अकड़न में मदद कर सकता है।

examples.en: He stretched and yawned as soon as he woke up.
examples.hi: उठते ही उसने स्ट्रेच किया और जम्हाई ली।

examples.en: Try to stretch every hour if you sit at a desk all day.
examples.hi: अगर तुम पूरे दिन डेस्क पर बैठे रहते हो, तो हर घंटे स्ट्रेच करने की कोशिश करो।

common_mistake.wrong: I did little exercise before sitting at desk.
common_mistake.right: I stretched a little before sitting at my desk.
common_mistake.why: 'Did little exercise' is vague; the specific verb for extending your muscles to relieve stiffness is 'stretch'.

cloze.sentence: Remember to ____ your legs after sitting through that long flight.

en_def: to open your mouth wide and breathe in deeply, usually because you are tired or bored
hi_def: मुँह को चौड़ा खोलकर गहरी साँस लेना, आमतौर पर थकान या बोरियत की वजह से
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers correctly know this concept ('jamhai lena'), and 'yawn' is the direct English equivalent, though some learners mispronounce it as 'yawn' rhyming with 'own' instead of the correct /jɔːn/.

examples.en: He yawned loudly during the long meeting.
examples.hi: उसने लंबी मीटिंग के दौरान ज़ोर से जम्हाई ली।

examples.en: I couldn't stop yawning after staying up late.
examples.hi: देर तक जागने के बाद मैं जम्हाई लेना बंद नहीं कर पा रहा था।

examples.en: She yawned and rubbed her eyes before the early call.
examples.hi: जल्दी की कॉल से पहले उसने जम्हाई ली और अपनी आँखें मलीं।
